notes.title: Play Release 95 Now! Pet Equipment! Platform & Trap Decorations!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7181173/b2c362b4741e5050f1030859961d392df46db810.jpg[/img]

[b]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/b]

The Catnip Games development team now brings the players of Shroud of the Avatar another round of new content and improvements. For Release 95 (R95), players will experience a very LARGE variety of changes to the game. Pet equipment has arrived! The first 6 gear items and 6 subcomponents are now available to create at your crafting stations!

A new decoration concept called “platforms” allows players to place decorations on uneven terrain! Lava Pools are the first line of traps that actually damage players, which can be utilized for concepts like PvP arenas or lava fishing endeavors! 

The Conversationalist system has been greatly expanded with new functions! The Lua system has been greatly expanded with new functions! SO many changes, so what are you waiting for? notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7181173/83e31f2690c8703ec9f87d9562957c31f8b78865.jpg[/img]

[b]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/b]

To herald in 2021, the first release of the new year brings players of [i]Shroud of the Avatar[/i] a robust offering of wonderful new content items, decorations, and other game updates. A new adventure scene has been been added, an extensive revamp of how gear patterns function is now live, a new decoration type that buffs players with magical attunement is now available, dragon eggs now drop as loot which can be crafted into Baby Dragon Conversationalists, and Public Cache Chests have received additional variations! notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2019/10/r71stream.jpg[/img]

The Release 71 Livestream is set for Friday, November 8, at 3 PM Central Time on twitch.tv/shroudoftheavatar! All Avatars from around the world are welcome to join us in the livestream activities. We will be touring Tartarus and Despair dungeons, having a Lava Fishing Contest, answering questions, and handing out prizes.

Livestream Schedule (Central Time Zone)

[list]
[*] 3 PM: Introductions
[*] 3:30 PM: Scenes Tour: Tartarus (new content), Despair (polish)
[*] 4:15 PM: Lava Fishing Contest
[*] 5 PM: Ending Announcements
[/list]

To participate in the Lava Fishing Contest go to Oracle Colossus and start fishing at 4:15 PM (you can also try whispering one of the devs for a teleport). The best trophy fish (longest) caught by 5 PM will win a prize! NOTE: We will be verifying location and time!

notes.title: Release 60 Patch Notes: November 21, 2018
notes.content:
[b]November 21, 2018[/b]

[b]Build Number 877 11:30 AM[/b]

[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Elemental and magic resist potions can now be added to combat bar.[/*]
 	[*]Fix "Poison potion" reduced reagent use from subterfuge specialization.[/*]
 	[*]Fix issue with Death Shield duration with Specialization.[/*]
 	[*]Fix Cash register player vendor nameplates.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue where Magic Cancellation Field would incorrectly calculate attunement.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue with resource node highlighting for survey skill.[/*]
 	[*]Northwest Blackblade Mountains - put Darkstarr corpions back in.[/*]
 	[*]Fix bug that prevented picking up items via drag-and-drop in some cases.[/*]
 	[*]Solace Bridge: fix issues with water.[/*]
 	[*]Battle of Highvale: Updated some combat-related tutorial text to be skillset-agnostic.[/*]
 	[*]Battle of Solace Bridge: Updated some combat-related tutorial text to be skillset-agnostic.[/*]
 	[*]Brittany Fields - adjusted LOD settings on a bridge.[/*]
 	[*]Ardoris: Emma the barmaid now has a response for "love."[/*]
 	[*]Red Stone Dungeon - deleted erroneous geometry.[/*]
 	[*]Fixes for various Unity warnings caused by switch to Unity 2018.2.[/*]
 	[*]Sunless Barrens - extended water trigger to encompass entire seaside.[/*]
 	[*]Aerie: The "Open Arms" now uses weapon shop decorations (instead of blacksmith decorations). Henry Steel's occupation is "weaponsmith" (instead of "blacksmith") but his inventory remains the same.[/*]
 	[*]Solace Bridge: The quest from Emily in Soltown to find evidence of Quincy's fate can now be continued in both the Battle of Solace Bridge ("before") and Solace Bridge ("after") versions of the scene.[/*]
 	[*]Matchmaking and multiplayer mode switching improvements[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Crashes may occur when running the game in MacOS Mojave. A workaround is to launch the game with -force-glcore (which can be added to the Launch Arguments box in the launcher options)[/*]
 	[*]Elysian Illumination no longer damages undead, and has a broken range for applying heals.[/*]
 	[*]Party/Companion nameplates can be visually obscured if enough buffs are added for icons to wrap to three rows.[/*]
 	[*]Visual quest indicators may be missing from compass. Adding the data to support them is an ongoing design process.[/*]
 	[*]Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.[/*]
 	[*]If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.[/*]
 	[*]Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.[/*]
 	[*]Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns cannot be placed on docks.[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
 	[*]Some virus programs with outdated libraries may attempt to quarantine essential game files, mistakenly identifying them as threats. This can have significant effects, including the client not starting at all. We recommend keeping antivirus programs updated frequently as they address problems. Workarounds include reinstalling and launching the client with the aggressive antivirus software disabled, or whitelisting the game directory in the antivirus list of exceptions.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Q4 2018 Schedule Update
notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2018/09/Q42018Update.jpg[/img]
 
Greetings Avatars,

As 2018 comes to a close we can reflect on what an amazing year it has been! We moved out of Early Access in March and Collector’s Boxes shipped in Q3! As we have finished our Kickstarter promises we have been able to focus on polish and serious improvements to quality of life! The final quarter of 2018 is going to be amazing with Player Made Dungeons, Fishing Phase 2, Seasonal Content, and more polish!

PLEASE NOTE: The last two releases of the year (Nov/R60 and Dec/R61) will be very early in their respective months so that they are released well ahead of the US winter holidays (Thanksgiving and Christmas).

Q4 is just a warmup for 2019 which will be an amazing year for Shroud of the Avatar players! Crafting specializations (choose your effects!), Grandmaster Craftsman only effects, more loot improvements, more expansions to the fishing system, better boss fights and more! 2019 will of course culminate with Episode 2 which will have a new story, new lands, a revamp of the Quest and Journal system, a Theater System, Treasure Hunting with treasure maps that show up as loot, Item Affinity, Taming system expansions, Customizable NPCs, and expanded permissions for containers and doors!

Here are some Q4 Highlights:
 
[b]RELEASE 59, October 25, 2018:[/b] Each harvest season, Novians warn their children to not go into the fields at night because of Pumpkin Head! The starting areas will be improved with the addition of a new tutorial focused area on the Isle of Storms.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2018/09/pumpkinhead.jpg[/img]

[b]RELEASE 60, November 15, 2018:[/b] We will continue expansions to the fishing system. We will also dramatically increase the salvage rates for in-game patterns (common patterns will be almost 100%). Additionally we will continue systemic and game-wide upgrades to the quality and quantity of loot.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2018/09/LavaRod.jpg[/img]

[b]RELEASE 61, December 13, 2018:[/b] Have you been naughty or nice? The Krampus doesn’t care! He and his captured minions will eat you either way! Also back slot items (cloaks, wings, backpacks, etc.) will now be able to have stats, enchantments, and masterworks associated with them. 
 
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2018/09/ornatebackpack.jpg[/img]
 
and much, much more!
 
For all the details, please read the entire [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=99547]Q4 2018 Schedule Update[/url] post!
 
Have fun exploring New Britannia!

notes.title: Release 55 Patch Notes: July 2, 2018
notes.content:
[b]July 2, 2018[/b]

[b]Build Number 800 11:00AM[/b]

[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Aerie overworld entrances are now named correctly.[/*]
 	[*]All glowing portal teleporters in Halls of Artifice should now function properly.[/*]
 	[*]You can now unlock the option to spawn into Highvale at the north archway entrance.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed party member health/focus bars.[/*]
 	[*]Players who wish to turn in their Ecology Survey to Eretria Moonglow in Aerie may now do so.[/*]
 	[*]Zombie female no longer T-poses from the waist up.[/*]
 	[*]Moved teleporter target in The Obsidian Trial to not have camera clip into rocks.[/*]
 	[*]Made an improvement to Vivienne's "Bank Key" quest in Aerie to help ensure tasks clear properly.[/*]
 	[*]Royal Gardener Title was added.[/*]
 	[*]Moved treasure chest in Desert Encounter so lid doesn't clip into cliff.[/*]
 	[*]Deleted floating plant in Norgard Fens.[/*]
 	[*]Updated Umberjack's conversation in Broochash to improve responses when turning in a task.[/*]
 	[*]Corrected rock Collison in East Vauban Foothills to avoid people floating on rocks.[/*]
 	[*]Added Obsidian Boar Meat recipe to Butchery merchants.[/*]
 	[*]Replaced unreachable bedrolls in Norgard Fens with furs.[/*]
 	[*]Elven mages can again be looted.[/*]
 	[*]Cloth simulation updated for cloaks.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue where the Reflection Quality value was not getting saved properly.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue with new pet foals not being able to be dismissed[/*]
 	[*]Adding variations to tree chopping audio.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]The client may default to full screen when the options menu is first used.[/*]
 	[*]Linux clients may experience certain types of trees being rendered incorrectly[/*]
 	[*]Elysian Illumination no longer damages undead, and has a broken range for applying heals.[/*]
 	[*]The in-game map (M key shortcut) cannot be accessed on Linux clients.[/*]
 	[*]Linux is using an older version of Unity until known performance issues can be addressed.[/*]
 	[*]There are ongoing issues with being able to target, heal, and flag in parties of mixed PVP-flagging.[/*]
 	[*]Party/Companion nameplates can be visually obscured if enough buffs are added for icons to wrap to three rows.[/*]
 	[*]Visual quest indicators may be missing from compass. Adding the data to support them is an ongoing design process.[/*]
 	[*]Dazzling Rays, and other caster-based AOE spells, have difficulty hitting nearby enemies in confined spaces (like narrow hallways)[/*]
 	[*]Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.[/*]
 	[*]If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.[/*]
 	[*]Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.[/*]
 	[*]Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
 	[*]Some virus programs with outdated libraries may attempt to quarantine essential game files, mistakenly identifying them as threats. This can have significant effects, including the client not starting at all. We recommend keeping antivirus programs updated frequently as they address problems. Workarounds include reinstalling and launching the client with the aggressive antivirus software disabled, or whitelisting the game directory in the antivirus list of exceptions.[/*]
[/list]

[b]June 29, 2018[/b]

[b]Build Number 799 9:00PM[/b]

[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Tree chopping sound now plays on every hit.[/*]
 	[*]Added more chances for elf spellcasters to randomly spawn in Verdantis Mines.[/*]
 	[*]Server logging updates.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a bug that caused players to be naked and missing inventory after leaving Isle of Storms the first time.[/*]
 	[*]Clan of the Stag chest armor no longer incorrectly changes skin color.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed icon for Luminous Atavist Robe.[/*]
 	[*]The quest to deliver Kinsey’s report to Stanley in Soltown has been fixed.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed chest mimics in Dragonbone Crypt.[/*]
 	[*]Updated cursed skeletons in Soltown Catacombs to spawn dynamically.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a typo in the Skeleton Prince's dialogue in Soltown Catacombs.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Corpse Explosion not hitting any targets.[/*]
 	[*]Crag Foothills and Port Phoenix no longer get stuck on loading.[/*]
 	[*]Corrected date formatting used for the date column in vendor listings.[/*]
 	[*]Frame rate performance updates in Blood River Outskirts.[/*]
 	[*]Ignite Weapon VFX is now much less extreme while running.[/*]
 	[*]Updated the exit to Blood Bayin K'rul.[/*]
 	[*]Improved the ability for NPCs in Hills Encounter to climb on top of climbable rocks.[/*]
 	[*]String light decorations can no longer be placed indoors.[/*]
 	[*]Arrow recipe now outputs 500 arrows instead of 100.[/*]
 	[*]The climbable rope on the main bridge in Verdantis Mines can now be selected from all angles.[/*]
 	[*]Avatar feet no longer sink in rocks in Norgard Fens.[/*]
 	[*]Bear Plaque/Trophy updates were made.[/*]
 	[*]Added mud rock to cover up clipping paver in Norgard Fens.[/*]
 	[*]Adjusted a staircase in Norgard Fens for a smoother walking transition to platforms.[/*]
 	[*]Updated the tier markers in Ruined Keep and in Hidden Vale to reflect its new "Tier 10+" nature.[/*]
 	[*]Updated a task name in Oracle Temple to clarify you need to speak with the Oracle and Arabella.[/*]
 	[*]The Tome of Greatness in Shaminian Hills is now properly named.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue with stalactite trap in Verdantis Mines interfering with looting bodies.[/*]
 	[*]Jumping during fireworks usage now correctly cancels the fireworks without displaying the effect.[/*]
 	[*]White Sky Navy Helmet is now visible when worn.[/*]
 	[*]Removed the compass labels from the exit compass discoveries in Storms Reach.[/*]
 	[*]Reduced the range of audio on Tesla tower in Ardoris.[/*]
 	[*]All ranged skills now return 100% experience when using Scrolls of Unlearning.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Release 54 Patch Notes: June 5, 2018
notes.content:
[b]Build Number 790 June 5 1:15 PM CDT[/b]

[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Changed name in Soltown quest task text to more commonly used Stan Clark to avoid rabid fans of Bill Collins.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a gap in floor on staircase in Obsidian Keep to prevent players falling through.[/*]
 	[*]Slowed down VFX on Water Elemental bindings.[/*]
 	[*]Added a valve wheel to the lid of the Nautical Basement Entrance hatch.[/*]
 	[*]All random encounters now list as "Tier 3+," except for the Troll encounter which lists as Tier 10+.[/*]
 	[*]All siege encounters now list as "Tier 4+."[/*]
 	[*]Talking mirror no longer has the ability to move.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed error on breakaway scaffolding bridge in Verdantis Mines.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed error on wooden palisade gate teleporter in Brittany Fields to Brittany Alleys and Novia.[/*]
 	[*]Changed name of R54 raffle tickets to R55.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue where some summoned creatures had incorrect health.[/*]
 	[*]Added defense to tamed creatures.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a choppy animation on a sarcophagus in crypts throughout the game.[/*]
 	[*]A chat message is now received if a song played on an instrument is too long.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed texture coordinates on Heraldry Chests to prevent decal from showing up on bottom sections.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed trade window notifications for remote clients being less than adventuring level 15.[/*]
 	[*]Increased party experience bonus to 50% base and 25% per extra member.[/*]
 	[*]Strength of Earth VFX no longer goes through Throneguard shield.[/*]
 	[*]Containers with 16 or more containers in them can now be moved.[/*]
 	[*]Using the interact hotkey when a player property container is open will no longer take all items from it.[/*]
 	[*]Vigilante loot has been updated.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a typo in a backer NPC name in Central Brittany.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an error in the devotional caretaker conversation in Jaanaford that prevented players from turning in the "Defeat Nefas" quest.[/*]
 	[*]Hazy appearance of some blazons on Heraldry Banners has been corrected.[/*]
 	[*]Greatly reduced the time to drop out of combat mode once sheathed.[/*]
 	[*]Reduced the hit time on all bludgeon weapons to match the majority of blades.[/*]
 	[*]You no longer have to wait 60 seconds to loot breakable crates and barrels.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]The client may default to full screen when the options menu is first used.[/*]
 	[*]Linux clients may experience certain types of trees being rendered incorrectly[/*]
 	[*]Low client performance and bad framerates can influence resurrection timers, making them last longer than their intended duration.[/*]
 	[*]Elysian Illumination no longer damages undead, and has a broken range for applying heals.[/*]
 	[*]The in-game map (M key shortcut) cannot be accessed on Linux clients.[/*]
 	[*]Linux is using an older version of Unity until known performance issues can be addressed.[/*]
 	[*]There are ongoing issues with being able to target, heal, and flag in parties of mixed PVP-flagging.[/*]
 	[*]Party/Companion nameplates can be visually obscured if enough buffs are added for icons to wrap to three rows.[/*]
 	[*]Visual quest indicators may be missing from compass. Adding the data to support them is an ongoing design process.[/*]
 	[*]Dazzling Rays, and other caster-based AOE spells, have difficulty hitting nearby enemies in confined spaces (like narrow hallways)[/*]
 	[*]Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.[/*]
 	[*]If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.[/*]
 	[*]Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.[/*]
 	[*]Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
 	[*]Some virus programs with outdated libraries may attempt to quarantine essential game files, mistakenly identifying them as threats. This can have significant effects, including the client not starting at all. We recommend keeping antivirus programs updated frequently as they address problems. Workarounds include reinstalling and launching the client with the aggressive antivirus software disabled, or whitelisting the game directory in the antivirus list of exceptions.[/*]
[/list]

[b]Build Number 789 June 4 12:00 PM CDT[/b]

[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Vigilantes in Blood River Outskirts had their loot updated.[/*]
 	[*]Weapons and shields gained from companion quests are now correctly denoted as quest items.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed minor text issues in conversations.[/*]
 	[*]Fiona's lute buff was updated.[/*]
 	[*]Festering Potion ingredients were updated.[/*]
 	[*]Ambient audio in Skrekk is now linked to volume sliders.[/*]
 	[*]Issues with Companion gear have been corrected.[/*]
 	[*]In-game maps now appear correctly immediately after scene load.[/*]
 	[*]The male avatar thumb no longer goes through goblets.[/*]
 	[*]All rocks now have collision in Port Graff.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed the rotation for the Skull Goblet.[/*]
 	[*]Light levels were adjusted in Elysium Mines and Spectral Mines.[/*]
 	[*]The book "Lord British Sings Work Songs" will now properly appear if placed as a decoration.[/*]
 	[*]Obsidian Wizard clothing can now be dyed.[/*]
 	[*]Ruins of Ravensmoor had animation, interactive, and AI navigation updates.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed doe/stag walk and run animation playback.[/*]
 	[*]The four alcoves behind sluice doors in Grand Artificer no longer have the chance of trapping players.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Release 51 Patch Notes: February 28, 2018
notes.content:
[b]Build Number 742 4:30PM[/b]

[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Fixed a bug that caused some recipes to display an incorrect skill level requirement.[/*]
 	[*]Simone von Eglinger in Ardoris will now accept help from players.[/*]
 	[*]Changing your title now updates the UI immediately.[/*]
 	[*]Updates to PvP state are now reflected in the UI immediately.[/*]
 	[*]Switching between training and maintaining multiple skills should now work more clearly.[/*]
 	[*]Offline mode no longer has sieges on player owned towns.[/*]
 	[*]Added support for buying emotes from Crown Merchants.[/*]
 	[*]Environmental damage will no longer remove spawn protection.[/*]
 	[*]Reducing the PvP damage bonus now that the damage balance has shifted closer to neutral.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]The in-game map (M key shortcut) cannot be accessed on Linux clients.[/*]
 	[*]Linux is using an older version of Unity until known performance issues can be addressed.[/*]
 	[*]Fire is visible when dead.[/*]
 	[*]There are ongoing issues with being able to target, heal, and flag in parties of mixed PVP-flagging.[/*]
 	[*]Juggle emotes do not properly sync hand/item movements in low performance environments.[/*]
 	[*]Crafting UI will not properly recognize Gold Ingots to fulfill Metal Ingot recipes.[/*]
 	[*]Party/Companion nameplates can be visually obscured if enough buffs are added for icons to wrap to three rows.[/*]
 	[*]Visual quest indicators may be missing from compass. Adding the data to support them is an ongoing design process.[/*]
 	[*]Dazzling Rays, and other caster-based AOE spells, have difficulty hitting nearby enemies in confined spaces (like narrow hallways)[/*]
 	[*]Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas for Windows 10 users. Playing in Windows 8 compatibility mode may fix this.[/*]
 	[*]Ring of Cuttlekin turns avatar skin grey instead of translucent.[/*]
 	[*]Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.[/*]
 	[*]If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.[/*]
 	[*]Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.[/*]
 	[*]It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill.[/*]
 	[*]Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.[/*]
 	[*]Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
[/list]

[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Some previously invisible NPC merchants in player owned towns are fixed.[/*]
 	[*]Area-of-effect ranges have been corrected.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed NPCs not spawning in certain maps.[/*]
[/list]

[list]

 	[*]Healing Ray and Healing Touch will now correctly decrease the cast time.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue with the Lord Servant pattern applying wrong visuals.[/*]
 	[*]Strength of Earth will now grant the correct additional capacity with specialization.[/*]
 	[*]Douse will now give the correct amount of fire resistance.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a problem on Aerie Castle elevators that caused players to be scaled incorrectly.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed scaling issues on Mushroom Men.[/*]
 	[*]Containers no longer sort to the top of the list in merchant windows.[/*]
 	[*]Rain emote SFX was updated.[/*]
 	[*]Sneak attack now has an animation when using 2-handed hammers.[/*]
 	[*]The Bear Headdress no longer blinks along with female avatar eyes.[/*]
 	[*]Sick emote liedown animation is now level with the ground.[/*]
 	[*]South Drachvald Spur in-game map was created.[/*]
 	[*]Text for Lost Vale exit to Novia discovery now reads 'Exit'.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a typo in Fortify Defenses.[/*]
 	[*]Shield of Air and Shield of Ice no longer lose their attunement bonuses when zoning.[/*]
 	[*]No longer showing unimplemented skills at all, instead of blank icons.[/*]
 	[*]Updated secret door SFX.[/*]
 	[*]Caelestis Canton player owned town connections updated with Dragons Watch, Islands of Wonders, Lockbrier, and Serenity Isle.[/*]
 	[*]Improved pathfinding in West Ravenswood to improve ability to loot corpses.[/*]
 	[*]Dogs now have head tracking to look at things they walk past.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed broken-looking Dragon Clan Boots.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed secret doors in Epitaph so that brick switches reach beyond wall colliders.[/*]
 	[*]Your own ghost is now visible when you die.[/*]
 	[*]Chess and Checkers game board renamed to contain the game names for inventory searching.[/*]
 	[*]Added 100 items to the equipment crown merchant.[/*]
 	[*]Players with specialization to master level 80 will now receive one additional glyph for each school in the tree.[/*]
 	[*]Purify and Purify Burst lasting effects from specialization can now be dismissed.[/*]
 	[*]Aimed Shot will no longer show a fizzle rate.[/*]
 	[*]Banish undead should now correctly damage players wearing the Lich Ring.[/*]
 	[*]Blinding Shot will now add a parry debuff when specialized.[/*]
 	[*]Disabling Shot will now add a dodge debuff when specialized.[/*]
 	[*]Rapid Fire will now increase the effective skill and increase the chance for an additional arrow when specialized.[/*]
 	[*]Clarified the description for the Pull skill.[/*]
 	[*]Forest Metropolis player owned town performance optimizations.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue where specialized Bolster Balance was not applying the Dexterity bonus.[/*]
 	[*]Spiders no longer slide in place while dancing.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue where a player using Knockdowns would be knocked down instead of the intended target.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue where certain combat effects would not use an old position to calculate range.[/*]
 	[*]Some NPCs in Xenos that had lost their conversations have been fixed.[/*]
 	[*]Player Vendors are no longer invisible.[/*]
 	[*]Patch notes completed.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Trial users on the Path of Courage cannot currently re-enter Highvale.[/*]
 	[*]The in-game map (M key shortcut) cannot be accessed on Linux clients.[/*]
 	[*]Linux is using an older version of Unity until known performance issues can be addressed.[/*]
 	[*]Fire is visible when dead.[/*]
 	[*]It is possible for moving platforms to appear out of synchronization with others.[/*]
 	[*]There are ongoing issues with being able to target, heal, and flag in parties of mixed PVP-flagging.[/*]
 	[*]Juggle emotes do not properly sync hand/item movements in low performance environments.[/*]
 	[*]Crafting UI will not properly recognize Gold Ingots to fulfill Metal Ingot recipes.[/*]
 	[*]Party/Companion nameplates can be visually obscured if enough buffs are added for icons to wrap to three rows.[/*]
 	[*]Visual quest indicators may be missing from compass. Adding the data to support them is an ongoing design process.[/*]
 	[*]Dazzling Rays, and other caster-based AOE spells, have difficulty hitting nearby enemies in confined spaces (like narrow hallways)[/*]
 	[*]Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas for Windows 10 users. Playing in Windows 8 compatibility mode may fix this.[/*]
 	[*]Ring of Cuttlekin turns avatar skin grey instead of translucent.[/*]
 	[*]Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.[/*]
 	[*]If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.[/*]
 	[*]Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.[/*]
 	[*]It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill.[/*]
 	[*]Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.[/*]
 	[*]Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
[/list]

 	[*]The text “Agro Boost” has been updated to “Aggro Boost”[/*]

 	[*]Fixed all phonographs and radios so that their lights are correctly off when placed and the item is turned off.[/*]
 	[*]Removed movement delay after spawning.[/*]
 	[*]When using magic on an enemy, the higher of the caster’s Dex or Int will now be used to counter the dodge chance of the target.[/*]
 	[*]Load screen optimizations.[/*]
 	[*]Preparing map data with Siege information.[/*]
 	[*]World items only respawn in multiplayer matchmaking modes.[/*]
 	[*]Updated AI pathing in Hills Encounter to correct mining ore on the edge of the map.[/*]
 	[*]Micsere's task in Yew to gather ten ingots for him now completes upon giving him the ingots.[/*]
 	[*]Performance optimization for compass updates in large towns.[/*]
 	[*]Conversations will no longer fail if the player is too close to the NPC.[/*]
 	[*]Fixes to quest pointers for a scout within Highvale.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]It is possible to debuff enemies when out of reach due to environment positioning.[/*]

 	[*]Quest NPCs will not accept inexact stacks of quest items. Items must be exact quantity requested at time of turn-in to be recognized as valid.[/*]
 	[*]Party/Companion nameplates can be visually obscured if enough buffs are added for icons to wrap to three rows.[/*]
 	[*]Visual quest indicators may be missing from compass. Adding the data to support them is an ongoing design process.[/*]
 	[*]Dazzling Rays, and other caster-based AOE spells, have difficulty hitting nearby enemies in confined spaces (like narrow hallways)[/*]
 	[*]Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas for Windows 10 users. Playing in Windows 8 compatibility mode may fix this.[/*]

notes.title: Q1 2018 Schedule Update
notes.content:
[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=80776][img]https://scontent-atl3-1.xx.fbcdn.net/v/t1.0-9/25353889_903961479766074_4274670404002978129_n.jpg?oh=148212458173f1ebabed386a875c3a12&oe=5A8DABE5[/img][/url]

Greetings Avatars,

We are excited to announce a candidate launch date for Shroud of the Avatar! On Tuesday March 27, 2018 (Release 52), we are planning to launch out of Early Access!

So what does that mean exactly for a game that has been both persistent for over a year and been doing monthly releases for over 4 years? Well, for us it means that we are delivering the list of features, including physical goods, promised during the Kickstarter albeit with a few exceptions and/or replacements (see below). It also means that we are going to grow our community through marketing campaigns

As we have stated previously, we intend to publish quarterly schedule updates detailing our monthly releases and those monthly releases will continue. Even though the goals outlined in these schedules are likely to change somewhat as we react to feedback, we feel it is important to periodically provide you with an updated roadmap.

Our priority continues to be to deliver new content to our backers regularly, so that you can give us feedback that will help us iteratively improve Shroud of the Avatar. This collaborative process continues to benefit the game, and often results in sweeping changes such as the recent polish passes to the user interface. As you have seen in previous releases, the flexibility inherent to this process means that we sometimes push things out, but we also often pull new things in.

Most recently we have been collaborating with our partner Travian to survey our backers on their experience with the game so we can correlate feedback scientifically with the metrics we are collecting in the game. Thank you everyone who has participated, your survey answers have helped guide our Top 10 priorities for launch and our Q1 schedule.

Check out the  [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=80776]Q1 2018 Post[/url] on the main website to see what's coming up!

So what does that mean exactly for a game that has been both persistent for over a year and been doing monthly releases for over 4 years? Well, for us it means that we are delivering the list of features, including physical goods, promised during the Kickstarter albeit with a few exceptions and/or replacements (see below). It also means that we are going to grow our community through marketing campaigns

As we have stated previously, we intend to publish quarterly schedule updates detailing our monthly releases and those monthly releases will continue. Even though the goals outlined in these schedules are likely to change somewhat as we react to feedback, we feel it is important to periodically provide you with an updated roadmap.

Our priority continues to be to deliver new content to our backers regularly, so that you can give us feedback that will help us iteratively improve Shroud of the Avatar. This collaborative process continues to benefit the game, and often results in sweeping changes such as the recent polish passes to the user interface. As you have seen in previous releases, the flexibility inherent to this process means that we sometimes push things out, but we also often pull new things in.

Most recently we have been collaborating with our partner Travian to survey our backers on their experience with the game so we can correlate feedback scientifically with the metrics we are collecting in the game. Thank you everyone who has participated, your survey answers have helped guide our Top 10 priorities for launch and our Q1 schedule.

Check out the  [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=80776]Q1 2018 Post[/url] on the main website to see what's coming up!

notes.title: Release 48 Patch Notes: November 21, 2017
notes.content:
[b]Build Number 702 3:30PM[/b]

[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
 	[*]The Cabalist Robe no longer causes performance issues when cloth simulation is turned on.[/*]
 	[*]Decay will now apply to ghosts in the overworld map.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Halberd of the Sun auto-attacks will force a global cooldown timer on all abilities with every swing.[/*]
 	[*]Some extreme resolution options are not possible due to an inability to scroll the video resolution list.[/*]
 	[*]Elements of tree curtains used in many scenes will appear to be rendered black.[/*]
 	[*]Dazzling Rays, and other caster-based AOE spells, have difficulty hitting nearby enemies in confined spaces (like narrow hallways)[/*]
 	[*]The animation for "kicking something open" puts away weapons and torches.[/*]
 	[*]Death Shield does not mitigate damage from critical hits[/*]
 	[*]The crafting window does not have proper messaging to indicate when a tool is broken, and will simply say that there is no recipe found.[/*]
 	[*]Dynamically spawned NPCs may have delayed spawn in scenes that are dense with player homes and decorations.[/*]
 	[*]Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas for Windows 10 users. Playing in Windows 8 compatibility mode may fix this.[/*]
 	[*]Ring of Cuttlekin turns avatar skin grey instead of translucent.[/*]
 	[*]Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.[/*]
 	[*]Hitching may occur when using UI windows like “Options” or “DeckBuilder”[/*]
 	[*]Phonograph audio cannot be heard if approached while it is already playing.[/*]
 	[*]If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.[/*]
 	[*]Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.[/*]
 	[*]When a client first logs in as a trial visitor then relogs as a full account, many Trial permissions will still be present (inability to trade) until the client is restarted.[/*]
 	[*]The Piercing Breeze combo ability does not do damage to Dragons as expected.[/*]
 	[*]When a party member dies while targeted, the target focus is reset.[/*]
 	[*]When moving NPC Buildings, it’s possible to crash the client by overlapping structures/boundaries during placement.[/*]
 	[*]It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.[/*]
 	[*]Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.[/*]
 	[*]Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.[/*]
 	[*]Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.[/*]
 	[*]Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]

 	[*]The monkey room monkeys in K'rul will no longer stay at their spawn location.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a hitching animation for female avatar sitting.[/*]
 	[*]Charlotte in Battle of Solace Bridge is no longer interrupting her own cry animations.[/*]
 	[*]Timothy in Ardoris will now perform the "Love Salute" emote without error.[/*]
 	[*]The Wealthy Merchant Coat no longer has a gap in the midsection.[/*]
 	[*]Removed a sight-blocking tree in Brittany.[/*]

 	[*]Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.[/*]

 	[*]Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.[/*]

 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]

notes.title: Release 47 Patch Notes: October 30, 2017
notes.content:
[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Fixed an issue where the blacksmithing station colliders are rendered as white boxes while being placed as a decoration.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed minor clipping with female hair through Nurse’s Hat.[/*]
 	[*]Facial animation added to Satyr rig.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue where negative heals would not get applied at full health.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue that would cause the left arm to shake while casting certain skills.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue with "On Hit" enchantments that would significantly reduce the chance to hit.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed interactive collider for post mounted mailboxes.[/*]
 	[*]Bears are now less likely to move out of weapon range while fighting them.[/*]
 	[*]Performance testing updates.[/*]
 	[*]Added collision to prevent camera from popping out of ceiling in Epitaph.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed the gate to the child's pen in Halls of Artifice so that the gate can be unlocked and opened once again.[/*]
 	[*]When in free-mouse mode the reticle will now show while the right mouse button is held down.[/*]
 	[*]Merchant window now closes when the merchant dies.[/*]
 	[*]Setup entries for new scene scenarios in Kobold Expeditionary Camp.[/*]
 	[*]Minor modifications to the resource gathering UI in response to player feedback.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed pillars at wrong scale in Elads.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed inaccessible ore nodes in Blackblade Foothills.[/*]
 	[*]Merchants no longer exit conversation after using the "buy" keyword.[/*]
 	[*]Removed rocks blocking entrance in Epitaph.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue with Horatio's conversation in Highvale Outskirts that was giving an error when talking about the new Formal Courage Salute emote.[/*]
 	[*]Corrected several leashing range issues with non-combat NPCs in Highvale Outskirts.[/*]
 	[*]Demig will now close his conversation when completing his quest in Demig's Battle Camp.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed decorative brazier so it no longer causes fire damage.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an LOD issue with Midras Ruins on Novia overworld map.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed bug that caused NPC chat bubbles to appear long after they said something.[/*]
 	[*]Added audio mixers and their corresponding audio sources so that SFX will be affected by the master volume slider.[/*]
 	[*]A Denis Loubet art piece was added to crown merchants.[/*]
 	[*]Mace of Unsummoning now has the correct damage stats.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Some weapons may salvage for incorrect types of scrap.[/*]
 	[*]Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas for Windows 10 users. Playing in Windows 8 compatibility mode may fix this.[/*]
 	[*]Sheet music played on instruments will cause background music to start skipping noticeably. Restarting the client may fix this.[/*]
 	[*]Skill values will appear to carry over between accounts on the same client.[/*]
 	[*]Ring of Cuttlekin turns avatar skin grey instead of translucent.[/*]
 	[*]Pets cannot follow players onto moving platforms.[/*]
 	[*]Hitching may occur when using UI windows like "Options" or "DeckBuilder"[/*]
 	[*]Phonograph audio cannot be heard if approached while it is already playing.[/*]
 	[*]Logging off will not clear previous party associations. UI will show previous party members.[/*]
 	[*]If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.[/*]
 	[*]Adventurer Levels, when viewed from the Character Sheet, do not properly update values based on equipment.[/*]
 	[*]Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.[/*]
 	[*]Many rugs and Sigil decorations can be placed beneath existing pavers, making them inaccessible.[/*]
 	[*]Kindred players can place deco Flyers on other players’ private Bulletin Boards[/*]
 	[*]When a client first logs in as a trial visitor then relogs as a full account, many Trial permissions will still be present (inability to trade) until the client is restarted.[/*]
 	[*]The Piercing Breeze combo ability does not do damage to Dragons as expected.[/*]
 	[*]When a party member dies while targeted, the target focus is reset.[/*]
 	[*]When moving NPC Buildings, it’s possible to crash the client by overlapping structures/boundaries during placement.[/*]
 	[*]Chat content from one account may be visible by a second account if logged in from the same client.[/*]
 	[*]It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.[/*]
 	[*]Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.[/*]
 	[*]Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.[/*]
 	[*]Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.[/*]
 	[*]Not all items listed in R47 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store[/*]
 	[*]Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
[/list]

notes.content:
[b]Build Number 672[/b]

[b]Updates[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Restored missing dead oak trees in Solace Bridge Outskirts, Blood Bay, and Elad's Lighthouse.[/*]

 	[*]When a client first logs in as a trial visitor then relogs as a full account, many Trial permissions will still be present (inability to trade) until the client is restarted.[/*]
 	[*]The Piercing Breeze combo ability does not do damage to Dragons as expected.[/*]
 	[*]When a party member dies while targeted, the target focus is reset.[/*]
 	[*]When moving NPC Buildings, it’s possible to crash the client by overlapping structures/boundaries during placement.[/*]
 	[*]Chat content from one account may be visible by a second account if logged in from the same client.[/*]
 	[*]It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.[/*]

 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]

[/list]

notes.title: Q4 2017 Schedule Update
notes.content:
[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=29385][img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/09/q4-2017-1024x576.jpg[/img][/url]

Greetings Avatars,

As we have stated previously, we intend to publish quarterly schedule updates for our monthly releases. Even though the goals outlined in these schedules are likely to change somewhat as we react to feedback, we feel it is important to periodically provide you with an updated roadmap.

Our priority continues to be to deliver new content to our backers each and every month, so that you can give us feedback that will help us iteratively improve Shroud of the Avatar. This collaborative process continues to benefit the game, and often results in sweeping changes such as the upcoming addition of the Outskirts scenes. As you have seen in previous releases, the flexibility inherent to this process means that we sometimes push things out, but we also often pull new things in.

[b]Top 10 Priorities:[/b] We keep a running list of our Top 10 priorities at all times that we use when building our schedule and prioritizing where to allocate our team’s resources. We often refer to it when making decisions about the project. While it has a VERY strong influence on what we work on at any given time, it does not mean that we only work on something that is on the list. It just means that if someone can assist with something that will help address an item on the list, then we will make sure they do that first before working on anything else. Sometimes team members cannot assist with anything on our top priorities, so they work on other tasks such as visual polish, combat balance, or content that helps us raise funds.

Until now we have only used this list internally and we have not shared it externally with you, our backers. However, we felt that as we approach launch we definitely should share this list, especially because our current Top 10 list consists of everything that we need to address BEFORE we are ready to launch.

[b]Reduce Load Times:[/b] There are a lot of benefits to being a game that is divided up into multiple scenes, including everyone playing on one server and the ability to dynamically update scenes at will. However, being a scene-based game means that our load times MUST be mere seconds or the entire experience of playing the game is destroyed. Right now scene loads can still be over a minute on physical media drives (HDs) and up to 30 seconds even on solid state drives (SSDs). Reducing load times to seconds on both drive types is our number one goal for Q4 because the entire game experience depends on it.

[b]Client Performance (FPS):[/b] Once we have reduced load times, we can focus on improving client performance. We will work on improving framerate, minimizing hitching, and lowering the game’s memory footprint.

[b]Improved Reward Cycle:[/b] Right now, our reward cycle for play is completely unsatisfying. The loot is infrequent, not exciting, and requires multiple steps to gain a reward (ex. salvaging followed by crafting). We are going to add more immediately gratifying items (artifacts and gear with stats that can be salvaged for unique components). We are also going to slowly increase the amount of resources available in the world while carefully monitoring the game balance. Finally, we are going to add more unique quest rewards, especially items related to the virtues (ex. banners with virtue symbols).

....and more! Read the complete [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=77776#more-77776]Q4 2017 Post[/url] on the main website.

notes.content:
[list]
 	[*]Fixed missing LOD meshes for ornate shogun crafting pavilion.[/*]
 	[*]Offline reward delivery asset path bugs were corrected.[/*]
 	[*]Helen Garriott art support for Children and Family Charities store sales.[/*]
 	[*]Game client language is now set system default language, this setting can be changed in game options.[/*]
 	[*]Updated Unity game engine to new patch version.[/*]
 	[*]Plate chest armor is no longer missing when equipped.[/*]
 	[*]Plate gauntlets are no longer mangled when equipped.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]The equipable Shroud of the Avatar may display visual issues on both Male and Female avatars.[/*]
 	[*]Equipment functionality breaks if armor is equipped that was contained within an equipable container that is also equipped at the same time. Examples include the Elite Elven Archer Quiver and the Ornate Backpack.[/*]
 	[*]Enemies may continue to spin to face you despite being stunned/knocked down.[/*]
 	[*]Quest Tasks that should update after looting a container may not progress if another player loots the container before you.[/*]
 	[*]Squirrels and rabbits will not dance when instructed to do so.[/*]
 	[*]Logging off will not clear previous party associations. UI will show previous party members.[/*]
 	[*]If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.[/*]
 	[*]Adventurer Levels, when viewed from the Character Sheet, do not properly update values based on equipment.[/*]
 	[*]Gawain, the wounded knight in the Battle of Highvale, will incorrectly stand up when spoken with.[/*]
 	[*]Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.[/*]
 	[*]Many rugs and Sigil decorations can be placed beneath existing pavers, making them inaccessible.[/*]
 	[*]Kindred players can place deco Flyers on other players’ private Bulletin Boards[/*]
 	[*]Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas. Reloading the scene appears to fix this in many cases.[/*]
 	[*]When a client first logs in as a trial visitor then relogs as a full account, many Trial permissions will still be present (inability to trade) until the client is restarted.[/*]
 	[*]The Piercing Breeze combo ability does not do damage to Dragons as expected.[/*]
 	[*]When a party member dies while targeted, the target focus is reset.[/*]
 	[*]When moving NPC Buildings, it’s possible to crash the client by overlapping structures/boundaries during placement.[/*]
 	[*]Chat content from one account may be visible by a second account if logged in from the same client.[/*]
 	[*]It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.[/*]
 	[*]Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.[/*]
 	[*]Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.[/*]
 	[*]Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.[/*]
 	[*]Not all items listed in R45 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store[/*]
 	[*]Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
[/list]

 	[*]Leg equipment sorting polish.[/*]

 	[*]Fixed the scale of the paper doll in the character sheet.[/*]

 	[*]The Piercing Breeze combo ability does not do damage to Dragons as expected.[/*]
 	[*]When a party member dies while targeted, the target focus is reset.[/*]
 	[*]When moving NPC Buildings, it’s possible to crash the client by overlapping structures/boundaries during placement.[/*]
 	[*]Chat content from one account may be visible by a second account if logged in from the same client.[/*]
 	[*]It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.[/*]
 	[*]Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.[/*]
 	[*]Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.[/*]
 	[*]Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.[/*]
 	[*]Not all items listed in R45 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store[/*]
 	[*]Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Release 45 Patch Notes: September 1, 2017
notes.content:
[list]
 	[*]Updates to ensure that NPCs only turn on lights during night periods, and off during day periods.[/*]
 	[*]Various cloth-simulation leggings polish updates.[/*]
 	[*]Replaced some buggy trees in the Hidden Vale Plains Encounter map.[/*]
 	[*]Updated trees in Forest Road Encounter to current trees, fixing improper collision and rendering.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a case where an item failed to sync properly when placed on property from a stack in the player inventory.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed emissive pond fog in Middle Downs and adjusted some other environmental settings.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a problem with Shogun light decorations becoming invisible when moving them.[/*]
 	[*]Armor no longer sorts through the Ornate Floral Kimono.[/*]
 	[*]Made the Lord British helm usable as a decoration.[/*]
 	[*]Created sitting variation for /scowl, /smile, and /frown emotes.[/*]
 	[*]The Bandit Leader's Note can now be looted in Longfall Woods.[/*]
 	[*]The endlesscloth emote has been renamed to mouthcoil.[/*]
 	[*]The mouthcoil emote now displays from all camera angles, even when camera is zoomed up close to the avatar's face[/*]
 	[*]Added a splash of color to discord chat in game.[/*]
 	[*]Portions of the Shogun Wall and Streetlamp are no longer invisible.[/*]
 	[*]Decoration layers in the Shogun Crafting Pavilion house are now set to interior.[/*]
 	[*]Chainmail Chest Quarter Armor no longer overlaps the Long Skirted Bodice.[/*]
 	[*]Adjusted a wall in the Ornate Shogun Crafting Pavilion so that lamps and wall decorations don't show through.[/*]
 	[*]Made the SyndCon 2017 cloak usable as a decoration.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed missing facial hair when wearing the Lord British helmet.[/*]
 	[*]Dancing pets will no longer always face their owner when dancing.[/*]
 	[*]Disabling cloth physics no longer breaks capes.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]The player owned town Journey's End is inaccessible from the Overworld. Access is still possible from neighboring interconnected scenes.[/*]
 	[*]Decorations placed on top of basic tables will inherit the table's scaling and appear to shrink in size.[/*]
 	[*]Quest Tasks that should update after looting a container may not progress if another player loots the container before you.[/*]
 	[*]Squirrels and rabbits will not dance when instructed to do so.[/*]
 	[*]Logging off will not clear previous party associations. UI will show previous party members.[/*]
 	[*]If an item’s name is in Runic, its flag as “Private Property” will also appear in Runic.[/*]
 	[*]The avatar may appear too tall when viewed in the Character Sheet UI.[/*]
 	[*]Adventurer Levels, when viewed from the Character Sheet, do not properly update values based on equipment.[/*]
 	[*]Gawain, the wounded knight in the Battle of Highvale, will incorrectly stand up when spoken with.[/*]
 	[*]Some NPC prefab mouths will not properly animate when talking.[/*]
 	[*]Players with Tenant permissions on a Lot cannot place their own Player Vendors.[/*]
 	[*]Many rugs and Sigil decorations can be placed beneath existing pavers, making them inaccessible.[/*]
 	[*]Kindred players can place deco Flyers on other players’ private Bulletin Boards[/*]
 	[*]Some world items will be equipped immediately upon looting, replacing previous equipment.[/*]
 	[*]Wearable Cabalist Robes will stretch awkwardly when running[/*]
 	[*]Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas. Reloading the scene appears to fix this in many cases.[/*]
 	[*]When a client first logs in as a trial visitor then relogs as a full account, many Trial permissions will still be present (inability to trade) until the client is restarted.[/*]
 	[*]Party members with active PvP flags will also be affected by a friendly-fire Gust spell.[/*]
 	[*]The Piercing Breeze combo ability does not do damage to Dragons as expected.[/*]
 	[*]When a party member dies while targeted, the target focus is reset.[/*]
 	[*]When moving NPC Buildings, it’s possible to crash the client by overlapping structures/boundaries during placement.[/*]
 	[*]Chat content from one account may be visible by a second account if logged in from the same client.[/*]
 	[*]Disabling cloth physics may result in capes/cloaks appearing completely flat, rigid, and disconnected from the Avatar’s body[/*]
 	[*]It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.[/*]
 	[*]Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.[/*]
 	[*]Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.[/*]
 	[*]Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.[/*]
 	[*]Not all items listed in R45 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store[/*]
 	[*]Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
[/list]

 	[*]Party members with active PvP flags will also be affected by a friendly-fire Gust spell.[/*]

 	[*]When a party member dies while targeted, the target focus is reset.[/*]

 	[*]Chat content from one account may be visible by a second account if logged in from the same client.[/*]
 	[*]Disabling cloth physics may result in capes/cloaks appearing completely flat, rigid, and disconnected from the Avatar’s body[/*]

 	[*]Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.[/*]

 	[*]Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.[/*]
 	[*]Not all items listed in R45 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store[/*]
 	[*]Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]

 	[*]Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]

[/list]

notes.title: Release 44 Patch Notes: August 1, 2017
notes.content:
[list]
 	[*]Cloth equipment now scales correctly in the character sheet.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed some bugs with supply bundles.[/*]
 	[*]The Elven Elite Archer Quiver can now be placed as a decoration.[/*]
 	[*]Ensured both dead guards in the burning inn of Battle of Solace Bridge have loot.[/*]
 	[*]Players will no longer get betrothal bands from vigilantes in Blood River Outskirts after turning in a band to Paeon.[/*]
 	[*]Moved both the monkey and bottle of wine to different spots in Blood River Outskirts.[/*]
 	[*]Changed the conversation for the trainer inside the tree in the main elven camp of Blood River Outskirts.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue where a switch in Rhun Ruins wouldn't open a "trap" door.[/*]
 	[*]Portals are now linked to audio sliders.[/*]
 	[*]Village and Keep sized moondials now clear terrain when placed as decorations.[/*]
 	[*]Giant crystals in Sequanna's crystal cage now draw correctly.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a bug that prevented changes to door permissions from being updated for remote players.[/*]
 	[*]The Boletusporis Infans at the elven worship tree in Blood River Outskirts are once again dropping loot, but not weapons, thankfully.[/*]
 	[*]Hephaestus in Artifice no longer tries to give his final reward twice.[/*]
 	[*]Created new Short Assassin's Leggings to support length of outfit.[/*]
 	[*]Alberic in Blood River Outskirts will once again reward helpful players of the refugees without the expectation of turning in the unrelated vigilante manifesto.[/*]
 	[*]Added pre-placed light fixtures to Shogun City Ships.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed exit volumes reporting they will take you into a siege even when it is completed.[/*]
 	[*]Many objects Xenos for all objects that were suffering from the "Background View" Error.[/*]
 	[*]Old Elven Heirlooms named “unknown item” should now be fixed.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas. Reloading the scene appears to fix this in many cases.[/*]
 	[*]Mature agriculture plants may not appear in the correct visual state when placed back down from Magic Movers[/*]
 	[*]Approaching the glowing doors in Halls of Artifice may leave a white overlay on the screen, changing maps or moving completely through the doorway should resolve this.[/*]
 	[*]When a client first logs in as a trial visitor then relogs as a full account, many Trial permissions will still be present (inability to trade) until the client is restarted.[/*]
 	[*]Party members with active PvP flags will also be affected by a friendly-fire Gust spell.[/*]
 	[*]The Piercing Breeze combo ability does not do damage to Dragons as expected.[/*]
 	[*]When a party member dies while targeted, the target focus is reset.[/*]
 	[*]When moving NPC Buildings, it’s possible to crash the client by overlapping structures/boundaries during placement.[/*]
 	[*]Indoor lights in the Duke Benefactor City Home will frequently appear as Exterior lights when placed.[/*]
 	[*]Water Lot Island Keeps may experience difficulty placing decorations on open terrain. This is caused by a bug that visually removed trees from this terrain, but did not remove their collision.[/*]
 	[*]Chat content from one account may be visible by a second account if logged in from the same client.[/*]
 	[*]When a Journal entry’s title is long and wraps to a new line, it may unexpectedly overlap the entry’s body text.[/*]
 	[*]Disabling cloth physics may result in capes/cloaks appearing completely flat, rigid, and disconnected from the Avatar's body[/*]
 	[*]It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.[/*]
 	[*]Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.[/*]
 	[*]Ring of Fire VFX will appear distorted when displayed against walls and water surfaces.[/*]
 	[*]Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.[/*]
 	[*]Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.[/*]
 	[*]Not all items listed in R44 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store[/*]
 	[*]Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Release 44 Patch Notes: July 28, 2017
notes.content:
[list]
 	[*]Fixed broken item reference for sword in Celestis.[/*]
 	[*]Set proper item type and fixed tooltip crash on Heart Of Sorrows.[/*]
 	[*]Residents of Ardoris that have a title will continue to display their title after you learn their name.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue with the Ground Pound animation.[/*]
 	[*]Missing wood strip component have returned.[/*]
 	[*]The washed-out icon for "The Dirae Prophecy of Evard" item looks nicer now.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a typo in the phrase "Shroud of the Avatar" in the “Helpful Guide to Deck Building” book.[/*]
 	[*]Extended entrance hallway in K'rul, adjusted the exit volume, and decreased the awareness range of spawners.[/*]
 	[*]All auto-ballista now has far more precise firing capabilities![/*]
 	[*]Blast of Dread has had its range doubled to 20 meters.[/*]
 	[*]The “Unknown Item” in Blood River Outskirts relating to Elven Heirlooms has be fixed.[/*]
 	[*]Clockwork cats on patrol in K'rul can no longer get you at the spawn-in point.[/*]
 	[*]Korabar's dialog in Skrekk has been made clearer when discussing past events in Valhold.[/*]
 	[*]The Scepter of Dread should now be rotated during main hand usage.[/*]
 	[*]Pinky finger while wearing Epic Cloth Gloves now looks correct.[/*]
 	[*]Bows animate when firing and charging up again.[/*]
 	[*]The slime stuck in a tree in Blood River Outskirts has been released and is now free to slime anyone that comes its way.[/*]
 	[*]Fixes for Arabella armor.[/*]
 	[*]FX for Puke emote no longer continues after the character has risen and is wiping his or her face.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed carpentry merchant in Owl’s Head that was missing inventory.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed animation hold pose for hands on two-handed blades.[/*]
 	[*]Gus in Blood River Outskirts now explains more about the monkeys when a player clicks on the automaton monkey keyword.[/*]
 	[*]The confluence chamber now has music.[/*]
 	[*]Boleusporis Infans in Blood River Outskirts will no longer be carrying concealed weapons.[/*]
 	[*]Now showing permissions on container window for containers placed on housing lots.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed invisible stairs on Duke Founder City Water Home.[/*]
 	[*]Applying a sparkly dye to Assassin Chest secondary color no longer affects the primary color.[/*]
 	[*]Elven Elite Archer Quiver is becoming a backpack.[/*]
 	[*]Doors are no longer disabled in arena basement.[/*]
 	[*]Woman in Sequanna Colossus tent no longer sits on an invisible chair.[/*]
 	[*]The Ornate Gazebo is no longer missing its icon.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed offset wall tile in the Crypt of the Avatar.[/*]
 	[*]Lenses and pages can be collected during the Path of the Oracle by everyone who is on the quest in multiplayer scenes.[/*]
 	[*]Icon added for Shogun Ship City Home.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed stats on the Shroud of the Avatar quest item.[/*]
 	[*]Minor updates to user-interface elements.[/*]
 	[*]VFX for breathing emotes now have the correct duration and no longer last too long.[/*]
 	[*]Turning elf scalps in to Phineas in Blood River Outskirts has been refined.[/*]
 	[*]Paeon in Blood River Outskirts no longer triggers a journal entry for Alberic.[/*]
 	[*]The player-owned town “Ullr Ridge” has an updated location.[/*]
 	[*]Improved the AI pathing in Jaanaford which will help the devotional caretakers access their shrine.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed bug that prevented plants from appearing watered when they are watered.[/*]
 	[*]If the note in the Grannus Colossus is never read during the “Path of the Oracle”, the task it completes is cleared once the Confluence Podium is used.[/*]
 	[*]The “Path of Love” task "Find a way to reach Sequanna" now clears correctly.[/*]
 	[*]Updated shared patcher code.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed the minecart light in Serpents Spine Mines.[/*]
 	[*]Healing Blast now has a unique icon.[/*]
 	[*]Assassins armor now split at the waist to have coattails.[/*]
 	[*]The “Shroud of the Avatar” icon was updated.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed sorting issue and improved the visuals of the blood fountain in the Crypt of the Avatar.[/*]
 	[*]The “Shroud of the Avatar” hood is no longer disabled after changing maps, and is now enabled by default when equipped.[/*]
 	[*]Grannus now correctly plays his transformation animation.[/*]
 	[*]Modified runes to say "Courageous" on the Ornate Viking Short Sword.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas. Reloading the scene appears to fix this in many cases.[/*]
 	[*]Mature agriculture plants may not appear in the correct visual state when placed back down from Magic Movers[/*]
 	[*]Approaching the glowing doors in Halls of Artifice may leave a white overlay on the screen, changing maps or moving completely through the doorway should resolve this.[/*]
 	[*]When a client first logs in as a trial visitor then relogs as a full account, many Trial permissions will still be present (inability to trade) until the client is restarted.[/*]
 	[*]Party members with active PvP flags will also be affected by a friendly-fire Gust spell.[/*]
 	[*]The Piercing Breeze combo ability does not do damage to Dragons as expected.[/*]
 	[*]When a party member dies while targeted, the target focus is reset.[/*]
 	[*]When moving NPC Buildings, it’s possible to crash the client by overlapping structures/boundaries during placement.[/*]
 	[*]Indoor lights in the Duke Benefactor City Home will frequently appear as Exterior lights when placed.[/*]
 	[*]Water Lot Island Keeps may experience difficulty placing decorations on open terrain. This is caused by a bug that visually removed trees from this terrain, but did not remove their collision.[/*]
 	[*]Chat content from one account may be visible by a second account if logged in from the same client.[/*]
 	[*]When a Journal entry’s title is long and wraps to a new line, it may unexpectedly overlap the entry’s body text.[/*]
 	[*]Disabling cloth physics may result in capes/cloaks appearing completely flat, rigid, and disconnected from the Avatar's body[/*]
 	[*]It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.[/*]
 	[*]Linux: Adjusting shadows may resize the resolution of the game client.[/*]
 	[*]Interrupting sheet music with another song may result in the music breaking for remote clients listening.[/*]
 	[*]Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.[/*]
 	[*]Ring of Fire VFX will appear distorted when displayed against walls and water surfaces.[/*]
 	[*]Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.[/*]
 	[*]Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.[/*]
 	[*]Not all items listed in R44 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store[/*]
 	[*]Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
[/list]

 	[*]The “Shroud of the Avatar” icon was updated.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed sorting issue and improved the visuals of the blood fountain in the Crypt of the Avatar.[/*]
 	[*]The “Shroud of the Avatar” hood is no longer disabled after changing maps, and is now enabled by default when equipped.[/*]
 	[*]Grannus now correctly plays his transformation animation.[/*]
 	[*]Modified runes to say "Courageous" on the Ornate Viking Short Sword.[/*]

[list]
 	[*]Overworld map terrain may appear missing or flattened in areas. Reloading the scene appears to fix this in many cases.[/*]
 	[*]Mature agriculture plants may not appear in the correct visual state when placed back down from Magic Movers[/*]
 	[*]Approaching the glowing doors in Halls of Artifice may leave a white overlay on the screen, changing maps or moving completely through the doorway should resolve this.[/*]
 	[*]When a client first logs in as a trial visitor then relogs as a full account, many Trial permissions will still be present (inability to trade) until the client is restarted.[/*]
 	[*]Party members with active PvP flags will also be affected by a friendly-fire Gust spell.[/*]
 	[*]The Piercing Breeze combo ability does not do damage to Dragons as expected.[/*]
 	[*]When a party member dies while targeted, the target focus is reset.[/*]
 	[*]When moving NPC Buildings, it’s possible to crash the client by overlapping structures/boundaries during placement.[/*]
 	[*]Indoor lights in the Duke Benefactor City Home will frequently appear as Exterior lights when placed.[/*]

 	[*]When a Journal entry’s title is long and wraps to a new line, it may unexpectedly overlap the entry’s body text.[/*]
