 	[*]Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.[/*]
 	[*]Ring of Fire VFX will appear distorted when displayed against walls and water surfaces.[/*]
 	[*]Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.[/*]
 	[*]Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.[/*]
 	[*]Not all items listed in R44 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store[/*]
 	[*]Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Release 43 Patch Notes: July 5, 2017
notes.content:
[list]
 	[*]Fixed some weapons appearing pink.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed name inconsistency with Summoning Whistle Necklace recipe.[/*]
 	[*]Robert Villines in Blood River, and Edvard in Solace Bridge, will now recognize if you have finished their quests.[/*]
 	[*]Adjusted skeleton spawner groups in ruins in Sequanna.[/*]
 	[*]Robert Villines no longer generates error messages during final conversation in Blood River Massacre.[/*]
 	[*]Removed the collision from several troublesome roots in Brookside: that were making players stuck who tried to climb on them.[/*]
 	[*]Added extra resurrection ankhs and chaos icons to Etceter Crag Mines.[/*]
 	[*]Wealthy Merchant Boots no longer are A8clipping on avatars.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a bug that caused skill levels to be blank on the skill tree.[/*]
 	[*]Athard in Demig's Battle Camp will now properly interrupt avatars visiting the camp.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Magical sparkling dye in secondary dye channel making the entire Epic Cloth outfit sparkle.[/*]
 	[*]Players moving to crafting stations on lots should now operate smoother.[/*]
 	[*]Demig in Demig's Battle Camp no longer force-closes conversation.[/*]
 	[*]Failing to socket a gem no longer destroys the gem.[/*]
 	[*]Ferig om Ferig's Battle Camp no longer force-closes conversation.[/*]
 	[*]Added container scripts to renaissance bed when placed as a decoration.[/*]
 	[*]Removed white glowing orbs from fire VFX in Highvale Village.[/*]
 	[*]Corrected the overbright lighting on Character Creation Mirror interface.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a bug that caused the Nearby Players window to be shown instead of the PvP Stats window in PvP zones.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a stuck spot on the terrain in the Vigilante Camp in Blood River Outskirts.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a lighting issue in Savrenoc Stronghold.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a stuck spot in Verdantis Mines.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an error with a ladder in Vertas Pass.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed low-health indicator appearing on first map load.[/*]
 	[*]Restored moons and weather-based clouds to skies of Eastreach Gap, Southern Grunvald Barrens, Northern Grunvald Barrens, Savrenoc Timberland, and Brisach Maple Forest.[/*]
 	[*]Updated water triggers in Graff Gem Mines to allow NPCs to pass through water.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Loading into scenes with previously opened/opening gates may display them in broken states, preventing players from using them.[/*]
 	[*]The zombie emote does not produce the expected dance.[/*]
 	[*]Players may experience combat lag when playing in scenes with others.[/*]
 	[*]Disabling cloth physics may result in capes/cloaks appearing completely flat, rigid, and disconnected from the Avatar's body[/*]
 	[*]It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.[/*]
 	[*]The dread artifact Heart of Sorrows is currently held awkwardly by avatars.[/*]
 	[*]Attempting to use stealth skills in the vicinity of undead corpses may prevent the spell from working.[/*]
 	[*]Using the /drink or /toast emotes will activate intoxication effects, which results in the Avatar being locked in a walking state for a period of time.[/*]
 	[*]Tabbing between targets may select neutral NPCs. Be wary of nearby non-hostiles if using auto-attack while tabbing![/*]
 	[*]Linux: Adjusting shadows may resize the resolution of the game client.[/*]
 	[*]Interrupting sheet music with another song may result in the music breaking for remote clients listening.[/*]
 	[*]Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.[/*]
 	[*]Ring of Fire VFX will appear distorted when displayed against walls and water surfaces.[/*]
 	[*]Avatars do not go back to idle animations after walking with an instrument being played.[/*]
 	[*]The barrier in Etceter Crag Mines has been removed temporarily, there are issues with the primary puzzle triggering the removal.[/*]
 	[*]Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.[/*]
 	[*]Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.[/*]
 	[*]Not all items listed in R43 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store[/*]
 	[*]Cloaks will often sort through the avatar’s body[/*]
 	[*]Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Free Trial Test Starts Now! Runs From July 3-26
notes.content:
[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=69568][img=//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/07/free_trial_wide.jpg][/img][/url]

We are excited to announce the third test of our Free Trial Test system, running live now through July 26! This will be the longest test so far of the system so that we can gather even more data on uptake, drop-off, conversions, etc.

If you know anyone who would like to try the game for free, then send them to the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=69568][u]Download page[/u][/url]. These tests are invaluable for us in order to improve the New User Experience and the Free Trial System itself.

Free Trial Test access during the game’s current Early Access period allows you to play the entire game in any of the Online modes with a few key differences in game play:

[list][*]Free Trial Test Current Time Period: July 3-26, 2017[*]The term (Visitor) is appended to your Character Name[*]Cannot give items to other players via Trade[*]Cannot purchase nor sell items via Player Vendors nor Public Vendors[*]No ownership of property nor use of lot signs[*]Cannot interact with public chests[*]Cannot move/interact with items on a plot even if they are given permissions[*]Cannot flag as Open PVP[*]Cannot gain nor do they create any ransom items when they kill or are killed in PVP (in Open PVP zones)[*]Character data may be deleted after Free Trial period is over if character is not upgraded to a paid account[*]Items purchased in the Add On Store cannot be accessed after the Free Trial Period is over unless you purchase Game Access[*]Cannot play in Offline Mode[*]Can only start on the Path of Love[/list]
You can still explore hundreds of scenes, talk with thousands of players, adventure through the opening quests, and gain experience and skills as you get used to the world of New Britannia!

If you wish to continue playing after the free trial concludes, you can obtain an [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=9085&open=shroud_of_the_avatar:_forsaken_virtues__digital_]Early Access account here[/url].

For those in the Free Trial Test, we would love your feedback! We have opened up our [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?categories/release-43.1016/]Release Feedback Forums[/url]. If you have a constructive comment about this release that will help the game to improve, please post it there.

Also be sure to say hello in the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?forums/new-player-welcome.611/]New Player Forum[/url]!

Have fun, and thanks for trying out Shroud of the Avatar in Early Access!

notes.title: Release 43 Patch Notes: July 3, 2017
notes.content:
[list]
 	[*]Incorrectly rotated skeleton in Dragon Bone Crypt has been corrected.[/*]
 	[*]Phineas' documents in Blood River Outskirts were updated.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed missing walls in the Great Hall in Resolute.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed bug that caused target indicators to be invisible after character creation.[/*]
 	[*]More skeletons that were rotated incorrectly in Ravensmoor were corrected.[/*]
 	[*]Sitting animations for dragonfly and butterfly were added.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed corrupted grass textures in Aerie.[/*]
 	[*]Removed obsolete rug in Brookside Tavern[/*]
 	[*]Fixed floating apple in Samael's house in Brookside.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed non-matching bricks in the walls of MIdras Vault.[/*]
 	[*]Set the default state to “on” for the flame table lamp.[/*]
 	[*]Made the Spiked Club and the Long Club able to be placed on walls as decorations.[/*]
 	[*]Updated scales and colliders on Oracle Minions in K'rul.[/*]
 	[*]Updated terrain trees in Mariah Overlook.[/*]
 	[*]Added ceiling decoration layer to Shogun Four-Story Town home 2nd and 3rd floor.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed bad LOD group on exterior of Pristine Gothic Mansion.[/*]
 	[*]Healing Grace VFX now lasts for the duration of the spell and also now appears similar to other healing spells.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed font size for party member location text.[/*]
 	[*]Visual anomalies for the Headless Mask have been corrected.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue that sometimes prevented sheep or cows from appearing in Plans Encounter and Plains Road Encounter.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed camera clipping issues in Graff Gem Mines.[/*]
 	[*]Moved the player spawn-in location at the docks of Celestis away from a pile of boxes.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed the Eye of Naturamans in Blood River Outskirts lack of decoration capabilities, it can now be proudly displayed to keep an eye on things.[/*]
 	[*]Naturamans' skills in Blood River Outskirts were updated.[/*]
 	[*]Holiday 2017 Cloak visual errors were corrected.[/*]
 	[*]Corrected an issue where the gate near the entry point of Battle of Solace Bridge was controlled by switches that weren't active in the scene.[/*]
 	[*]Flame and Thorn Sword VFX trails now better align with curved blades.[/*]
 	[*]Removed all water from basins on devotionals.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed inaccurate collision on trees in Deep Savrenoc Timberland.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed the missing moons in the sky of Deep Savrenoc Timberland.[/*]
 	[*]Correction for cloth simulation and textures on Iron Maiden’s Cloak.[/*]
 	[*]Removed doors on Krishach's escort path in Skrekk.[/*]
 	[*]Oracle Minions in K'rul can now move around correctly.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed collision error on debris inside tavern in Battle of Solace Bridge.[/*]
 	[*]Immolation VFX now last for complete spell duration.[/*]
 	[*]Lenses will now appear where they are supposed to in Path of the Oracle for players on the quest.[/*]
 	[*]Highvale Defender's sword textures were corrected.[/*]
 	[*]Soothing Rain VFX now lasts the entire duration of the spell.[/*]
 	[*]Ornate Moondial VFX culling distances were extended.[/*]
 	[*]Smokeship work-in-progress emote entry should no longer be seen on the emote list.[/*]
 	[*]Added decoration version of virtue balloons.[/*]
 	[*]Updated stools in Celestis to prevent NPCs from sinking while sitting.[/*]
 	[*]Restored moons and weather system clouds to the Celestis sky.[/*]
 	[*]Undead enemies can now be regularly looted.[/*]
 	[*]The housing decoration merchant Albert Lock in Aerie will now properly sell his wares.[/*]
 	[*]Krishach in Skrekk will accept the diplomatic note even if not previously shown to a guard at the front gate.[/*]
 	[*]Daily bonus XP message is now delivered on the chat window.[/*]
 	[*]The dragon spawner in Boreas Colossus was moved out of the water.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed conversation camera angles for the dragon in Boreas Colossus.[/*]
 	[*]Ysaranth the Curious in Boreas Colossus is no longer curiously passive but will fight back appropriately if attacked; you have been warned.[/*]
 	[*]The nomads in the nomad camp of Sequanna Colossus are now somewhat more talkative and may have a clue or two.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]The zombie emote does not produce the expected dance.[/*]
 	[*]Gold values do not update in inventory across accounts on the same client: the value of the first account's gold will be reflected in the second account's gold value. This is only a visual issue.[/*]
 	[*]The Virtue Cloak is visibly broken, and does not look like it should.[/*]
 	[*]Players may experience combat lag when playing in scenes with others.[/*]
 	[*]Swimming in underground scenes like mines or sewers may cause the combat hotbar to become nonfunctional upon exiting the water.[/*]
 	[*]Disabling cloth physics may result in capes/cloaks appearing completely flat, rigid, and disconnected from the Avatar's body[/*]
 	[*]It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.[/*]
 	[*]The dread artifact Heart of Sorrows is currently held awkwardly by avatars.[/*]
 	[*]Attempting to use stealth skills in the vicinity of undead corpses may prevent the spell from working.[/*]
 	[*]Using the /drink or /toast emotes will activate intoxication effects, which results in the Avatar being locked in a walking state for a period of time.[/*]
 	[*]Tabbing between targets may select neutral NPCs. Be wary of nearby non-hostiles if using auto-attack while tabbing![/*]
 	[*]Linux: Adjusting shadows may resize the resolution of the game client.[/*]
 	[*]Interrupting sheet music with another song may result in the music breaking for remote clients listening.[/*]
 	[*]Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.[/*]
 	[*]Ring of Fire VFX will appear distorted when displayed against walls and water surfaces.[/*]
 	[*]Avatars do not go back to idle animations after walking with an instrument being played.[/*]
 	[*]The barrier in Etceter Crag Mines has been removed temporarily, there are issues with the primary puzzle triggering the removal.[/*]
 	[*]Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.[/*]
 	[*]Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.[/*]
 	[*]Not all items listed in R43 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store[/*]
 	[*]Cloaks will often sort through the avatar’s body[/*]
 	[*]Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]

 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]

[/list]

 	[*]Soothing Rain VFX now lasts the entire duration of the spell.[/*]
 	[*]Ornate Moondial VFX culling distances were extended.[/*]
 	[*]Smokeship work-in-progress emote entry should no longer be seen on the emote list.[/*]
 	[*]Added decoration version of virtue balloons.[/*]
 	[*]Updated stools in Celestis to prevent NPCs from sinking while sitting.[/*]
 	[*]Restored moons and weather system clouds to the Celestis sky.[/*]
 	[*]Undead enemies can now be regularly looted.[/*]
 	[*]The housing decoration merchant Albert Lock in Aerie will now properly sell his wares.[/*]
 	[*]Krishach in Skrekk will accept the diplomatic note even if not previously shown to a guard at the front gate.[/*]
 	[*]Daily bonus XP message is now delivered on the chat window.[/*]
 	[*]The dragon spawner in Boreas Colossus was moved out of the water.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed conversation camera angles for the dragon in Boreas Colossus.[/*]
 	[*]Ysaranth the Curious in Boreas Colossus is no longer curiously passive but will fight back appropriately if attacked; you have been warned.[/*]
 	[*]The nomads in the nomad camp of Sequanna Colossus are now somewhat more talkative and may have a clue or two.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]The zombie emote does not produce the expected dance.[/*]
 	[*]Gold values do not update in inventory across accounts on the same client: the value of the first account's gold will be reflected in the second account's gold value. This is only a visual issue.[/*]
 	[*]The Virtue Cloak is visibly broken, and does not look like it should.[/*]
 	[*]Players may experience combat lag when playing in scenes with others.[/*]
 	[*]Swimming in underground scenes like mines or sewers may cause the combat hotbar to become nonfunctional upon exiting the water.[/*]
 	[*]Disabling cloth physics may result in capes/cloaks appearing completely flat, rigid, and disconnected from the Avatar's body[/*]
 	[*]It is currently difficult to find harvest resources in scenes with the Surveying skill. This will be revisited after a VFX review of this system.[/*]
 	[*]The dread artifact Heart of Sorrows is currently held awkwardly by avatars.[/*]
 	[*]Attempting to use stealth skills in the vicinity of undead corpses may prevent the spell from working.[/*]
 	[*]Using the /drink or /toast emotes will activate intoxication effects, which results in the Avatar being locked in a walking state for a period of time.[/*]
 	[*]Tabbing between targets may select neutral NPCs. Be wary of nearby non-hostiles if using auto-attack while tabbing![/*]
 	[*]Linux: Adjusting shadows may resize the resolution of the game client.[/*]
 	[*]Interrupting sheet music with another song may result in the music breaking for remote clients listening.[/*]
 	[*]Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.[/*]
 	[*]Ring of Fire VFX will appear distorted when displayed against walls and water surfaces.[/*]
 	[*]Avatars do not go back to idle animations after walking with an instrument being played.[/*]
 	[*]The barrier in Etceter Crag Mines has been removed temporarily, there are issues with the primary puzzle triggering the removal.[/*]
 	[*]Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.[/*]
 	[*]Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.[/*]
 	[*]Not all items listed in R43 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store[/*]
 	[*]Cloaks will often sort through the avatar’s body[/*]
 	[*]Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Release 43 Patch Notes: June 30, 2017
notes.content:
[list]

 	[*]Blood River Outskirts performance tuning.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed clipping issues with the canvas cot bed.[/*]

 	[*]Changed some of Naturamans' spells in Blood River Outskirts.[/*]
 	[*]The wayward smoke over the Fire Lotus Tavern in Owl's Head has been moved to be above its chimney.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed transparency issues on the Oak Display Cabinets.[/*]
 	[*]Adjusted culling range on the Ornate Kobold Backpack decoration.[/*]
 	[*]Lunar Rift in Isle of Storms tutorial no longer has incorrect tooltips.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a small piece of wood sticking through a blanket on the renaissance bed.[/*]

 	[*]Fires in Blood River no longer have white orbs.[/*]

 	[*]Set “ship smoke” emote to show pipe in hand.[/*]
 	[*]Created sitting variations for the sneeze, burp, belch, and cough emotes.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed room of black furniture in the Epitaph.[/*]
 	[*]Altered the giant mushroom in Blood River Outskirts to stay stationary and still have ranged attacks.[/*]
 	[*]Created a new weapon for the giant mushroom in Blood River Outskirts.[/*]
 	[*]Adjusted Naturamans' skills and added a reward to Phieas in Blood River Outskirts.[/*]
 	[*]Partial fix added for merchants moving during conversations while behind a counter.[/*]
 	[*]Added blocking volumes to prevent escape from map in chess room of Boreas Colossus.[/*]
 	[*]Performance optimization for North Majestic Forest.[/*]
 	[*]Some weapons showed trails all the time, this has been corrected.[/*]
 	[*]Fix for Oracle room door interruptions.[/*]
 	[*]Assassin's Bracers now have the correct display name.[/*]
 	[*]Added LODs to the Golden Ornate Greenhouse 4-Story Row House.[/*]
 	[*]Healing Touch visual effects now move correctly with the avatar.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed error with May-May's journal entry in Kiln.[/*]
 	[*]Missing mailboxes throughout the world were updated.[/*]
 	[*]The animatronic merchant in Soltown can again be used to purchase goods and services.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed ladders in NPC watchtower in Blood River Outskirts that was causing players to fall and die.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed summoned phoenix getting a fake copy at its point of origin.[/*]
 	[*]Disabled distortion effect on Death Ray.[/*]
 	[*]Removed tree growing out of tower in Blood River Outskirts.[/*]
 	[*]Added tooltip text to teleport by statue in Boreas Colossus.[/*]
 	[*]Changed owner of “Ordinis Mortis” player owned town.[/*]
 	[*]Samael's wandering to heal Gawain in Highvale is no longer easily interruptible.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed water elemental attack crash.[/*]
 	[*]Mountain collision in Sequana Colossus updated.[/*]
 	[*]Mideval tunic textures have been updated.[/*]
 	[*]Decreased interact range on valve wheel in Kiln Cistern.[/*]
 	[*]Corrected the scale of garlic nodes in Wyrmsands.[/*]
 	[*]Improved distance leash on elf at back of tent in Battle of Highvale, and adjusted furniture and spawners in tent.[/*]
 	[*]Alberic's dialogue in Blood River Outskirts went missing but has now returned.[/*]
 	[*]A check was put in Marcus' dialogue in Blood River Outskirts to measure knowledge about the elves.[/*]
 	[*]Made the spider lair trigger in Blood River Outskirts much bigger and added directions to the lair in Phineas' conversation and journal entry.[/*]
 	[*]Added missing wood board recipes[/*]
 	[*]Piercing breeze has been modified to be more effective against more targets and also had the buff for the target removed.[/*]
 	[*]Removed collision volumes from equipable papers, scrolls, books, and quills.[/*]
 	[*]Adjusted specular values on textures in the ancient environment assets.[/*]
 	[*]Many white oak trees were updated to correct collision issues.[/*]
 	[*]Deleted terrain and grass clipping onto stone structure in Ardoris.[/*]
 	[*]Performance pass on Hallowed Plains.[/*]
 	[*]Removed an extra sword in Celestis.[/*]
 	[*]Trees on the Plains Road random encounter maps were updated to fix improper collision.[/*]
 	[*]Added a little fence to ledge in Boreas Colossus.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed crashes that can occur when using various skills such as Death Touch.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed persistent buffs not loading correctly when starting the game and entering the first map.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed bug that caused target indicators to be invisible after character creation.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Wearing a Cabalist Robe will disable visuals for equipped gloves/back equipment.[/*]

 	[*]The dread artifact Heart of Sorrows is currently held awkwardly by avatars.[/*]
 	[*]Attempting to use stealth skills in the vicinity of undead corpses may prevent the spell from working.[/*]
 	[*]Using the /drink or /toast emotes will activate intoxication effects, which results in the Avatar being locked in a walking state for a period of time.[/*]
 	[*]Tabbing between targets may select neutral NPCs. Be wary of nearby non-hostiles if using auto-attack while tabbing![/*]
 	[*]Linux: Adjusting shadows may resize the resolution of the game client.[/*]
 	[*]Interrupting sheet music with another song may result in the music breaking for remote clients listening.[/*]
 	[*]Number keys do not activate hotbar skills if set to auto-hide from game settings.[/*]
 	[*]Deleting a character will reset the local settings for the entire client. Other accounts, or offline/online characters will also have their settings reset.[/*]
 	[*]Ring of Fire VFX will appear distorted when displayed against walls and water surfaces.[/*]
 	[*]Avatars do not go back to idle animations after walking with an instrument being played.[/*]
 	[*]The barrier in Etceter Crag Mines has been removed temporarily, there are issues with the primary puzzle triggering the removal.[/*]
 	[*]Some decorations placed in basements may shift through walls and end up in inaccessible locations.[/*]
 	[*]Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.[/*]
 	[*]Not all items listed in R43 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store[/*]
 	[*]Cloaks will often sort through the avatar’s body[/*]
 	[*]Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]

[/list]

notes.title: Release 43 Patch Notes: June 29, 2017
notes.content:
[b]Build Number 617, 6PM[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Magical sparkling dye in secondary dye channel no longer makes the entire Epic Cloth outfit sparkle.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a visual bug in Verdantis Shardfall.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed grass poking through floorboards in Celestis.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed animation bug with falling platforms.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue where the player could get locked into the swimming state preventing them from activating skills.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed some shiny materials from the arctic castle set.[/*]
 	[*]Added weapons and armor to the Brittany merchant for offline, removed recipes from this merchant.[/*]
 	[*]Basement offline prices updated.[/*]
 	[*]The “teleport to” UI now forces the cursor to be shown.[/*]
 	[*]Summer Telethon 2017 balloons are now set up for physics.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed stretching on all fur-mantled cloaks that stretched badly with emotes that raise arms.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed typo in Ebon Dawn speech on death.[/*]
 	[*]Added missing decoration surfaces in Twin Spire Lord of the Manor player home.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed typo in generic crafting trainer conversation.[/*]
 	[*]Light from smelting stations no longer causes beards to turn gray.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed typo in Hyland Xaan conversation in Spite.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed eye bulging during character customization.[/*]
 	[*]Barry the Banker in Owl’s Head no longer refers to NPCs that have moved out of his building. They're dead to him now.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed typo in Jacob Corey conversation.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed wall decoration surface imperfections in the Knight Founder Lighthouse.[/*]
 	[*]Lord Robinson in Resolute now sits on his designated throne as is fitting of a Lord Marshal.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed second-floor stairwell asymmetry in Pristine Gothic Mansion.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed firedancing outfits and coconut bra that changed skin tones.[/*]
 	[*]Various localization corrections.[/*]
 	[*]Can now learn Joseph Sepp's name in Jaanaford.[/*]
 	[*]Removed blank letter from Resolute Sewers.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed typo in /writescroll emote.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed typo in Necropolis journal entry.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed broken keyword hinting for these Ardoris NPCs: Chantik, Sarah, and Caroline Sjolund.[/*]
 	[*]Jumping no longer clears the global cooldown for Rapid Fire.[/*]
 	[*]Arabella's cloak is no longer stiff and stuck to her legs.[/*]
 	[*]Flattened out the decoration version of augmented chainmail leggings.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed ceiling collision in the Grand City Chateau.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed broken keyword hinting for Sequanna in Malice.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed bad ceiling decoration surface in the Lord of the Manor Keep.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed bug that caused hidden tasks to reappear on the HUD when changing scenes.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed levels-of-detail for the small bag decoration.[/*]
 	[*]Bear trap damage area is off by default now.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed lunar rift issues in Highvale.[/*]
 	[*]Disabled cloth physics no longer breaks many capes, turning them into a single rigid body.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a bug that caused the top-right encumbrance icon to disappear when changing scenes.[/*]
 	[*]Updated party member HUD nameplates when changing scenes.[/*]
 	[*]Allowing italics on overworld location names.[/*]
 	[*]Fix for terrain not casting shadows in Dracheninsel.[/*]
 	[*]Resurrection timer now goes away if you change scenes while dead.[/*]

notes.title: Q3 2017 Schedule Update
notes.content:
[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/q3_2017_update_v3-1024x576.jpg[/img]

Greetings Avatars,

As we have stated previously, we intend to publish quarterly schedule updates for our monthly releases. Even though the goals outlined in these schedules are likely to change somewhat as we react to feedback, we feel it is important to periodically provide you with an updated roadmap.

Our priority continues to be to deliver new content to our backers each and every month so that you can give us feedback that will help us iteratively improve Shroud of the Avatar. This collaborative process continues to benefit the game, and often results in sweeping changes such as the upcoming addition of the Outskirts scenes. As you have seen in previous releases, the flexibility inherent to this process means that we sometimes push things out, but we also often pull new things in.

[b]Performance:[/b] One of our biggest priorities for the third quarter will be to improve performance. A significant portion of each release will be spent on improving client stability, framerate, memory usage, and load times.

[b]New User Experience (NUE): [/b]Another large priority for the third quarter will continue to be about improving the new user experience. These efforts will include adding the final two Outskirts maps and polishing the User Interface.

[b]Story Complete: [/b]Our goal is to complete the story no later than the end of Q3 (most of it will actually be done in R44 minus one Outskirts map), so story efforts in Q3 will be focused on finishing the Path of the Oracle (aka the finale) as well as polishing the paths of Truth and Courage (including adding side quests along those two paths), and refining the last two Outskirts map. Since the story will be complete in Q3, we plan to allow all players to make a one-time-only reset of the story status for their character (so they can start fresh with their current character) at some point during Q3.

To repeat what I said in the Q1 post:

[i]“We believe that we have reached the final 20% of development before Commercial Release, at which point we will transition out of Early Access. The next two quarters will be the most exciting and challenging times for the project so far. This will be when we get the final features and content in the game and make the last important balance changes. The changes will be fast and furious, and they may occasionally be hard to understand when you become accustomed to the way things were before. Please trust that we firmly believe that every change we make is best for the long term health of the project.”[/i]

As always, all dates, durations, and deliverables are subject to change as we adjust our designs based on direct feedback from you, our backers.

[b]RELEASE 44, July 27, 2017 [/b]
[list]
 	[*][b]Story: [/b]Polish will continue on the Path of the Oracle (aka the Finale) including work on the Destiny Pool and the Grannus Colossus (which is getting completely rebuilt). This will make the core of the story for Episode 1 complete and playable from beginning to end along all three paths (Truth, Love, and Courage). Blood River Outskirts, the new scene that players start in after Blood River Massacre, will get a polish pass. Also the first three cities along the Path of Truth (Aerie, Vertas, and Jaanaford) will get visual polish passes to better show off the fact that they are cities of Truth and to generally improve visuals (terrain, flora, etc.). Finally some adventure scenes in the northwest regions of Novia will be rebuilt from scratch, including Hallowed Plains.[/*]
[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Bloodriver-Outskirts-2-1024x553.jpg[/img]
 	[*][b]Performance: [/b]Significant focus will continue to be made on performance including stability, framerate, memory, and load times.[/*]
 	[*][b]Player Towns: [/b]Updates to Dynamic Player-Owned Towns that have locked submission forms will appear in the game.[/*]
[*][b]Rent: [/b]Property Owners will be able to add an additional "Tenant" permission for users of their lot and also set those permissions on doors. [/*]
 	[*][b]Combat: [/b]Avatars will be able to wield the Dread Artifacts (Heart of Sorrows, Bone Steel Crown, Scepter of Dread) for the first time and unleash their powers, if they dare. We will also continue our polish pass on all the visual effects related to combat. Additionally work will continue on overall combat balance.[/*]
[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_HeartSorrow-300x209.jpg[/img]
 	[*][b]Character: [/b]We will begin creating Viking-inspired clothing for the NPCs in the Norgard and Verdantis areas of Novia to better define that region, including outfits for Royalty, Guards, Citizens, and Merchants.[/*]
 	[*][b]Looking For Group: [/b]A tool to help players find a group to adventure with will appear in the game.[/*]
 	[*][b]Economy:[/b] Loot on mid-level creatures will be adjusted to be more rewarding while still maintaining game balance.[/*]
[/list]
[b]RELEASE 45, August 31, 2017 [/b]
[list]
 	[*][b]Story: [/b]Highvale Outskirts, a new scene that players start in after the Battle of Highvale Village, will come online for the first time. We will also focus on adding sidequests and polish to the Paths of Truth and Courage. Finally some adventure scenes in the northwest regions of Novia will be rebuilt from scratch, including Longfall Woods.[/*]
[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Highvale-Outskirts-1-1024x560.jpg[/img]
 	[*][b]Performance: [/b]Significant focus will continue to be made on performance including stability, framerate, memory, and load times.[/*]
 	[*][b]Single-Player Offline Combat Balance: [/b]We will adjust and balance combat for play in offline mode with companions.[/*]
 	[*][b]Player Housing: [/b]Players will be able to claim property in Blood Bay, in our first Open PVP housing area. Additionally, updates to Dynamic Player-Owned Towns that have locked submission forms will appear in the game.[/*]
 	[*][b]Combat: [/b]We will continue to polish visual effects related to combat, and we will continue work on overall combat balance.[/*]
 	[*][b]Character: [/b]At least one new creature will appear in the game as well as several new weapons.[/*]
 	[*][b]Crafting: [/b]More recipes and more patterns in gear that is dropped from enemies will appear in game.[/*]
 	[*][b]User Interface Polish: [/b]Time will be spent polishing the user interface.  This will include the ability to separate chat tabs into separate windows.[/*]
[/list]
[b]RELEASE 46, September 28, 2017[/b]
[list]
 	[*][b]Story: [/b]Highvale Outskirts will get a polish pass and the Paths of Truth and Courage will keep growing with additional sidequests. We will also continue rebuilding adventure scenes in the northwest regions of Novia, including Crooked Shank.[/*]
 	[*][b]Performance: [/b]Significant focus will continue to be made on performance including stability, framerate, memory, and load times.[/*]
 	[*][b]Offline Spawning Rules: [/b]The rates and rules for how creatures and resources respawn will be adjusted to work differently in Offline mode so that while some areas (wilderness) can be “farmed” with regular respawns (just like in online mode), and other areas can be cleared/conquered (dungeons and story-related areas).[/*]
 	[*][b]Crafting: [/b]Polish will be done on Agriculture and Fishing including the additions of new skills and functionality like Batch Planting. Additionally the ability to brew and consume Alcohol will come online.[/*]
 	[*][b]Character: [/b]At least one new creature will appear in the game as well as several new weapons.[/*]
[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/SotA_Fishing_Trophies-300x205.jpg[/img]
 	[*][b]Player Housing:[/b] Tools for Player Owned Town Owners will come online to assist with building and maintaining their towns includings a lawn mower. Updates to Dynamic Player-Owned Towns that have locked submission forms will appear in the game.[/*]
 	[*][b]Combat: [/b]We will continue our polish pass on all the visual effects related to combat and continue work on overall combat balance.[/*]
[/list]
We continue to be incredibly thankful for the support we receive from this amazing community. While the funding you provide makes all of this possible, it pales in comparison with the faith you have in us, the feedback you provide us, and the content you are making for everyone to enjoy. We are humbly grateful, and we cannot wait to see you again in New Britannia!

Before I go, I wanted to include an excerpt from my original post about our Early Release Schedule that is important to set the framework for our ongoing schedule:

[i]As a crowd funded and crowd sourced project, we feel it is incredibly important that we provide our backers with information and access well before game studios would normally do so in a traditional development model. Traditionally, the players are given information and access only after the development team has already decided exactly how things will be done, and at times, even after it has already been implemented. By the time the public normally has access to the product, there is usually no time to meaningfully react to the public feedback. Shroud of the Avatar is different than the traditional model, as we intend to offer our backers extremely early access to information and even the game itself.


Our strategy over the next few months is to provide you with focused and iterative releases of content. Your feedback during these releases will be critical to making the final product the best it can be, and we appreciate that you are all so willing to devote your time to helping us.


[b]It is important to note that all dates, durations, and deliverables are subject to change.[/i][/b]

Sincerely,
Starr Long
Executive Producer
Shroud of the Avatar

notes.title: Q3 2017 Schedule Update
notes.content:
[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/06/q3_2017_update_v3-1024x576.jpg[/img]

Greetings Avatars,

As we have stated previously, we intend to publish quarterly schedule updates for our monthly releases. Even though the goals outlined in these schedules are likely to change somewhat as we react to feedback, we feel it is important to periodically provide you with an updated roadmap.

Our priority continues to be to deliver new content to our backers each and every month so that you can give us feedback that will help us iteratively improve Shroud of the Avatar. This collaborative process continues to benefit the game, and often results in sweeping changes such as the upcoming addition of the Outskirts scenes. As you have seen in previous releases, the flexibility inherent to this process means that we sometimes push things out, but we also often pull new things in.

[b]Performance:[/b] One of our biggest priorities for the third quarter will be to improve performance. A significant portion of each release will be spent on improving client stability, framerate, memory usage, and load times.

[b]New User Experience (NUE): [/b]Another large priority for the third quarter will continue to be about improving the new user experience. These efforts will include adding the final two Outskirts maps and polishing the User Interface.

[b]Story Complete: [/b]Our goal is to complete the story no later than the end of Q3 (most of it will actually be done in R44 minus one Outskirts map), so story efforts in Q3 will be focused on finishing the Path of the Oracle (aka the finale) as well as polishing the paths of Truth and Courage (including adding side quests along those two paths), and refining the last two Outskirts map. Since the story will be complete in Q3, we plan to allow all players to make a one-time-only reset of the story status for their character (so they can start fresh with their current character) at some point during Q3.

To repeat what I said in the Q1 post:

[i]“We believe that we have reached the final 20% of development before Commercial Release, at which point we will transition out of Early Access. The next two quarters will be the most exciting and challenging times for the project so far. This will be when we get the final features and content in the game and make the last important balance changes. The changes will be fast and furious, and they may occasionally be hard to understand when you become accustomed to the way things were before. Please trust that we firmly believe that every change we make is best for the long term health of the project.”[/i]

As always, all dates, durations, and deliverables are subject to change as we adjust our designs based on direct feedback from you, our backers.

notes.title: Release 42 Patch Notes: May 31, 2017
notes.content:
[h1]Release 42[/h1]
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 42! How to Play instructions and game update notes on Release 42 are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=72576]here[/url].

[b]May 31, 2017[/b]

[b]Build Number 614, 10:30AM[/b]

[b]Fixes[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Ambient audio effects in South Naryad Pinelands have been fixed.[/*]
 	[*]Audio effects in Ardoris Sewers have been fixed.[/*]
 	[*]A Research Note in Oracle Colossus has had its text updated for spelling errors.[/*]
 	[*]Constellations have been enabled in the Hidden Vale Overworld.[/*]
 	[*]Broken doors have been removed from PvP Castle Arena (Teams) scenes.[/*]
 	[*]Eyeballs will no longer bulge forward and clip through the lower eyelid when settings are at max.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Palisade Gates in Brittany Alleys.[/*]
 	[*]Gaps between platforms in Opalis Ruins have been updated to allow for NPC AI to properly path across.[/*]
 	[*]Conversations will now automatically close if the targeted NPC has a schedule change based on time of day.[/*]
 	[*]The Braids hairstyle on male avatars have been improved to avoid clipping through certain armor types.[/*]
 	[*]Skin color is now consistent when wearing Firedancer Leggings[/*]
 	[*]Root will no longer cause AI leashing behaviors under rare conditions.[/*]
 	[*]Labels for the exits in the Halls of Artifice have been corrected for the Lyceum and the Forge of Hephaestus.[/*]
 	[*]Compass directions have been fixed for the following scenes: Ardoris Sewers, Blackblade Pass, Spectral Mines, Caverns of Skrekk, Valhold Palace, Elysium Mines, Brittany Sewers, Crypt of the Avatar, Verdantis Mines, K'rawl, Serpent's Spine Mines, Owl's Head Sewers, Kingsport Sewers, Solania Catacombs, The Fall, The Clink, Midmaer Passage, Kiln Cistern, and K'rul.[/*]
 	[*]Khary will now reliably recognize when you are ready to move between Harvest and Estgard as part of the Path of Courage questline.[/*]
 	[*]Equipment that alters skin tone (e.g. Ring of Cuttlekin) will no longer cause body parts to disappear completely.[/*]
 	[*]Mail messages/letters can now be stored in chests/containers.[/*]
 	[*]A mailbox has been added to the interior of the bank in Elad's Lighthouse.[/*]
 	[*]Mailboxes in PoT Bank Buildings can now be accessed by residents; not only PoT Owners and Stewards[/*]
 	[*]All letters generated by vendor activity now include the location of the vendor.[/*]
 	[*]Extra doors blocking Decoration Shops have been removed, restoring access.[/*]
 	[*]Resurrect Creature will no longer work to resurrect other players.[/*]
 	[*]Resurrect Creature will now appropriately resurrect dead pets when targeting self.[/*]
 	[*]Avitas's dialogue in Etceter will now clearly indicate what is needed for Passage, as part of the Path of Truth questline.[/*]
 	[*]Edvard's dialogue in Battle of Solace Bridge will appropriately reference the journey to Solace Bridge Outskirts instead of Soltown.[/*]
 	[*]A scavenger hunt letter container has been restored in Brittany Fields.[/*]
 	[*]Audio for a number of runes have been fixed (Light, Dash, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Item Count/Limits for containers will now be visible while stored in a bank.[/*]
 	[*]All generic merchants and trainers should now respond to the "buy" and "train" keywords respectively.[/*]
 	[*]Players that killed the alpha wolf in Solace Bridge Outskirts but couldn't turn in the quest to Filmore the farmer should now be able to talk to him again to clear that task.[/*]

 	[*]Fixed stuck spot in Viking town-sized stronghold player home.[/*]

notes.title: Free Trial Test Starts Now! Runs Thru May 31st
notes.content:
[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=69568][img=//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Free_Trial_610px.png][/img][/url]

We are excited to announce the third test of our Free Trial system, running live now through May 31! This will be the longest test so far of the system so that we can gather even more data on uptake, drop-off, conversions, etc.

If you know anyone who would like to try the game for free, then send them to the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=69568][u]Download page[/u][/url]. These tests are invaluable for us in order to improve the New User Experience and the Free Trial System itself.

Free Trial access during the game’s current Early Access period allows you to play the entire game in any of the Online modes with a few key differences in game play:

[list][*]Free Trial Current Time Period: May 10-31, 2017[*]The term (Visitor) is appended to your Character Name[*]Cannot give items to other players via Trade[*]Cannot purchase nor sell items via Player Vendors nor Public Vendors[*]No ownership of property nor use of lot signs[*]Cannot interact with public chests[*]Cannot move/interact with items on a plot even if they are given permissions[*]Cannot flag as Open PVP[*]Cannot gain nor do they create any ransom items when they kill or are killed in PVP (in Open PVP zones)[*]Character data may be deleted after Free Trial period is over if character is not upgraded to a paid account[*]Items purchased in the Add On Store cannot be accessed after the Free Trial Period is over unless you purchase Game Access[*]Cannot play in Offline Mode[*]Can only start on the Path of Love[/list]
You can still explore hundreds of scenes, talk with thousands of players, adventure through the opening quests, and gain experience and skills as you get used to the world of New Britannia!

If you wish to continue playing after the free trial concludes, you can obtain an [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=9085&open=shroud_of_the_avatar:_forsaken_virtues__digital_]Early Access account here[/url].

For those in the Free Trial, we would love your feedback! We have opened up our [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?categories/release-41.952/]Release 41 Feedback Forums[/url]. If you have a constructive comment about this release that will help the game to improve, please post it there.

Also be sure to say hello in the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?forums/new-player-welcome.611/]New Player Forum[/url]!

Have fun, and thanks for trying out Shroud of the Avatar in Early Access!

notes.title: Release 41 Patch Notes: April 28, 2017
notes.content:
[b]Build Number 595, 10:30AM[/b]

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Fixed bug in Artifice where one of the final task list entries may not be cleared if done out of sequence.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed several typos and missed responses in Artifice and Xenos.[/*]
 	[*]Teleporter mages now have clickable answers in Eastreach Gap when asking whether or not you would like to pay their fee.[/*]
 	[*]NPCs can no longer run through the gate in Verdantis mines.[/*]
 	[*]Meteor Shower now requires a skill of 40 in Fire Flies.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue where pipe smoke VFX was disconnected while sitting.[/*]
 	[*]Katana resting position now animates correctly.[/*]
 	[*]A pass was made on player home and NPC building door sounds to connect proper audio mixers and correct spatial blending.[/*]
 	[*]Cotton Cloth Chest Armor sleeves are back to green color.[/*]
 	[*]Gave pewter plates a similar look to other pewter items.[/*]
 	[*]Updated several chairs to help ensure NPCs sit properly within them.[/*]
 	[*]Stag Hats are now brown instead of black.[/*]
 	[*]Players can no longer get into a bad state by casting a fishing line while jumping.[/*]
 	[*]Darkened skill tooltips background to make them more readable.[/*]
 	[*]Streamlined font settings of skill tooltips for a more appealing aesthetic.[/*]
 	[*]Restored collision to the fallen pillar over lava in Verdantis Mines.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed NPCs improperly leashing when dropping in on NPCs from above.[/*]
 	[*]Added a pit at the back of the prisoner cells in The Fall to allow players to suicide out of a stuck area if a friend cannot free them.[/*]
 	[*]Steel correctly clears the "Gain passage to Xenos" task list entry when ferrying players to Xenos. (Players with this task list entry can remove it by purchasing passage to Xenos from Steel again.)[/*]
 	[*]Many equippable decoration bugs were fixed.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Ant Cloak sorting with cloth torso armors.[/*]
 	[*]Items equipped in the left hand will no longer be put away when sitting in a chair.[/*]
 	[*]Tabs with quantity text on vendor tabs polished.[/*]
 	[*]Localization errors corrected.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed dividers being transparent in right-click menu for decoration permissions.[/*]
 	[*]Darkened the crafting UI background for improved readability.[/*]
 	[*]Improved some of the NPC conversations and journal entries in Solace Bridge Outskirts.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue with Resurrect Creature where it would not resurrect creatures.[/*]
 	[*]Changed Resurrect Creature so experience is only applied when successfully resurrecting a creature.[/*]
 	[*]Entrances into and within Artifice now work correctly.[/*]
 	[*]Removed chair interest from bartender Margot in Jaanaford and assigned random patrol path with emotes.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a bug that prevented tamed creatures from being renamed.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed scrolling overflow bug in Bank Vendor List for "Locate Player Vendor Items”.[/*]
 	[*]Talking while having an offhand weapon equipped will no longer animate the left arm.[/*]
 	[*]Baron's cloak (and other cloaks) now fit properly with bodice and yule bodice.[/*]
 	[*]Players will no longer get quest credit in Solace Bridge Outskirts for killing an Alpha Wolf when they kill a Beta Wolf.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a sideways rug in Ardoris.[/*]
 	[*]Cut back hostile spawners in immediate vicinity of Cyannis in Highvale.[/*]
 	[*]Tweaked respawn rates and max populations for numerous spawn groups in Highvale.[/*]
 	[*]The reticle now shows in the overworld.[/*]
 	[*]Aether Aeronaut Helmet decorations no longer disappear when viewed at a distance.[/*]
 	[*]Darkened the quit UI background.[/*]
 	[*]Harvest town crier once again accepts mail and will reset your current task list.[/*]
 	[*]Emma the barmaid in Soltown will no longer accept Japeth's poem more than once.[/*]
 	[*]The waist of both the Long and Short Skirt Bodices no longer have an uneven edge along the waist.[/*]
 	[*]Buff and debuff timer overlay is now visible.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a typo in Ackerley of Solace Bridge Outskirts conversation.[/*]
 	[*]The Tavern Counter with Gate decoration can now have other decorations placed on it.[/*]

notes.title: The Magnificent Trophy Room Contest Begins!
notes.content:
[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/the-magnificent-trophy-room-contest-begins.87133/][img=https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/trophy_contest.jpg][/img][/url]

Get your houses ready for the most intense contest yet this year! Over the next several weeks, you will have the fun opportunity to show off your hunting heroism, crafting coordination, and trophy triumphs in this new three part contest kicking off today.

[b]PART 1:[/b] Hunt down a creature, kill another player (to get their skull), or catch a fish!

[b]PART 2:[/b] Craft the trophy from that creature (human skulls come as-is, no preparation needed…)

[b]PART 3:[/b] Display your trophy triumphs in a single room of a house you have access too!​

[u][b]WINNERS & PRIZES[/b][/u]

Prizes will be awarded on a tier basis:
[list][*]1st Place: 100 in-game COTOs and three developer skulls of your choice.[*]2nd Place: 50 COTOs and two developer skulls of your choice.[*]Two Runner-ups: 25 COTOs and one developer skull of your choice.[*]All valid entries will receive a custom title in-game (exact title yet to be decided… community suggestions are welcome! Should refer to the contest in some way, and not be a title that we would use for other hunting/trophy purposes.)[/list]
As we receive contest submissions, they will be announced in the forums and on social with eventually a gallery of all submissions put together. Winners will be announced at the start of the Summer Telethon on May 31 around 12:30pm CT.

Read more about the contest and submit your entry [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/the-magnificent-trophy-room-contest-begins.87133/]in the forums[/url]!

notes.title: Free Trial Test Starts Now! From April 6-10
notes.content:
[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=69568][img=//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/Free_Trial_610px.png][/img][/url]

We are excited to open up our second test of the Free Trial System! This latest trial begins now and will end on April 10. If you know anyone who would try the game for free, please send them to the Download Page. These tests are invaluable for us in order to improve the New User Experience (NUE) and the Free Trial System itself.

Free Trial access during the game’s current Early Access period allows you to play the entire game in any of the Online modes with a few key differences in game play:
[list][*]Free Trial Current Time Period: April 6-10, 2017[*]The term (Visitor) is appended to your Character Name[*]Cannot give items to other players via Trade[*]Cannot purchase nor sell items via Player Vendors nor Public Vendors[*]No ownership of property nor use of lot signs[*]Cannot interact with public chests[*]Cannot move/interact with items on a plot even if they are given permissions[*]Cannot flag as Open PVP[*]Cannot gain nor do they create any ransom items when they kill or are killed in PVP (in Open PVP zones)[*]Character data may be deleted after Free Trial period is over if character is not upgraded to a paid account[*]Items purchased in the Add On Store cannot be accessed after the Free Trial Period is over unless you purchase Game Access[*]Cannot play in Offline Mode[/list]
You can still explore hundreds of scenes, talk with thousands of players, adventure through the opening quests, and gain experience and skills as you get used to the world of New Britannia!

If you wish to continue playing after the free trial concludes, you can obtain an [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=9085&open=shroud_of_the_avatar:_forsaken_virtues__digital_]Early Access account here[/url].

For those in the Free Trial, we would love your feedback! We have opened up our [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?categories/release-40.903/]Release 40 Feedback Forums[/url]. If you have a constructive comment about this release that will help the game to improve, please post it there.

Also be sure to say hello in the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?forums/new-player-welcome.611/]New Player Forum[/url]!

Have fun, and thanks for trying out Shroud of the Avatar in Early Access!

notes.title: Release 40 Patch Notes: April 7, 2017
notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 40! How to Play instructions and game update notes on Release 40 are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=70390]here[/url].

[b]April 7, 2017[/b]

[b]Build Number 587, 6:00PM[/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Player Town “Home Shop” decoration building is no longer invisible.[/*]
 	[*]Visual updates to the Wood Duck.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed various server and client exceptions.[/*]
 	[*]Server logging messages were added.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.[/*]
 	[*]Not all items listed in R40 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store[/*]
 	[*]Cover System is not applying to magic spells[/*]
 	[*]Some of the Obsidian Cabalist abilities are still placeholder[/*]
 	[*]Some NPCs are not holding items correctly (mugs, brooms, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Cloaks will often sort through the avatar’s body[/*]
 	[*]Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.[/*]
 	[*]A new Conversation interface has been introduced and may introduce various issues with resolving quests and talking to NPCs.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Lot Deeds cannot be purchased in Offline Mode[/*]
 	[*]Some UI text is not wrapping correctly[/*]
 	[*]Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
 	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
 	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
 	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
 	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
 	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Announcing the Summer Telethon 2017!
notes.content:
[url=https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/summer_telethon_2017_v3.jpg][img=https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/04/summer_telethon_2017_v3.jpg][/img][/url]

Avatars! Get ready to soak up the summer sun with us. Today, we’re announcing the Summer Telethon 2017 Part 1! Telethons are livestreamed on Twitch and include a complete schedule of developer Deep Dives, answers to your gameplay questions, community activities, prize giveaways, sales on items, and more!

[b]Summer “Hot Air” Expirations Sale Begins[/b]

In honor of the waves of hot air that will be blowing over us this summer we are expiring all of our hot air Aeronaut items. At Midnight CST, May 31, 2017 (5:00 UTC, June 1, 2017), we are expiring the following content from the Add On Store (and the in-game Crown Merchants). This means that these items will no longer be available at all after this date.

Before the following items expire for good, we have put them on sale at approx. 20% off*. Check out what’s now on sale:

[list][*]Ornate Black Leather Aeronaut Helmet Pattern Pack (digital)[*]Black & Chrome Ornate Aeronaut Outfit Pattern Pack (digital)[*]Black & Chrome Ornate Aeronaut Outfit (digital)[*]Ornate Black Leather Aeronaut Helmet (digital)[*]Aeronaut Wearable Pack (digital)[*]Aeronaut Hot Air Balloon Pack (digital)[*]Hot Air Balloon (digital)[*]Airship City Home (digital)[*]Star Citizen Aeronaut Helmet Starter Bundle (digital)[*]Star Citizen Airship City Home (digital)[/list]

Check out the complete [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=70648]Summer Telethon Announcement[/url] on the main website that lists prize giveaways, developer deep dives, Q&A, and more. See you on [url=http://www.twitch.tv/shroudoftheavatar]Twitch[/url] on May 31st!

notes.title: Release 40 Patch Notes: April 5, 2017
notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 40! How to Play instructions and game update notes on Release 40 are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=70390]here[/url].

[b]April 5, 2017[/b]

[b]Build Number 585, 12:30PM[/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Fixed bad texture stretching on River Birch SpeedTree trunks on Isle of Storms and elsewhere.[/*]
 	[*]Avatars now play Flame Arrow charge and fire animations while running.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed the position of where avatars sit on chairs.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue with crafted longbow and elven woodwind longbow losing their visuals.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a bug where an avatar's arm is too stiff when attacking with 1-handed blades.[/*]
 	[*]Enemies should no longer get stuck on the fallen tree in Forest Siege overworld entrance.[/*]
 	[*]Instrument and equipped melee weapon no longer both visible while playing instruments.[/*]
 	[*]Prevent lich spawning in Sieges when Cabalists spawn.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue that would prevent players gathering water from a fountain on a lot if fountain was set to private.[/*]
 	[*]The Night Step ability will now be greyed out if the player is over encumbered.[/*]
 	[*]Edvard in Solace Bridge will again prompt you if Charlotte Gray is too far away from you to get credit for saving her.[/*]
 	[*]"Auto Decline Duels" game option no longer requires a map change to be recognized.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue that could allow players to access restricted homes via resurrection ankh.[/*]
 	[*]Added bottom-floor decoration surfaces to the Lord houseboat town-sized player house.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed non-textured desert backdrop mountains in scenes throughout Novia and Hidden Vale.[/*]
 	[*]Remote game clients no longer lose combat functionality after being stunned.[/*]
 	[*]Robert Villines in Blood River will no longer try to speak to you and end the sequence while you are still in combat.[/*]
 	[*]Artifact instruments will no longer break stealth.[/*]
 	[*]While work continues on the New User Experience, help entries now display more text in old-style windows to be less intrusive or overwhelming.[/*]
 	[*]MML song files can now be heard and observed by remote players.[/*]
 	[*]Whirling Blades plays the correct animation for 2-handed swords again.[/*]
 	[*]Target selection and leashing improved.[/*]
 	[*]Main menu and character screen backgrounds have been updated.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed flora in Artifice Entrance map to prevent it from rendering completely black on initial map load.[/*]
 	[*]Corrected errors with player town Magic Shop NPC buildings.[/*]
 	[*]After auto-declining a duel you can now participate in another duel.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Chaotic Clone is not distracting enemies.[/*]
 	[*]Not all items listed in R40 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store[/*]
 	[*]Cover System is not applying to magic spells[/*]
 	[*]Some of the Obsidian Cabalist abilities are still placeholder[/*]
 	[*]Some NPCs are not holding items correctly (mugs, brooms, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Cloaks will often sort through the avatar’s body[/*]
 	[*]Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.[/*]
 	[*]A new Conversation interface has been introduced and may introduce various issues with resolving quests and talking to NPCs.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Lot Deeds cannot be purchased in Offline Mode[/*]
 	[*]Some UI text is not wrapping correctly[/*]
 	[*]Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
 	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
 	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
 	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
 	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
 	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
[/list]
