notes.title: Q2 2017 Schedule Update
notes.content:
[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/q2_update_header-1024x576.jpg[/img]

Greetings Avatars,

As we have stated previously, we intend to publish quarterly schedule updates for our monthly releases. Even though the goals outlined in these schedules are likely to change somewhat as we react to feedback, we feel it is important to periodically provide you with an updated roadmap.

Our priority continues to be to deliver new content to our backers each and every month so that you can give us feedback that will help us iteratively improve Shroud of the Avatar. This collaborative process continues to benefit the game, and often results in sweeping changes such as the upcoming addition of the Outskirts scenes. As you have seen in previous releases, the flexibility inherent to this process means that we sometimes push things out, but we also often pull new things in.

[b]New User Experience (NUE): [/b]A large priority for the second quarter is going to be improving the new user experience. For several years now, our backers have been providing us feedback that the first few hours of our game have several major issues. Those issues include too many loading screens, scenes that are too small, overloading the user with too many options, and starting towns that include player housing/vendors. As we shift our focus to improving the New User Experience, and as we are able to measure new player progress during events such as our recent free trial, we realize that we must address these issues sooner rather than later.

As we announced during the Spring Telethon, one of our solutions to these issues is to add three new maps to the game that we are calling "Outskirts." These scenes will be very close to the three starting scenes, and players will go directly there after finishing those starting scenes. Outskirts will be very large scenes, similar in scope to some of the recently added big scenes like Blood Bay. Each Outskirt scene will have a small outpost that will include some shopkeepers, trainers, crafting stations, and a few quest givers (and no player housing!). The scenes will also include plenty of adventuring areas (forests, ruins, bandit camps, etc.). The large scale of the Outskirts, as well as the variety of experiences and services that they provide, will allow new players to base themselves in a single scene for adventuring and resupply for their first couple of hours of gameplay without needing to go through multiple loading screens or needing to use the Overworld.

In addition to Outskirts, we plan to improve the new user experience by delaying more advanced features until later in the game (which we began doing in Release 40). We also plan to implement Contextual Help, Improved Tutorial Systems, and a Polished Skill Training Interface.[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/03/Solace-Bridge-Outskirts-2-1024x530.jpg[/img]

[b]Polish: [/b]In addition to the focus on the first few hours of gameplay, Q2 will include a lot of work on polishing the overall experience of playing [u]Shroud of the Avatar[/u]. A large focus of this work will be on performance and stability, which is why you may see fewer new features than in previous quarters as you scan the list below. However, we will be adding some new features that are aimed at polishing the game. These include Mail, Looking for Group, and a Raid System. Additionally, continual passes will be made each release to address overall balance issues, especially in the first few hours of game play.

[b]Story Complete:[/b] Our goal is to complete the story by Release 44 (July), so story efforts in Q2 will be focused on bringing the Paths of Truth and Courage to a playable and polished state. We also plan to unveil the game’s Finale. Since the story will be complete in R44, we plan to allow all players to make a one-time-only reset of the story status for their character (so they can start fresh with their current character) in Release 44 (July).

To repeat what I said in the Q1 post:

[i]“We believe that we have reached the final 20% of development before Commercial Release, at which point we will transition out of Early Access. The next two quarters will be the most exciting and challenging times for the project so far. This will be when we get the final features and content in the game and make the last important balance changes. The changes will be fast and furious, and they may occasionally be hard to understand when you become accustomed to the way things were before. Please trust that we firmly believe that every change we make is best for the long term health of the project.”[/i]

As always, all dates, durations, and deliverables are subject to change as we adjust our designs based on direct feedback from you, our backers.

[b]RELEASE 41, April 27, 2017[/b]
[list]
 	[*][b]Story: [/b]We will begin polishing the Path of Truth with the Dungeon of Artifice coming online for the first time. We will also polish visuals of the final sequence with the Titan Grannus in the Path of Courage. The incidental NPCs and side quests along the Path of Courage will also be worked on in locations like Estgard and Harvest. Verdantis Mines and the Kas Ruins scenes will both be uncloned. The Fall, a new PvP dungeon underneath Blood Bay, will appear in the game. Solace Bridge Outskirts, a new scene that players start in after the Battle of Solace Bridge will come online for the first time.[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/Hall-of-Wealth-Without-Limits_03a-1024x551.jpg[/img][/*]
 	[*][b]Performance: [/b]Significant focus will be made on performance this release with emphasis on stability, framerate, memory, and load times.[/*]
 	[*][b]Player Towns & Player Housing: [/b]Updates to Dynamic Player-Owned Towns that have locked submission forms will appear in the game. Additionally Shields, Tools, and Helmets will become place-able as decorations.[/*]
 	[*][b]Combat: [/b]We will continue our polish pass on all the visual effects related to combat as well as make major improvements to the new user experience with combat.[/*]
 	[*][b]Character:[/b] The Titan Grannus will get his own unique art for the first time. Wounded variations of our guards and soldiers will appear in game. We will also be polishing the medieval peasants.[/*]
 	[*][b]Contextual Help: [/b]A contextual help system will come online that allows players to hover over content (interface elements, items, etc.) in the game and get information about it.[/*]
 	[*][b]Game Balance: [/b]Major efforts will be devoted towards game balance.[/*]
 	[*][b]Crafting:[/b] More recipes and more patterns in gear that is dropped from enemies.[/*]
[/list]
[b]RELEASE 42, May 25, 2017[/b]
[list]
 	[*][b]Story: [/b]We will do final polish on the Path of Truth including incidental NPCs and side quests in areas like Xenos and Etceter. We will polish visuals of the final sequence with Titan Boreas in the Path of Truth. Highvale Outskirts, a new scene that players start in after the Battle of Highvale Village, will come online for the first time.[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Xenos-Subpost-V_14-1024x549.jpg[/img][/*]
 	[*][b]Player Housing: [/b]Updates to Dynamic Player-Owned Towns that have locked submission forms will appear in the game.[/*]
 	[*][b]Combat: [/b]We will continue our polish pass on all the visual effects related to combat.[/*]
 	[*][b]Character: [/b]The Titans Sequanna and Boreas, as well as Arabella, will get their own unique visuals. We will also do some polish work on Player Customization.[/*]
 	[*][b]Crafting: [/b]More recipes and more patterns in gear that is dropped from enemies.[/*]
 	[*][b]Raid System:[/b] Tools will come online for large groups, and groups of groups, to go on adventures together.[/*]
 	[*][b]Looking For Group: [/b]A tool to help players find a group to adventure with will appear in the game.[/*]
[/list]
[b]RELEASE 43, June 29, 2017[/b]
[list]
 	[*][b]Story: [/b]Polish will begin on the Finale of the plot including work on the Destiny Pool and the Oracle Chamber. Blood River Outskirts, a new scene that players start in after Blood River Massacre, will come online for the first time.[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/08/New-Desolis-19-Pool-of-Destiny-02-1024x554.jpg[/img][/*]
 	[*][b]Character:[/b] The Oracle herself will appear for the first time in the game as will the Shroud of the Avatar. We will be doing polish work on various creatures in the game, such as the Troll. We will also begin creating Viking-inspired clothing for the NPCs in the Norgard and Verdantis areas of Novia to better define that region, including outfits for Royalty, Guards, Citizens, and Merchants.[/*]
 	[*][b]Performance: [/b]Significant focus will be made on performance this release with emphasis on stability, framerate and load times.[/*]
 	[*][b]Bug Fixes and Game Balance: [/b]Much of this release will be spent on fixing bugs and balancing game systems.[/*]
 	[*][b]Mail: [/b]Players will be able to send mail to each other through an in-game interface.[/*]
 	[*][b]Offline Combat and Economy Balance: [/b]A pass will be made through the game to adjust combat balance for play in offline mode with companions. Additionally, the economy in offline mode will be tuned to be better balanced for single-player. For instance, NPC merchants will buy player-crafted items at a profit to the player. Also, pledge and Add-On Store items will be available from NPC merchants for purchase with in-game gold.[/*]
 	[*][b]Player Housing:[/b] Updates to Dynamic Player-Owned Towns that have locked submission forms will appear in the game. Additionally the ability to rent rooms in a player home will start to become available to homeowners.[/*]
[/list]
We continue to be incredibly thankful for the support we receive from this amazing community. While the funding you provide makes all of this possible, it pales in comparison with the faith you have in us, the feedback you provide us, and the content you are making for everyone to enjoy. We are humbly grateful, and we cannot wait to see you again in New Britannia!

Before I go, I wanted to include an excerpt from my original post about our Early Release Schedule that is important to set the framework for our ongoing schedule:

[i]"As a crowd funded and crowd sourced project, we feel it is incredibly important that we provide our backers with information and access well before game studios would normally do so in a traditional development model. Traditionally, the players are given information and access only after the development team has already decided exactly how things will be done, and at times, even after it has already been implemented. By the time the public normally has access to the product, there is usually no time to meaningfully react to the public feedback.
Shroud of the Avatar is different than the traditional model, as we intend to offer our backers extremely early access to information and even the game itself. With that said, we also want to be very careful that we only provide access to portions of the game when they are ready for a wider range of feedback. If we can play it internally and we know it is not ready, then there is nothing to be gained by having a wider audience come to the same conclusion. In fact, it could be quite damaging to do so.

Our strategy over the next few months is to provide you with focused and iterative releases of content. Your feedback during these releases will be critical to making the final product the best it can be, and we appreciate that you are all so willing to devote your time to helping us. After each release we will review the results and reevaluate the plan including the duration of availability of each release.


[b]It is important to repeat that all dates, durations, and deliverables are subject to change.​"[/b][/i]

Sincerely,
Starr Long
Executive Producer
Shroud of the Avatar

notes.title: Release 40 Patch Notes: March 30, 2017
notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 40! How to Play instructions and game update notes on Release 40 are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=70390]here[/url].

[b]March 30, 2017[/b]

[b]Build Number 577, 1:15PM
[/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Male and female Cabalist wearable robes are now fitted correctly.[/*]
 	[*]Eye bulge clipping during character creation has been fixed.[/*]
 	[*]Missing collision on palisade walls in Kingsport has been added.[/*]
 	[*]High-level creature weapon loot added.[/*]
 	[*]Kobold Champion in Skrekk Test of Courage instance now displays the proper nameplate.[/*]
 	[*]Kobolds in Skrekk should now make some noise.[/*]
 	[*]Adjusted collision for elven greenhouse to allow for more lenient decoration placement inside.[/*]
 	[*]Ghost Corpion is transparent again.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a bug that caused hints and help messages in the chat window to appear in the wrong order.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a decoration wall surface in Stone 2-story Keep w/ Corner Turret village home, decorations no longer go through wall.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Kobold Statue level-of-detail meshes.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed stray geometry crashing through ceiling in Owl's Head NPC Building.[/*]
 	[*]Added a context menu option to clear a locked glyph in the combat hotbar.[/*]
 	[*]Female avatar legs no longer disappear if wearing leg armor along with the Short Skirted Satin Bodice.[/*]
 	[*]Ornate Elven Longbow shaft is no longer rotated incorrectly when equipped.[/*]
 	[*]Walls now block the camera correctly in the Wizard Tower.[/*]
 	[*]Founders Cloaks no longer appears all white.[/*]
 	[*]Male-avatar hand finger-spacing was updated.[/*]
 	[*]Turned shadowcasting off on windows of Greenhouse deco.[/*]
 	[*]Playing sheet music from the chat command /play now works properly.[/*]
 	[*]Shadow will no longer be rendered while stealthed.[/*]
 	[*]Duck models updated.[/*]
 	[*]Brown Suede Sofa sitting position was updated to not sit so far forward.[/*]
 	[*]Grammar fixes for some task list entries.[/*]
 	[*]Ornate Elven Mage staff is now usable as a decoration.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed stair ramp colliders in Viking two story stronghold village home.[/*]
 	[*]In the Battle of Highvale, Edvard no longer stands as close to the gate (thus fixing conversation issues in some situations)[/*]
 	[*]In the Battle of Highvale, Nena's initial request correctly registers as a task.[/*]
 	[*]Avatars can once again talk with NPCs that have a required response.[/*]
 	[*]Lord Demig is no longer invisible in Caverns of Skrekk.[/*]
 	[*]Introduced new guard models for Ferig and Demign[/*]
 	[*]NPC in Harvest now holds his staff correctly.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed airship wheel that was missing a material in Blood Bay.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue where on-and-off states for Geometric Stained Glass Floor Lamps did not affect level-of-detail meshes.[/*]
 	[*]Made on-and-off states more obvious for Frosted Glass Floor Lamps.[/*]
 	[*]The player is no longer stopped when talking.[/*]
 	[*]Carved Oak Furniture recipes are now teachable.[/*]
 	[*]Scrolling the camera all the way in no longer blurs the screen.[/*]
 	[*]Missing icons for pavers, fountains, and other decorations added.[/*]
 	[*]Fixes for some transparent grass.[/*]
 	[*]Adjusted a few crafted item values based on ingredient cost.[/*]
 	[*]The Obsidian Crown Alchemist merchant in Aerie no longer goes off duty.[/*]
 	[*]The Fishing Supply Merchant in Brittany Fields by the docks will no longer run back and forth haphazardly.[/*]
 	[*]Most merchants in Brittany Fields now have a small-but-comfortable wander area.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed interaction on door in Brittany Sewers.[/*]
 	[*]Corrected compass orientation in Brittany Sewers and several other underground scenes.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed some ladders sometimes not being able to be traversed by NPCs and pets.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed missing Vile Shield mesh.[/*]
 	[*]In Harvest, the names of Aldis Adisson and Dagmar, Bjorn's Wife, now correctly update after you learn them.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed player being blown through wall from rockslide in Serpent's Spine Mines.[/*]

notes.title: Release 39 Patch Notes: February 24, 2017
notes.content:
Another game patch has made its way to Release 39! In addition to the patch notes, How to Play instructions on this release are available at [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=32989]shroudoftheavatar's website[/url].

[b]Build Number 563, 7:30 PM CST[/b][list] 	[*]Modified handle on lich axe to be straight so it matches other axes.[/*] 	[*]In Blood River, Edvard gives clearer instructions when greeted without a sword.[/*] 	[*]Improved flow of journal/task entries in Blood River when Edvard asks you to find the bonesteel dagger.[/*] 	[*]Fingers Slate no longer gives incorrect directions in Blood River when greeted without a sword.[/*] 	[*]Combat effects now require line of sight in more situations.[/*] 	[*]Chaotic Clone now correctly copies the caster's body.[/*] 	[*]Umbrella now stays equipped while performing sit emote.[/*] 	[*]Trails in VFX will no longer be left behind when the effect ends.[/*] 	[*]Ant and Ants cloaks no longer hover over shoulders.[/*] 	[*]Unnamed blacksmith supplier in Ardoris now has a proper name.[/*] 	[*]Minerva in Aerie no longer wanders into her own cooking fire only to die horribly.[/*] 	[*]Simone von Eglinger in Ardoris now properly gives feedback when her quest is finished.[/*] 	[*]Emma in Soltown will properly highlight when participating in Japeth's poem quest.[/*] 	[*]Fixed inaccurate Points of Interest in Blood River.[/*] 	[*]When the Broadcast Automated Phonograph is empty the music now defaults to built-in scene music[/*] 	[*]Avatars will no longer turn back around when getting up from chairs.[/*] 	[*]Glowing White Dye on Epic Cloth Armor has been toned downed.[/*] 	[*]Removed mesh collider from  general bust deco so that it can be placed at any rotation.[/*] 	[*]An issue that may have prevented renaming some NPC pets or summons has been corrected.[/*] 	[*]Ardoris navmesh updated.[/*] 	[*]ChainLighting, Discharge, EarthQuake, Lighting, and Obsidian Arrow have had their damage bonus for Str or Dex moved from being linear to being based on the Sqrt of the value, like most other elements.  The change in math will mean that those with a Strength under 100 for Earth spells or Dexterity under 100 for Air skills will see an increase in damage.  Those with stats over 100 will see diminishing returns on damage bonus.[/*] 	[*]Corrected an error with dramatic ambient music not turning off when required.[/*] 	[*]Fixed a stuck spot in Upper Fortus.[/*] 	[*]Multishot improvements: after significant play testing, multishot is finally getting a much needed rework.  Previously it picked up to 8 targets in the forward arc and each had a 75% chance to get hit by one full damage arrow.  The new version picks up to 8 targets in the forward arc and each will get hit 0-3 arrows, on average, each will get hit by 2 arrows and each will do 75% of melee damage. The net result is on no armor targets, this will double the effective damage.  On high armor targets, this will likely still do significantly more damage.  To compensate for the significant improvement in power of this shot, the cool down time is being moved from 6/12 to 10/20.  Also, Arrow usage chance is now 12 but now Ammo Scavenger chance will apply to help reduce arrows.  Previously it did not.[/*] 	[*]Fixed mask on female avatar during Macarena animation to fix upper body.[/*] 	[*]Discharge and Lightning sounds linked to sliders.[/*] 	[*]Shogun home lights and other SFX added.[/*] 	[*]Watcher enemy electricity attack now linked to volume slider.[/*] 	[*]Fixed a Central Brittany stuck spot.[/*] 	[*]Fine oak furniture updates.[/*] 	[*]Made sure Village Lot in Spite was at the proper ground level.[/*] 	[*]Healing spells SFX updated.[/*] 	[*]The old poison potion will now work as a consumable to poison your weapon.  To use it, just put it in your combat bar or utility bar.[/*] 	[*]Added two Chaos resurrection icons along the Upper Fortus river, and added several ladders and stairs in the bandit town to help them navigate their home[/*] 	[*]Fixed a minor error with the Upper Foruts elevator.[/*] 	[*]Crafted items with material overrides will now render correctly when equipped in the left hand.[/*] 	[*]Spawning from lunar rifts now uses the correct animation[/*] 	[*]Auto attack will only attack a breakable until it is broken.[/*] 	[*]Darkstarr Blood and Clasped Gauntlets cloaks no longer have missing override materials[/*] 	[*]Apply pooled experience to Poison Weapon when a Poison Potion is used.[/*] 	[*]Brittany Fields bed are no longer out-of-reach.[/*] 	[*]Castle Stone Arena Basement and Keep Stone Arena Basement now have lamps in the stairwells and entrances turned on by default.[/*] 	[*]A fix for the female avatar magic dance.[/*] 	[*]K'Kong stats corrected and giving a more worthy loot bundle.[/*] 	[*]Improved combat text performance.[/*] 	[*]Stealing from the stall in Kiln will now be considered a crime and adversely affect one's Virtue.[/*][/list]

notes.title: Release 39 Patch Notes: February 24, 2017
notes.content:
Another game patch has made its way to Release 39! In addition to the patch notes, How to Play instructions on this release are available at [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=32989]shroudoftheavatar's website[/url].

[b]Build Number 561, February 24, 2017 at 12:00 PM[/b]
[*]Added sound effect to Gated Green Leaf  Box Hedge Fence.
[*]Fixed bug that caused a glyph to get stuck in a slot in the deck building interface.
[*]Fixed an error during equip item via context menu.
[*]Fixed an error during salvage that could occur if multiple salvageable items were placed on the crafting station.
[*]Corpse explosion no longer affects breakable objects.
[*]Updated some weapon icons.
[*]Now using the bounds center rather than adding the y-extent for interactive reticles.
[*]Linked audio with the proper mixers in K’rul.
[*]Fixed issues with the “More…” dialog prompt where it would often display incorrectly. Also, the “More…” dialog prompt no longer blocks input.
[*]Can now progress Path of Love past Crypt of the Avatar if player has Samael in their party and chooses to speak to Miles Shepard instead of Eris.
[*]Fixed issue where targeting some NPCs shows the blue crosshair at their feet.
[*]Fixed seam in the interior of NPC building in Brittany Alleys.
[*]Fixed bad LODs on bell tower in Brittany.
[*]Fixed collision on Ardoris castle stairs to allow for cleaner navmesh baking.
[*]Fixed a typo in concept art rug name.
[*]Made collision shorter on Medium Ivy Covered Stone Fence deco to prevent floating stacked decorations.
[*]Added cutouts in collision of gothic water mansion bridge arches to allow players to swim through them.
[*]Changed name from Roadway to Walkway for new paver recipes.
[*]Fixed a stuck spot on doorways of baron benefactor home.
[*]Fixed colliders on Epic Bamboo cluster decorative tree to make it able to be placed.
[*]Weapon and armor procs no longer initiate global cooldown.
[*]Adjusted LOD ranges on table top elder bush.
[*]Recipe names in the recipe book can now wrap to a second line in order to be more legible.
[*]Reduced the wood rewards from catapult engineers
[*]Fixed gap between wall and doorway frame on front door of the obsidian city sized keep.
[*]Fire VFX now correctly aligned on wands when ignited.
[*]Fixed candle VFX LOD distances – also made candles look better with better performance.
[*]Moved Ardoris Crown Merchant to bank area.
[*]Moved Ardoris blacksmith near crafting pavilion.
[*]Removed dynamic Doe spawners in an Ardoris pond.
[*]Swapped out non-interactive book on counter in Ardoris “New You Salon” for a new one with unique text.
[*]Collision on several Brittany Fields buildings has been updated, allowing beds and other interactives within them to be used.
[*]Fix for patterns in character sheet and on remote players.
[*]Fixed duplicate skill records.
[*]Fixed a spelling mistake in the Pax Ring Artifact description.
[*]Imported correct quill for the “reading” emote on male avatar to align pivot.
[*]Added several lights in K’rul that toggle on when hatch is opened via switch.
[*]Lighting the North Drachvald Spur signal tower’s fire will catch the attention of powerful enemies and draw them to the tower.
[*]Replaced temporary Novia collision along the shore from Ardoris to south of [*]Brightbone Pass with collision that better follows the shoreline.
[*]Changed Player Town name from Silverston to Knight’s Watch.
[*]Preventing patterns from being consumed on reshape failure.
[*]Removed colliders from equipable quill, book, and paper.
[*]Fixing NPC animations during use of instruments.
[*]Lute SFX updated to lower octave.
[*]Updated bagpipes SFX notes and tone.
[*]Fixed floating items in Brittany Fields and architecture poling through gole on a hut.
[*]The “Reclining Figure Relief” decoration now has the correct icon (not a bucket).
[*]Changed the display name of “Cobblestone Roadway Pavers” and “Rough [*]Stone Roadway Pavers” to “Cobblestone Walkway Pavers” and “Rough Stone Walkway Pavers”.
[*]Fixed bugs in Brittany Central involving missing flora, LODs, and seams and gaps in floor pieces in Brittany Castle and Brittany Docks.
[*]Fix for practice dummies not taking damage from attacks.
[*]Weapon icon for Vile Falchion updated.

notes.title: Release 39 Patch Notes: February 24, 2017
notes.content:
Another game patch has made its way to Release 39! In addition to the patch notes, How to Play instructions on this release are available at [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=32989]shroudoftheavatar's website[/url].

[b]Build Number 561, February 24, 2017 at 12:00 PM[/b]
[*]Added sound effect to Gated Green Leaf  Box Hedge Fence.
[*]Fixed bug that caused a glyph to get stuck in a slot in the deck building interface.
[*]Fixed an error during equip item via context menu.
[*]Fixed an error during salvage that could occur if multiple salvageable items were placed on the crafting station.
[*]Corpse explosion no longer affects breakable objects.
[*]Updated some weapon icons.
[*]Now using the bounds center rather than adding the y-extent for interactive reticles.
[*]Linked audio with the proper mixers in K’rul.
[*]Fixed issues with the “More…” dialog prompt where it would often display incorrectly. Also, the “More…” dialog prompt no longer blocks input.
[*]Can now progress Path of Love past Crypt of the Avatar if player has Samael in their party and chooses to speak to Miles Shepard instead of Eris.
[*]Fixed issue where targeting some NPCs shows the blue crosshair at their feet.
[*]Fixed seam in the interior of NPC building in Brittany Alleys.
[*]Fixed bad LODs on bell tower in Brittany.
[*]Fixed collision on Ardoris castle stairs to allow for cleaner navmesh baking.
[*]Fixed a typo in concept art rug name.
[*]Made collision shorter on Medium Ivy Covered Stone Fence deco to prevent floating stacked decorations.
[*]Added cutouts in collision of gothic water mansion bridge arches to allow players to swim through them.
[*]Changed name from Roadway to Walkway for new paver recipes.
[*]Fixed a stuck spot on doorways of baron benefactor home.
[*]Fixed colliders on Epic Bamboo cluster decorative tree to make it able to be placed.
[*]Weapon and armor procs no longer initiate global cooldown.
[*]Adjusted LOD ranges on table top elder bush.
[*]Recipe names in the recipe book can now wrap to a second line in order to be more legible.
[*]Reduced the wood rewards from catapult engineers
[*]Fixed gap between wall and doorway frame on front door of the obsidian city sized keep.
[*]Fire VFX now correctly aligned on wands when ignited.
[*]Fixed candle VFX LOD distances – also made candles look better with better performance.
[*]Moved Ardoris Crown Merchant to bank area.
[*]Moved Ardoris blacksmith near crafting pavilion.
[*]Removed dynamic Doe spawners in an Ardoris pond.
[*]Swapped out non-interactive book on counter in Ardoris “New You Salon” for a new one with unique text.
[*]Collision on several Brittany Fields buildings has been updated, allowing beds and other interactives within them to be used.
[*]Fix for patterns in character sheet and on remote players.
[*]Fixed duplicate skill records.
[*]Fixed a spelling mistake in the Pax Ring Artifact description.
[*]Imported correct quill for the “reading” emote on male avatar to align pivot.
[*]Added several lights in K’rul that toggle on when hatch is opened via switch.
[*]Lighting the North Drachvald Spur signal tower’s fire will catch the attention of powerful enemies and draw them to the tower.
[*]Replaced temporary Novia collision along the shore from Ardoris to south of [*]Brightbone Pass with collision that better follows the shoreline.
[*]Changed Player Town name from Silverston to Knight’s Watch.
[*]Preventing patterns from being consumed on reshape failure.
[*]Removed colliders from equipable quill, book, and paper.
[*]Fixing NPC animations during use of instruments.
[*]Lute SFX updated to lower octave.
[*]Updated bagpipes SFX notes and tone.
[*]Fixed floating items in Brittany Fields and architecture poling through gole on a hut.
[*]The “Reclining Figure Relief” decoration now has the correct icon (not a bucket).
[*]Changed the display name of “Cobblestone Roadway Pavers” and “Rough [*]Stone Roadway Pavers” to “Cobblestone Walkway Pavers” and “Rough Stone Walkway Pavers”.
[*]Fixed bugs in Brittany Central involving missing flora, LODs, and seams and gaps in floor pieces in Brittany Castle and Brittany Docks.
[*]Fix for practice dummies not taking damage from attacks.
[*]Weapon icon for Vile Falchion updated.

notes.title: Release 39 Patch Notes: February 23, 2017
notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 39! How to Play instructions and game update notes on Release 39 are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=69175]here[/url].

[b]February 23, 2017[/b]

[b]Build Number 559, 5:00 PM[/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Modified handle on Lich axe to better fit avatar grip[/*]
 	[*]High Tier Elven Mages now drop Elven Staff[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue with stealthing effects and using the /visible command.[/*]
 	[*]Removed duration from Dig In tool tip display[/*]
 	[*]Fixed various exceptions[/*]
 	[*]Added Post and Rope Water Fence to Water Home Crown Merchant[/*]
 	[*]More weapons added to high level enemies including Vile Falchion, Norgard Spatha, Kobold Chain Swords, etc.[/*]
 	[*]Recipes for Greco / Roman decorations[/*]
 	[*]Fixed naming incosistancy between potion and recipe for Potion of Restoration, Imbued[/*]
 	[*]Added "Highlight Quest NPCs" option[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue with umbrella's open state for remote players.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed various sounds that were not connected to the volume controls including wind, crickets, owls, frogs, leaky pipes, running water, water wheels, fire, city noises, swinging signs, looting sound, and tree chopping.[/*]
 	[*]Removed no trade flag from R38 raffle tickets[/*]
 	[*]Abigail in Soltown will now properly show as an active quest NPC if Charlotte has been saved in Solace Bridge.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an issue with weapon trails showing up when they shouldn't.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed collider on K'konng so he can't run through small doors anymore[/*]
 	[*]Expired Glyphs lo longer have cooldowns applied. Fixed issue where discarded runes would not get recycled back into the hand.[/*]
 	[*]Added short bow to blacksmith in Soltown for quest reasons[/*]
 	[*]Gust no longer affects dead characters.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed inconsistencies with Guard Abe's dialog in Ardoris[/*]
 	[*]Added locked target indicator on nameplates[/*]
 	[*]Night vision now correctly modifies the ambient light levels.[/*]
 	[*]Summoning a phoenix no longer causes an error.[/*]
 	[*]PoT Magic Merchant Female is no longer invisible[/*]
 	[*]Create diversity for new roaming shopkeeper clothes - applied new materials with different colors to wealthy merchant prefabs[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Poison Weapon skill advancement[/*]
 	[*]Beauty pass on poison weapon trail[/*]
 	[*]Fire weapon trail fixes[/*]
 	[*]Elysian Illumination - fixed problem with rune[/*]
 	[*]Elysian Illumination beauty pass - effect no longer resembles a giant cloud of urine[/*]
 	[*]Pipe smoke now appears in front of player's head instead of behind[/*]
 	[*]Added a recipe to high end loot table.[/*]
 	[*]Aerie: Fixed the chairs at (-154.3, 30.7, 262.9) so characters can sit in them.[/*]
 	[*]Ardoris: Fixed issues with lovers at (117.4, 53.3, -273.2)[/*]
 	[*]Blackblade Foothills, East Vauban Foothills, Northwest Blackblade Mountains, Rumor Peaks, Spectral Peaks, Verdantis Foothills, North Varisalla Foothills: Fixed the climbable rope at (-132.3, 55.3, -165.1) so players can climb all the way up.[/*]
 	[*]Brittany Estates: The stool used in the tavern at (150.1, 78.0, 423.8) now seats characters properly.[/*]
 	[*]Brittany Fields: Fixed beds that weren't accessible.[/*]
 	[*]Brittany Fields: Fixed the collision for the building at (25.7, 42.8, 258.0), and similar buildings in the game, so that NPCs can't pass through the walls. S[/*]
 	[*]Changed the Shield of Attraction stats[/*]
 	[*]Hilt Fortress: Moved copper ore from (65.2, -44.9, 25.0) to (62.76 -44.788 33.72).[/*]
 	[*]Fixed floating crate in North Drachvald Spur[/*]
 	[*]K'rawl - Fixed Floating objects.  Added ceiling to a ceilingless chamber. Fixed a hole between rocks in the large blue chamber.[/*]
 	[*]Polish Magic Mover UI[/*]
 	[*]POT Desert 01 template: fixed issue where NPCs would get stuck in cracks in the docks[/*]
 	[*]POT Underground template: Added a fix to block off a "stuck spot" at (268.1, 89.6, -292.0).[/*]
 	[*]Ruined Keep, Spindrift Passage, Upper Fortus: Added new mushroom monster spawners[/*]
 	[*]Sequanna Colossus: Ensured all compass discoveries are in place and labelled correctly.[/*]
 	[*]Show server status as offline when in "Dev Only" mode[/*]
 	[*]Soltown Catacombs: Slowed down respawn of all bandits. Added waypoint paths for some spellcasters in the "bandit camp" area. Changed name of "Well-Worn Key" to "Soltown Catacombs Key."[/*]
 	[*]Soltown: Harvey, a child in the refugee camp, now has his own bedroll to sleep in at night. Removed weapon rack from (-29.7, 27.1, 4.5).[/*]
 	[*]Adjusted floating wall deco in Brittany Estates.[/*]
 	[*]Skrekk: fixed collision issue with large rock piece. Adjusted crashing deco objects.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed some overly intense bloom settings on alpine weather scenes[/*]
 	[*]Superstition Canyon: Partial fix for players being able to attack enemies from below in Superstition canyon.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed an overly reflective rock wall material that was noticed as a bug while in the Sequanna Colossus map, but the fix will affect all locations with that asset[/*]
 	[*]Material refinements to the Cloud Imperium Airship to compensate for environmental reflections that were recently enabled[/*]
 	[*]Shogun Homes: added "Lights On" SFX[/*]
 	[*]Added colliders to alien plant visible in Rhun Ruins[/*]
 	[*]Improved tooltip for Poison Weapon[/*]
 	[*]Fixed NPCs visibly teleporting during schedule changes.[/*]
 	[*]Brittany Central: Fixed several stuckpots.[/*]
 	[*]Brittany Central: Fixed issues involving seams in architecture, floating props, broken doors, and misplaced props.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed watchers not scanning players[/*]
 	[*]Clockwork pets: Fixed gears SFX not stopping upon death[/*]
 	[*]Fix for NPCs sometimes popping on top of the player during collision.[/*]
 	[*]Fix for NPCs not using beds and chairs when instructed.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed gigantic table floating above Central Brittany[/*]
 	[*]Fixed player vendor, deco automatons, and deco servants t-posing.[/*]
 	[*]South Celestial Wetlands: Updated the names for letters and compass POI discoveries in this scene to better represent the local factions.[/*]
 	[*]Tower of the Shuttered Eye: Improved the titles of several ambiguously-named letters. Also, all prison benches in the scene are now sittable.[/*]
 	[*]Valhold: NPCs should no longer walk through walls in the town's buildings. Also, removed the extra door at (15.9, 85.0, -134.3). Beds in the town should all be usable.[/*]
 	[*]Wooden Piers: Fixed a collision issue with a commonly-used pier that should help NPCs walk on them without issue.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Not all items listed in R39 Instructions are yet in the game or Add On Store[/*]
 	[*]Eternal Patterns can be lost when Reshaping. DO NOT USE Eternal Patterns.[/*]
 	[*]Cover System is not applying to magic spells[/*]
 	[*]You can only see your equipped grayed out tools in your inventory if they were equipped when you loaded into the scene. Any attempt to equip new tools will cause them to appear missing (they won't appear greyed out) until the scene changes.[/*]
 	[*]When casting the Charm Animal spell on a mob it will turn it's health bar white/grey and the animal becomes passive, but it's not properly updating the health bar when left clicking the mob as shown below. The health bar on the left is in the animal's passive state but the spell has already worn off, and the spider's name should be in red again.[/*]
 	[*]Some Devotionals do not allow for two devotional buffs at the same time
[list]
 	[*]Honesty[/*]
 	[*]Honor[/*]
 	[*]Humility[/*]
 	[*]Justice[/*]
 	[*]Sacrifice[/*]
 	[*]Spirituality[/*]
 	[*]Valor[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Mushroom monster corpses are hard to loot[/*]
 	[*]New "More..." convo system is sometimes incorrectly blocking conversations[/*]
 	[*]Brittany Fields has some pathfinding issues[/*]
 	[*]Some NPCs are not holding items correctly (mugs, brooms, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Cloaks will often sort through the avatar's body[/*]
 	[*]Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.[/*]
 	[*]A new Conversation interface has been introduced and may introduce various issues with resolving quests and talking to NPCs.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Hair is not properly working with lighting, fog, etc.[/*]
 	[*]Lot Deeds cannot be purchased in Offline Mode[/*]
 	[*]AMD A8 Graphics Chipsets do not work with Unity Games including Shroud[/*]
 	[*]Using the Mirror on Isle of Storms can crash sometimes[/*]
 	[*]Novia Overworld rework has introduced various stuck spots, incorrect collision and “exit into the air” issues[/*]
 	[*]Some UI text is not wrapping correctly[/*]
 	[*]Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]Some SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
 	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
 	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
 	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
 	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
 	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Release 38 Patch Notes: February 6, 2017
notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 38! How to Play instructions and game update notes on Release 38 are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=68011]here[/url].

[b]February 6, 2017[/b]

[b]Build Number 554, 5:30 PM[/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Fixed issue with players getting stuck in the water in Owl's Head[/*]
        [*]Fix /roll command not showing the same numbers for everyone.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Some NPCs are not holding items correctly (mugs, brooms, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Cloaks will often sort through the avatar's body[/*]
 	[*]Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.[/*]
 	[*]A new Conversation interface has been introduced and may introduce various issues with resolving quests and talking to NPCs.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Hair is not properly working with lighting, fog, etc.[/*]
 	[*]Lot Deeds cannot be purchased in Offline Mode[/*]
 	[*]AMD A8 Graphics Chipsets do not work with Unity Games including Shroud[/*]
 	[*]Using the Mirror on Isle of Storms can crash sometimes[/*]
 	[*]Novia Overworld rework has introduced various stuck spots, incorrect collision and “exit into the air” issues[/*]
 	[*]Some UI text is not wrapping correctly[/*]
 	[*]Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]Many SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
 	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
 	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
 	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
 	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
 	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]

 	[*]Fixed scale of Barrel decoration[/*]

 	[*]Adjusted window materials so they are back to being more transparent (hopefully)[/*]
 	[*]Attempted fix on 2-story Obsidian Rowhouse crashing into neighboring rowhouses.[/*]
 	[*]New user registration is now direct, and doesn't require getting credentials from email[/*]
 	[*]Added pre-built lighting to Shogun Homes.[/*]
 	[*]Fixes for Forced Conversation mode getting players stuck in bad state.[/*]
 	[*]Shock Monkeys can now be looted if they die with stealth active[/*]
 	[*]Icons for the new valentine's day gift boxes are now correct[/*]
 	[*]Chained Obsidian Shard can now be placed on floors (inside and on top of buildings)[/*]
 	[*]The two Gallows decorations can now be used in Player Owned Towns[/*]

 	[*]Xenos: Various framerate and visual fixes
[list]
 	[*]Fixed stuck locations[/*]
 	[*]Removed half of all grass in all areas[/*]
 	[*]Added butterfly VFX[/*]
 	[*]Restored correct materials to 3 greco roman statues[/*]
 	[*]LODs for greco-roman statuary[/*]
 	[*]Fixed statue LOD popping in xenos[/*]

[list]
 	[*]Facial Hair transparency is showing big opaque squares ironically[/*]
 	[*]Some Add On Store items listed in the Release Instructions post are not yet available (Dry Docked Pirate Galleon, Squirrel Pets, Baby Clockwork Dragon Pets, Ornate Circlet, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Some of the new potion recipes are not working correctly[/*]
 	[*]Some NPCs are not holding items correctly (mugs, brooms, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]When you watch another avatar swim the animations look broken.[/*]
 	[*]Cloaks will often sort through the avatar's body[/*]
 	[*]Some scene instances may be bugged in which it is easy for players to fall through the ground. An existing workaround is to reload the scene.[/*]
 	[*]A new Conversation interface has been introduced and may introduce various issues with resolving quests and talking to NPCs.[/*]
 	[*]Players may be unable to interact with objects via double-click if their framerate is poor. A workaround is to use the “E” interaction key.[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Hair is not properly working with lighting, fog, etc.[/*]
 	[*]Lot Deeds cannot be purchased in Offline Mode[/*]
 	[*]AMD A8 Graphics Chipsets do not work with Unity Games including Shroud[/*]
 	[*]Using the Mirror on Isle of Storms can crash sometimes[/*]
 	[*]Novia Overworld rework has introduced various stuck spots, incorrect collision and “exit into the air” issues[/*]
 	[*]Some UI text is not wrapping correctly[/*]
 	[*]Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]The new Targeting system still has various issues that need fixing[/*]
 	[*]Pathfinding is breaking in some houses and basements[/*]
 	[*]Local chat is failing in some situations[/*]
 	[*]Many SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
 	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
 	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
 	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
 	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
 	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Release 38 Instructions
notes.content:
WARNING: THIS GAME IS EARLY ACCESS. PLEASE DO NOT PURCHASE IT UNLESS YOU WANT TO ACTIVELY SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT OF THE GAME VIA CROWD FUNDING, BUG TESTING, AND FEEDBACK. PLEASE ONLY PURCHASE IF YOU ARE ALSO PREPARED TO HANDLE PERIODIC WIPES, SERIOUS ISSUES AND INCOMPLETE CONTENT. PLEASE READ THE NEGATIVE REVIEWS PRIOR TO PURCHASE, MANY OF WHICH WARN YOU OF THE CURRENT UNFINISHED STATE OF THE GAME. 

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/r38_instructions_lead_image_v3.jpg[/img]

Avatars,

[b]Please read this entire message, as well as the linked instructions and known issues.[/b]

Release 38 is one of our larger releases because some of the work was started before the holiday break and some of the content has been worked on for several releases (Xenos, Blood Bay, Scaled Crafting).

[b]Perennial Coast Improvements (Architecture/Flora):[/b] In Release 38, we are moving through all the scenes along the Perennial Coast and updating the flora and architecture to match the new Asian influence we first showed in Ardoris during Release 37. This includes replacing all the exit arches, adding in more bamboo (along with other flora), adding or swapping out Asian architectural elements, along with other details. The only scene we are not touching in R38 is Celestis, which is getting its own specific un-cloning task in a future release.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Perennial-Coast-4.jpg[/img]

[b]Perennial Coast Improvements (Character):[/b] All NPCs along the Perennial Coast are now using custom regional Asian influenced outfits including the Guards, Citizens, Farmers, Merchants, and Nobility. Additionally all Guards along the Perennial Coast are now equipped with Katanas. This, of course, includes Ardoris itself.

[b]Solania:[/b] The small town of Solania is located in the Perennial Coast region in the southeast of Novia. Solania is located on a high point in the Celestial Swamp that lines the southern shore of Celestial Lake, so getting there can be quite dangerous. Like the other Perennial Coast scenes, Solania got a polish pass to incorporate the Asian influence. This included updating all of the NPC buildings with new rooflines (blue tiles) and wall textures, putting in a new perimeter Shogun style wall, updating the foliage, and adding in various other details. As with all polish and un-clone passes we make on maps we do NOT change lot placements. We only make cosmetic changes of building styles, terrain, and foliage.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Solania5.jpg[/img]

[b]Brookside:[/b] Brookside is located in the Drachvald region in the northeast of Novia directly south of Spite. It is the hometown of Samael and was overrun by the Undead armies of Anapa not long ago. Starting with Release 38, players will encounter this town when following their quests along the Path of Love. Brookside started as a cloned scene using one of our PRT/POT templates based off of the Forest 02 POT template (a forested variation of the Grasslands POT template). In Release 38, it is was rebuilt with new flora, new atmospheric settings like permanent fog, a graveyard, and other unique features for the plot including Samael’s farm. Note that when we un-clone these scenes, we do NOT change lot placements. We only make cosmetic changes of building styles, terrain, and foliage.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Brookside7.jpg[/img]

[b]Highvale Polish:[/b] Various changes were made to this starting scene on the Path of Courage. The scene in general has been given a level of polish with the addition of many more difficulty-appropriate monsters in previously unused areas, fixing of outstanding bugs, fixing pathing errors, etc., so that it is comparable to the other two tutorial areas. A new optional quest has been added to the tutorial as well—visit the central keep to begin.

[b]Courage Path Polish:[/b] Various changes were made to the Path of Courage. In addition to other bugs addressed with quests in Resolute and post-tutorial Highvale, players who were unable to progress the Path of Courage due to a certain uncommunicative NPC within Valhold Keep will find the path open to them now.

[b]Vauban Pass:[/b] Vauban Pass is one of the numerous Control Points that limits travel between regions in Novia. It is located between the Grunvald and Drachvald regions and is controlled by the Undead armies of Anapa. Vauban Pass started as a clone of Sanctus Spine but now has been completely rebuilt for Release 38; making all the Control Points unique scenes.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/12/Vauban-Pass-1.jpg[/img]

[b]Xenos:[/b] Right before we went persistent, we uncloned Xenos and made some modifications to it for specific plot points. However, we were not satisfied with the level of polish, so we chose to do a major rebuild of this scene to bring it up to the quality it needed to be at. Xenos is on the island of Elysium, southwest of Novia, and is a critical juncture on the Path of Truth. The modifications focused on bringing out the Greco-Roman character of the region as well as highlighting the various aspects of the Lottery of Artifice—including pilgrim encampments, an ancient caravanserai, and the temple of Boreas. We also greatly expanded the aqueduct system, rebuilt the dock area, and added a Lagoon of Pleasures.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Xenos-Subpost-V_13.jpg[/img]

[b]Blood Bay:[/b] Blood Bay is a tropical island that was smashed by shards of the moons during the Cataclysm. These shards triggered a massive volcanic event that is still happening today. Toxic minerals in the lava have stained the water red, giving the island its distinctive name. Obsidian Shards in the area make the Protection of the Oracle impossible, making the entire island an Open PvP zone where Outlanders slaughter each other at will. Due to the incredibly unstable nature of the island, only the most desperate and dangerous individuals dare live there: Pirates, Brigands, Thieves, etc. In response, some others who follow a more virtuous path have taken it upon themselves also reside here to keep a watchful eye on the miscreants of the island. Both groups have formed their own settlements on the highest cliffs opposite the volcano above the bay. These two settlements represent opposite ends of the spectrum of virtue and are known as Scoundrel’s Hold and Judge’s Watch, respectively. In future releases if your virtue is high, the townspeople of Judge’s Watch will interact with you, but if your virtue is low, they will refuse to have any business with you. The opposite will be true for Scoundrel’s Hold, where they will only interact with you if your virtue is low. For R38, the NPCs work just like other towns and the virtue mechanic does not yet factor in. Outside the towns, the island is filled with dangerous beasts and a landscape just as dangerous, filled with quicksand (slows you down), fields of poison gas, magic-boosting shards, magic nullifying shards, fields of confusion, and other hazards. This map is a testing ground for many of these new systems, features and ideas that we will then propagate out to other maps over the next several releases. Player housing is not yet available in Blood Bay but should be available in the next few releases.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/11/SotA_BloodBay_5.jpg[/img]

[b]Canyon Siege:[/b] We created another scene for use in the Town Sieges. This scene is a bridge across a canyon for use in towns near mountainous areas.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Canyon-Siege-1.jpg[/img]

[b]Control Points:[/b] Mages in control points now have spells that manipulate player position (much like the Daemon). Additionally, during the final wave there is a small chance a boss-level NPC will show up, of a type appropriate for the NPCs of that control point.

[b]Non-Hostile Overworld Encounters:[/b] Roving Encounters on the Overworld now have the ability to be flagged as Non-Hostile. We can use this flag for prey animals like Deer or domestic animals like Sheep as well as wandering merchants (when we add that encounter). This means that these particular encounters will no longer attack you on sight (we are very sorry if you enjoyed being chased by aggressive deer).

[b]Traps and Puzzles:[/b] We have implemented a set of new traps and puzzles for the game. Release 38 will include Pressure Plates (these can open doors as well as trigger traps), Flame Jets, Arrow Shooters, and updated versions of the old Spike Traps. We will begin propagating these throughout the game over the next several releases. In R38, you can find Arrow Shooters and Flame Jets in the Brittany Sewers.

[b]Keys & Locks:[/b] As you adventure throughout Novia and the Hidden Vale, you'll find that many keys now have a chance to break on each use. Keys may have a good chance to break (such as the keys for the locked passages that interconnect underground scenes and the cages found in wilderness scenes throughout Novia), while others break about half the time (such as the key for the Kiln Cistern Alchemist's Workshop), and some will never break (such as special keys required for quests).

[b]Moving Platforms:[/b] We now have the ability to move players on platforms for things like elevators, mine carts, etc. Our first example is an airship patrol of Blood Bay. We will be adding many more examples in upcoming releases.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Blood-Bay-30.jpg[/img]

[b]New NPC Conversation Interface:[/b] We have updated the conversation window used for interacting with NPCs to make it both more immersive and easier to use. For immersion, we are hiding almost all of the other interface elements, including all other chat and the hotbar. We are also placing the chat in the very middle of the screen where you are looking at the NPC in order to keep you focused on the interaction. We have also tried to keep the interface itself as minimal as possible, with very few borders and as much transparency in the elements as we can. For ease of use, we are placing all the keywords in a toolbar at the bottom of the window. This toolbar will include every keyword you have uncovered with the NPC, including keywords relating to quests you are currently on and keywords learned from past conversations with that NPC. This saves you from having to scroll back to find keywords you might not remember. Players who preferred the older text-based conversation interface will find that still works as well, and in some cases will discover hidden secrets. 

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/NPC-convo-UI-with-spaces-and-name-colors.jpg[/img]

[b]Scaling Masterworking and Enchanting:[/b] The higher your skill level in Masterworking and Enchanting the higher the power of the effect you add.

[b]Proportional Masterworking and Enchanting:[/b] The power of the effect added is now directly proportional to how many levels of masterworking/enchanting have been applied to better balance risk versus reward. So the power of the first effect added is much weaker than the sixth effect added.

[b]Weapons and Armor Enchanting Skills:[/b] There are now two specialization skills in Enchanting: Weapons and Armor. You will need to level these up in order to gain access to higher level enchantments (aka Major Enchants). The addition of these is to further our efforts to rewards specialization in crafting.

[b]Grandmaster Masterworking Maximum Durability:[/b] If you are a Grandmaster at Masterworking, you have a chance to add Maximum Durability back to the item you are working on instead of adding an effect.

[b]Grandmaster Enchanting Durability Hardening:[/b] Grandmaster Enchanters now have the ability to add an enchantment that hardens weapons and armor against durability reduction.

[b]Attunement and Resistance Enchantments:[/b] There are now attunement (weapons) and resistance (chest armor) available to enchanters where the effects are tied to the gem used.

[b]Food Buffs in Combat:[/b] Buffs and bonuses from food now work during combat as well as out of combat.

[b]Bone Armor:[/b] Bone Armor has been greatly increased in power. As a reminder, Bone Armor is classified as Light Armor but offers a level of protection similar to Plate while still being very light in weight and low in Fizzle. For R38, we increased the Damage Avoidance, increased Durability, and added some Damage Resistance.

[b]Obsidian Armor and Weapons:[/b] Obsidian Armor and Weapons have been greatly increased in power as well. Both weapons and armor have had their maximum durability raised to match other gear and had their weight reduced. Armor also had its Fizzle chance reduced greatly and Damage Resistance was increased. As a reminder, Obsidian Armor comes with a damage reflection bonus and Obsidian weapons have a high critical damage chance.

[b]Over 20 New Crafting Recipes:[/b] Including torches, Perennial Coast Outfits, Circlets, and new combat potions.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Perrenial-Coast-Peasant-Outfits.png[/img]

[b]Clockwork Dragon:[/b] Kobold scientists at the K’rul (Kobold Research Underground Lab) unleashed these gigantic mechanical terrors on Novia to invoke panic among humans. Their program appears to be succeeding… You can find one in Blood Bay, if you dare.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/SS_Clockworkdragon_J.jpg[/img]

[b]Shock Monkey:[/b] Shock Monkeys are another mechanical nightmare from K’rul, developed for covert missions. These mechanical monkeys are a terrible version of their cute organ grinder cousins, with sharp claws and teeth plus a shocking electrical attack. They also have stealth abilities that allow them to completely disappear from view. They are rumored to have been found in Skrekk, Blood Bay, Sanctus Spine, and a few other location in Novia.

[b]NPC Preferential Targeting:[/b] We now have the ability to set preferences on creatures for which kinds of targets they prefer. Starting with Slimes who prefer metallic targets (players wearing metal armor) and Flesh Flayers who prefer fleshier targets (players wearing cloth and leather).

[b]NPC Stealth:[/b] Creatures now have the ability to go into stealth mode like players. The first creature to take advantage of this ability is the Shock Monkey (see above).

[b]NPCs Attack While Rooted:[/b] NPCs will now continue to attack while rooted (just like players).

[b]New Potions:[/b] Including Healing and Focus Potions of various strengths, stat boosts, regeneration boosts, and resistance boosts.

[b]Rare Loot:[/b] Players can now find rare Artifacts (non-craftable magical items) as loot on high level creatures they fight. They can also find recipes starting with the new potions we created this release (more recipes will follow). Here's a brief list of some of these artifacts: 
[list]
    [*][b]Ring of Brittle Brawn:[/b] Reduces hit points by 40% but adds significant (20-50) strength.
    [*][b]Ring of the Frogkin:[/b] When worn you are able to jump slightly higher. However your skin turns green.
    [*][b]Torch of Jerik:[/b] This large iron basket torch can be wielded as a mace.
    [*][b]Belt of the Ox:[/b] Cuts your move speed in half but quadruples carrying capacity.
    [*][b]Ring of Luck:[/b] Gives a small wishing well bonus.
    [*][b]Slipshod Shooter's Sash:[/b] This belt gives a bonus to your Rapidfire skill, gives a small bonus to Rapidfire power, but decreases your Ammo Scavenger.  So you can shoot more arrows but you lose more arrows…
    [*][b]Lavalliere of the Lagomorph:[/b] This necklace of the rabbit greatly decreases your strength but increases your movement and attack speed.
[/list]

[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=68011] And much more including more player outfits, tons of bug fixes, new pets, inventory and UI polish, combat balance, etc.! Click here for the complete R38 Instructions[/url]

[i] [And did we mention that you should read the negative reviews that warn you about the unfinished state of this game before you purchase? Don't buy this game until you read them!] [/i]

This toolbar will include every keyword you have uncovered with the NPC, including keywords relating to quests you are currently on and keywords learned from past conversations with that NPC. This saves you from having to scroll back to find keywords you might not remember. Players who preferred the older text-based conversation interface will find that still works as well, and in some cases will discover hidden secrets. 

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/NPC-convo-UI-with-spaces-and-name-colors.jpg[/img]

[b]Scaling Masterworking and Enchanting:[/b] The higher your skill level in Masterworking and Enchanting the higher the power of the effect you add.

[b]Proportional Masterworking and Enchanting:[/b] The power of the effect added is now directly proportional to how many levels of masterworking/enchanting have been applied to better balance risk versus reward. So the power of the first effect added is much weaker than the sixth effect added.

[b]Weapons and Armor Enchanting Skills:[/b] There are now two specialization skills in Enchanting: Weapons and Armor. You will need to level these up in order to gain access to higher level enchantments (aka Major Enchants). The addition of these is to further our efforts to rewards specialization in crafting.

[b]Grandmaster Masterworking Maximum Durability:[/b] If you are a Grandmaster at Masterworking, you have a chance to add Maximum Durability back to the item you are working on instead of adding an effect.

[b]Grandmaster Enchanting Durability Hardening:[/b] Grandmaster Enchanters now have the ability to add an enchantment that hardens weapons and armor against durability reduction.

[b]Attunement and Resistance Enchantments:[/b] There are now attunement (weapons) and resistance (chest armor) available to enchanters where the effects are tied to the gem used.

[b]Food Buffs in Combat:[/b] Buffs and bonuses from food now work during combat as well as out of combat.

[b]Bone Armor:[/b] Bone Armor has been greatly increased in power. As a reminder, Bone Armor is classified as Light Armor but offers a level of protection similar to Plate while still being very light in weight and low in Fizzle. For R38, we increased the Damage Avoidance, increased Durability, and added some Damage Resistance.

[b]Obsidian Armor and Weapons:[/b] Obsidian Armor and Weapons have been greatly increased in power as well. Both weapons and armor have had their maximum durability raised to match other gear and had their weight reduced. Armor also had its Fizzle chance reduced greatly and Damage Resistance was increased. As a reminder, Obsidian Armor comes with a damage reflection bonus and Obsidian weapons have a high critical damage chance.

[b]Over 20 New Crafting Recipes:[/b] Including torches, Perennial Coast Outfits, Circlets, and new combat potions.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/Perrenial-Coast-Peasant-Outfits.png[/img]

[b]Clockwork Dragon:[/b] Kobold scientists at the K’rul (Kobold Research Underground Lab) unleashed these gigantic mechanical terrors on Novia to invoke panic among humans. Their program appears to be succeeding… You can find one in Blood Bay, if you dare.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2017/01/SS_Clockworkdragon_J.jpg[/img]

[b]Shock Monkey:[/b] Shock Monkeys are another mechanical nightmare from K’rul, developed for covert missions. These mechanical monkeys are a terrible version of their cute organ grinder cousins, with sharp claws and teeth plus a shocking electrical attack. They also have stealth abilities that allow them to completely disappear from view. They are rumored to have been found in Skrekk, Blood Bay, Sanctus Spine, and a few other location in Novia.

[b]NPC Preferential Targeting:[/b] We now have the ability to set preferences on creatures for which kinds of targets they prefer. Starting with Slimes who prefer metallic targets (players wearing metal armor) and Flesh Flayers who prefer fleshier targets (players wearing cloth and leather).

[b]NPC Stealth:[/b] Creatures now have the ability to go into stealth mode like players. The first creature to take advantage of this ability is the Shock Monkey (see above).

[b]NPCs Attack While Rooted:[/b] NPCs will now continue to attack while rooted (just like players).

[b]New Potions:[/b] Including Healing and Focus Potions of various strengths, stat boosts, regeneration boosts, and resistance boosts.

[b]Rare Loot:[/b] Players can now find rare Artifacts (non-craftable magical items) as loot on high level creatures they fight. They can also find recipes starting with the new potions we created this release (more recipes will follow). Here's a brief list of some of these artifacts: 
[list]
    [*][b]Ring of Brittle Brawn:[/b] Reduces hit points by 40% but adds significant (20-50) strength.
    [*][b]Ring of the Frogkin:[/b] When worn you are able to jump slightly higher. However your skin turns green.
    [*][b]Torch of Jerik:[/b] This large iron basket torch can be wielded as a mace.
    [*][b]Belt of the Ox:[/b] Cuts your move speed in half but quadruples carrying capacity.
    [*][b]Ring of Luck:[/b] Gives a small wishing well bonus.
    [*][b]Slipshod Shooter's Sash:[/b] This belt gives a bonus to your Rapidfire skill, gives a small bonus to Rapidfire power, but decreases your Ammo Scavenger.  So you can shoot more arrows but you lose more arrows…
    [*][b]Lavalliere of the Lagomorph:[/b] This necklace of the rabbit greatly decreases your strength but increases your movement and attack speed.
[/list]

[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=68011] And much more including more player outfits, tons of bug fixes, new pets, inventory and UI polish, combat balance, etc.! Click here for the complete R38 Instructions[/url]

[i] [And did we mention that you should read the negative reviews that warn you about the unfinished state of this game before you purchase? Don't buy this game until you read them!] [/i]

notes.title: Release 38 Offline Data Format Change – Character Preservation Notice
notes.content:
Greetings Avatars,

For Release 38, the Offline Mode save game format is changing to support new and upcoming gameplay features.

Here’s what you need to do in order to preserve your Offline Mode save games and characters:
[list][*]Patch your game client to Release 38.
[*]Load each saved game and then re-save. This will convert your save file into the latest format.
[*]If you do not convert your saved games during Release 38, your saved games (from releases prior to R38) may not load.[/list]
If you do not convert your saved games during Release 38, your saved games (from releases prior to R38) may not load in releases after Release 38. In other words we cannot guarantee the ability to load pre-R38 saves after R38.

Our sincere apologies if this change causes any disruption in your gameplay. We always make every attempt to avoid having to make these kinds of requirements of our players when we make changes like this. After very careful consideration, we’ve deemed this change, and the accompanying requirement, as necessary. Please note that this change will not affect the online game or characters in any way.

As a reminder, Release 38 starts on January 26 and runs through February 22.

Please [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/r38-offline-data-format-change-character-preservation-notice.76808/]let us know[/url] if you have any questions on this update!

notes.title: Release 37 Patch Notes: January 11, 2017
notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 37! How to Play instructions and game update notes on Release 37 are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/release-37-instructions.74226/]in the forums[/url].

[b]January 11, 2017[/b]

[b]Build Number 538, 2:00 PM[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Fixed issues with character positions getting out of synch[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Ornate Katana is missing its ornate hilt[/*]
 	[*]Ornate Katana is titled simply "Katana"[/*]
 	[*]Shogun houses have swinging doors but should have sliding doors[/*]
 	[*]Ranged (Bow) players experiencing combat desyncs. Attacks not being registered the longer they play with others. This will happen if the player who is Master is having connection issues or is on a low end machine.[/*]
 	[*]Targeting: Beneficent spells hit un-selected pets, not the caster[/*]
 	[*]If you are patching R37 for the first time you will be going from 0 > 522 due to overall size of R37. This is as designed.[/*]
 	[*]Dig In Skill has no cooldown timer[/*]
 	[*]Some spell VFX do not play properly[/*]
 	[*]Some textures may look incorrect due to optimizations (white, black, pink, low resolution, pixelated, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Hair is not properly working with lighting, fog, etc.[/*]
 	[*]Lot Deeds cannot be purchased in Offline Mode[/*]
 	[*]AMD A8 Graphics Chipsets do not work with Unity Games including Shroud[/*]
 	[*]Using the Mirror on Isle of Storms can crash sometimes[/*]
 	[*]Novia Overworld rework has introduced various stuck spots, incorrect collision and “exit into the air” issues[/*]
 	[*]Some UI text is not wrapping correctly[/*]
 	[*]Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]The new Targeting system still has various issues that need fixing[/*]
 	[*]Pathfinding is breaking in some houses and basements[/*]
 	[*]Local chat is failing in some situations[/*]
 	[*]Many SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
 	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
 	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
 	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
 	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
 	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Apologies for our Mess. ETA on Patch 522: 10 PM CST
notes.content:
We are so very sorry about the messiness of this release. The performance changes we made introduced a lot of unfortunate side effects that did not manifest themselves during internal testing that we are slowly working through.

We had a build failure but we are back on track.

This build has fixes for player position errors, stability problems, offline rewards and a host of other minor issues.

Check out details on the [URL='https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=32989']patch page[/URL].

 	[*]Brittany Alleys: Fixed wandering bankers[/*]
 	[*]Turned on shadows on POT icons on Overworld[/*]
 	[*]Fixed fog not showing properly on Linux[/*]
 	[*]Awkward stairs in Crypt of the Avatar: Replaced pile of mesh rubble with a tiny little terrain and a few rubble elements[/*]
 	[*]Fixed issue where VFX were not attaching to proper location on lots of creatures[/*]
 	[*]Obsidian Arrow now properly animating again[/*]
 	[*]Now properly turning off held items while eating.[/*]
 	[*]Added VFX for Animal Charm[/*]
 	[*]Yet another fix for the audio bugs with the German Automaton (we swear we think this fixed it)[/*]
 	[*]Fixed invisible wall in Greenhouse Rowhouse.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed stuck spot in Rustic Village Inn home[/*]
 	[*]Some fixes related to party members and disconnects[/*]
 	[*]Added Yule soundtrack to game[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Recipes purchase prior to R36 that are Teachable cannot be upgraded to Taught nor can they be upgraded to teachable[/*]

 	[*]Lot Deeds cannot be purchased in Offline Mode[/*]
 	[*]Rewards are not yet being delivered in Offline Mode[/*]
 	[*]AMD A8 Graphics Chipsets do not work with Unity Games including Shroud[/*]
 	[*]Fire Arrow icon not visible in tutorial[/*]
 	[*]Using the Mirror on Isle of Storms can crash sometimes[/*]
 	[*]Novia Overworld rework has introduced various stuck spots, incorrect collision and “exit into the air” issues[/*]

 	[*]Rain and Snow is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]The new Targeting system still has various issues that need fixing[/*]
 	[*]Pathfinding is breaking in some houses and basements[/*]
 	[*]Local chat is failing in some situations[/*]
 	[*]Many SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
 	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
 	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
 	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
 	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
 	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
[/list]

 	[*]Fixed 4th story wall gap in Stone 4 story Row House.[/*]
 	[*]Yet another fix to address deco lights not providing light properly[/*]

 	[*]Fixed internal door frame texture in 4 story Wood & Plaster Row Houses.[/*]

 	[*]Fixed planter box highlight bug[/*]
 	[*]Fixed icon for music symbol that looked like a fish[/*]
 	[*]Control Points: Modified leash ranges for NPCs[/*]
 	[*]NPCs using the white male Owl's Head guard model can again be interacted with.[/*]

 	[*]Fixed various Elven City Home issues.[/*]

 	[*]Fixed blocked rear entrance of Shingle Roof 3-story Open Plan Village Home[/*]

 	[*]"Pyrotechnic Bagpipes" now correctly named "Flaming Bagpipes".[/*]
 	[*]Did a pass through the world to make sure all Wells can be used to gather water and can be used as Wishing Wells except the well teleporter from Northwest Blackblade Mountains to Blackblade Pass.[/*]
 	[*]Removed the rug outside the global Bank prefab building that was in multiple scenes that was sorting through terrain[/*]
 	[*]The Elven 3 and 4 story row homes now have correct icons.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed multiple issues with the Viking Town Stronghold.[/*]
 	[*]Removed some global Combat Shop upstairs-wall candles and replaced them with a tall, standing chandelier.[/*]
 	[*]The Etceter Crag Mines stone bridge has been rotated to properly reach over the lava.[/*]

 	[*]Fixed bricked-up windows in the Twin Spire Manor.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed bug that sometimes caused drawn glyphs in hotbar to flicker when used.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed z fighting in dungeon piece in The Tower of the Shuttered Eye.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed floating dagger in Tower of the Shuttered Eye[/*]
 	[*]Fixed issue where Oracle watchers in Ardoris were going into a certain area too much[/*]

 	[*]Moved an ore node in Spectral Foothills so it is now accessible.[/*]

[/list]
