notes.title: Clasped Gauntlets Cloak for Community Events
notes.content:
We believe very strongly that community events that extend into the real world are very important and we have always worked hard to support them. We have been considering for a long time now how players who attend these real world events can display their attendance inside the game.

With all that in mind we came up with the Clasped Gauntlets Cloak! Any Shroud of the Avatar community event, of any size, is eligible to receive a cloak for each attendee. The organizer will need to submit a request for approval and then once approved provide a list of backers who attended. Large events can request a customized version of the cloak with a unique color scheme and a custom name.

The first approved use of these customized versions are SotA Con East 2016 and Ultima Dragons 25th Anniversary Party (see below on how to get these rare exclusive versions of the cloak).

[url=https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/Gauntlets-Cloak.jpg][img=https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/Gauntlets-Cloak.jpg][/img][/url]

[h1][url=http://east.sotacon.org/]SotA Con East 2016[/url][/h1]

[img=http://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/sotacon_logo.png][/img]

[b]Special Cross Promotion:[/b] Anyone who backs both Shroud of the Avatar (at a level with Game Access)  and SotA Con East 2016 ($25+) will get a special custom Clasped Gauntlets Cloak in Blue and Yellow that says "SotA Con East 2016".

Portalarium is excited to participate in the first ever community organized convention for Shroud of the Avatar - SotA Con East 2016! SotA developers and players alike will be gathering together for a casual for a casual weekend filled with exciting activities, engaging panel discussions, and of course plenty of gameplay sessions.

SotA Con East runs from November 4-6, 2016 in Baltimore Inner Harbor, Maryland. Registration is still open, so get your tickets by visiting the official event site links below!

[url=https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/SotA-Con-Gauntlet-Cloak.jpg][img=https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/SotA-Con-Gauntlet-Cloak.jpg][/img][/url]

SotA Con is entirely planned and funded by the players, for the players and developers. This once again shows how our passionate and dedicated players are creating exciting opportunities for the rest of the community, and succeeding magnificently.

[h1][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1245334886/ultima-dragons-25th-anniversary-bash/description]Ultima Dragons 25th Anniversary Bash![/url][/h1]

[b]Special Cross Promotion:[/b] Anyone who backs both Shroud of the Avatar at a level with Game Access) and the Ultima Dragons 25th Anniversary ($30 Recommended) will get a special custom Clasped Gauntlets Cloak in Blue and Silver that says "Ultima Dragons 25th Anniversary".

[url=https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/Ultima-Dragons-25-Gauntlets-Cloak.jpg][img=https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/10/Ultima-Dragons-25-Gauntlets-Cloak.jpg][/img][/url]

February 25-27, 2017 Disneyland, California, USA

[url=http://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/UDIC-party.jpg][img=http://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/UDIC-party.jpg][/img][/url]

Join the Ultima Dragons as they celebrate twenty-five years of one of the oldest online fan-created gaming clubs! More than just a party, the Ultima Dragons 25th Anniversary Bash is a celebration of an entire online culture. We were one of the first communities to emerge from the early Internet, and our roots go even further back! It is this beginning, as a gaming club of Prodigy, that we are celebrating the 25th anniversary of today. Many factions of Ultima fans formed there in 1992, but only the Ultima Dragons survived.

"We're going to Disneyland!" This decision was as random as the UDIC itself. We're bringing together Dragons from all over the world, many of whom are friends but have never met in person before, at the Happiest Place on Earth. The party will be kid-friendly, and all Dragons, their friends and family, and fans of the Ultima Dragons are invited. Those who have made the games we're fans of have also been fans of US for almost as long as we've been around, so we're inviting everyone who worked for Origin Systems or who currently works for Portalarium, the company currently making Shroud of the Avatar, the Ultimas' spiritual successor.

To that end we're renting a "Fellowship Hall" in the Disneyland Hotel for the weekend of February 25th and 26th. You'll get to meet Origin Systems veterans Richard Garriott, Denis Loubet, and Dr. Cat, play games with Dragons and by Dragons, try out various Ultima games, and participate in some Ultima-inspired activities.

notes.title: Release 34 Patch Notes: October 7, 2016
notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 34! How to Play instructions and game update notes on Release 34 are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/release-34-instructions.64769/]in the forums[/url].

[b]October 7, 2016[/b]

[b]Build Number 492, 11:45 AM[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Fixed issue (hopefully) that was causing SFX to arbitrarily cut out[/*]
 	[*]Novia and Hidden Vale: Slightly increased size of teleport triggers for boat-to-Novia/Hidden Vale. Decreased the size of teleport triggers for boats that connect to POT islands. (Note: This should dramatically reduce the chances that players will accidentally click on the Jade Island POT boat teleporter when trying to click on the boat-to-Novia.)[/*]
 	[*]Fixed various exceptions[/*]
 	[*]Fix for players getting stuck when teleporting to chairs. We now save last valid position before laying in bed or sitting in chair and restore that when getting up.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed issue with spells interrupting during casting and messing up Global Cooldown[/*]
 	[*]Fixed hair sorting issues with One Man Bands[/*]
 	[*]Fixed issue where attempting to Tame a creature breaks game inputs until scene reload[/*]
 	[*]Fixed bug that caused the death location skeleton to appear where the player was resurrected rather than where they died[/*]
 	[*]Fixed bug that caused a pile of skeletons to appear where a single death occurred[/*]
 	[*]Elysian Illumination will no longer damage party members for 0 points of damage.  Duration has also been increased as well as healing amount[/*]
 	[*]Increasing Shadow bias on sky boxes to remove shadow acne.  This seems to have gotten worse with 5.4 upgrade.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Some items listed in the R34 instructions are not in the game yet including:
[list]
 	[*]Ornate Marching Band Shirt and Hat (Add-Ons)[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Various visual anomalies with all versions of the One Man Bands[/*]
 	[*]Various issues with Sound Effects and Music (sfx not effected by volume sliders, odd popping noises, no music in main menu, etc)[/*]
 	[*]Portable Aetheric Amplifier (aka Headphones) will sometimes stop working[/*]
 	[*]AMD A8 Graphics Chipsets do not work with Unity Games including Shroud[/*]
 	[*]Fire Arrow icon not visible in tutorial[/*]
 	[*]Using the Mirror on Isle of Storms can crash sometimes[/*]
 	[*]Novia Overworld rework has introduced various stuck spots, incorrect collision and “exit into the air” issues[/*]
 	[*]Some UI text is not wrapping correctly[/*]
 	[*]Rain is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]The new Targeting system still has various issues that need fixing[/*]
 	[*]Pathfinding is breaking in some houses and basements[/*]
 	[*]Local chat is failing in some situations[/*]
 	[*]Many SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
 	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
 	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
 	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
 	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
 	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
[/list]

Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 34! How to Play instructions and game update notes on Release 34 are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/release-34-instructions.64769/]in the forums[/url].

[b]October 6, 2016[/b]

[b]Build Number 491, 11:50 AM[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Fixed issue where mail packets were not being issued for Brittany Wharfs. Reset everyone's "I lost my mail" flag.[/*]
 	[*]Easier to discover how to get the /shrug emote from the Shish in Desolis if you've already spoken to her once.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed female zombie masks sorting issues[/*]
 	[*]Fixed issue where you sometimes would get a tamed creature even when taming failed[/*]
 	[*]Fixed theft detection in Guard Towers[/*]
 	[*]Elysian Illumination now reveals hidden and damages undead as the description states[/*]
 	[*]Fixed male kilts sorting poorly with legs while running[/*]
 	[*]Central Brittany: Ensured all horses and cows are outside of stalls and in open areas good for taming[/*]
 	[*]Updated text for moon skills to be more clear about when they are active.[/*]
 	[*]Piercing breeze no longer stops movement by caster[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a null pointer exception on fish schools that was making fish invisible[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Charlotte's broken arm during cheer emote[/*]
 	[*]Novia Overworld: Reassigned some hexes on/near the road around (-55.7, 16.3, 106.6) to be road (or grass) hexes instead of forest.[/*]
 	[*]Backed out latest change to destructible barrel prefab, which shrunk all instances of this barrel in the game.[/*]
 	[*]Brightbone Pass, Superstition Canyon: 3 of the 6 ladders near the Control Point had their trigger volumes blocked by the collision of the walls they were against. I expanded the trigger volumes and all ladders now work correctly.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed issue that was causing game lockups on Mac & Linux[/*]
 	[*]Whiteguard Foothills and clones: Smoothed out the terrain at (33.6, 74.8, -114.9) to help ensure NPCs don't walk into a little dip that used to be there which was deep enough to think they were falling and cause them to jump. They now walk smoothly up the slope.[/*]
 	[*]Flapping bats flap more[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Some items listed in the R34 instructions are not in the game yet including:
[list]
 	[*]New POT templates in the POT Submission Form[/*]
 	[*]Ornate Marching Band Shirt and Hat (Add-Ons)[/*]
 	[*]3 and 4 Story Elven Row House Bundles (Add-On)[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Various visual anomalies with all versions of the One Man Bands[/*]
 	[*]Various issues with Sound Effects and Music (sfx not effected by volume sliders, odd popping noises, no music in main menu, etc)[/*]
 	[*]Portable Aetheric Amplifier (aka Headphones) will sometimes stop working[/*]
 	[*]AMD A8 Graphics Chipsets do not work with Unity Games including Shroud[/*]
 	[*]Fire Arrow icon not visible in tutorial[/*]
 	[*]Using the Mirror on Isle of Storms can crash sometimes[/*]
 	[*]Novia Overworld rework has introduced various stuck spots, incorrect collision and “exit into the air” issues[/*]
 	[*]Some UI text is not wrapping correctly[/*]
 	[*]Rain is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]The new Targeting system still has various issues that need fixing[/*]
 	[*]Pathfinding is breaking in some houses and basements[/*]
 	[*]Local chat is failing in some situations[/*]
 	[*]Many SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
 	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]

 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
 	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
 	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]

notes.title: Release 34 Patch Notes: October 5, 2016
notes.content:
[b]October 5, 2016[/b]

[b]Build Number 489[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Fixed decoration functionality of Large Knight Tent.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed windows in Shingle-Roof Two Story w/ Overhang[/*]
 	[*]Enter key should now work for "Do you want to quit?" dialog.[/*]
 	[*]Solace Bridge: Fixed bed scaling and moved pillow.[/*]
 	[*]Crafting tools should now appear in hand when crafting[/*]
 	[*]Mariah Overlook: Swapped in properly configured snowy tents across the scene.[/*]
 	[*]Stewards can now place/move PoT Broadcast Phonographs.[/*]
 	[*]Brittany: Fixed bug in Castle Walls/Architecture.[/*]
 	[*]Added /datafolder command to open file explorer to the AppData folder.[/*]
 	[*]Vertas Pass: Tightened up the teleporter volume that are part of the Control Point, to ensure players who push against the related houses don't push into a too-large teleporter volume.[/*]
 	[*]Fix bug that caused bags to turn red when you pick them up and drop them back into the same parent bag[/*]
 	[*]Central Brittany: Floating bowl near (360.0, 46.0, 198.6) is now sitting on nearby table. Pavilion and adjacent building at (380.1, 29.9, 305.8) were moved slightly so that pavilion frame no longer crashes through adjacent buildings. Welcome mat at (392.1, 25.9, 313.1) now sits on the ground. Bookcase at (218.6, 96.4, 70.8) no longer clips into wall behind it.[/*]
 	[*]More fixes for One Mand Band visuals[/*]
 	[*]Allow "street" lamps to be placed on player house exterior floor surfaces[/*]
 	[*]Increased effectiveness of passive skills that affect critical hit chance.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed broken materials on female grim reaper mask 2016[/*]
 	[*]Fix persistence of equipped decks when deleting an equipped deck while an alternate is set[/*]
 	[*]Overworld party shield now works for random encounter scenes. Also "Resume on Overworld" works for random encounter scenes.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Some items listed in the R34 instructions are not in the game yet including:
[list]
 	[*]New POT templates in the POT Submission Form[/*]
 	[*]Ornate Marching Band Shirt and Hat (Add-Ons)[/*]
 	[*]3 and 4 Story Elven Row House Bundles (Add-On)[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Various visual anomalies with all versions of the One Man Bands[/*]
 	[*]Various issues with Sound Effects and Music (sfx not effected by volume sliders, odd popping noises, no music in main menu, etc)[/*]
 	[*]Portable Aetheric Amplifier (aka Headphones) will sometimes stop working[/*]
 	[*]AMD A8 Graphics Chipsets do not work with Unity Games including Shroud[/*]
 	[*]Fire Arrow icon not visible in tutorial[/*]
 	[*]Using the Mirror on Isle of Storms can crash sometimes[/*]
 	[*]Novia Overworld rework has introduced various stuck spots, incorrect collision and “exit into the air” issues[/*]
 	[*]Some UI text is not wrapping correctly[/*]
 	[*]Rain is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]The new Targeting system still has various issues that need fixing[/*]
 	[*]Pathfinding is breaking in some houses and basements[/*]
 	[*]Local chat is failing in some situations[/*]
 	[*]Many SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
 	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
 	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
 	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
 	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
 	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
[/list]

 	[*]Moving a player corpse along with ghost has been fixed.[/*]
 	[*]Replaced Atmosphere material with a transparent material (Clear Alpha) for the Isle of Storms sky.[/*]
 	[*]Updated icons for non-combat pets: Ghost Dog, Cat, and Raven; Zombie Dog, Cat, and Raven; Giant Monarch Butterfly[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Cocoon of Night description typo[/*]
 	[*]One-man band: Repositioned Gear01 and skinned it to rig. Fixed other skinning issues on all the LODs.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed issues with Adobe Two-Story w/ Three Level Terrace player house[/*]
 	[*]Fixed torso disappearing on female avatar.[/*]
 	[*]Level loading navigation optimizations.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed ladder targets in Haunted House.[/*]
 	[*]Editing pass performed on all Ardoris guard dialogs for plot compliance and coherence[/*]

 	[*]Fixed sleeping guards floating next to beds.[/*]
 	[*]Plains Random Encounter did not have the "Random Encounter" flag, now it does.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed impassable secret passage in haunted house.[/*]
 	[*]Weapon miss sounds added.[/*]
 	[*]Time bonus for fire passives now works on Immolation effect.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed loot bug that caused the corpse or resource node to remain visible after it was looted.[/*]
 	[*]Placed gear joint on one-man band over new gear and fixed all "lute" animations to work with new rig.[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Release 34 Patch Notes: October 4, 2016
notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 34! How to Play instructions and game update notes on Release 34 are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/release-34-instructions.64769/]in the forums[/url].

[b]October 4, 2016[/b]

[b]Build Number 487 11:45 AM CDT[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Fixed performance issue with Soothing Rain[/*]
 	[*]Fixed hold issue with Cordovan Harp for female avatars[/*]
 	[*]Playing broken music files no longer causes client to freeze/crash[/*]
 	[*]Hitting escape while playing an instrument now stops playing the instrument.[/*]
 	[*]Added smoke loop to succeed the rings/hearts.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed bug where smoke burst could be performed without a pipe.[/*]
 	[*]Added cane/torch to smoke emote so they don't disappear when you smoke[/*]
 	[*]Lord Robinson in Resolute will once again accept his scout's report.[/*]
 	[*]Stanley in Soltown no longer asks for Edvard's notes if you've already shown them to him.[/*]
 	[*]More current task support for Ardoris sniper quest added.[/*]
 	[*]Flute is now on the correct side on One Man Bands[/*]
 	[*]Fixed issue where summoned Skeletons/Liches would immediately lose a large chunk of their health[/*]
 	[*]Various typo fixes in converslation dialogs in Clink and Blood River[/*]
 	[*]Increased based durability on Bone Armor[/*]
 	[*]Novia: Shadowmist buildings now sit solidly on the surface of Novia's terrain.[/*]
 	[*]Spiderweb cloak names updated to reflect add-on store names corrrectly[/*]
 	[*]Added SFX for Zombie pets[/*]
 	[*]Fix for slime creatures failing to respawn.[/*]
 	[*]Cugel once again accept's Stanley's notes from Soltown[/*]
 	[*]Fixed a few incorrect animal head drops (for trophy heads)[/*]
 	[*]Estgard: Made sure Duke Island Terrains were enabled, they were accidentally disabled in the scene.[/*]
 	[*]Nyrond in Etceter Crag Mines once again drops copies of the Mors Ex Tenebris to people who are on the associated quest.[/*]
 	[*]Set type on cinamon bark so it shows up under crafting tab in inventory[/*]
 	[*]Fixed hair problems in One Man Bands[/*]
 	[*]Fixed missing materials on Lute & Drum in One Man Bands[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Slime spawn rates in Etceter Crag Mines[/*]
 	[*]The Rise: Fixed stuck spot in Huge Statue.[/*]
 	[*]More updates to Names Blacklist[/*]
 	[*]Fixed error that occurred when trying to transfer a tax-free deed to another lot and was getting "need to pay Past Due Fee" message[/*]
 	[*]Fixed rounding issue with current health at max that was showing player health not being at maximum[/*]
 	[*]Saying "bye" or "farewell" to Edvard in Solace Bridge correctly ends the conversation if used before crossing the bridge.[/*]
 	[*]Set Iolo's Lute to be repaired via carpentry - fixed other instruments that could not be repaired[/*]
 	[*]Fixed invisible aeronaut helm for female avatar[/*]
 	[*]Made Elven Elder Robes Dyable (seriously)[/*]
 	[*]Flattened lots in Solania to correct errors related to fence placement. Made same corrections in Mud and West End[/*]
 	[*] Fixed incorrect notes and missing instrument sounds for One Man Bands[/*]
 	[*]Added Miss Sounds to All Weapons[/*]
 	[*]Fixed uneven terrain at a lot locaiton in Owls Head[/*]
 	[*]Fixes for Wedding Dress[/*]
 	[*]Fixed issue where the Damaged Armor icon was not disabling after repairing gear[/*]
 	[*]POT Crag: Changed overworld exit hex coordinates for POT Crag - center of hex encompassing town deco is over water, so used adjacent hex. Also changed hex coordinates for Etceter, as it was exiting on top of deco for POT Bladewyke.[/*]
 	[*]Set all instruments to durability 0 since they are not weapons used in combat (at least not until we have Bards!)[/*]
 	[*]Added a check to make sure a decoration item is actually consumable before giving an option to pick it up and use it[/*]
 	[*]Fixed oracle in PoTs not giving experience for quest[/*]
 	[*]Changed tree clearing distance in towns back to how it was[/*]
 	[*]Fixed mml song file playback for musical instruments.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed issue where band files would end abruptly after the shortest track was completed[/*]
 	[*]Fixed calculations and reporting of Inner Strength and Strength of Earth Modifiers[/*]
 	[*]Fixed issue with banish undead weapon proc having extra effects triggering[/*]
 	[*]Updated Street organ SFX and fixed bugs with clipping, added maschine loop[/*]
 	[*]All Chests : SFX updated, new sounds[/*]
 	[*]Removed house sign from a playerhouse prefab that shouldn't be there[/*]
 	[*]Wynton's Folly: Adjusted the awareness, leash, and wander ranges of Riel Firefeather (phoenix) to better accommodate the local plateau and navigation rules. S[/*]
 	[*]Made all customizable items (signs & gravestones) non-stackable since they would lose their customized text when stacke[/*]
 	[*]Control Points: Added a fix to ensure perks always appear on final waves. Improved the ladders near the Control Point in Brightbone Pass and Superstition Canyon to ensure NPCs can use them. Fixed first cage door in Brightbone Pass to ensure it opens at the end of the second wave like it's supposed to.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Some items listed in the R34 instructions are not in the game yet including:
[list]
 	[*]New POT templates in the POT Submission Form[/*]
 	[*]Ornate Marching Band Shirt and Hat (Add-Ons)[/*]
 	[*]3 and 4 Story Elven Row House Bundles (Add-On)[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Female Avatar torso disapears at certain angles and distances[/*]
 	[*]Avatar positions are sometimes out of synch and can even lead to unexpected death![/*]
 	[*]Various visual anomalies with all versions of the One Man Bands[/*]

 	[*]The new Targeting system still has various issues that need fixing[/*]
 	[*]Pathfinding is breaking in some houses and basements[/*]
 	[*]Local chat is failing in some situations[/*]
 	[*]Many SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
 	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]

 	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]

 	[*]Fixed issues with Tent Decorations that cannot be placed[/*]
 	[*]Fixed fireworks volume not being linked to distance[/*]
 	[*]PRT Grumridge: This town is no longer marked as "party only" and "return at start point." (It never should have been.) S[/*]

 	[*]Fixed equip slot definition for Street Organ for female avatars[/*]

 	[*]Fixed Copper ingots not being recognized in Carpentry for Street Organ[/*]

 	[*]Restored missing shutters on Wood & Plaster 4 Story Row House[/*]
 	[*]Fixed window rendering issue in Blue Tile Roof 4-Story Row House[/*]
 	[*]Ardoris General store sells recipes for trophy heads (for now)[/*]
 	[*]Restored interior windowpanes to Shingle-Roof Row Houses[/*]
 	[*]Fixed scale of Campfire globally[/*]
 	[*]Player vendors are once again accepting new listings[/*]
 	[*]Extended the interactive collision on the Breakaway Cave Wall to make it easier to use these in tight spaces (like caves!)[/*]
 	[*]LifeDrain and DeathRay visuals no better align to targets[/*]
 	[*]Smoke emotes should now be visible on Mac and Linux[/*]
 	[*]All player owned towns have had dedicated banker NPCs added; town criers in those towns have enough to do without juggling bank balances.[/*]
 	[*]The Master Trainers in Brittany Wharfs have names that although are placeholder copies of other NPCs in Novia correctly denote what they train. Please note that for R34 other trainers do not know about these new Masters.[/*]
 	[*]Many NPCs in Ardoris set to bark much less frequently and only when in sight.[/*]
 	[*]Fix for Ardoris lover not having a name assigned[/*]
 	[*]Ardoris merchants no longer try to walk around stalls to talk to players.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed issue involving turning in pre-R34 mail to Desolis town crier. Added ability to reset whether one is delivering mail, once per month, to fix players caught with "lost" mail.[/*]

[/list]

[list]

 	[*]/sigh emote learnable from NPC[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Q4 2016 Schedule Update
notes.content:
[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/q4-2016-schedule-update.64824/][From a forum post by Starr "Darkstarr" Long][/url]

Greetings Avatars,

As we have stated previously, our goal is to once-per-quarter post an updated schedule for our monthly releases. Even though these goals will likely change somewhat as we react to feedback, we feel it is important to provide you an updated roadmap periodically.

Our goal continues to be to deliver our backers content each and every month so that we can get feedback and use it to iterate improvements. This continues to benefit the game, sometimes with sweeping changes like the switch over to use-based advancement. Meeting that monthly goal is our highest priority, but we require flexibility in our deliverables in order to meet that goal. As you have seen in previous releases, sometimes we push things out, but we also often pull new things in.

For the fourth quarter of 2016, we will continue to polish the Path of Love while moving on to the Path of Courage. We will continue to expand Crafting with focus on Cooking, Food, Agriculture, Alcohol, and Fishing in particular. Combat will continue to be balanced and will expand to include cover as well as a refactor of Damage Types and Resistances. Town Sieges and Roving Encounters will also come online to greatly expand our feature set.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/SotA_TowerShutteredEye_external1b.jpg[/img]

As always, all dates, durations, and deliverables are subject to change as we adjust our designs based on direct feedback from you, our backers.

[b]RELEASE 35, October 27, 2016[/b]
[list]
 	[*][b]Story: [/b]The Path of Love will continue to be polished with a focus on the Tower of the Shuttered Eye along with continued work on Ardoris. We will also continue polish on the Path of Courage.[/*]
 	[*][b]Multiplayer Combat Balance:[/b] A pass will be made through combat skills, creature stats, player stats, advancement rates, zone difficulties, and other values for continued balance of multiplayer combat. We may also create additional skills, spells, and combos.[/*]
 	[*][b]Player Towns & Player Housing:[/b]  POT Owners will now be able to select from a set of start points for their town. Also, new housing content will appear; including new Elven homes for the Elven bundles and Testing Incentive Program decorations. Finally, updates to Dynamic Player-Owned Towns that have locked submission forms will appear in the game.[/*]
 	[*][b]Offline Reward Delivery: [/b]Reward delivery for Offline Mode will become available to players using this mode to play.[/*]
 	[*][b]Roving Encounters: [/b]Potential encounters (wandering merchants, monsters, etc.) will appear on the overworld for players to engage (or avoid).[/*]
 	[*][b]Crafting: [/b]Cooking, Food, and Agriculture will be the focus of Release 35, with one of the major goals being the reduction in reliance on purchasing ingredients from NPC merchants to cook food. This means increasing the number of plants in Agriculture and polishing Agriculture itself, including the addition of features like water harvesting. We also hope to add Alcohol recipes and Teachable Recipes. Finally, the visual effect for items that have been Enchanted or Masterworked will be redone.[/*]
 	[*][b]Character: [/b]Ardoris will be the first city where we begin adding region specific clothing (Japanese themed) for the residents, including unique armor for guards, clothing for citizens, and regalia for royalty. Work will also continue on Summer Telethon items, including Flaming Bagpipes and Firedancing.[/*]
[/list]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/09/SotA_Ardoris_Castle_exterior1.jpg[/img]

[b]RELEASE 36, November 17, 2016[/b]
[list]
 	[*][b]Story: [/b]Path of Love polish will continue but primary focus will begin shifting to the Path of Courage with special attention on Estgard. We also hope to have the new PVP area begin coming online with the town area first.[/*]
 	[*][b]Combat: [/b]We plan to refactor how Damage Types and Resistances work to better balance different weapon types, spell schools, and creature types against each other. This will also improve the variety of crafted items.[/*]
 	[*][b]Player Towns & Player Housing:[/b] Towns with player housing will now dynamically update their icon on the Overworld based on various data, including number of claimed lots and online population. Additionally we will continue to expand the Dynamic POT Tool set. Also Obsidian homes for the Obsidian bundles will come online. Finally, updates to Dynamic Player-Owned Towns that have locked submission forms will appear in the game.[/*]
 	[*][b]Crafting: [/b]Crafting will be refactored to include the new Damage Types and Resistances. We will also add more Enchantments and Masterwork modifiers, including some related to Celestial Mechanics.[/*]
 	[*][b]Character: [/b]We will begin work polishing the Kobolds and updating them to better reflect their lore (much of the technology in Novia can be attributed to them). We will also work on the Testing Incentives Program Wearables and Summer Telethon items.[/*]
 	[*][b]Social: [/b]Guilds will now be able to form alliances with each other and we will be introducing a new default guild for all new players called the Outlander Guild.[/*]
[/list]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/03/SotA_Skrekk_u167_2.jpg[/img]


[b]RELEASE 37, December 15, 2016[/b]
[list]
 	[*][b]Story: [/b]The Path of Courage polish will continue with focus on Harvest and Resolute. We will also continue expansion of the new PVP area with the addition of the dungeons area. Finally, the NPC Conversation System will be getting a much needed refactoring and polish pass.[/*]
 	[*][b]Town Sieges: [/b]The first iteration of Town Sieges will come online where periodically you will have to fight through battle lines to get into and out of a town under siege by the 8 Obsidian Cabalists.[/*]
 	[*][b]Combat: [/b]The cover system will be introduced and will modify attack and defense values when you (or your target) are behind cover.[/*]
 	[*][b]Player Towns & Player Housing:[/b] The first iteration of Player Owned Town Blessings will go live where monuments placed in POTs will grant long term buffs whose power and/or duration will be based on the population of the town. Also, more Obsidian homes for the Obsidian bundles will appear. The ability to Rent Rooms in a player home will start to become available to homeowners. Additionally, work will begin on the first Static POTs. Finally, updates to Dynamic Player-Owned Towns that have locked submission forms will appear in the game.[/*]
 	[*][b]Crafting: [/b]Fishing will get an expansion and polish pass. We will also expand weapon recipes to include more visual variants (Elven, Norgard, Obsidian, Kobold).[/*]
 	[*][b]Character: [/b]Valhold will be the second city where we begin adding region specific clothing (Viking themed) for the residents, including unique armor for guards, clothing for citizens, garb for merchants, and regalia for royalty. We will also begin introducing the first of the Obsidian Cabalists.[/*]
[/list]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/04/valhold17.jpg[/img]

We continue to be incredibly thankful for the support we receive from this amazing community. While the funding you provide makes all of this possible, it pales in comparison with the faith you have in us, the feedback you provide us, and the content you are making for everyone to enjoy. We are humbly grateful, and we cannot wait to see you again in New Britannia!

Before I go, I wanted to include an excerpt from my original post about our Early Release Schedule that is important to set the framework for our ongoing schedule:

[i]As a crowd funded and crowd sourced project, we feel it is incredibly important that we provide our backers with information and access well before game studios would normally do so in a traditional development model. Traditionally, the players are given information and access only after the development team has already decided exactly how things will be done, and at times, even after it has already been implemented. By the time the public normally has access to the product, there is usually no time to meaningfully react to the public feedback.


Shroud of the Avatar is different than the traditional model, as we intend to offer our backers extremely early access to information and even the game itself. With that said, we also want to be very careful that we only provide access to portions of the game when they are ready for a wider range of feedback. If we can play it internally and we know it is not ready, then there is nothing to be gained by having a wider audience come to the same conclusion. In fact, it could be quite damaging to do so.


Our strategy over the next few months is to provide you with focused and iterative releases of content. Your feedback during these releases will be critical to making the final product the best it can be, and we appreciate that you are all so willing to devote your time to helping us. With each release, we will have specific tests we will ask you all to make. As we get closer, we will send instructions on how to download, install, report bugs, etc. After each release we will review the results and reevaluate the plan including the duration of availability of each release. Please note that game data will be wiped periodically during early access.


It is important to note that all dates, durations, and deliverables are subject to change.[/i]

Sincerely,
Starr Long
Executive Producer
Shroud of the Avatar

notes.title: SotA Con – A Shroud of the Avatar Fan Convention – Nov. 4-6, 2016
notes.content:
[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=63172][img=https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/sotacon_logo.png][/img][/url]

Hail Avatars!

Portalarium is excited to participate in the first ever community organized convention for Shroud of the Avatar – SotA Con East 2016! SotA developers and players alike will be gathering together for a casual for a casual weekend filled with exciting activities, engaging panel discussions, and of course plenty of gameplay sessions.

[url=http://east.sotacon.org/]SotA Con East[/url] runs from November 4-6, 2016 in Baltimore Inner Harbor, Maryland. Registration is still open, so get your tickets by visiting the official event site links below!

[h1]Developers Attending[/h1]

[img=https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/Lord-of-the-Manor-Event-73.jpg]

Richard “Lord British” Garriott
Creative Director

“I am humbled and thrilled to be speaking at SotA Con. It’s amazing how passionate our community is in supporting each other around such a great idea as this event, which is entirely organized and driven by the community itself. Even if you are not yet a player of Shroud of the Avatar but are interested in learning more about it, I encourage you to attend!”

[img=https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/starr_long-1.jpg]

Starr “Darkstarr” Long
Executive Producer

“Talking directly to the players about the game’s development is super important to me, and what better way to do that than in person. I really look forward to getting to know everyone that can make it to SotA Con. If you haven’t already purchased your tickets to the event, do it! SotA Con is going to be a blast!”
 
[img=https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/berek.jpg]

Mathew “Berek” Anderson
Senior Community Manager

“I am so impressed by this community! SotA Con is a magnificent face-to-face event that is going to be perfect to get players together for one fun weekend. I can’t wait to arrive and get to know everyone in person, play the game with others, and have a ton of fun celebrating what the community has built in the game so far!”
 
[h1]About SotA Con[/h1]

SotA Con is entirely planned and funded by the players, for the players and developers. This once again shows how our passionate and dedicated players are creating exciting opportunities for the rest of the community, and succeeding magnificently.

The event’s planning team had the following to say:

[quote]“SotA Con creates a casual Shroud of the Avatar themed gathering so players and developers can come together, grow together, and share ideas. This is essentially a huge player gathering with the developers and lots of things to do, even for the whole family!

We have a hotel conference room for the discussions, a board-game room, and a large hospitality suite open each evening. We are also planning a group King’s Tournament Dinner at Medieval Times: Baltimore Castle on Saturday night (Nov. 5th) — Lord British will be with us!  Baltimore Inner Harbor is a great place with many museums, restaurants, attractions, sports and more, so bring your family too for a wonderful vacation. [url=http://baltimore.about.com/od/landmarksattractions/ss/InnerHarborGuide.htm]Take a look here about the Inner Harbor[/url].

You are encouraged to dress in medieval garb to add to the fun, though it is not required. Just dress casually to enjoy the weekend. Bring your Sword of Midras book and other collectables for Lord British and Darkstarr to sign! You can also bring a board game to hang out in the game room, or a laptop to play Shroud of the Avatar with others.  How you want to have fun during the event is up to you!

There are panel discussions, lots of Q&A, and plenty of hanging out with players and the devs. The main stage discussions will be:
[list][*][b]Foundations of Shroud of the Avatar[/b] – Richard Garriott will describe the path he took to become the Creative Director of Shroud of the Avatar. His discussion includes the 400 years of backstory prior to the setting of Shroud of the Avatar (including some of the real world events between Ultima and SotA).
[*][b]Building New Britannia[/b] – Starr Long will lead a discussion about building Novia systems and design and the making of Shroud of the Avatar.  This covers using Unity and custom tools and also provides an overview of the creation of Shroud of the Avatar from concept to Early Access in three years.  He will describe how crowdsourcing and crowdfunding has helped and hurt along with what Portalarium expects over the next three years. This session will be the ideal place for discussion around world design and essential game systems.
[*][b]The Story of the Avatar[/b] – Richard Garriott will discuss the storyline and virtue within Shroud of the Avatar.  This will be a focus on the single player and party narrative within Shroud of the Avatar and will likely include backstory spoilers and details. This session will be the ideal place for discussion around single player story and virtue.
[*][b]The Heroes of New Britannia[/b] – Richard Garriott will discuss “encouraging and controlling the sandbox storyline.”  He will describe how Portalarium is telling a multiplayer virtue narrative with a single player story. Find out about things that can affect your virtue and how that can change the world around you. This session will be the ideal place for discussion around multiplayer story and questing.
[*][b]Framing the Box[/b] – Starr Long will talk about systems and community growth based on the sandbox side of Shroud of the Avatar.  The focus will be on how developer interaction with the player community has led new capabilities for the community-at-large, such as making the gustball for Bambino and the battle banner for Violation to support community events. This session will be the ideal place for discussion around multiplayer systems and non-essential game design.[/list]

[url=http://east.sotacon.org/schedule-details\]See the full schedule-at-a-glance here[/url].

[h1]Join The Event![/h1]

Here is how to join in on the fun this Nov. 4-6, 2016 in the Baltimore Inner Harbor, Maryland:
[list][*][b]Schedule:[/b] See the ever-expanding schedule here: http://east.sotacon.org/schedule
[*][b]Tickets and added donations:[/b] SotA Con organizers ask for a minimum of $25 for a ticket for all three days (Fri, Sat, Sun) and humbly request donations beyond that to help pay for all the fun things that can be done. Go to: [url=http://east.sotacon.org/schedule-details]http://east.sotacon.org/register[/url]
[*][b]Donations (those who cannot attend):[/b] If you can’t attend yet want to contribute to a great event and help lower costs for attendees, [url=https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_s-xclick&hosted_button_id=9BBV3TF2PZWP2]please contribute directly via PayPal[/url]
[*][b]Hotel and Travel:[/b] Get your hotel reservations at the group rate – they are going fast! Also see some travel ideas. Go to: [url=http://east.sotacon.org/hotel-and-travel]http://east.sotacon.org/hotel-and-travel[/url][/list][/quote]

Since SotA Con East 2016 is the first SotA convention of its kind, be among the first to hear details on the proceeding and sure to be epic SotA Con Central 2017 event!”

If you have any questions, you can reach organizers through the official website at [url=http://east.sotacon.org/contact-us]http://east.sotacon.org/contact-us[/url], and can discuss the event on the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/sota-con-–-a-shroud-of-the-avatar-fan-convention-–-nov-4-6-2016.62572/]SotA Forums Post[/url] with other attendees.

See you there Avatars!

notes.title: SotA Con – A Shroud of the Avatar Fan Convention – Nov. 4-6, 2016
notes.content:
[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=63172][img=https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/sotacon_logo.png][/img][/url]

Hail Avatars!

Portalarium is excited to participate in the first ever community organized convention for Shroud of the Avatar – SotA Con East 2016! SotA developers and players alike will be gathering together for a casual for a casual weekend filled with exciting activities, engaging panel discussions, and of course plenty of gameplay sessions.

[url=http://east.sotacon.org/]SotA Con East[/url] runs from November 4-6, 2016 in Baltimore Inner Harbor, Maryland. Registration is still open, so get your tickets by visiting the official event site links below!

[h1]Developers Attending[/h1]

[img=https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/Lord-of-the-Manor-Event-73.jpg]

Richard “Lord British” Garriott
Creative Director

“I am humbled and thrilled to be speaking at SotA Con. It’s amazing how passionate our community is in supporting each other around such a great idea as this event, which is entirely organized and driven by the community itself. Even if you are not yet a player of Shroud of the Avatar but are interested in learning more about it, I encourage you to attend!”

[img=https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/starr_long-1.jpg]

Starr “Darkstarr” Long
Executive Producer

“Talking directly to the players about the game’s development is super important to me, and what better way to do that than in person. I really look forward to getting to know everyone that can make it to SotA Con. If you haven’t already purchased your tickets to the event, do it! SotA Con is going to be a blast!”
 
[img=https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/09/berek.jpg]

Mathew “Berek” Anderson
Senior Community Manager

“I am so impressed by this community! SotA Con is a magnificent face-to-face event that is going to be perfect to get players together for one fun weekend. I can’t wait to arrive and get to know everyone in person, play the game with others, and have a ton of fun celebrating what the community has built in the game so far!”
 
[h1]About SotA Con[/h1]

SotA Con is entirely planned and funded by the players, for the players and developers. This once again shows how our passionate and dedicated players are creating exciting opportunities for the rest of the community, and succeeding magnificently.

The event’s planning team had the following to say:

[quote]“SotA Con creates a casual Shroud of the Avatar themed gathering so players and developers can come together, grow together, and share ideas. This is essentially a huge player gathering with the developers and lots of things to do, even for the whole family!

We have a hotel conference room for the discussions, a board-game room, and a large hospitality suite open each evening. We are also planning a group King’s Tournament Dinner at Medieval Times: Baltimore Castle on Saturday night (Nov. 5th) — Lord British will be with us!  Baltimore Inner Harbor is a great place with many museums, restaurants, attractions, sports and more, so bring your family too for a wonderful vacation. [url=http://baltimore.about.com/od/landmarksattractions/ss/InnerHarborGuide.htm]Take a look here about the Inner Harbor[/url].

You are encouraged to dress in medieval garb to add to the fun, though it is not required. Just dress casually to enjoy the weekend. Bring your Sword of Midras book and other collectables for Lord British and Darkstarr to sign! You can also bring a board game to hang out in the game room, or a laptop to play Shroud of the Avatar with others.  How you want to have fun during the event is up to you!

There are panel discussions, lots of Q&A, and plenty of hanging out with players and the devs. The main stage discussions will be:
[list][*][b]Foundations of Shroud of the Avatar[/b] – Richard Garriott will describe the path he took to become the Creative Director of Shroud of the Avatar. His discussion includes the 400 years of backstory prior to the setting of Shroud of the Avatar (including some of the real world events between Ultima and SotA).
[*][b]Building New Britannia[/b] – Starr Long will lead a discussion about building Novia systems and design and the making of Shroud of the Avatar.  This covers using Unity and custom tools and also provides an overview of the creation of Shroud of the Avatar from concept to Early Access in three years.  He will describe how crowdsourcing and crowdfunding has helped and hurt along with what Portalarium expects over the next three years. This session will be the ideal place for discussion around world design and essential game systems.
[*][b]The Story of the Avatar[/b] – Richard Garriott will discuss the storyline and virtue within Shroud of the Avatar.  This will be a focus on the single player and party narrative within Shroud of the Avatar and will likely include backstory spoilers and details. This session will be the ideal place for discussion around single player story and virtue.
[*][b]The Heroes of New Britannia[/b] – Richard Garriott will discuss “encouraging and controlling the sandbox storyline.”  He will describe how Portalarium is telling a multiplayer virtue narrative with a single player story. Find out about things that can affect your virtue and how that can change the world around you. This session will be the ideal place for discussion around multiplayer story and questing.
[*][b]Framing the Box[/b] – Starr Long will talk about systems and community growth based on the sandbox side of Shroud of the Avatar.  The focus will be on how developer interaction with the player community has led new capabilities for the community-at-large, such as making the gustball for Bambino and the battle banner for Violation to support community events. This session will be the ideal place for discussion around multiplayer systems and non-essential game design.[/list]

[url=http://east.sotacon.org/schedule-details\]See the full schedule-at-a-glance here[/url].

[h1]Join The Event![/h1]

Here is how to join in on the fun this Nov. 4-6, 2016 in the Baltimore Inner Harbor, Maryland:
[list][*][b]Schedule:[/b] See the ever-expanding schedule here: http://east.sotacon.org/schedule
[*][b]Tickets and added donations:[/b] SotA Con organizers ask for a minimum of $25 for a ticket for all three days (Fri, Sat, Sun) and humbly request donations beyond that to help pay for all the fun things that can be done. Go to: [url=http://east.sotacon.org/schedule-details]http://east.sotacon.org/register[/url]
[*][b]Donations (those who cannot attend):[/b] If you can’t attend yet want to contribute to a great event and help lower costs for attendees, [url=https://www.paypal.com/cgi-bin/webscr?cmd=_s-xclick&hosted_button_id=9BBV3TF2PZWP2]please contribute directly via PayPal[/url]
[*][b]Hotel and Travel:[/b] Get your hotel reservations at the group rate – they are going fast! Also see some travel ideas. Go to: [url=http://east.sotacon.org/hotel-and-travel]http://east.sotacon.org/hotel-and-travel[/url][/list][/quote]

Since SotA Con East 2016 is the first SotA convention of its kind, be among the first to hear details on the proceeding and sure to be epic SotA Con Central 2017 event!”

If you have any questions, you can reach organizers through the official website at [url=http://east.sotacon.org/contact-us]http://east.sotacon.org/contact-us[/url], and can discuss the event on the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/sota-con-–-a-shroud-of-the-avatar-fan-convention-–-nov-4-6-2016.62572/]SotA Forums Post[/url] with other attendees.

See you there Avatars!

notes.title: Release 33 Patch Notes: September 8, 2016
notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 33! Notes on what is in this release are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=62419]here[/url].

[b]September 8, 2016[/b]

[b]Build Number 480 11:00 AM CDT[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Added a way to set renamable items back to default name[/*]
 	[*]Fixed some doors in Ardoris that were not opening that were blocking access to Skill Trainers[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Fire Arrow icon not visible in tutorial[/*]
 	[*]Using the Mirror on Isle of Storms can crash sometimes[/*]
 	[*]Novia Overworld rework has introduced various stuck spots, incorrect collision and “exit into the air” issues[/*]
 	[*]Some UI text is not wrapping correctly[/*]
 	[*]Rain is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]The new Targeting system still has various issues that need fixing[/*]
 	[*]Stability: The latest version of Unity we are using has introduced significant stability issues along with memory leaks. We are working with Unity to resolve these as quickly as we can[/*]
 	[*]Pathfinding is breaking in some houses and basements[/*]
 	[*]Local chat is failing in some situations[/*]
 	[*]Many SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
 	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
 	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
 	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
 	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
 	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Release 33 Patch Notes: September 1, 2016
notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 33! Notes on what is in this release are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=62419]here[/url].

[b]September 1, 2016[/b]

[b]Build Number 477 12:30 PM CDT[/b]
[list]
 	[*]The Soltown fire quest now has much clearer journal entries, and an error that would cause one suspect to not give vital information has been fixed.[/*]
 	[*]Elysium Mines, Verdantis Mines, Serpent's Spine Mines, and Graff Gem Mines: An ore node that was under the floor is now accessible[/*]
 	[*]Novia Overworld:
[list]
 	[*]Replaced the temporary collision along the mountains to the west of Brightbone Pass.[/*]
 	[*]Replaced temporary collision for North Paladis rivers with improved version[/*]
 	[*]Replaced temporary collision with improved version for river along Midmaer-Grunvald border[/*]
 	[*]Replaced the temporary collision along the mountains to the west of Brightbone Pass[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]More Spite Backer designed NPCs implemented[/*]
 	[*]The letter from Emily to Quincy found in Solace Bridge can no longer be ransomed, traded, or destroyed.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Taunt targeting so it should work now finally (really, we mean it)[/*]
 	[*]Fixed male tiaras sorting with hairstyles[/*]
 	[*]Fixed water appearing light blue in Nightshade Pass[/*]
 	[*]Fixed per-item permission default settings for add/remove from containers being reversed.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed male and female wearable elven mage robes getting caught behind legs[/*]
 	[*]Fixed invisible 4 Story Wood & Plaster Row House[/*]
 	[*]Players can now put Scrap in Purchase Orders on Vendors[/*]
 	[*]Dragons now have a longer leash distance![/*]
 	[*]Soltown: Made some terrain edits and reduced the max slope on the navmesh to help with kids sinking into hills. Shifted some waypoint positions for the path the kids use to help them avoid these problem areas altogether.[/*]
 	[*]Sanctus Spine: Fixed an issue where the last "wave door" would open and shut repeatedly.[/*]
 	[*]All Control Points: Reduced the time between waves. Adjusted the difficulty of wave-based enemies.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed animation timeout errors with breakable walls[/*]
 	[*]Don't play the interaction animation for torch lights in the challenge dungeon.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed glow pulse on harvesting nodes[/*]
 	[*]Added non-craftable rugs on deco merchants and made unique names for all rugs[/*]
 	[*]Made Public Vendor listing text more explicit that your item will be destroyed if it expires[/*]
 	[*]Fixed decorations being able to be placed in walls in Stone 2-Story Keep with Corner Turret Village Home[/*]
 	[*]Fixed issue with Ornate Aeronaut Jacket not being gem socketable[/*]
 	[*]Fixed math for Armor Procs for Sun/Moon that was causing them to be too powerful[/*]
 	[*]first full pass of animation for OMB_lute equip/unequip and idle.[/*]
 	[*]Fixing a bird infestation in someone's house!  I moved all bird flocks up 10m as they all looked low and would intrude on tower homes.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed rotated sewer kit piece in Kingsport Sewers[/*]
 	[*]Removed Slime SFX that sounded when you would hit Elves[/*]

notes.title: Release 33 Patch Notes: August 26, 2016
notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 33! Notes on what is in this release are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=62419]here[/url].

[b]August 26, 2016[/b]

[b]Build Number 473 6:00 PM CDT[/b]

•	Fixed fading state of music after playing from the broadcast automated phonograph
•	Fixed Royal Elderberry being set to seed which was causing issue with Sow Plant
•	Fixed white limbs on male avatars
•	Fixed typo with facial hair rendering option
•	Changed flame fist to arc targeting. 
•	Rotated chest in Plains Road Encounter to face forward
•	Fixed targeting your pet with friendly skills
•	Fixed Charlotte's arm dislocating during celebration at Solace Bridge
•	Fixed taunting having no effect
•	Increased the difficulty of the Phoenix
•	Navigation mesh rebuilt for Plains Road Encounter, Forest Road Encounter, and Swamp Road Encounter
•	Fixed NPC kneeling emotes
•	Disabled cloth chest armor LOD game objects
•	Changed flame fist to arc targeting
•	Forced LOD zero in character sheet and front end
•	Fixed issue with Estgard gatekeepers not recognizing Brigid's amulet
•	Reduced taming restrictions (now more powerful creatures at a lower summon skill)
•	Fixed new kobolds not having weapons with proper tiered damage levels
•	Spite Public Vendor is no longer ever off duty, and merchants in general go off duty less often
•	Blinding shot debuff now lowers dexterity of target
•	Fixed being able to auto-path to decorations in Eleven Greenhouse
•	Fixed incorrect experience points on low-tiered satyrs
•	Polish for Owls Head water
•	Fix issue where transferring a claimed lot deed to another lot would not refund prepaid taxes to tax credit

Known Issues

•	Royal Scepters can’t be used to increase tax credit on other’s lots
•	Some armor causes male avatar skin to appear white
•	Masterwork/Enchanting has a new base level requirement that prevents low-level access to these crafting elements
•	Some items listed in the R33 instructions are not in the game yet (mostly the Add On Store stuff) including:
o	Aeronaut Outfits
o	Tiaras
•	Obsidian Book of Unlearning gift
•	Using the Mirror on Isle of Storms can crash sometimes
•	Novia Overworld rework has introduced various stuck spots, incorrect collision and “exit into the air” issues
•	Some UI text is not wrapping correctly
•	Rain is coming through the roof of some buildings
•	The new Targeting system still has various issues that need fixing
•	Stability: The latest version of Unity we are using has introduced significant stability issues along with memory leaks. We are working with Unity to resolve these as quickly as we can
•	Pathfinding is breaking in some houses and basements
•	Local chat is failing in some situations
•	Many SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.
•	Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies
•	Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena
•	Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks
•	If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.
•	Some cities are experiencing performance spikes
•	Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.
•	The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.
•	Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.
•	Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body
•	ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT

 	[*]Added Mustard Seed to cooking merchant[/*]

 	[*]Novia Overworld: Moved the spawn-into-Novia target for Noreach so players enter the scene at ground level.[/*]
 	[*]Obsidian Alchemists will now hand out a pamphlet explaining how to obtain Crowns of the Obsidians when asked.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Combat popup help to note that 'G', not 'TAB' is the default key to cycle through enemy targets.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed bug where you could detach cursor from game in Fullscreen mode[/*]
 	[*]LINUX: Fixed bug where movement controls would break in fullscreen mode[/*]
 	[*]Changed turn-ins for Statue of Virtue quest in Ardoris to use the correct drag-and-drop interface.[/*]
 	[*]Brittany Central: Added some missing materials in the scene and fixed stretched terrain textures.[/*]
 	[*]Soltown Catacombs: Updated trash pile room treasure type and changed skeletons to respawn slightly faster. Also, the scene now resets when empty.[/*]
 	[*]Brightbone Pass: Fixed stuck spot caused by jagged terrain.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Healing Grace and Engage so they will actually work[/*]
 	[*]Offline mode: saving character on the mirror scene now succeeds[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Confusion advancement, validate combat effects[/*]
 	[*]Holtrot: All resurrection ankhs (such as the one at (-25.0, 29.7, -16.5) ) are now above ground and accessible[/*]
 	[*]Fixed icons for new pipes-fixed icon size for all pipes[/*]
 	[*]Game will now log the player's current loc to a file every 2 seconds. File is named CurrentPlayerData.txt and will be in the root folder for the game.  This is for 3rd party apps that want to parse this data.[/*]
 	[*]Healing touch now only affects a single target (instead of up to 8 targets)[/*]
 	[*]Fixed PVP confirmation issues[/*]
 	[*]Adjust durability on weapons dropped in some of the highest profiting zones[/*]
 	[*]Fix Radio/Add Channel interface sorting bug[/*]
 	[*]Allow interruption of npcs during pathing towards chairs and beds.[/*]
 	[*]Shooter emote is no longer delivered as teachable[/*]
 	[*]Removing skill cap on Chaos to unblock players due to a bug in Confusion.[/*]
 	[*]Dyeing an item from the player inventory brings up the character sheet like it did in the past.[/*]

 	[*]Socketing recipes will display success chance.[/*]

notes.title: Release 32 Instructions
notes.content:
[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/spite11.jpg[/img]

WARNING: THIS GAME IS EARLY ACCESS PRE-ALPHA. PLEASE DO NOT PURCHASE IT UNLESS YOU WANT TO ACTIVELY SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT OF THE GAME VIA CROWD FUNDING, BUG TESTING, AND FEEDBACK. PLEASE ONLY PURCHASE IF YOU ARE ALSO PREPARED TO HANDLE PERIODIC WIPES, SERIOUS ISSUES AND INCOMPLETE CONTENT. PLEASE READ THE NEGATIVE REVIEWS PRIOR TO PURCHASE, MANY OF WHICH WARN YOU OF THE CURRENT UNFINISHED STATE OF THE GAME. 

[b]Please read this entire message, as well as the linked [/b][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z-svq1OvcZwViqGxFCKdjH3NCn2LTfLuGny5qaAqjTM/pub][b]instructions[/b][/url][b] and [/b][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EQczZJxj38npLbysCEjSa_xiWwx7jQ9zFgvX9yPg2xY/pub][b]known issues[/b][/url][b]. [/b]

Thank you for being a loyal backer and follower of Shroud of the Avatar. Release 32 access for all backers at First Responder level and above begins this Thursday, July 28, at [b]9:30 AM[/b] US Central Daylight Time (14:30 UTC).

[b]One Hour Early: [/b]Please note that we are opening the servers one hour early this time to give Group 1 more time to prepare for Lot Selection.

[b]Patch at Midnight: [/b]Please also note that we hope to have the first build for R32 available for download to players as early as Midnight, right after wipe so that everyone can be fully patched up in the morning. Also please note that some of the below deliverables did not make the first patch.

[b]History:
[/b]On Thursday December 12, 2013 [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=32570]Release 1[/url] allowed our backers to play Shroud of the Avatar for the very first time. Since that very first release, we have provided you a monthly release on the last Thursday of every month for the last 31 months. Thanks to our amazing backers, our game and community have both grown each release to the point that we are now the second largest crowd-funded video game ever. Help us celebrate this historic moment as we move into our next phase with our 12-hour [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=60564]Summer Telethon of the Avatar[/url]!

[b]Persistence:
[/b]This Release will be different from all of those other releases because we are finally going Persistent. This means that the progress a player makes will no longer be reset every three months. Just because we are persistent, however, does not mean we are going to slow down! We will continue our Monthly Releases just like we always have. We still have features to implement, content to complete (see our [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/roadmap.52342/]Roadmap[/url]), and lots (and lots) of balancing to do. Even though this is the “Final Wipe” we are still in Early Access and, if needed, we will do small Rollbacks and/or Partial Wipes if we absolutely need to in order to maintain the health of the product.

[b]New User Experience:
[/b]We continued the work we started in Release 31 and polished more of the new user experience in the Isle of Storms, Solace Bridge, Soltown, and even as far as Ardoris. This included a new Oracle in the Isle of Storms, more NPC behaviors, and further transitions of the hints to the new on-screen system.

[b]Balance:
[/b]We began what will be multiple releases of balance adjustments to combat and economy starting with major overhauls to Merchant inventories. We have also adjusted starting recipes, starting skills, and starting gear for better balance and better advancement curves.

Yet again, I want to express a huge amount of gratitude to our Dev+ backers who tested all of the items below on the QA server and uncovered lots of bugs. They also provided editorial feedback on this post. So, they are a big reason that this post actually matches what is in the game, and that it is easy to read.

While we are getting closer to launch, we are still in a constant state of change, and we do not yet have all the in-game systems to inform players of these changes, or to share ways to help them to explore new content and systems. This means we rely mostly on this message, and the linked [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z-svq1OvcZwViqGxFCKdjH3NCn2LTfLuGny5qaAqjTM/pub]instructions[/url] and [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EQczZJxj38npLbysCEjSa_xiWwx7jQ9zFgvX9yPg2xY/pub]known issues[/url] to convey the current game state. We regularly have to answer questions or filter bug reports because some players elect not to read this valuable information.

By taking a few moments to read through this information, a great deal of our time and efforts can be redirected to focus on new “unanswered” questions, and addressing critical issues impacting each release. We greatly appreciate you taking the time to review this post, and for all the truly valuable feedback you continue to provide.

Also, remember that while we are providing new content with each release, our community is working overtime to make new events for you to enjoy. Be sure to check out a couple of the event calendars run by our community members (via in-game book or the player run websites: [url=http://avatarscircle.com/community-events/]Avatars Circle[/url] and [url=http://sotaevents.com/]Events of the Avatars[/url]). You can also get the latest official events on the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=35475]Main Website[/url].

Without further ado, here is a list of what you can expect to see in Release 32.

[b]Full Wipe (except Social):[/b] We wiped all player data including inventory and housing. Social information (friends and guilds) will remain intact. If you have Add-On Store items you wish to convert to credit, then you can do so on the Shroud of the Avatar website multiple times this week. Remember to do it before you claim your rewards in the bank (Live or QA) since that will make all add on store items “claimed in game.” Also please note that if you upgraded a property owning pledge since the last wipe, you ended up with extra lot deeds which will have now been wiped (lot deeds do not stack). Your current deed amount will match your purchases when R32 goes live. Please note that because we are wiping offers multiple times this week you will end up with multiple sets of rewards. 

[b]Lot Selection:[/b] Starting at 11:00 AM CDT, players can begin selecting lots in the game in order of their lot selection group. You can view your lot selection group on your account page. Lot Selection Rules are: 
- You may use any ONE deed you own to claim any one unclaimed lot you wish.
- The type of deed, the location of the lot does not matter, all are covered under the same rule. (except Water Lots, see below)
- Any deed may be used to claim a lot of the listed size or smaller.
- The beginning time of the group after yours does NOT affect your ability to claim a lot; if the next group after you has begun their claim window prior to you being able to claim a lot, you CAN still claim a lot. The times listed are Beginning times. Once begun, your ability to claim your one lot does not expire.
- Any remaining deeds in your inventory may be used to claim lots after the beginning of Group 91 at 03:00 CDT on the 24th of August.
- Water Lots can only be claimed using Founder Deeds
- There are no restrictions on location changes. If you change your mind and want to claim a different lot you have that ability.
To claim a lot you must move your Avatar to the location of the lot in the town in the game. There is no lot claiming outside the game.
- As a reminder Lot Deeds are flagged “No Trade” during Release 32.

[b]Brittany Estates:[/b] This final neighborhood completes Greater Brittany. It is northwest of Central Brittany on the shores of Lake Equitas in the North Paladis region of Novia. It is filled with manicured gardens, water features, and high end shops surrounded by mostly City-sized lots.
[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/BrittanyEstates5.jpg[/img]

[b]Spite (Unclone):[/b] Spite is located on the shores of Stormwater Lake in the Drachvald Region and is a pivotal location in the Path of Love. Spite started as a cloned scene (based on the Forest 01 PRT/POT template, aka the PaxLair template). We completely rebuilt it from scratch in Release 32. The city is now built into terraced cliffs with a beautiful waterfall and has some key landmarks like the Mortuarium. Note that scenes that we unclone after the Final Wipe will NOT get this level of rework, and the placement of NPC buildings and player housing lots in those towns will remain unchanged; only cosmetic changes of building styles, terrain, and foliage will be made.
[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/Spite8.jpg[/img]

[b]Xenos (Unclone):[/b] Located on the Isle of Elysium, Xenos is where pilgrims stop on their way to Artifice on the Path of Truth. Like Spite, Xenos started as a cloned scene (using our Forest 01 PRT/POT template, aka PaxLair). We used the same base template but modified it heavily to build the new scene.
[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2016/07/xenos6.jpg[/img]

[b]NPC Behaviors[/b]: We greatly expanded NPC behaviors to include Theft Detection, Virtue Reactions, sleep schedule interruptions and other activities.

[b]44 New Crafting Recipes[/b]: New decorations, wearables, and armor.

[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=61059] And Much More! Click here for the complete R32 Instructions[/url]

[i] [And did we mention that you should read the negative reviews that warn you about the unfinished state of this game before you purchase? Don't buy this game until you read them!] [/i]

notes.title: Release 31 Patch Notes: July 14, 2016
notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 31! Notes on what is in this release are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=60080]here.[/url]

[b]July 14, 2016[/b]

[b]Build Number 444 1:00 PM[/b]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Fixed issue with Red Dress that was making people disappear[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Dragon Statue decorations so they can be placed again[/*]
 	[*]Updated Avatar's Radio url.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Any item with Cloth physics attached (cloaks, cloth armor, cloth clothing, dresses, flags, etc.) will cause crashes on scene load. Try disabling cloth in the Options menu and/or removing all cloth items from your character to lower crash frequency[/*]
 	[*]Novia Overworld rework has introduced various stuck spots, incorrect collision and "exit into the air" issues[/*]
 	[*]Some UI text is not wrapping correctly[/*]
 	[*]Rain is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]The new Targeting system still has various issues that need fixing[/*]
 	[*]/spyglass effect can be done even if you don't have the spyglass equipped[/*]
 	[*]Stability: The latest version of Unity we are using has introduced significant stability issues along with memory leaks. We are working with Unity to resolve these as quickly as we can[/*]
 	[*]Linux: We are experiencing significant issues with the Linux version of the game due to the latest version of Unity. We are working with Unity to resolve these as quickly as we can
[list]
 	[*]Avatars don’t idle. Stuck in walking animation.[/*]
 	[*]Movement breaks when casting various skills while running.[/*]
 	[*]Dying snaps avatars to incorrect position within a scene. Will eventually crash.[/*]
 	[*]Using Coconuts in select scenes (like Aerie) will throw the avatar out of boundaries. Will eventually crash.[/*]
 	[*]Taking screenshots crashes the client[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Pathfinding is breaking in some houses and basements[/*]
 	[*]Local chat is failing in some situations[/*]
 	[*]Many SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
 	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]If you upgrade from a property owning pledge between data wipes you will receive extra lot deeds.[/*]
 	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
 	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
 	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
 	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
 	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
[/list]
