notes.title: Q3 2016 Schedule Update
notes.content:
[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/q3-2016-schedule-update.53494/][From a forum post by Starr "Darkstarr" Long][/url]

Greetings Avatars,

As we have stated previously, our goal is to once-per-quarter post an updated schedule for our monthly releases. Even though these goals will likely change somewhat as we react to feedback, we feel it is important to provide you an updated roadmap periodically.

Our goal continues to be to deliver our backers content each and every month so that we can get feedback and use it to iterate improvements. This continues to benefit the game, with sweeping changes, like the switch over to use-based advancement. Meeting that monthly goal is our highest priority, but we require flexibility in our deliverables in order to meet that goal. As you have seen in previous releases, sometimes we push things out, but we also often pull new things in.

The third quarter of 2016 starts with the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/final-wipe-and-lot-selection.44430/]Final Wipe and Lot Selection[/url] and then moves on to steadily progressing through the list of features and content promised during our Kickstarter.

As always, all dates, durations, and deliverables are subject to change as we adjust our designs based on direct feedback from you, our backers.

[b]RELEASE 32, July 28, 2016 [u](see above for possible changes)[/u][/b]
[list]
 	[*][b]Final Wipe: [/b]Please note that[b] if you have been waiting to convert your purchases to store credits, these will be your FINAL three chances to do so[/b] as long as you do [u]NOT[/u] claim your rewards at the bank. There will be three windows the week of release to convert your purchases to store credit. These windows will be on Monday, Wednesday, and then finally on the day of release, Thursday. This will work exactly as it has in previous releases.[/*]
 	[*][b]Lot Selection: [/b]Starting at 11:00 CDT players can begin selecting lots in the game in order of their lot selection group. You can view your lot selection group on your account page.[/*]
 	[*][b]Story: [/b]The Love Path will get a major polish pass with a special focus on NPC behaviors in Soltown and Ardoris. Greater Brittany will be finished with the addition of the final neighborhood of Brittany Estates, a plush area composed mostly of City sized lots. Additionally several NPC towns, including Spite, that are currently clones will be replaced with original scenes.[/*]
 	[*][b]New User Experience Polish:[/b] Continued polish passes will be done on the Tutorials, hints, and starting scenes with special focus on the Isle of Storms and Bloodriver.[/*]
 	[*][b]Service Hardening: [/b]We will continue a series of passes through the client, authentication, and server to harden the service for security and customer service. Special attention will be paid to the Patcher.[/*]
 	[*][b]Player Towns & Player Housing:[/b] Player-Owned Towns that have locked submission forms will appear in the game. New variations on the town templates may also appear.[/*]
 	[*][b]Performance:[/b] Major efforts will be done to optimize performance.  This will include frame rate improvements, load time improvements, and memory footprint improvements.[/*]
 	[*][b]Multiplayer Economic Balance: [/b]A pass will be made through creature loot bundles, merchant pricing, property taxes, public vendor fees, harvesting rates, agriculture growth, crafting recipe ingredient amounts, and other factors to begin establishing an equilibrium for the multiplayer economy[/*]
 	[*][b]Multiplayer Combat Balance:[/b] A pass will be made through combat skills, creature stats, player stats, advancement rates, zone difficulties, and other values to establish an equilibrium for multiplayer combat.[/*]
 	[*][b]Crafting: [/b]More enchantments and more masterwork modifiers will come online. Most decorations will be removed from NPC merchants and moved to recipes for crafters. Additionally several homes will be craftable for the first time.[/*]
 	[*][b]Character:[/b] A polish pass will be completed through all the hair styles.[/*]
[/list]
[b]RELEASE 33, August 25, 2016[/b]
[list]
 	[*][b]Story: [/b]The polish pass through the Love Path of the story will continue with special focus on NPC behaviors in the town of Spite. Brittany NPCs will also get a behavior improvement pass. Additionally several NPC towns that are currently clones will be replaced with original scenes.[/*]
 	[*][b]New User Experience Polish:[/b] Continued polish passes will be done on the Tutorials, hints, and starting scenes with special focus on Highvale.[/*]
 	[*][b]Player Towns & Player Housing:[/b] Player-Owned Towns that have locked submission forms will appear in the game. New variations on the town templates may also appear. Additionally the Lot Deed Lottery system for in game purchase of Lot Deeds will come online.[/*]
 	[*][b]Offline Mode Combat Balance: [/b]A pass will be made through the game to adjust combat balance for play in offline mode with companions.[/*]
 	[*][b]Offline Mode: [/b]Patching and Reward delivery for Offline Mode become available to players using this mode to play.[/*]
 	[*][b]Crafting: [/b]Cooking and the Food System will expand with more recipes and more functionality including more food buffs.[/*]
 	[*][b]Creatures:[/b] We will begin a major polish pass through our creatures.[/*]
[/list]
[b]RELEASE 34, September 29, 2016[/b]
[list]
 	[*][b]Story:  [/b]A final polish pass will be completed through the Love Path of the story and we will begin a polish pass on the Courage Path. Aerie and Resolute NPCs will also get a behavior improvement pass. Additionally several NPC towns that are currently clones will be replaced with original scenes.[/*]
 	[*][b]Player Towns & Player Housing:[/b] Player-Owned Towns that have locked submission forms will appear in the game. New variations on the town templates may also appear.[/*]
 	[*][b]Offline Economy: [/b]The economy in offline mode will be tuned to be better balanced for single player. NPC merchants will buy player crafted items at a profit to the player for instance. Additionally pledge and add-on store items will be available from NPC merchants for purchase with in-game gold.[/*]
 	[*][b]Crafting: [/b]Recipes will become teachable (much like emotes). Agriculture will get a polish pass and some new content.[/*]
 	[*][b]Creatures:[/b] We will continue a major polish pass through our creatures.[/*]
 	[*][b]Roving Encounters: [/b]Potential encounters (wandering merchants, monsters, etc.) will appear on the overworld for players to engage (or avoid).[/*]
[/list]
We continue to be incredibly thankful for the support we receive from this amazing community. While the funding you provide makes all of this possible, it pales in comparison with the faith you have in us, the feedback you provide us, and the content you are making for everyone to enjoy. We are humbly grateful, and we cannot wait to see you again in New Britannia!

Before I go, I wanted to include an excerpt from my original post about our Early Release Schedule that is important to set the framework for our ongoing schedule:

[i]"As a crowd funded and crowd sourced project, we feel it is incredibly important that we provide our backers with information and access well before game studios would normally do so in a traditional development model. Traditionally, the players are given information and access only after the development team has already decided exactly how things will be done, and at times, even after it has already been implemented. By the time the public normally has access to the product, there is usually no time to meaningfully react to the public feedback.


Shroud of the Avatar is different than the traditional model, as we intend to offer our backers extremely early access to information and even the game itself. With that said, we also want to be very careful that we only provide access to portions of the game when they are ready for a wider range of feedback. If we can play it internally and we know it is not ready, then there is nothing to be gained by having a wider audience come to the same conclusion. In fact, it could be quite damaging to do so.


Our strategy over the next few months is to provide you with focused and iterative releases of content. Your feedback during these releases will be critical to making the final product the best it can be, and we appreciate that you are all so willing to devote your time to helping us. With each release, we will have specific tests we will ask you all to make. As we get closer, we will send instructions on how to download, install, report bugs, etc. After each release we will review the results and reevaluate the plan including the duration of availability of each release. Please note that game data will be wiped periodically during early access.


It is important to note that all dates, durations, and deliverables are subject to change."[/i]

Sincerely,
Starr Long
Executive Producer
Shroud of the Avatar

notes.title: Release 30 Patch Notes: June 3, 2016
notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 30! Notes on what is in this release are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=59062]here.[/url]

[b]June 3, 2016  [/b]

[b]Build Number 426 11:00 AM[/b]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Fixed a very nasty bug that was causing in some conditions (like crashing) maximum durability to go down at same rate as current durability. Was also causing durability to go down faster than normal in some conditions[/*]
 	[*]Grannus will not stop talking to the player if they for whatever reason decline to turn in Brigid's amulet.[/*]
 	[*]Demig will speak to players who turn in the necessary paperwork.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Novia Overworld rework has introduced various stuck spots, incorrect collision and "exit into the air" issues[/*]
 	[*]Some UI text is not wrapping correctly[/*]
 	[*]Rain is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]The new Targeting system still has various issues that need fixing[/*]
 	[*]/spyglass effect can be done even if you don't have the spyglass equipped[/*]
 	[*]Pledge items and Add On Store Items are having their Maximum Durability reduced[/*]
 	[*]Stabilty: The latest version of Unity we are using has introduced significant stabilty issues along with memory leaks. We are working with Unity to resolve these as quickly as we can[/*]
 	[*]Linux: We are experiencing significant issues with the Linux version of the game due to the latest version of Unity. We are working with Unity to resolve these as quickly as we can
[list]
 	[*]Avatars don’t idle. Stuck in walking animation.[/*]
 	[*]Movement breaks when casting various skills while running.[/*]
 	[*]Dying snaps avatars to incorrect position within a scene. Will eventually crash.[/*]
 	[*]Using Coconuts in select scenes (like Aerie) will throw the avatar out of boundaries. Will eventually crash.[/*]
 	[*]Taking screenshots crashes the client[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Pathfinding is breaking in some houses and basements[/*]
 	[*]Local chat is failing in some situations[/*]
 	[*]Many SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
 	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]If you upgrade from a property owning pledge between data wipes you will receive extra lot deeds.[/*]
 	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
 	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
 	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
 	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
 	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
[/list]

notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 30! Notes on what is in this release are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=59062]here.[/url]

[b]May 27, 2016  [/b]

[b]Build Number 419 6:30 PM[/b]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Novia Overworld: Fixed various invisible blockers, spawn into air issues, and other items
[list]
 	[*]Adjusted spawn-into-Novia target for POT Praga so players spawn at the town instead of in the air[/*]
[/list]
[/*]

 	[*]Now delivering the /spyglass emote to anyone who purchased the spyglass item[/*]
 	[*]Wars menu can now be opened again via the window selector menu[/*]
 	[*]Brittany: Now has 3 songs instead of 1[/*]
 	[*]Updated bag mode crafting UI to support viewing the entire crafting summary[/*]
 	[*]Fixed being able to select friendlies and showing there nameplate in the top left.[/*]
 	[*]POT Cottage Grove: Changed location as per player request in aftermath of Novia rework[/*]
 	[*]Breakable Walls & Gates are now working again[/*]
 	[*]Fixed POT NPCs walking through walls[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Novia Overworld rework has introduced various stuck spots, incorrect collision and "exit into the air" issues[/*]
 	[*]Some UI text is not wrapping correctly[/*]
 	[*]Rain is coming through the roof of some buildings[/*]
 	[*]The new Targeting system still has various issues that need fixing[/*]
 	[*]/spyglass effect can be done even if you don't have the spyglass equipped[/*]
 	[*]Pledge items and Add On Store Items are having their Maximum Durability reduced[/*]
 	[*]Stabilty: The latest version of Unity we are using has introduced significant stabilty issues along with memory leaks. We are working with Unity to resolve these as quickly as we can[/*]
 	[*]Linux: We are experiencing significant issues with the Linux version of the game due to the latest version of Unity. We are working with Unity to resolve these as quickly as we can
[list]
 	[*]Avatars don’t idle. Stuck in walking animation.[/*]
 	[*]Movement breaks when casting various skills while running.[/*]
 	[*]Dying snaps avatars to incorrect position within a scene. Will eventually crash.[/*]
 	[*]Using Coconuts in select scenes (like Aerie) will throw the avatar out of boundaries. Will eventually crash.[/*]
 	[*]Taking screenshots crashes the client[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Pathfinding is breaking in some houses and basements[/*]
 	[*]Local chat is failing in some situations[/*]
 	[*]Many SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
 	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
 	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
 	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
 	[*]If you upgrade from a property owning pledge between data wipes you will receive extra lot deeds.[/*]
 	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
 	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
 	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
 	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
 	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
 	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
 	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
[/list]
[b]Build Number 418 11:00 AM[/b]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Novia Overworld: Fixed various invisible blockers, spawn into air issues, and other items
[list]
 	[*]Fixed invisible walls blocking paths at (121.5, 13.0, 64.1) and (115.1, 14.3, 41.3)[/*]
 	[*]Novia and Highvale Village: Made adjustments to the collison in Novia and spawn-into-Novia target for Highvale Village to ensure players don't spawn in the air when entering Novia.[/*]
 	[*]Corrected label of Vauban Pass discovery.[/*]
 	[*] Updated the collision around Celestis (it's entire island) and Solania to ensure players don't spawn high in the air when entering Novia from these scenes.[/*]
 	[*]Adjusted collision in the area of (-154.1, 17.8, 196.8) to allow for pasage between the mountains and river.[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Brittany: Increased the size of the interaction volume on three of the main exit gates.[/*]
 	[*]Added light to death visuals.[/*]
 	[*]Fixing missing material on dungeon balcony[/*]
 	[*]Fixed various exceptions[/*]
 	[*]Fixed line break problem in tooltips for crafting components[/*]
 	[*]Fixed issue with Ring masterworking[/*]
 	[*]Fix for all gloves that are not behaving well with /headbang emote[/*]
 	[*]Player vendor rewards were not being delivered past citizen, this is now fixed with new delivery method that is account-based[/*]
 	[*]Removed collision from the floors in Greenhouses so that items can be placed in them again[/*]
 	[*]Adjusted LOD group on dresser decoration (cupboard2) so that it culls at a further distance[/*]
 	[*]Enchanting and Masterworking skills should now finally be leveling up properly[/*]
 	[*]Enabled run with mouse in combat with auto attack.[/*]
 	[*]Etceter Crag Mines: Moved gold node on ground at (85.7, -10.0, 139.0) to across the room on the ground. Moved gold node on ceiling at 21.8,-24.9,68.7) across room to waist level. This is to ensure nodes aren't stacked with other nodes that will inhibit mining.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Elven chest armors using wrong cloak sizes[/*]
 	[*]Fixed pink exit archways in Elysium Mines Entrance map[/*]
 	[*]Fixed naming errors for Masterworked items[/*]
 	[*]Brittany Fields: Temporarily disabled all the crop fields due to a crummy shader that was eating up 30% of our frame time.[/*]
 	[*]Show non-PvP players on Nearby Players list[/*]
 	[*]Halved the durability destruction rate which doubled the effective time it takes to destroy weapons and armor and tools.[/*]
 	[*]Added rings to the list of item types available for repair[/*]
 	[*]Fixed issue where player could get locked into /spyglass emote if any other emote was used while in /spyglass mode[/*]
 	[*]Noble Discourse Orb will now work while it is in a subcontainer in your inventory[/*]
 	[*]Pets set to Aggressive will  no longer freely attack other people's pets at will, regardless of PVP flagging or duels.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed auto attack targeting dead bodies[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Epic Plate gear not using crafted metal colors[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Owl's Head discovery Steam achievement[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Portuguese compass[/*]
 	[*]Adding arrows to basic Blacksmith merchants (Spite, Brittany, etc.)[/*]
 	[*]Fixed camera sinking while at crafting table[/*]
 	[*]Musical Instruments will no longer be able to gain exceptional item bonuses[/*]
 	[*]The Master of Air trainer in Kingsport should no longer be taking a swim under the docks.[/*]
[/list]

notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 30! Notes on what is in this release are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=59062]here.[/url]

[b]May 26, 2016  [/b]

[b]Build Number 417 7:00 PM[/b]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
 	[*]Fixed Long Plain Longboat missing oar textures[/*]
 	[*]Baron Founder Boats display pink sails[/*]
 	[*]Fixed typo in Obsidian Blessing of Capacity potion description[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Obsidian Potion of Stamina potion not having any effect hooked up[/*]
 	[*]Fixed range of eye sizes for new female in character creation so eyes will no longer clip past eyelids at maximum size[/*]
 	[*]Fixed various exeptions[/*]
 	[*]Performance optimizations[/*]
 	[*]Added death animations to the Giant Butterfly and Dragonfly pets because people are cruel[/*]
 	[*]Restored bridges to Ardoris from Eastern and Western shores on Novia Overworld[/*]
 	[*]Elad's Lighthouse: removed Novia Map Atlas (backer reward) and replaced with a different book[/*]
 	[*]Etceter: Fixed Satyr bank guard who was getting stuck in the doorway[/*]
 	[*]Fixed LOD issues with the floors in the Crypt of the Avatar[/*]
 	[*]Renamed the player vendor inventory item reward from "Vendor" to "Commission-Free Vendor"[/*]
 	[*]Novia Overworld:
[list]
 	[*]The boats near (288.0, 11.7, -254.8) have been properly labelled as to their destinations (Celestis and Solania)[/*]
 	[*]The stuck spot at (-112.4, 13.0, -348.1) is now blocked off from access.[/*]
 	[*]Adjusted collision at Brightbone Pass near (91.4, 21.7, -314.0) to have a better entry path for players.[/*]
 	[*]Adjusted the entry location for East Veiled Swamp to be closer to the entry point.[/*]
 	[*]The spot at (435.9, 11.9, -360.4) now correctly points to West Veiled Swamp and not the North Celestial Wetlands.[/*]
 	[*]Players that exit the Boreas Colossus scene now appear in Novia next to the entry for that scene.[/*]
 	[*]Updated the entry points for Point West, POT Celestial Gardens, and Graff Island to ensure players spawn in a good location[/*]
 	[*]Updated the entry location for Solace Forest to be near that scene entrance.[/*]
 	[*]Removed collison neear Resolute that blocked playeers from entering that scene[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
 	[*]Fixed issue where hair was visible before the rest of the avatar when a player first appeared into a scene[/*]
 	[*]Fixed LOD errors on the Moontowers[/*]
 	[*]POT NPCs now walking around properly[/*]
 	[*]Updated /flower emote visuals to have more flower petals and different colored petals[/*]
 	[*]Fixed issue where some interactives (doors, crates, etc.) were requiring point blank interaction[/*]
 	[*]Malice and Valhold: Replaced poison field that had gotten removed from magical barriers in Malice and the bottom of the well in Valhold.[/*]
 	[*]Overworld party markers are now working again[/*]
 	[*]Soft targets are now cleared when an NPC is looted.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed issues with trading equipped items[/*]
 	[*]Resolute Sewers: Key animation now plays every time locked doors in the scene are unlocked. All pipe wheels are now interactive and emit a burst of steam on use.[/*]
 	[*]Companion stats now properly scale with player stats[/*]
 	[*]Spyglass now works properly for female characters[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Break Armor visual effects and timing with animation[/*]
 	[*]Fixed missing weapon trail for Battle Spear[/*]
 	[*]All offensive skills/spells and heal spells will consume more focus[/*]
 	[*]LOD for Fountains[/*]
 	[*]Ghost Corpion fight has been tuned to be more challenging.[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Male Bow sounds while moving[/*]
 	[*]Fixed Water fountain sounds in Ardoris[/*]
 	[*]Enchanting and Masterworks Skills now properly influence your chances when attempting to Enchant or Masterwork[/*]
 	[*]Masterworks effects now being properly applied to crafted items[/*]
 	[*]Masterworking and enchanting now properly decreases durability[/*]
 	[*]Lunar Rifts in Bloodriver, Highvale, and Solace Bridge should be properly hooked up and cycling properly for the first time[/*]
 	[*]Graff Gem Mines: Fixed issue causing random spawn in locations[/*]
 	[*]Graff Gem Mines Entrance: Players leaving this scene are no longer trapped in an inaccessible area of the Novia Overwold[/*]
 	[*]North Brightbone Woods: Fixed issue causing random spawn in locations[/*]

Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 29! Notes on what is in this release are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=58158]here.[/url]

[b]May 4, 2016  [/b]

[b]Build Number 412 12:00 PM[/b]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Fixed a bunch of exceptions[/*]
	[*]Fixed issue with musical instruments not playing multiple notes[/*]
	[*]Fixed issues with ransom locations[/*]
	[*]Fix for booting a user from a basement when the plot ownership changes[/*]
	[*]Fixed issue where humanoid NPCs without weapons were breaking[/*]
	[*]Fixing healing touch only working on caster[/*]
	[*]Fixed Kobold Rowhouse: anyone who had this house placed needs to re-place it, i.e. change their house to something else, then back[/*]
	[*]Novia: Players entering Novia from Solania will always spawn at ground level.[/*]
	[*]Fixed access issues for POTs: Cornerstone & Glenraas[/*]
	[*]Optimizations for crafting that should reduce the amount of hitching[/*]
	[*]Removed lot-encroaching tree from Large Coastal Forest PRT Loc: (-215.9, 42.0, -301.0)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
	[*]POT NPCs can no longer be right clicked to be picked up[/*]
	[*]Linux: We are experiencing significant issues with the Linux version of the game.
[list]
	[*]Avatars don’t idle. Stuck in walking animation.[/*]
	[*]Movement breaks when casting various skills while running.[/*]
	[*]Dying snaps avatars to incorrect position within a scene. Will eventually crash.[/*]
	[*]Using Coconuts in select scenes (like Aerie) will throw the avatar out of boundaries. Will eventually crash.[/*]
	[*]Taking screenshots crashes the client[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*]The new Targeting system still has various issues that need fixing[/*]
	[*]Pathfinding is breaking in some houses and basements[/*]
	[*]Local chat is failing in some situations[/*]
	[*]Many SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
	[*]If you upgrade from a property owning pledge between data wipes you will receive extra lot deeds.[/*]
	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
[/list]

[list]
	[*]Gustballs now interactable for summoner[/*]
	[*]Fixed LOD issues with Kobold Wind Generators[/*]
	[*]Kingsroad: Fixed ore nodes in this scene (such as the one at 34.8, 36.5, 11.9)[/*]
	[*]Fixed players getting status updates for one way friends (should only get updates for two-way friends) (yes we really hope we fixed it this time)[/*]

	[*]Performance optimizations[/*]
	[*]Fixed issue where /play was not finding Sheet Music[/*]

	[*]Mining and Harvesting no longer restarts music[/*]

	[*]Performance work in Arodoris[/*]
	[*]Fix for party member names not showing up[/*]
	[*]Players are now always set to begin the Path of Courage quest line and to exit the Highvale tutorial when receiving the Highvale Gate Key from Gawain.[/*]
	[*]Making Healing touch a short ranged AoE[/*]
	[*]Weapons equipped in offhand now take durabilty damage[/*]
	[*]Looks like instruments no longer start with 0 durability... Also, the client was not allowing the same types for repair as the server. They are now in sync, which includes instruments as repairable items.[/*]
	[*]POTs:
[list]
	[*]Carmel: Upgraded to Village[/*]
	[*]Fixed stuck spot on Mountain POT terrain[/*]
	[*]Vesper: New, nested in Brittany[/*]
	[*]Honor Hold: Fixed access issue[/*]
	[*]Drachenhort: New, nested in Drachensteig[/*]
	[*]Umbra Pugno Holdfast: New, nested in Westend[/*]

[/list]
[/*]

[list]
	[*]Movement is stuttering visually[/*]
	[*]Moving things to and from crafting stations is experiencing some performance issues[/*]
	[*]Linux: We are experiencing significant issues with the Linux version of the game.
[list]
	[*]Avatars don’t idle. Stuck in walking animation.[/*]
	[*]Movement breaks when casting various skills while running.[/*]
	[*]Dying snaps avatars to incorrect position within a scene. Will eventually crash.[/*]
	[*]Using Coconuts in select scenes (like Aerie) will throw the avatar out of boundaries. Will eventually crash.[/*]
	[*]Taking screenshots crashes the client[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*]PVP Scoreboard is broken[/*]
	[*]The new Targeting system still has various issues that need fixing[/*]
	[*]Pathfinding is breaking in some houses and basements[/*]
	[*]Local chat is failing in some situations[/*]
	[*]Many SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
	[*]If you upgrade from a property owning pledge between data wipes you will receive extra lot deeds.[/*]
	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
	[*]Some pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Release 29[/h1]
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Early Access Release 29! Notes on what is in this release are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=58158]here.[/url]

[b]April 29, 2016  [/b]

[b]Build Number 407 8:45 PM[/b]

[b]Changes:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Samael in Highvale now no longer flees at the sight of the wounded knight he is supposed to help.[/*]
	[*]Fixed master volume slider bug caused by fade in/out between scenes[/*]
	[*]Brigid in Resolute now is more likely to respond to players who have an amulet of testimony for her.[/*]
	[*]Fixed Oracles in Brittany[/*]
	[*]Fixed various Exceptions[/*]
	[*]Polished reticle colors[/*]
	[*]Players should no longer receive online status messages from players who are not 2-way friends.[/*]
	[*]Players in Isle of Storms told their archetype explicitly after choosing one.[/*]
	[*]Fixed culling layers on rocks at Foundation Wall in Brittany[/*]
	[*]Solania: Fixed navmesh[/*]
	[*]Don't show friend requests from blocked players[/*]
	[*]Fixed issues with Crypt of the Avatar[/*]
	[*]Can now interact with Hospitaller Book when placed as decoration[/*]
	[*]Players must speak to Edvard and begin the Path of Love before taking the boat to Soltown.[/*]
	[*]Made hotkey behavior for combat and non-combat hotbars consistent[/*]
	[*]Brittany: Fixed some bugs with Stairs, edited culling layer on Boulders, terrain polish.[/*]
	[*]Do not allow blessing effects to be dismissed[/*]
	[*]Fixed for gap at wrist on male sleeveles cloth, chain, and leather armors[/*]
	[*]Fixed issues with Tracy of Resolute identification paperwork[/*]
	[*]Changed animation for using Blessing Potions from Eat to Drink Potion[/*]
	[*]Fixed issue where one player's pet was being propagated to all other players resulting in apparently random[/*]
	[*]Fixed male dreadlocks clipping with hats and helmets (again)[/*]
	[*]Players now get confirmations for all three times you use the enchant ability[/*]
	[*]Batch crafting now possible with ingredients in containers inside inventory[/*]
	[*]Splitting stacks on a crafting station table now has the source stack correctly showing the remaining quantity[/*]
	[*]Crafting warnings now happen before completion[/*]
	[*]Disabled Salvage at Alchemy Station (which was locking up client)[/*]
	[*]Added "R" key back for combos.[/*]
	[*]Edvard in Blood River no longer quits out of his dialog immediately when shown the bonesteel dagger.[/*]
	[*]Edvard in Highvale no longer tells the player to go to Resolute to get to Soltown, but instead points the player towards the caravan about to leave.[/*]
	[*]Fixed issues where targeting reticle was not properly displaying in range versus out of range[/*]
	[*]Solace Bridge switches, gates, levers now properly linked to volume sliders[/*]
	[*]Fixed bug where game would stutter and mouse cursor would flicker violently when rotating camera with select UI panels open[/*]
	[*]Changes for free attach charge times.  Faster, but lower max for charged attacks[/*]
	[*]Fixed missing collision with Dungeon Stairs[/*]
	[*]Avatars will once again play talk emote when in conversation[/*]
	[*]Melee weapons can now hit multiple targets again[/*]
	[*]POTs:
[list]
	[*]Avanish Hope: Fixed bug blocking access to Novia[/*]
	[*]Carmel: Upgraded to Village[/*]
	[*]Vale Halla (Frost Valley): New, nested in Brittany[/*]
	[*]Isle of Ghosts: Restored island to Novia overworld. Removed interconnection to/from POT Neath.[/*]
	[*]Estate D'LaRose: New, near Aerie (-483.1 12.5 -204.1).[/*]
	[*]Allaman: New, nested in Ardoris.[/*]
	[*]Haunted Keep of Solania: New, nested in Solania[/*]
	[*]Mountain POT template: Added generic Town Crier in central hub. Added Discovery for Town Crier that is awarded at the west entrance, the east entrance, and upon entring the hub.[/*]
	[*]Goldfield: New, nested in Braemar[/*]
	[*]Clevedon: New POT, nested in Aerie[/*]
	[*]D'Jernstad: Cleaned up interconnection wagon placement on Holtrot end.[/*]
	[*]Underground POT Template: Minor update to Town Crier discovery[/*]
	[*]Avernus: New POT, nested in Brittany[/*]
	[*]D'Jernstad: New POT, nested in Holtrot[/*]
	[*]Stormsong Vale: Fixed name/ownership issue[/*]
	[*]Grayskull: New, nested in Kingsport[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Linux: We are experiencing significant issues with the Linux version of the game.
[list]
	[*]Avatars don’t idle. Stuck in walking animation.[/*]
	[*]Movement breaks when casting various skills while running.[/*]
	[*]Dying snaps avatars to incorrect position within a scene. Will eventually crash.[/*]
	[*]Using Coconuts in select scenes (like Aerie) will throw the avatar out of boundaries. Will eventually crash.[/*]
	[*]Taking screenshots crashes the client[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*]PVP Scoreboard is broken[/*]

	[*]Local chat is failing in some situations[/*]
	[*]Many SFX are not properly tied to the sound volume controls.[/*]
	[*]Some items like musical instruments will show as 0/0 durability. This does not affect their functionality[/*]
	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]

	[*]Skrekk: various dialog fixes[/*]

	[*]Fixed issue where Decorative Pets were not moving when placed in "Patrol" mode[/*]
	[*]Fixed NPCs not animating some emotes[/*]
	[*]Hospitaller custom book cover no longer uses Sojourner Tales image[/*]
	[*]Fix for male dreads hairstyle clipping with head wearables[/*]
	[*]Added LOS check to player targeting. No more shooting through walls![/*]
	[*]Skrekk: unique conversations for Kobold officers and castle advisors added.[/*]
	[*]POTs:
[list]
	[*]Findupre - changed biome to Mountain[/*]
	[*]The Stormlands - changed biome to Island[/*]
	[*]Misika : Changed biome to Swamp 01a. Added interconnection with Point West.[/*]
	[*]Serenite: Changed biome to Swamp. Removed interconnection with POT Malus[/*]
	[*]Port Arx Draconis: Changed biome to Forest 01a[/*]
	[*]Irenholde: Changed biome to Mountains[/*]
	[*]Horned Society: Changed biome to Mountains[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*]Don't allow destroying items that are currently offered for trade.  Update item name when renamed while currently offered for trade.[/*]
	[*]New Hospitaller book gets its own icon[/*]

	[*]Fix for missing textures on Baron Frigate[/*]

notes.title: POLL: All Content Available in Offline Mode?
notes.content:
[i][b]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/b][/i]

Back in December, Executive Producer Starr Long (aka Darkstarr), posted a survey in the SotA Dev+ Forums about making all Add-On Store items and Pledge Rewards available to be earned or crafted in-game in Single Player Offline Mode. We believe this will greatly increase the quality and value of the basic game experience in single player offline mode. 

There are currently 91% "Yes" votes out of the 580+ responses from the Dev+ poll. Based on feedback in that thread, we feel it is important to poll our entire backer community. Please [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/poll-all-content-available-in-offline-mode.43943/]follow this link to the Public Forum Survey post[/url] and cast your vote.

Here is the full content of Starr's public forum survey post:

[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/poll-all-content-available-in-offline-mode.43943/][h1]POLL: All Content Available in Offline Mode?[/h1][/url]

Back in February 2015 I posted about some unique items related to Single Player Offline. Item #4 of that post stated the following:
[list] [*][i][b]Content:[/b] There are a few items that we are not going to sell in game in Online mode including the Castle and Keep sized lots. However we do plan to make those available in Offline mode along with a handful of other items yet to be finalized.[/i][/*] [/list]
After reading about how negatively many backers (and external folks as well) view our Pledge structure and Add On Store we thought a powerful gesture would be to make ALL content available in Offline mode including ALL add on store items and pledge rewards. Players would still have to earn enough gold to purchase them or gather enough resources to make them in game, unless they purchased them which in that case they would start the game with them just like they do now.

Our only concern is that backers who did pay for the content might feel upset that content they believed exclusive was available to any player (even if only in offline mode).

Last month I started a poll in the Dev+ forums to get some initial reaction from the group with the "most to lose". That poll is currently standing at over 90% positive, so at the request of several Dev+ backers we have decided to expand the poll to ALL our backers. Thank you in advance for participating. ([url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/poll-all-content-available-in-offline-mode.43943/]vote here[/url])

[b][i]Notes:[/i][/b]
[list]
[*][b]Earned/Crafted:[/b] As mentioned above all these item will have to be crafted or purchased with gold. The bigger items like LotM house will only be affordable after many, many hours of play. You will NOT just get them all at the start, unless you purchased them. That is the purchase value in offline: you start with items everyone else has to earn.[/*]
[*][b]Offline Firewalled[/b]: Offline mode has ZERO connectivity to online modes. Nothing can move between the two modes.[/*]
[*][b]Online only items[/b]: Some items have functionality that is only useful in online mode (ex. Fyndoro's Tablet, Noble Discourse Orb, etc.). In most cases these items will be reduced to non-functional decorations but in a few cases we will try to make an offline function.[/*]
[*][b]Hacking[/b]: In Offline mode hackers will create mods that unlock all the content anyway[/*]

notes.title: Release 24 Patch Notes: November 20, 2015
notes.content:
[h1]Release 24[/h1]
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Pre-Alpha Release 24! Notes on what is in this release are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=54347]here[/url].

[b]November 20, 2015  [/b]

[b]Build Number 352 11:00 AM CST: [/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Did a pass on correcting female eye-targeting so they don't roll too far out of view when doing facial animations[/*]
	[*]Fix for skirted bodice clipping[/*]
	[*]Fixed difficulty setting on expert crafting stations so they now modify success chance correctly[/*]
	[*]Fixing an issue where attacks were not correctly reporting critical hits.[/*]
	[*]Added recipes for harp, drum to merchant[/*]
	[*]Minor Etceter NPC fixes including pilgrims not updating name tags and Captain Steel has stopped meowing[/*]
	[*]Hooked up proper Engage Opponent icon[/*]
	[*]Snowy Biome scenes now have proper snowy skies and snowfall[/*]
	[*]Set snowballs target type to be "All". This will allow snowballs to be thrown at any valid target[/*]
	[*]Equippable items that make up multiple pieces like the Tabor Drum as well as the Mortar and Pestle now display properly[/*]
	[*]Fixed NPCs that were not loading conversations in Jaanaford.[/*]
	[*]Fixed error with loading public vendor conversation in Vertas[/*]
	[*]Augmented Chainmail can now be salvaged[/*]
	[*]Fixed issue with Tracy's papers[/*]
	[*]Doubled the speed at which experience points are applied to Taming per skill use after hearing the sob story of how Sindariya used 140 collars to gain 3 points.[/*]
	[*]The tour guide in Hometown now awards the Pilgrim's Bonnet in game. Avatars who did not get a Pilgrim's Bonnet because of this bug can talk to any tour guide to receive one.[/*]
	[*]Updated Enchant Weapon and Socketed Gem icons for recipe book[/*]
	[*]Air Balloon, Crypt and Talking Mirror now displaying correct icons[/*]
	[*]Etceter Realtor now has proper list of deeds for sale at correct prices[/*]
	[*]Dale Leland in Ardoris now works as a proper crafting trainer. His brother Chip has moved in to handle selling supplies and recipes.[/*]
	[*]Fixed performance issue related to pets moving around on player property[/*]
	[*]Gate in Vertas should now work properly[/*]
	[*]Fixed issue with female harvesting and mining animations[/*]
	[*]Fixed some issues with animations for the Textiles crafting station[/*]
	[*]Finishing Abigail's quest to find her lost child in Soltown now also rewards the Backflip emote (as does asking about her daughter once the quest is finished)[/*]
	[*]Overworld location names should no longer wrap awkwardly onto a second line[/*]
	[*]Added localization strings for joystick axis  (for keybinding screen)[/*]
	[*]Some polish on the Brittany Graveyard[/*]
	[*]Water in island towns is back.[/*]
	[*]Added a disclaimer for current state of localization being in progress and a link to information for volunteer translators[/*]
	[*]Undead are now immune to the bleed effect in combos that use Rend[/*]
	[*]Fixed issue where swimming visual effects were showing up when the player was standing above the water on docks.[/*]
	[*]Windmill power generators sound effects are now connected to the sound effect volume slider[/*]
	[*]Holiday Wreath can now be placed on the exterior walls of homes[/*]
	[*]Kingsport: Removed some of the clutter from the Overworld so players won't get stuck.[/*]
	[*]Kiss emote will begin to be *re*teachable as well as teachable for some (unfortunately if you've gotten it already it won't change until next wipe)[/*]
	[*]Harps and Tabor Drums now available in game[/*]
	[*]Fixed issue where water did not appear in Hometown until you turned the camera to certain directions[/*]
	[*]Reduced damage of critical hits a little bit (still more than R23 levels) and reduced the high end effect of Attunement skills.The combination of those two together was blowing out both heals and critical damage on spells.[/*]
	[*]Castle Wall display names updated to match new naming structure[/*]
	[*]Changed the case where a player can not navigate to a crafting station to show the crafting UI instead of post "can't make it" to the chat log. This means there should be nothing that can block a player from crafting.[/*]
	[*]Windmills should now turn slowly with changing wind direction not rapidly, no matter how quickly wind direction changes.[/*]
	[*]Player Owned Towns:[/*]
[list]
	[*]Isle of Nylorac: Fixed ownership[/*]
	[*]Knowhere: Fixed ownership[/*]
	[*]Unter Kampf: Fixed ownership[/*]
	[*]Tuned wave height in the Player Owned Town islands so it doesn't go higher than camera height[/*]
[/list]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Aether Amplifiers do not work on Mac nor Linux clients[/*]
	[*]Players are unable to interact with triggers with weapons[/*]
	[*]We do not yet officially support Windows 10. If you have upgraded to Windows 10 you may experience instability[/*]
	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
	[*]Weather has not been propagated to all scenes yet so there may be mismatches[/*]
	[*]Zooming into First Person camera leaves floating hair in view[/*]
	[*]Some skills have not been fully adjusted to work properly with the new use based system[/*]
	[*]Sound effects are not always playing properly[/*]
	[*]Players in the same scene will sometimes be invisible to each other, usually leaving the scene and returning will fix[/*]
	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
	[*]If you upgrade from a property owning pledge between data wipes you will receive extra lot deeds.[/*]
	[*]Time is not in synchronized between scenes that have the new sky vs. the old sky[/*]
	[*]Red crystal nodes in Etceter Crag Mines are all yielding blue crystals.[/*]
	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
	[*]Some assets create flash bulb like sparks on screen[/*]
	[*]Many pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
	[*]Unity 5 Engine Bug: Objects in the foreground sort incorrectly against objects in the distance like trees and the horizon[/*]
[/list]

[h1]Release 23[/h1]
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Pre-Alpha Release 23! Notes on what is in this release are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=54347]here[/url].

[b]November 3 2015  [/b]

[b]Build Number 346 12:00 PM CST: [/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Accidental super-plate-chest-armor-loot removed from The Epitaph[/*]
	[*]Fixed invisibility of rough wooden fence decorations while placing[/*]
	[*]Cloaks can now be repaired[/*]
	[*]Fixed issue where all gems were mislabeled as Uncut Sapphire Gems[/*]
	[*]Tabletop decorations no longer have the weight of their full-sized counterparts[/*]
	[*]Crag Mines final ghost spawner disabled (until we can fix it properly)[/*]
	[*]Train Dextertiy now available at lower level trainers[/*]
	[*]Tabletop Grim Reaper Statue and Skull Candle can now bemoved in bag mode[/*]
	[*]Fixed "Add Character" fields in town and lot permissions window[/*]
	[*]Added scrap as mininum wolf drop[/*]
	[*]Fixed bug where combat would prevent all subsequent interactions[/*]
	[*]Fixed terrain stuck spot in both Highvale Scenes.[/*]
	[*]Party invite dialog now re-appears if you zone before responding to it[/*]
	[*]Relogging while dead resurrects you at the location your ghost was, not where your body was[/*]
	[*]Fixed stuck spot in burned down elf-house in Bloodriver Scenes.[/*]
	[*]Fixed Morton's dialog in Owl's Head so he no longer refers to players as $name$.[/*]
	[*]Fixed typo in Min Liang Tan dialog[/*]
	[*]Fixed equipped items not showing properly on some non-combat NPCs[/*]
	[*]Open pvp players can now heal non-pvp party members.[/*]
	[*]Fixed NPC pathfinding in Vertas (no more elves dancing on tables)[/*]
	[*]Lowered height of dynamic plot colliders to allow placement in underground PoT[/*]
	[*]Fixed issue where sometimes skill timers would go negative[/*]
	[*]Fixed Melee AI not pathing back to player's melee range, AI with higher reach than player's weapon[/*]
	[*]Flattened more terrain in pot underground[/*]
	[*]Fixed Light spell timer not displaying[/*]
	[*]Fixed stuck spot in Verdantis Shardfall[/*]
	[*]Fixed rotation on avatar rug so it now lays flat again[/*]
	[*]Invisible announcers (such as in Tower of Shuttered Eye) no longer slow player down when running through them.[/*]
	[*]Fixed formatting issues in the Recipe book[/*]
	[*]Owl's Nest: Changed display name to "Owl's Nest Mine."[/*]
	[*]Fixed Grandmaster tooltip[/*]
	[*]Fixed NPCs getting stuck in doorways.[/*]
	[*]Fixed logic to prevent right click unequip while fishing.[/*]
	[*]Ardoris castle guards will always let players through the castle gates if they have completed the Tower of the Shuttered Eye quest.[/*]
	[*]Fixed multiple lot markers lighting up when only one is selected[/*]
	[*]Can now complete summoning if standing in shallow water[/*]
	[*]Animated the electric arcs on the phonographs[/*]
	[*]Resurrection ankhs placed in Owl's Head, Kingsport, and Ardoris Sewers[/*]
	[*]Fixed lighting in Owl's Head Sewers[/*]
	[*]Fixed misplaced sky dome in Highvale[/*]
	[*]Moved Blacksmithing table in Soltown that was causing pathing issues for players[/*]
	[*]Player Owned Town Fixes:
[list]
	[*]Fixed lot claiming restrictions for Player Owned Towns to make them unlimited again[/*]
	[*]Brewood: Players can now enter this town from Novia[/*]
	[*]Golden Cove: The Lockbrier boat teleporter now sends players to the Lockbrier docks instead of the default overworld entrance[/*]
	[*]Grumpie Hermit's Hide-a-way and Falling Waters Fortress boats now send you to the correct locations inside the PoTs[/*]
	[*]Bravehaven: Added new Island POT to Novia at (11.39 11.94172 435.24)[/*]
	[*]Sea Nymph Grotto correctly links back to PaxLair[/*]
	[*]Removed old/redundant access point to Wizard's Rest POT from hex grid. (Wizard's Rest POT is still accessible from the one correct hex at the correct POT location.)[/*]
	[*]Nested connections for Dragons Watch and Sea Nymph Grotto now work properly[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Some scenes are not displaying lighting (or any lights)[/*]
	[*]There are numerous errors with PoT data, we are working as fast as we can to resolve them. In the meantime if you have a PoT and you notice something is wrong DO NOT place nor claim any lots until we can fix it.[/*]
	[*]We do not yet officially support Windows 10. If you have upgraded to Windows 10 you may experience instability[/*]
	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
	[*]Weather has not been propagated to all scenes yet so there may be mismatches[/*]
	[*]Zooming into First Person camera leaves floating hair in view[/*]
	[*]Some skills have not been fully adjusted to work properly with the new use based system[/*]
	[*]Sound effects are not always playing properly[/*]
	[*]Players in the same scene will sometimes be invisible to each other, usually leaving the scene and returning will fix[/*]
	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
	[*]If you upgrade from a property owning pledge between data wipes you will receive extra lot deeds.[/*]
	[*]Time is not in synchronized between scenes that have the new sky vs. the old sky[/*]
	[*]Red crystal nodes in Etceter Crag Mines are all yielding blue crystals.[/*]
	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
	[*]Some assets create flash bulb like sparks on screen[/*]
	[*]Many pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support.[/*]
	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
	[*]Unity 5 Engine Bug: Objects in the foreground sort incorrectly against objects in the distance like trees and the horizon[/*]
[/list]

notes.content:
[b]October 30 2015  [/b]

[b]Build Number 344 5:30 PM CDT: [/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Plague Doctor's Mask awarded at maximum durability.[/*]
	[*]Fixed issues with Tracy's paperwork in Battle of Highvale[/*]

	[*]Water lots are now placeable on frozen lake in alpine player owned towns[/*]
	[*]House placement in valid locations within swampy section of dynamic, player-owned, swamp-biome towns is now possible[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]

[b]Build Number 343 11:30 AM CDT: [/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Fixed incorrect display names on multiple pieces of armor (boots, chest, etc.)[/*]
	[*]Distract skill is now in the game[/*]
	[*]Engage, Poison Weapon, all potions that you use on yourself, and swap deck no longer breaks stealth.[/*]
	[*]Sneak attack now does a base amount of damage and then additional damage if behind and even more damage if stealthed.[/*]
	[*]Engage now has a longer range.[/*]
	[*]Using a crafting station for the first time no longer causes the client to lock up for a period of time[/*]
	[*]Targeting highlight visual fix for Fire Elemental, Water Elemental[/*]
	[*]Fixed issue where creatures would get stuck after getting too close to non-traversable areas[/*]
	[*]You can no longer right click and unequip the fishing rod while fishing.[/*]
	[*]Distract: Creatures no longer start moving towards distract point before the skill is finished casting[/*]
	[*]Music added to Highvale[/*]
	[*]New icons for Shield of Air, Sap, Poison Weapon, and Distract[/*]
	[*]Air elemental visual effects no longer play too fast[/*]
	[*]Battle of Highvale: Replaced nonoperational curtains with interactive ones.[/*]
	[*]Updated the Quick Swapping skill to not give back more than 100% of focus![/*]
	[*]ID papers for Tracy of Highvale now readable[/*]
	[*]You can no longer fish from any distance[/*]
	[*]Lights will once again work in the Kingsport Sewers[/*]
	[*]Fixed text for receiving multiple items from an NPC[/*]
	[*]Avatar rug decoration no longer makes objects placed on it seem skewed[/*]
	[*]Conversations for servants working now[/*]
	[*]Fixed collision issue on a boulder asset in Crag Foothills and elsewhere[/*]
	[*]Fixed issues that were preventing Phonographs and Arrows working in Bag Mode[/*]
	[*]Isle of Storms: Added two resurrection ankhs[/*]
	[*]Player will no longer jump at the end of fishing if jump was used to interrupt the fishing operation[/*]
	[*]Fix for some help text during tutorial[/*]
	[*]Water particle shader fix[/*]
	[*]Fixed interactive curtains in Highvale[/*]
	[*]Lamps on balconies of Row houses can now be turned on/off[/*]
	[*]Moved Piercing Breeze combo sigil visual effect to be above the player versus in front[/*]
	[*]Now awarding the correct version of Plague Doctor's Mask after finishing Grand Tour quest.[/*]
	[*]Player Owned Town Fixes:
[list]
	[*]Drachenfels, Drachental, and Drakenhof are no longer missing interconnections.[/*]
	[*] Illusive Cavern: The interconnections between Illusive Passage and Finchfield are working[/*]
	[*]Swamp Template: Replaced missing water quad around (117.1 34 438.9) with a big gap in the ocean[/*]
	[*]Kam: Was replaced by Kai but never removed. Now removed from Novia[/*]
	[*]Port Beran returned to Novia and accessible by players[/*]
	[*]Brewood now accessible from Novia around (442.0, 12.2, 330.1)[/*]
	[*]Serpent's Watch has been upgraded from a Hamlet to a Village[/*]
	[*]Rift's End now has governor[/*]
	[*]Minock: Moved overland Novia entrance to  be adjacent to Blackrock Cove and Blackrock Point. Interconnection between all 3 set up. Customer also asked for interconnection with Obsidian Ridge but that was not confirmed by other owner. Customer also asked for interconnection with Mara Mesta but that is not confirmed AND is too far/not adjacent so can't be done.[/*]
	[*]Ferry between Blackrock Cove and Pomerantz added[/*]
	[*]Added connection between Irenholde and Unterwelt[/*]
	[*]The Caverns of Kahli: Fixed the interconnection manhole to point to Kahli[/*]
	[*]Fixed non-interactive caravan between Jade Valley and Port Phoenix[/*]
	[*]Fixed non-interactive caravan between Phoenix Fields and Port Phoenix[/*]
	[*]Added ferry from Lockbrier to Golden Cove[/*]
	[*]Ferry between Falling Waters Fortress and Grumpie Hermit's Hideaway added[/*]
	[*]Removed non-functional cart in Sparrowfall leading to Port Phoenix, replaced with boat ferry[/*]
	[*]Added caravan between Jaxton and Sparrowfall.[/*]
	[*]Added caravan between Journey's End and Snug Harbor[/*]
	[*]Caravan added from Lockbrier to PaxLair.[/*]
	[*]Fixed misdirected ferries in Islands of Wonders leading to Golden Cove and Serenity Isle[/*]
	[*]Fixed connection from Sea Nymph Grotto to PaxLair[/*]
	[*]Moved ferry between Grumpie Hermit's Hide-a-way and Falling Waters Fortress to where the town owners requested[/*]
[/list]
[/*]

notes.title: Release 23 Instructions - WARNING: Read Negative Reviews BEFORE Purchasing
notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/SotA_Jack-o-Lantern-6Pack_small.jpg[/img]

WARNING: THIS GAME IS EARLY ACCESS PRE-ALPHA. PLEASE DO NOT PURCHASE IT UNLESS YOU WANT TO ACTIVELY SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT OF THE GAME VIA CROWD FUNDING, BUG TESTING, AND FEEDBACK. PLEASE ONLY PURCHASE IF YOU ARE ALSO PREPARED TO HANDLE PERIODIC WIPES, SERIOUS ISSUES AND INCOMPLETE CONTENT. PLEASE READ THE NEGATIVE REVIEWS PRIOR TO PURCHASE, MANY OF WHICH WARN YOU OF THE CURRENT UNFINISHED STATE OF THE GAME.

Greetings Avatars,

[b]Please read this entire message, as well as the linked [/b][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z-svq1OvcZwViqGxFCKdjH3NCn2LTfLuGny5qaAqjTM/pub][b]instructions[/b][/url][b] and [/b][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EQczZJxj38npLbysCEjSa_xiWwx7jQ9zFgvX9yPg2xY/pub][b]known issues[/b][/url][b].[/b]

Thank you for being a loyal backer and follower of Shroud of the Avatar. Release 23 access for all backers at First Responder level and above begins this Thursday, October 29, at 10:30 AM US Central Time (16:30 UTC).

Release 23 is all about moving, literally and figuratively. In fact we literally packed up and moved our entire office during the release! Thanks to our amazing community though, we did not do it alone, and minus the packing, unpacking, and setup it only took us three hours to relocate everything.
When we announced we were going to save money and move ourselves we had no idea the response we would get from all of you. I keep thinking I will start becoming used to what an incredible community we have and then they remind me again with something like this. We are so grateful to have this community supporting us in all ways.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/SotA_Hello_OneFarWest_office.png[/img]

The move almost overshadowed my favorite holiday: Halloween! For as long as I can remember I could not wait to dress up in costume and run around our neighborhood. I actually did not care as much about the candy as I did the pretending that was involved.

I think many of us on the team have that same love of the holiday and as promised, we delivered a plethora of spooky content. As we have done in the last few releases, we are trying to better balance how much content we put in the add on store versus in the game as craftable goods. Because we are still actively raising funds, we still lean heavily towards the add on store but we are making more effort to always try to include at least one item of the type we are selling inside the game.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/SotA_2015_Spooky_Wearable_Bundle.png[/img]

We continued the work of the last few releases on massive changes to combat in an effort to make it more balanced, playable, and interesting. The biggest change is an entirely new combat tree that players have been asking for; Subterfuge! This tree will eventually encompass a well rounded set of rogue-ish skills that mixes new skills (Poison Weapon) along with moving skills from other trees (Silent Movement). We also did a complete rebalance and recalculation of how armor works and completely revamped how resistances work with something we call Attunement. Finally, we continued to expand my favorite magic tree: Chaos!

Woodsman types will be pleased to see expansions of Fishing and Taming. Taming has been restructured to support having an array of tamed creatures at your disposal. This also paves the way for an economy to be built up around the buying and selling of tamed creatures. Fishing has new skills and fishing hotspots along with improved visuals.

All the work with Fishing caused us to look at our current water more than we wanted to and it made us realize that we really, really needed to upgrade it. For this release, we started experimenting with a new system and implemented it in a few island scenes. We hope to move completely over to this new system eventually. We also upgraded to Unity 5.2 which fixes a bunch of very ugly visual issues.

Player homes and towns will certainly be more interesting now that players can finally place their servants, house pets, and town NPCs (guards, merchants, bankers, etc.). Players can also spice up their homes with interactive objects like the phonograph (which now plays wax cylinders of game music) and teletypes (which plays Richard’s very first game).

Last but not least, story continues to leap forward with another single player starting scene, more scenes in the truth and courage quest lines, and the addition of the enslaved fauns (along with their parasitic/symbiotic relationship to their Satyr masters).

I want to express a huge amount of gratitude to our Dev+ backers who tested all of the below on the QA server and found lots of bugs. They also provided editorial feedback on this post so they are a big reason that this post actually matches what is in the game and that it is easy to read.

While we are getting closer to launch, we are still in a constant state of change, and we do not yet have in-game systems to inform players of these changes, or to share ways to help them to explore new content and systems. This means we rely entirely on this message, and the linked instructions and known issues to convey the current game state.  We regularly have to answer questions or filter bug reports because some players elect not to read this valuable information. By taking a few moments to read through this information, a great deal of our time and efforts can be redirected to focus on new “unanswered” questions, and addressing critical issues impacting each release. We greatly appreciate you taking the time to review this post, and for all the truly valuable feedback you continue to provide.

Also, remember that while we are providing new content with each release, our community is working overtime to make new events for you to enjoy. So, be sure to check out a couple of the Community Events Calendars run by our community members (via in-game book or the player run websites Avatars Circle Community Events and Events of the Avatars calendar).

Without further ado, here are the R23 deliverables.

Key:
[list]
	[*]Plain Text: The original plan for the Release deliverables. We intentionally preserve the original text so that our backers can compare plan versus actuals.[/*]
	[*][i]Italics: Extra notes and new deliverables[/i][/*]
	[*][strike]Strikethrough: These are items that did not make the release[/strike][/*]
[/list]
[b] RELEASE 23, October 29, 2015[/b]

[list]
	[*]Full Wipe: We are going to make some fundamental changes to item architecture that require us to do a full wipe for Release 23. We apologize for the inconvenience. Please note that if you have been waiting to melt down add-ons, this is your chance to do so as long as you do NOT login once R23 goes live (which automatically claims the items and prevents melt down).[/*]
	[*]Halloween Content: Prepare for an explosion of spooky stuff! Masks, decorations, statues... the works![/*]
[/list]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/SotA_2015_Spooky_Decoration_Bundle.png[/img]

[list]
	[*]Subterfuge Skill Tree (Combat): The new Subterfuge tree is comprised of new skills and appropriate skills relocated from other combat schools where they made less sense.[/*]
[/list]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/10/SotA_Subterfuge_SkillTree.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=54347]And Much More! Click here for the complete R23 Instructions[/url]

[b][i][And did we mention that you should read the negative reviews that warn you about the unfinished state of this game before you purchase? Don't buy this game until you read them!]

notes.title: Release 22 Instructions - WARNING: Read Negative Reviews BEFORE Purchasing
notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/SotA_Dragon11.jpg[/img]

WARNING: THIS GAME IS EARLY ACCESS PRE-ALPHA. PLEASE DO NOT PURCHASE IT UNLESS YOU WANT TO ACTIVELY SUPPORT DEVELOPMENT OF THE GAME VIA CROWD FUNDING, BUG TESTING, AND FEEDBACK. PLEASE ONLY PURCHASE IF YOU ARE ALSO PREPARED TO HANDLE PERIODIC WIPES, SERIOUS ISSUES AND INCOMPLETE CONTENT. PLEASE READ THE NEGATIVE REVIEWS PRIOR TO PURCHASE, MANY OF WHICH WARN YOU OF THE CURRENT UNFINISHED STATE OF THE GAME.

Greetings Avatars,

[b]Please read this entire message, as well as the linked [/b][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z-svq1OvcZwViqGxFCKdjH3NCn2LTfLuGny5qaAqjTM/pub][b]instructions[/b][/url][b] and [/b][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EQczZJxj38npLbysCEjSa_xiWwx7jQ9zFgvX9yPg2xY/pub][b]known issues[/b][/url][b].[/b]

Thank you for being a loyal backer and follower of Shroud of the Avatar. Release 22 access for all backers at First Responder level and above (as well as DragonCon attendees) begins this Thursday, September 24, at 10:30 AM Central Time (16:30 UTC).

Release 22 feels like a turning point for us. We are starting to gain real momentum on being able to tell the story through new scenes added each release. 

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/SotA_IslandofStorms_1.jpg[/img]

This release in particular is important for the story because one of those new scenes is the Isle of Storms—our homage to the beloved starting experiences of Ultimas, where questions answered determine your starting path. We are also expanding the breadth of our sandbox experience with new ways for players to engage with the world (fishing) and each other (musical instruments and emote teaching). This expansion in two axes is exemplary of the kind of game we are trying to make, while at the same time very illustrative of how challenging it is to do so.

We also continue to remain dedicated to being responsive to all of your feedback and our analysis of gameplay data. We will continue to make iterative changes to the game to make it better, even if it costs us time. In Release 21, that dedication led us to move to a use-based advancement system. In Release 22, we finish the bulk of the work to complete that change-over. Going forward, we can now balance the game based completely on use-based advancement; no more lingering hidden player levels to hinder this progress. That responsiveness also led us to pull in PVP Loot and Ransom this release, because we felt that the PVP experience was not even close to where it needed to be and it had been too many releases since we had expanded PVP play in any meaningful way.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/SotA_Dragon2.jpg[/img]

Release 22 also brings us to the culmination of this entire quarter’s creature work. Many of you may remember that we first began with the Troll in Release 20, trying to see how big we could make creatures and how different we could make the experience of fighting large-scale enemies. This led us to solve technical challenges, like them turning around properly and their head tracking their current target, which in-turn led us to solve turning and head tracking. It also brought us cool features like trajectory-based knockback, allowing these big creatures to knock us off tall things (to better soften us up before eating). In Release 21, we started solving problems around combat with flying creatures with the Phoenix. Now we come to Release 22, where all that learning combines into our largest and most complex creature yet… the Dragon! We still have more polish on these large creatures to get them to the quality standard we all want, but they are already inspiring to see and fight.

We also were finally able to make some time for a round of optimizations that have greatly increased performance in our worst areas. Some say Ardoris is even playable! We plan to get even more performance improvements in Release 23, when we hope to upgrade to a newer version of Unity 5. Speaking of Release 23, tomorrow I will be posting our Fourth Quarter Schedule Update as usual. It will show the roadmap for the next three releases after Release 22 so everyone can see how we plan to finish out 2015 (spoiler: we don’t finish the game).

I want to express a huge amount of gratitude to our Dev+ backers who tested all of the below on the QA server and found lots of bugs. They also provided editorial feedback on this post so they are a big reason that this post actually matches what is in the game and that it is easy to read.

While we are getting closer to launch, we are still in a constant state of change, and we do not yet have in-game systems to inform players of these changes, or to share ways to help them to explore new content and systems. This means we rely entirely on this message, and the linked [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z-svq1OvcZwViqGxFCKdjH3NCn2LTfLuGny5qaAqjTM/pub]instructions[/url] and [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EQczZJxj38npLbysCEjSa_xiWwx7jQ9zFgvX9yPg2xY/pub]known issues[/url] to convey the current game state. We regularly have to answer questions or filter bug reports because some players elect not to read this valuable information. By taking a few moments to read through this information, a great deal of our time and efforts can be redirected to focus on new “unanswered” questions, and addressing critical issues impacting each release. We greatly appreciate you taking the time to review this post, and for all the truly valuable feedback you continue to provide.

Also, remember that while we are providing new content with each release, our community is working overtime to make new events for you to enjoy. So, be sure to check out a couple of the Community Events Calendars run by our community members (via in-game book or the player run websites [url=http://avatarscircle.com/community-events/]Avatars Circle[/url] Community Events and [url=http://sotaevents.com/]Events of the Avatars[/url] calendar).

Without further ado, here are the R22 deliverables.

Key:
[list]
	[*]Plain Text: The original plan for the Release deliverables. We intentionally preserve the original text so that our backers can compare plan versus actuals.[/*]
	[*][i]Italics: Extra notes and new deliverables[/i][/*]
	[*][strike]Strikethrough: These are items that did not make the release[/strike][/*]
[/list]
[b] RELEASE 22, September 24, 2015[/b]

[list]
	[*][b]Maps: [/b]More polish passes will be made in scenes beyond the Perennial Coast, including the shardfalls and the Graff Gem Mines. We will also continue to expand the story with new scenes including the town of Etceter and the dungeon of Artifice.
[list]
	[*][b][i][img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/SotA_IslandofStorms_2.jpg[/img]
Isle of Storms[/i][/b][i]: Long ago, incredible magical forces crafted this island on shards of the shattered moons where it still floats high above New Britannia. Arabella greets new avatars coming from Earth and guides them with a series of questions that will determine which path they start down: Truth, Love, or Courage. These paths not only determine which plot thread you begin with, they also determine what your starting abilities are and what equipment you have. Building this scene required some new solutions for terrain to allow us to show the island floating in space.[/i][/*]
[/list]

[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=53590]And Much More! Click here for the complete R22 Instructions[/url]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/09/SotA_Goggles_Gossamer_CoconutBra1.jpg[/img]

[b][i][And did we mention that you should read the negative reviews that warn you about the unfinished state of this game before you purchase? Don't buy this game until you read them!][/i][/b]

[h1]Release 21[/h1]
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Pre-Alpha Release 21! Notes on what is in this release are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=52883]here[/url].

[b]September 3, 2015  [/b]

[b]Build Number 325: [/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Fixed (hopefully) issue that was preventing looting corpses in some cases[/*]
[/list]

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
	[*]We do not yet officially support Windows 10. If you have upgraded to Windows 10 you may experience instability[/*]
	[*]Flame Fist DoT effect expires too quickly[/*]
	[*]Verdantis Shardfall light and sky settings are wrong[/*]
	[*]Adding a Gem to a weapon will break crafting, forcing a relog[/*]
	[*]Fireball DoT does not work[/*]
	[*]Lighting and fog levels are still being tuned to work with the new weather system, expect anomalies[/*]
	[*]Weather has not been propagated to all scenes yet so there may be mismatches[/*]
	[*]Zooming into First Person camera leaves floating hair in view[/*]
	[*]Two-handed swords cannot be crafted[/*]
	[*]Round Rugs cannot be placed[/*]
	[*]Some skills have not been fully adjusted to work properly with the new use based system[/*]
	[*]Phoenix flight movements are not working correctly in some cases[/*]
	[*]Sound effects are not always playing properly[/*]
	[*]Players in the same scene will sometimes be invisible to each other, usually leaving the scene and returning will fix[/*]
	[*]Death and Resurrection do not work properly in the team arena[/*]
	[*]Crafting Recipe book is not opening when you use a crafting station[/*]
	[*]Water lots in Dynamic Player Owned Towns can currently only be placed along shorelines, not on docks[/*]
	[*]If you upgrade from a property owning pledge between data wipes you will receive extra lot deeds.[/*]
	[*]Troll does not have all visual effects[/*]
	[*]Not all Player Owned Towns in the list are in the game yet[/*]
	[*]Some objects and NPCs in game are missing textures and show up bright pink[/*]
	[*]Time is not in synchronized between scenes that have the new sky vs. the old sky[/*]
	[*]Red crystal nodes in Etceter Crag Mines are all yielding blue crystals.[/*]
	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
	[*]Some assets create flash bulb like sparks on screen[/*]
	[*]Many pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support. These will not be complete until later this year[/*]
	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
	[*]Unity 5 engine bug: Terrain is not accepting shadow casting lights and terrain lighting shows up on grid vs. radius[/*]
	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
	[*]Unity 5 Engine Bug: Objects in the foreground sort incorrectly against objects in the distance like trees and the horizon[/*]
