Ravicus has long been an unlikely ally of the Republic, being given safe haven in the Republic lands in exchange for his help protecting the lands from those who would threaten them.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/07/PortPhoenix_logo_emblem-273x300.jpg[/img]

Together, the Phoenix Republic makes up a unique, if not odd, group of guilds, towns and individuals which work together collectively in the name of friendship and family. The Phoenix Republic is governed by a sovereign leader ruling along with the help of a council of the Republic's leadership. Their goal is to ensure every citizen has a voice and that each group within the republic is able to live out to their true potential. Most of all, the people of the Republic see each other as a family - a family that, after a year of waiting, is finally home.[/i]


[h1]Q3 2015 Schedule Update[/h1]

As we have stated previously, our goal is to once-per-quarter post an updated schedule for our monthly releases. Even though these goals will likely change somewhat as we react to feedback, we feel it is important to provide you an updated roadmap periodically.

As always, all dates, durations, and deliverables are subject to change as we adjust our designs based on direct feedback from you, our backers.

[b]RELEASE 20, July 30, 2015[/b]
[list]
	[*][b]Full Wipe: [/b]We are going to make some fundamental changes to item architecture that require us to do a full wipe for Release 20. We apologize for the inconvenience. Please note [u]that[u][b] if you have been waiting to melt down add-ons, this is your chance to do so[/b][/u] as[/u] long as you do [u]NOT[/u] login once R20 goes live (which automatically claims the items and prevents melt down).[/*]
	[*][b]Combat Pets & Taming: [/b]We will expand pet functionality to include the ability to tame some creatures and have them help you in combat.[/*]
	[*][b]Encounter Revamp: [/b]Random encounters are being reworked to be more engaging experiences, not just ambush scenarios. Additionally, roving encounters (patrolling creatures) will now appear on the overworld map and can be engaged (pulling you into a scene) or avoided if you wish to sneak past.[/*]
	[*][b]Player Owned Vendors: [/b]Players will now be able to place a Vendor on their property to sell goods.[/*]
	[*][b]Spells & Skills:[/b] We will continue to make a pass through the skill trees and add new skills, balance existing skills, and replace less useful skills.[/*]
	[*][b]Maps: [/b]We will continue to polish scenes along the Perennial Coast by converting to dynamic spawning and adding additional content like night-time spawners. We will also be adding a few new scenes; including the Crags Foothills (where players can enter the Etceter Crag Mines) and Desolate Hills.[/*]
	[*][b]Player Owned Towns: [/b]We will launch our island template and the first city using that template will be the Duchy of Dara Brae.[/*]
	[*][b]Creatures:[/b] We intend to introduce the Troll as our first very large creature and we hope to make the combat experience much different than would be found with normal sized opponents.[/*]
	[*][b]Crafting: [/b]Tailors and Alchemists will be able to begin crafting Taming Collars. Additionally, weapons and shields will now display material colors from crafting.[/*]
	[*][b]Player Made Books: [/b]This feature will continue to expand with the addition of Printing (making copies of books) as well as the ability to use Player Made Books as decorations.[/*]
[/list]

(cont...)


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=51664]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #132...[/url]

notes.title: Release 19 Patch Notes: June 29, 2015
notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Pre-Alpha Release 19! Notes on what is in this release are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=51456]here[/url].

[b]June 29, 2015[/b]

[b]Build Number 286: 1:00 PM[/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Made dull red dye pigment less pink[/*]
	[*]Fixed excessive Camera Shake in Etceter Crag Mines[/*]
	[*]Fixed stuck spot in Etceter Crag Mines[/*]
	[*]Fixed issue where crafted material colors were not displaying correctly to other users (i.e. your armor looked copper to you but not people looking at your armor)[/*]
	[*]Added quantity to writable books so you can buy more than one at a time[/*]
	[*]Town criers in Solania, Ardoris, and Soltown now will pay avatars to deliver mail between the three cities. Avatars can do this as many times as they like for a minor reward.[/*]
	[*]Fixed overly shiny material on crafted chainmail[/*]
	[*]Polished tooltip for resistances[/*]
	[*]Fixed error with Ashhaven location in Novia[/*]
	[*]Unique Get Hit VFX for Elves, Lich, Kobold, Scorpion, and Imp[/*]
	[*]Moved a garlic harvest node out of a campfire inWhiteguard Foothills[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Cloaks sorting and bunching through the body of players when doing directional changes[/*]
	[*]Time is not in synchronized between scenes that have the new sky vs. the old sky[/*]
	[*]Red crystal nodes in Etceter Crag Mines are all yielding blue crystals.[/*]
	[*]Books with writing in them (including Player Made Books) cannot be used as decorations[/*]
	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
	[*]Some assets create flash bulb like sparks on screen[/*]
	[*]The screen may go dark unexpectedly in some cases.  If this occurs, you can open the video options and turn off Tone Mapping as a temporary fix.[/*]
	[*]Many pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support. These will not be complete until later this year[/*]
	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
	[*]Unity 5 engine bug: Terrain is not accepting shadow casting lights and terrain lighting shows up on grid vs. radius[/*]
	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
	[*]Unity 5 Engine Bug: Objects in the foreground sort incorrectly against objects in the distance like trees and the horizon[/*]
[/list]

notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_R19_FireLotus_Release_Party7.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=51492]this week's Update of the Avatar:[/url] Play R19 Now!, Port Phoenix Launches, Player/Dev Combat Scrum, SpeedTree Blogs About SotA,Adobe Homes & Decos, The Challenge of Openness and Collaboration, $10 for $10 Summer Bonus Ends Tomorrow, World Builder and VFX Artist Job Openings, Weekend Events, and More!

[h1]Play Release 19 Now![/h1]

Release 19 successfully launched yesterday, June 25, with thousands of backers downloading, patching, logging in, and checking out the new changes! Lots of new content to explore, including:
[list] [*]Port Phoenix: SotA's first swamp biome Player Owned Town[/*] [*]Zombies![/*] [*]Etceter Crag Mines[/*] [*]Chaos Magic that rewrite the rules when cast[/*] [*]15 New Combo Skills[/*] [*]Combat Balance Overhaul[/*] [*]More Dyeability and Material Colors[/*] [*]An Actual Gustball[/*] [*]Player Written Books[/*] [*]Public Cache Chests[/*] [*]Enhanced Player Owned Lot and Town Permissions[/*] [*]...and more![/*] [/list]
Check out the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=51456]Release 19 Instructions update[/url] for detailed information about all the new R19 content.

[b]The Grand Tour Quest[/b]

Just as in our last several releases, we've included a Grand Tour Quest designed to guide you through all the new content. You will be able to get the Kobold Commander Mask by completing the Release 19 Grand Tour Quest. This reward can only be unlocked during Release 19 (did someone say rares?), so be sure to log in soon and talk to all the Tour Guides!

And if you need a little help with the R19 Grand Tour Quest, this month we have two video walk-thrus for you to select from. Thanks to The Mad Hermit and Envyco:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ADZ4BUwK8n0

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zvMgZKYfyE4


[h1]Player Owned Town #3: The Swamp Town of Port Phoenix[/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_PortPhoenix_ZombieGreetings.jpg[/img]

Our third Player Owned Town, Port Phoenix, launched with Release 19 yesterday! It is the first PoT to use the swamp biome template. The citizens of Port Phoenix are working diligently to get moved in. Next week, after they've had more time to get settled in, we'll share more images and Port Phoenix lore. In the meantime, here are a few "moving day" images from the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/release-19-screenshot-gallery.32369/]Release 19 Screenshot Gallery[/url]:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_PortPhoenix_MovingDay1.jpg[/img]

Wow! What a moving day feast! We usually just buy some beer and pizza for our moving day helpers!

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_PortPhoenix_Feast.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_PortPhoenix_MovingDay2.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_PortPhoenix_MovingDay3.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_PortPhoenix_MovingDay5.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_PortPhoenix_MovingDay4.jpg[/img]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_PortPhoenix_Overworld.jpg[/img]


[h1]Player/Developer Collaboration: The Combat Scrum[/h1]

The “Combat Scrum” is made up of 15 players and 5 devs.  We have met at least once per week for the past 5 weeks to test out new systems, new skills, demonstrate exploits, and discuss ways to make combat better.  Usually they last about 90 minutes and I take notes and create tasks during the session so we don’t lose that knowledge.

Since only the devs know how things really fit together and what changes are easy or hard, I push the players to focus on telling us problems, not fixes.  Then I propose fixes and try to get them in for the next session for them to test.  Each session has resulted in about 10 items to be addressed.

Some examples of actionable player feedback included rolling back changes to how armor worked. I moved hits so they hit a random location and just used the armor for that location.  Players expressed too much concern over it though because they felt like it was too punishing to the guys who were highly concerned with the look of their character and less concerned with min-maxing.

Also, based on their feedback I added set bonuses for armor.  I put that in for one session and they tried it out and liked it, but they pointed out that it could be punishing to people who liked to wear the quest hats or gear from their pledge.  So the next session I updated it so pieces could be set as “universal” meaning they work with any set!

I constantly use the Kibana tools for analyzing combat data.  An important example is the “Skill Usage” chart.  Seeing how much skills are used is one of the best ways to find things that are unbalanced and tune them.  For example, here is a snap shot from last month:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_Combat_Stats1.png[/img]

This is way out of whack.  Deathtouch is used almost twice as much as the next closest skill!  Based on this, I went and tuned death magic very slightly and made a few small tweaks to double slash. The chart shows what effect that change had on skill usage:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_Combat_Stats2.png[/img]

Still a ways to go but just a few tweaks and already got closer to a flatter slope!  For R19, Death Touch was moved up the tree one level to make it a bit more challenging to get to.  I’m shooting to have this MUCH flatter by R21.  Flat meaning that players are using a wide variety of skills instead of just a few unbalanced ones.

Chris "Dippy Dragon" Spears
[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_Chris_Spears_Forum_Banner.jpg[/img]


[h1]SpeedTree Blogs About SotA[/h1]

One of the awesome outcomes of switching to Unity 5 is that it provided native support for SpeedTrees. SpeedTrees are a massive visual improvement, and performance improvement, and we've been slowly replacing all our regular trees with SpeedTrees since Release 16. The SpeedTree tools are a pretty big deal, including winning an Academy Award this year!

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SpeedTree_AcademyAward.jpg[/img]

Additionally, you'll find SpeedTrees in many AAA games, including Witcher 3, Destiny, Assassin's Creed, Call of Duty 3, Grand Theft Auto IV, Batman Arkham Knight, and the list goes on!

Needless to say, we felt very honored to be included in such distinguished company when [url=http://blog.speedtree.com/2015/06/speedtree-and-shroud-of-the-avatar-forsaken-virtues/]SpeedTree posted an article last week about our use of SpeedTrees in Shroud of the Avatar![/url] Especially when they prefaced their article with the comment: [i]"Now, fair warning, there are some people in this office who cut their gaming teeth on the Ultima series starting with Ultima II. To say that we’re excited to be working with this talented studio is an understatement."[/i]


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=51492]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #131...[/url]

notes.title: Q3 2015 Schedule Update
notes.content:
Greetings Avatars,

As we have stated previously, our goal is to once-per-quarter post an updated schedule for our monthly releases. Even though these goals will likely change somewhat as we react to feedback, we feel it is important to provide you an updated roadmap periodically.

Our goal continues to be to deliver our backers content each and every month so that we can get feedback and use it to iterate improvements. This continues to benefit the game, with additional game features like jumping and swimming, and improvements to systems including crafting, conversations, and combat. Meeting that monthly goal is our highest priority, but we require flexibility in our deliverables in order to meet that goal. As you have seen in previous releases, sometimes we push things out, but we also often pull new things in.

As always, all dates, durations, and deliverables are subject to change as we adjust our designs based on direct feedback from you, our backers.

[B]RELEASE 20, July 30, 2015[/B]
[LIST]
[*][B]Full Wipe: [/B]We are going to make some fundamental changes to item architecture that require us to do a full wipe for Release 20. We apologize for the inconvenience. Please note that[B]if you have been waiting to melt down add-ons, this is your chance to do so[/B] as long as you do [U]NOT[/U] login once R20 goes live (which automatically claims the items and prevents melt down).
[*][B]Combat Pets & Taming: [/B]We will expand pet functionality to include the ability to tame some creatures and have them help you in combat.
[*][B]Encounter Revamp: [/B]Random encounters are being reworked to be more engaging experiences, not just ambush scenarios. Additionally, roving encounters (patrolling creatures) will now appear on the overworld map and can be engaged (pulling you into a scene) or avoided if you wish to sneak past.
[*][B]Player Owned Vendors: [/B]Players will now be able to place a Vendor on their property to sell goods.
[*][B]Spells & Skills:[/B] We will continue to make a pass through the skill trees and add new skills, balance existing skills, and replace less useful skills.
[*][B]Maps: [/B]We will continue to polish scenes along the Perennial Coast by converting to dynamic spawning and adding additional content like night-time spawners. We will also be adding a few new scenes; including the Crags Foothills (where players can enter the Etceter Crag Mines) and Desolate Hills.
[*][B]Player Owned Towns: [/B]We will launch our island template and the first city using that template will be the Duchy of Dara Brae.
[*][B]Creatures:[/B] We intend to introduce the Troll as our first very large creature and we hope to make the combat experience much different than would be found with normal sized opponents.
[*][B]Crafting: [/B]Tailors and Alchemists will be able to begin crafting Taming Collars. Additionally, weapons and shields will now display material colors from crafting.
[*][B]Player Made Books: [/B]This feature will continue to expand with the addition of Printing (making copies of books) as well as the ability to use Player Made Books as decorations.
[/LIST]

[B]RELEASE 21, August 27, 2015:[/B]
[LIST]
[*][B]Crafting: [/B]Crafting skills will start to come online, and be used during crafting to modify results. Additionally, players will now have the ability to salvage items for materials and components.
[*][B]Combat:[/B] The cover system will be introduced and will modify attack and defense values when you (or your target) are behind cover.
[*][B]Maps: [/B]Perennial Coast polish will continue and new scenes will come online that expand the story, including the desert town of Desolis and the Chamber of Souls dungeon beneath it.
[*][B]Emote “Teaching”:[/B] Emotes will now be teachable to other players. Some emotes (like the ones tied to pledges) will only be teachable by the original owner. Teaching will be done via secure trading.
[*][B]Player Owned Towns: [/B]We will continue to expand the number of templates and introduce a new Player Owned Town to the game.
[*][B]Creatures: [/B]Dragons will begin appearing in Novia! Burninating will begin. All hail Trogdor, the Burninator!
[*][B]Localization: [/B]We will begin crowdsourcing the translation of the game into various languages.
[*][B]Weather: [/B]Weather will make a first appearance with rain and snow linked to seasonal changes.
[*][B]Spells & Skills: [/B]More new spells, skills, and combos will come online.
[*][B]Control Points:[/B] These scenes will now pull you into them automatically if held by enemies
[/LIST]
[B]
RELEASE 22, September 25, 2015[/B]
[LIST]
[*][B]Maps: [/B]More polish passes will be made in scenes beyond the Perennial Coast, including the shardfalls and the Graff Gem Mines. We will also continue to expand the story with new scenes including the town of Etceter and the dungeon of Artifice.
[*][B]Housing: [/B]Property ownership will now incur regular fees (unless you are using a tax free deed from a pledge). If the fees are not paid, the player will lose their claim, and their possessions (including the house and decorations) will be moved to their bank.
[*][B]Creatures: [/B]Our creature list will continue to expand with Chaos Demons and Wisps.
[*][B]Guild Warfare:[/B] Guilds will now be able to declare war on each other.
[*][B]Musical Instruments: [/B]Players can play music in the game with a variety of instruments.
[*][B]Fishing: [/B]Players can begin catching fish in the game.
[*][B]Crafting: [/B]Crafting Table quality, location, and calendar will begin to factor into crafting results.
[*][B]Player Owned Towns: [/B]We will continue to expand the number of templates and introduce at least one new Player Owned Town to the game.
[/LIST]

We continue to be incredibly thankful for the support we receive from this amazing community. While the funding you provide makes all of this possible, it pales in comparison with the faith you have in us, the feedback you provide us, and the content you are making for everyone to enjoy. We are humbly grateful, and we cannot wait to see you again in New Britannia!

Before I go, I wanted to include an excerpt from my original post about our Early Release Schedule:

[I]As a crowd funded and crowd sourced project, we feel it is incredibly important that we provide our backers with information and access well before game studios would normally do so in a traditional development model. Traditionally, the players are given information and access only after the development team has already decided exactly how things will be done, and at times, even after it has already been implemented. By the time the public normally has access to the product, there is usually no time to meaningfully react to the public feedback.[/I]

[I]Shroud of the Avatar is different than the traditional model, as we intend to offer our backers extremely early access to information and even the game itself. With that said, we also want to be very careful that we only provide access to portions of the game when they are ready for a wider range of feedback. If we can play it internally and we know it is not ready, then there is nothing to be gained by having a wider audience come to the same conclusion. In fact, it could be quite damaging to do so.[/I]

Sincerely,
Starr Long
Executive Producer
Shroud of the Avatar

notes.title: Release 19 Instructions
notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_R19_GrandTourReward_Kobold_Commander_Mask_large.jpg[/img]

Greetings Avatars,

Thank you to our loyal backers of Shroud of the Avatar. Release 19 access for all backers at First Responder level and above begins this Thursday, June 25 at 10:30 AM Central Time (16:30 UTC). If you signed up at E3, please be sure to create an account on our [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/]website[/url] as soon as possible in order to gain access for the weekend.

[b]Please read this entire message, as well as the linked [/b][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z-svq1OvcZwViqGxFCKdjH3NCn2LTfLuGny5qaAqjTM/pub][b]instructions[/b][/url][b] and [/b][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EQczZJxj38npLbysCEjSa_xiWwx7jQ9zFgvX9yPg2xY/pub][b]known issues[/b][/url][b]. [/b]

While we are getting closer to launch we are still in a constant state of change, and we do not yet have in-game systems to inform players of these changes, or to share ways to help them to explore new content and systems. This means we rely entirely on this message, and the linked [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z-svq1OvcZwViqGxFCKdjH3NCn2LTfLuGny5qaAqjTM/pub]instructions[/url] and [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EQczZJxj38npLbysCEjSa_xiWwx7jQ9zFgvX9yPg2xY/pub]known issues[/url] to convey the current game state. We regularly have to answer questions or filter bug reports, because some players elect not to read this valuable information. By taking a few moments to read through this information, a great deal of our time and efforts can be redirected to focus on new “unanswered” questions, and addressing critical issues impacting each release. We greatly appreciate you taking the time to review this post, and for all the truly valuable feedback you continue to provide.

Those of you who have been with us for a more than three months know that each quarter we put out a release schedule for the upcoming quarter (expect a Q3 update this week). In general, the accuracy of that prediction, especially during the final release of the quarter, can sometimes be considerably off our original plan. This is symptomatic of our responsive and iterative production methodology that gives us the flexibility to respond directly to player feedback and pivot when needed. Release 19 is certainly no exception to this pattern, and when you scan the deliverables below, you will notice many items that have been struck through. Many of those were painful for us to delay, especially taming, musical instruments, and guild warfare. However, there were more fundamental issues with combat that needed resolving first before we could proceed with those other deliverables. Overall, we continue to maintain a robust pace, and the amount of content we deliver each month is always what we estimated, it is only the actual deliverables that change.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_PlayerEvents_book.jpg[/img]

As you will see below, we focused most of our efforts on improving the combat experience; an effort we will continue to focus on over several more releases. We have made sweeping improvements to AI, skills, spells, combat math, armor, animations, sound effects, and visual effects, all in order to make combat feel better and be more balanced. While we are still not quite there, we are beginning to see where we will end up, and we feel confident it will be a fun place to be. We also spent some time starting down the path of player created quests with the additions of player writable books (quest clues) and public cache chests (waypoints, quest rewards, clue repositories, etc.).

Also, remember that while we are providing new content with each release, our community is working overtime to make new events for you to enjoy. So, be sure to check out a couple of the Community Events Calendars run by our community members (via in game book or the player run websites [url=http://avatarscircle.com/community-events/]Avatars Circle[/url] Community Events and [url=http://sotaevents.com/]Events of the Avatars[/url] calendar).

Without further ado, here are the R19 deliverables.

Key:
[list]
	[*]Plain Text: The original plan for the Release deliverables. We intentionally preserve the original text so that our backers can compare plan versus actuals.[/*]
	[*][i]Italics: Extra notes and new deliverables.[/i][/*]
	[*][strike]Strikethrough: These are items that did not make the release.[/strike][/*]
[/list]
[b]RELEASE 19, June 25, 2015:[/b]

[list]
	[*][b]Maps: [/b]We hope to get the Quel Region [u]near final and start on the Midmaer Region[/u]
[list]
	[*][b][i]Midmaer Expansions Delayed: [/i][/b][i]As we did in Release 18 we decided to focus mostly on iterating and improving existing scenes, including dynamic spawning, instead of creating more new scenes (although we did add 2 new scenes: Etceter Crag Mines and Whiteguard Foothills). [/i][/*]
	[*][b][i]Nighttime Spawners: [/i][/b][i]Adventuring at night is now a more dangerous endeavor because higher level undead spawn at night, including Zombies. [/i][/*]
	[*][b][i]Improved Scenes (+Zombies and Nighttime Spawners): [/i][/b][i]We polished the creature and resource spawning in several Perennial Coast and Grunvald scenes. We also added Zombie and/or Nighttime spawners to almost all of them.[/i]
[list]
	[*][b][i]North Grunvald Barrens: [/i][/b][i]Nighttime and Zombie Spawners.[/i][/*]
	[*][b][i]South Grunvald Barrens: [/i][/b][i]Nighttime and Zombie Spawners.[/i][/*]
	[*][b][i]East Perennial Trail: [/i][/b][i]Nighttime and Zombie Spawners.[/i][/*]
	[*][b][i]Savrenoc Timberlands:[/i][/b][i] Nighttime and Zombie Spawners.[/i][/*]
	[*][b][i]Deep Savrenoc Timberlands:[/i][/b][i] Nighttime and Zombie Spawners.[/i][/*]
	[*][b][i]Savrenoc Stronghold:[/i][/b][i] Nighttime and Zombie Spawners.[/i][/*]
	[*][b][i]Solace Bridge: [/i][/b][i]Nighttime and Zombie Spawners. Dialog cleanup, general scene improvement to match the tutorial version, and a few new quests.[/i][/*]
	[*][b][i]Solace Forest: [/i][/b][i]Visual polish, general spawn polish, and dynamic spawns + Nighttime and Zombie Spawners.[/i][/*]
	[*][b][i]South Celestial Wetlands:[/i][/b][i] Dynamic spawns and general spawn polish + Nighttime and Zombie Spawners.[/i][/*]
	[*][b][i]East Veiled Swamp: [/i][/b][i]Dynamic spawns and general spawn polish + Nighttime and Zombie Spawners.[/i][/*]
	[*][b][i]Spectral Foothills:[/i][/b][i] General spawn polish + Nighttime and Zombie Spawners.[/i][/*]
	[*][b][i]Necropolis: [/i][/b][i]Dynamic spawns and general spawn polish.[/i][/*]
	[*][b][i]Human Battle Camp:[/i][/b][i] Visual polish and bug fixes.[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][b][i]Whiteguard Foothills: [/i][/b][i]Visitors to this new area in the Whiteguard mountains should keep their coin purses hidden. Savage wolves and bears are bad enough, but now rumors are spreading of highwaymen waylaying merchant caravans traveling through these foothills.[/i][/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Update of the Avatar #130 – 2015.06.19
notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_Emote_Taming_Prattkeeping.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=51354]this week's Update of the Avatar:[/url] Prattkeeping/Tame Emote, Port Phoenix and the Player Owned Town Swamp Template, Order of Vengeance Tournaments, The SotA Writing Round Table Unreliable Travel Guide, $10 for $10 Summer Bonus, Bear Tavern Brawl - War of 5 Armies!, Vengeance: Quests, World Builder and VFX Artist Job Openings, In-game Community Weekend Events, and More!

[h1]Prattkeeping, er, um, I Mean Tame Emote[/h1]

We found it amazingly coincidental that our new taming emote (/tame), included in Release 19 next week, bears some resemblance to Chris Pratt's velociraptor taming pose from the recent Jurassic World movie. How weird is that!


[h1]Port Phoenix and the Player Owned Town Swamp Template[/h1]

Michael Hutchison has completed our third Player Owned Town template, the swamp biome. Port Phoenix was selected as the first swamp-based Player Owned Town to help test the template. This template can now be selected and viewed in the Player Owned Town Submission form. Here is the template and a few scene images, which you will be able to see live in Port Phoenix in Release 19 next week, June 25th:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_PoT_Template_Swamp_1.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_PoT_Swamp3.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_PoT_Swamp2.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_PoT_Swamp1.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_PoT_Swamp4.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_PoT_Swamp5.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_PoT_Swamp6.jpg[/img]


[h1]Order of Vengeance Tournaments: Siege the Keep[/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_R18_Vengeance_overworld.jpg[/img]

Located at the northern end of the Grunvald Desert, the PvP town of Vengeance was introduced in R18 as the second Player Owned Town in New Britannia. Vengeance has hosted numerous PvP community events almost every night since they launched! Here are examples of some of their exciting events:

[quote][i][b][url=http://sotawiki.net/sota/Community:Vengeance/Moon_tower_power]Moon Tower Power[/url][/b][/i]

Team 1 and Team 2 will be told when to start via whisper and they will rush the moon tower. Team 1 is attempting to keep the tower powered ON... Team 2 is attempting to shut it OFF. After 15 minutes the teams will switch sides and purpose. Each time the judge will be attempting to keep an eye on the power and hopefully not get killed too many times. In the event he is killed there will be a pause to the event timer that will NOT be announced. The judge will call out when the time is up and suggests you do what you can to keep fighting for the tower until you see the text "TIME'S UP!" spammed in front of the moon tower.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=w9i-DptBgxs
[/quote]

[quote]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=50566]this week's Update of the Avatar:[/url] Zombies!, SotA at E3,Solace Forest, R18 Postmortem, Player Created Quests, Aether Vibration Amplifier Console, Kobold Masks, Bear Tavern Brawl - War of 5 Armies!, Vengeance: Quests, World Builder and VFX Artist Job Openings, In-game Community Weekend Events, and More!

[h1]Zombies![/h1]

The ranks of the undead armies have swelled of late with the addition of hordes of zombies. These reanimated corpses move slowly but they carry a foul zombie plague that can only be cured with magic spells or potions. The zombie plague is spread through vicious clawing attacks and a noxious cloud that explodes out of destroyed zombies. Anyone killed by a zombie or anyone who dies from the zombie plague creates another zombie that must be destroyed.

Character artists Geoff Mellon and Kevin Wells and animator Bren Wilson really nailed it with these awesome zombies!


[h1]SotA at E3 Next Week[/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/11416319_10207147013299157_3594808240401449079_o1.jpg[/img]

Both Starr Long and Richard Garriott will be showing off Shroud of the Avatar at E3 next week. We'll be at the Razer booth: 4800 West Hall! Come by and sign up for free access to the opening weekend of Release 20 and other prizes!


[h1]Solace Forest[/h1]

Abe, Hutch, and other members of the level design team have been prepping the new Solace Forest scene for Release 19. Here are a few sample pics:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_SolaceForest1.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_SolaceForest2.jpg[/img]


[h1]Hangout of the Avatar: Release 18 Postmortem[/h1]

We had a great Hangout of the Avatar this week, with Richard, Starr, and Chris chatting about Release 18 and looking ahead to Release 19. FireLotus was fielding lots of juicy questions live from the chat-room as well as in advance from the OP comments section, and several cool prizes were randomly given out to those attending the hangout! In case you missed it, here's the video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zFwvFPCyIZY


[h1]Player Created Quests[/h1]

[quote][b][i]A Note from Lord British[/i][/b]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_LordBritish_Portrait_150px.jpg[/img]

Greetings Avatars,

Many months ago, I began to see the amazing creativity of our community in the creation of quests. They were hacked in by players despite little intentional support from us to make this easy or powerful. Until now, live players had to stand in real-time to be the waypoints along any quest line. Likewise live players had to take or give any items or be the obstacles along any quest path. We began to explore ways we could create tools to help increase the ease and power of such community created events. Our goal is to allow players to craft deeper quests directly into the game world itself, to be able to leave clues in the world 24/7, and to have treasure (and ultimately protection of those treasures) that do not demand 24/7 live players to be ever present.

In R19, we are releasing the 1st features along this path. Writable books & notes and chest permissions open a broad new pallet for community quest making. Imagine for example, a community purposefully spreading a rumor about the local grave digger and his sinister nocturnal activities... players could write and leave notes in the graveyard they created in their town, describing how this grave digger bargained for body parts of deceased pets in graveyards in allied towns graveyards, or a specific person's home. Sequences of notes could be placed such that false leads abound, and only carefully following the trail from the start will lead through the correct sequence. Finally when the ultimate destination is found, a new cache chest could be placed (which allows all visitors to take anything out of or put anything into it). The creators of this quest could stock that chest with pet call whistles that summon the supposedly restored pet. Pets that the gravedigger may have brought back to life!

All of these notes and cache chests must be left on a player owned lot at the moment and all "treasure" left in the cache chest must be stocked by the owners as well, but I believe this is an important first step in creating tools for powerful player created quests.

Good luck in your quest building, I look forward to experiencing and celebrating some of the best ones created in each release!

- Lord British[/quote]

[h1]Public Cache Chest[/h1]

This public cache chest will be available at in-game vendors in Release 19. It operates just like other containers on your lot, only this one allows any player to take items from it, or put items in it (but they cannot move or take the chest). Fill it with any items that you want to make available to visitors. Great for player created quests where you may want to leave quest clues or loot for questors to discover.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_PublicCacheChest.jpg[/img]

 
[u][b][url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=9085&open=ornate_public_cache_chest__digital_]Ornate Public Cache Chest[/url][/b][/u]

This ornate public cache chest is only available in the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=9085&open=ornate_public_cache_chest__digital_]Add-On Store[/url]:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_Ornate_PublicCacheChest.jpg[/img]


[h1]Time Lapse Video of New Britannia's Celestial Bodies[/h1]

Our thanks to community member AvatarAcid for posting a time-lapse video in the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/the-sky-of-new-britannia-8-hour-time-lapse.28755/]SotA forums of The recently introduced Celestial Bodies in New Britannia[/url]!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=RVPHx9T9ycU




[h1]Sign Up for the Bear Tavern Brawl - War of 5 Armies[/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/BearTavernBrawl_zps50d444431.png[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/WarOfFiveArmies2_zpslizi27p81.png[/img]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_EtceterMines_2.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=50566]this week's Update of the Avatar:[/url] Etceter Crag Mines, Are You Ready for some Gustball!, Envyco Gaming: R18 Deck Building Tutorial, Hangout of the Avatar ~ Release 18 Postmortem, World Builder/Level Designer and VFX Artist Job Openings,  In-game Community Weekend Events, and More!

[h1]Etceter Crag Mines[/h1]

In preparation for Release 19, Scottie Jones has been crafting the Etceter Crag Mines with Rick Holtrop contributing gameplay elements. Here's a bit of the story of those mines:


Long ago, when Etceter was nothing more than a collection of prospector shacks and tents hugging the coast of the Bay of Storms at the mouth of the Barren River, the Etceter Crag Mines were being dug deep into the nearby mountainous hills known as the Crags. At first the miners were sure their fortunes were made. The deeper they dug, the richer the veins of gold ore seemed to be.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_EtceterMines_3.jpg[/img]

When they came upon the underground pool with its fresh mineral waterfall and the subterranean river to the sea, they saw this as an incomparable blessing! Now they could easily trade gold directly with the passing ships plying the ocean-routes back toward their home, without even bothering to leave their lucrative mines.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_EtceterMines_7.jpg[/img]

But the stories say they became too greedy, and they braved the trembling depths of the world too deeply. Perhaps the view of distant volcanic islands should have warned them of the dangers they were about to unearth. After a horrifying tragedy the mine was abandoned, with terrible tales of holes opened up into Hell itself, and fiery demons emerging to slay all in their path. The lower levels of the mine were supposedly sealed in an enormous cave-in, with barely half the terrified miners emerging to tell the tale.


[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_EtceterMines_6.jpg[/img]

These days, only bandits and brigands make use of the upper levels of the abandoned mines, and even they refuse to delve too deep.


[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_EtceterMines_1.jpg[/img]

Those who have the guts to speak with them will hear tales of rumbling deep within the earth, whispering voices, and the hideous spectres of the dead haunting the deeper recesses of the dark tunnels. Of course, these may merely be stories they tell to insure that the curious stay clear. Perhaps there are still golden treasures to be found deep within the rocky bowels of the mountains

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_EtceterMines_8.jpg[/img]


[h1]Are You Ready for some Gustball![/h1]

With the launch of PaxLair in Release 17 last month, community member Bambino orchestrated a rather unique event entitled "Gustball". As described by Bambino in his initial Release 17 Events forum post:

The essence of Gustball: Two teams are pitted against each other in sporting event not dissimilar from soccer, football, and basketball. The object of the game is to Gust a “Gustball” (an avatar named "The Ball") around the field and into your opponent’s goal; the team that scores the most goals within two halves wins the match. In the event of a tie, the game is extended and the very next goal decides the winner. Each half will last 10 minutes. Teams will either wear a white cloak or green cloak, depending on what team they are on. The Gustball will wear a red cloak.

Here is a screenshot shared on the forums by Soleidad of that first Gustball event held in the PaxLair Arena Basement:

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/i0tKybP1.png[/img]

[h1]Etceter Crag Mines[/h1]

In preparation for Release 19, Scottie Jones has been crafting the Etceter Crag Mines with Rick Holtrop contributing gameplay elements. Here's a bit of the story of those mines:


Long ago, when Etceter was nothing more than a collection of prospector shacks and tents hugging the coast of the Bay of Storms at the mouth of the Barren River, the Etceter Crag Mines were being dug deep into the nearby mountainous hills known as the Crags. At first the miners were sure their fortunes were made. The deeper they dug, the richer the veins of gold ore seemed to be.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_EtceterMines_3.jpg[/img]

When they came upon the underground pool with its fresh mineral waterfall and the subterranean river to the sea, they saw this as an incomparable blessing! Now they could easily trade gold directly with the passing ships plying the ocean-routes back toward their home, without even bothering to leave their lucrative mines.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_EtceterMines_7.jpg[/img]

But the stories say they became too greedy, and they braved the trembling depths of the world too deeply. Perhaps the view of distant volcanic islands should have warned them of the dangers they were about to unearth. After a horrifying tragedy the mine was abandoned, with terrible tales of holes opened up into Hell itself, and fiery demons emerging to slay all in their path. The lower levels of the mine were supposedly sealed in an enormous cave-in, with barely half the terrified miners emerging to tell the tale.


[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_EtceterMines_6.jpg[/img]

These days, only bandits and brigands make use of the upper levels of the abandoned mines, and even they refuse to delve too deep.


[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_EtceterMines_1.jpg[/img]

Those who have the guts to speak with them will hear tales of rumbling deep within the earth, whispering voices, and the hideous spectres of the dead haunting the deeper recesses of the dark tunnels. Of course, these may merely be stories they tell to insure that the curious stay clear. Perhaps there are still golden treasures to be found deep within the rocky bowels of the mountains

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/SotA_EtceterMines_8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Release 18 Patch Notes: June 2, 2015
notes.content:
[b]June 2, 2015[/b]

[b]Build Number 274: 11:00 AM[/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Females will no longer grunt like a man when jumping.[/*]
	[*]Skeletons no longer growl like dogs. The sound effect is still a terrible placeholder but now it is slightly less terrible[/*]
	[*]Skills that were knocking people down before, just do a stun. The knockdown is what was broken. We didn't change the accumulated stun resist buff but we'll be evaluating that this release.[/*]
	[*]Charge had its cool down time increased to 30 seconds and focus raised to 8. Reminder, once a card is used, it doesn't go back into the pool of cards until that cool down expires.[/*]
	[*]Dazzling Rays had its cool down increased to 60, lock time increased from 2 to 3 and its cast time increased from 0 to 2. That means it can now be interrupted for the first 2 seconds of casting it. Also, focus went from 4 to 10.[/*]
	[*]Gust will no longer knock people down and instead has a 33% chance to stun[/*]
	[*]Ignite Weapon focus cost increased to 12.[/*]
	[*]Moonbeams, cooldown from 20 to 30. Still a 2 second cast but interruptable for the first 1.5 seconds.[/*]
	[*]Piercing breeze no longer knocks down but does stun[/*]
	[*]Shield smash moved from a fixed range of 3 to use the set weapon range of the shield... which are all currently set to 3. Also removed the knockdown[/*]
	[*]Skeletons will now standup after they die the first time instead of just taking a nap[/*]
	[*]Resurrect issues should be fixed[/*]
	[*]Follow issues should be fixed[/*]
	[*]Players are now able to heal each other again and other party member's pets when in a group[/*]
	[*]Fixed bug where you could attack your own pet in Open PVP areas.[/*]
	[*]Female avatar's eyes should no longer roll back when doing the toast emote[/*]
	[*]Fixed max follow distance (can no longer follow someone regardless of how far away they are).[/*]
	[*]Fixed issue where when you attack or use a rune while following someone, you stop following them.[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Planets will stop rotating randomly[/*]
	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
	[*]Some assets create flash bulb like sparks on screen[/*]
	[*]The screen may go dark unexpectedly in some cases.  If this occurs, you can open the video options and turn off Tone Mapping as a temporary fix.[/*]
	[*]Many pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support. These will not be complete until later this year[/*]
	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
	[*]Unity 5 engine bug: Terrain is not accepting shadow casting lights and terrain lighting shows up on grid vs. radius[/*]
	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
	[*]Unity 5 Engine Bug: Objects in the foreground sort incorrectly against objects in the distance like trees and the horizon[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Update of the Avatar #127 – 2015.05.29
notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_AvatarsRadio_FireLotus_R18_Party.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=50566]this week's Update of the Avatar:[/url] Play Release 18 Now!, The Open PvP Town of Vengeance, Avatars Radio Presents FireLotusRelease (18) Party, Support Avatars Radio on Patreon, Over $8,000 Raised for Water.org, New Basements, Bard's Tale IV Kickstarter,  In-game Community Weekend Events, and More!


[h1]Play Release 18 Now![/h1]

Release 18 successfully launched yesterday, May 28, with thousands of backers downloading, patching, logging in, and checking out the new changes! Lots of new content to explore, including:
[list] [*]Vengeance: SotA's first Open PvP Player Owned Town[/*] [*]Dynamic Creature & Resource Spawning[/*] [*]16 Improved Scenes[/*] [*]New Combat Deck Mechanic[/*] [*]Overworld Camera Changes[/*] [*]New Armor and Armor Variations[/*] [*]Astronomy & Calendar[/*] [*]New User Experience Revamp[/*] [*]...and more![/*]
[/list]
Check out the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=50953]Release 18 Instructions update[/url] for detailed information about all the new R18 content.

[b]The Grand Tour Quest[/b]
Just as in our last several releases, we've included a Grand Tour Quest designed to guide you through all the new content. You will be able to get the Bycocket Hat by completing the Release 18 Grand Tour Quest. This reward can only be unlocked during Release 18 (did someone say rares?), so be sure to log in soon and talk to all the Tour Guides!

And if you need a little help with the R18 Grand Tour Quest, The Mad Hermit has graciously provided this how-to video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=lgzoljl1LCw


[h1]Player Owned Town #2: The Open PvP Town of Vengeance[/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/08/OrderOfVengeance.png[/img]

As soon as PvP was introduced in SotA Release 8, Duke Violation and the [url=http://orderofvengeance.com/]Order of Vengeance Guild[/url] hosted the very first PvP tournament in Shroud of the Avatar on July 24, 2014. Here's a screeenshot and excerpt about those first tournaments from [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=42986]Update of the Avatar #84[/url]:

[quote]The Order of Vengeance Guild hosted multiple tournaments starting on Thursday, July 24th and continuing through the weekend. The tournaments were held on The Brave Coast player island. Vengeance members procured two boats, a light house, and a Knight's Keep across the pond from Lord British's castle. The fights occurred on the beach with spectators watching from the bow of the boat.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/08/SotA_R8_pic13.jpg[/img][/quote]

The Order of Vengeance (along with other PvP-friendly groups such as The Bear Tavern, BMC, etc.), have been instrumental in helping us evolve combat and PvP in SotA. Thus, when we introduced the ability for Player Owned Towns to be flagged as Open PvP in Release 18, we chose Vengeance as the first PoT to test that functionality. Additionally, it allowed us to test the Desert biome template that Abe Robertson adapted from Michael Hutchison's original PaxLair forest biome template.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_PoT_Template_Desert_1.jpg[/img]

The player town of Vengeance is located at the northern end of the Grunvald Desert:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_R18_Vengeance_overworld.jpg[/img]

Vengeance is hosting many PvP events during Release 18. See the In-Game Community Events section below for all their events scheduled this weekend.

Below are a few screenshots of the desert town of Vengeance, but first, there's this message and runic scroll that Duke Violation posted in the Release 18 Event forum: [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/player-town-vengeance-quests.27508/]Player Town: Vengeance - Quests![/url]

[quote]Hail Avatars,

I have found this stuck on the wall of my website! I wanted to share it with you... it seems to be important in some way! Take note: this will only be viable information in the player town of Vengeance!

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/vengeance-quest-r18-courage1.png[/img][/quote]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_Vengeance_titan.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_Vengeance_oracle.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_Vengeance_3.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_Vengeance_1.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_Vengeance_4.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_Vengeance_2.jpg[/img]


[h1]Support Avatars Radio on Patreon[/h1]

[url=https://www.patreon.com/user?u=272464&ty=h][img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/AvatarsRadioLogo.jpg[/img][/url]

We want to give a special shoutout to Amber Raine, founder of [url=http://avatarsradio.info/]Avatars Radio[/url] (AR), for the selfless labor of love she pours into keeping AR on the air, keeping it fresh, recruiting and coordinating a host of awesome DJs to entertain the entire SotA community, in and out of the game!

AR's very first broadcasts were in December 2013, with random streaming for those hanging out in IRC. Their first actual air date as an official, legal, licensed and royalty paid station was January 31st, 2014, during SotA Release 1.  [url=https://www.patreon.com/user?u=272464&ty=h]AR's About Page describes[/url] their purpose thus:

[quote]This station was created with the love of our community and fellow citizens in Lord British - Richard Garriotts’ new world of Shroud of the Avatar. Our dream desire is to serve and share (simply by airing) communities work through the moon towers. We have an open welcoming of all submissions from our community.


Sharing the talents of the community as well as that of the Terrestrial in your events, parties, and celebrations. Avatars Radio also carries a news cast to keep you up to date on what is happening in your world![/quote]

Amber and her team go to great lengths to provide awesome programming for all of us, but it comes at a cost. As SotA continues to grow in popularity, bringing in more and more players, the number of Avatars Radio listeners also increases, and the music royalties they pay through stream licensing continues to increase. Amber and her team started a Patreon site to help offset the cost of keeping Avatars Radio on the air.

notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_AvatarsRadio_FireLotus_R18_Party.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=50566]this week's Update of the Avatar:[/url] Play Release 18 Now!, The Open PvP Town of Vengeance, Avatars Radio Presents FireLotusRelease (18) Party, Support Avatars Radio on Patreon, Over $8,000 Raised for Water.org, New Basements, Bard's Tale IV Kickstarter,  In-game Community Weekend Events, and More!


[h1]Play Release 18 Now![/h1]

Release 18 successfully launched yesterday, May 28, with thousands of backers downloading, patching, logging in, and checking out the new changes! Lots of new content to explore, including:
[list] [*]Vengeance: SotA's first Open PvP Player Owned Town[/*] [*]Dynamic Creature & Resource Spawning[/*] [*]16 Improved Scenes[/*] [*]New Combat Deck Mechanic[/*] [*]Overworld Camera Changes[/*] [*]New Armor and Armor Variations[/*] [*]Astronomy & Calendar[/*] [*]New User Experience Revamp[/*] [*]...and more![/*]
[/list]
Check out the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=50953]Release 18 Instructions update[/url] for detailed information about all the new R18 content.

[b]The Grand Tour Quest[/b]
Just as in our last several releases, we've included a Grand Tour Quest designed to guide you through all the new content. You will be able to get the Bycocket Hat by completing the Release 18 Grand Tour Quest. This reward can only be unlocked during Release 18 (did someone say rares?), so be sure to log in soon and talk to all the Tour Guides!

And if you need a little help with the R18 Grand Tour Quest, The Mad Hermit has graciously provided this how-to video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=lgzoljl1LCw


[h1]Player Owned Town #2: The Open PvP Town of Vengeance[/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/08/OrderOfVengeance.png[/img]

As soon as PvP was introduced in SotA Release 8, Duke Violation and the [url=http://orderofvengeance.com/]Order of Vengeance Guild[/url] hosted the very first PvP tournament in Shroud of the Avatar on July 24, 2014. Here's a screeenshot and excerpt about those first tournaments from [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=42986]Update of the Avatar #84[/url]:

[quote]The Order of Vengeance Guild hosted multiple tournaments starting on Thursday, July 24th and continuing through the weekend. The tournaments were held on The Brave Coast player island. Vengeance members procured two boats, a light house, and a Knight's Keep across the pond from Lord British's castle. The fights occurred on the beach with spectators watching from the bow of the boat.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/08/SotA_R8_pic13.jpg[/img][/quote]

The Order of Vengeance (along with other PvP-friendly groups such as The Bear Tavern, BMC, etc.), have been instrumental in helping us evolve combat and PvP in SotA. Thus, when we introduced the ability for Player Owned Towns to be flagged as Open PvP in Release 18, we chose Vengeance as the first PoT to test that functionality. Additionally, it allowed us to test the Desert biome template that Abe Robertson adapted from Michael Hutchison's original PaxLair forest biome template.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_PoT_Template_Desert_1.jpg[/img]

The player town of Vengeance is located at the northern end of the Grunvald Desert:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_R18_Vengeance_overworld.jpg[/img]

Vengeance is hosting many PvP events during Release 18. See the In-Game Community Events section below for all their events scheduled this weekend.

Below are a few screenshots of the desert town of Vengeance, but first, there's this message and runic scroll that Duke Violation posted in the Release 18 Event forum: [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/player-town-vengeance-quests.27508/]Player Town: Vengeance - Quests![/url]

[quote]Hail Avatars,

I have found this stuck on the wall of my website! I wanted to share it with you... it seems to be important in some way! Take note: this will only be viable information in the player town of Vengeance!

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/vengeance-quest-r18-courage1.png[/img][/quote]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_Vengeance_titan.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.patreon.com/user?u=272464&ty=h][img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/AvatarsRadioLogo.jpg[/img][/url]

[b]May 29, 2015[/b]

[b]Build Number 271: 11:00 AM[/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Fixed issue with plate boots showing up as red versus metallic[/*]
	[*]Fixed Renton Graff's dialog issues[/*]
	[*]Fixed Marlene Graff's dialog[/*]
	[*]Fixed Jeanne's dialog in Soltown.[/*]
	[*]Fixed beard turning off with certain leather helms[/*]
	[*]Edited glow color setting to make shadow side of planets not glow unnaturally. Also, turned up emission on lava seams on moon core[/*]
	[*]Removed invisible wall and cleaned up decoration layers in Benefactor Lord home[/*]
	[*]Set oracle faction to be FriendlyToAll to keep it from being killed by npcs[/*]
	[*]Fixes to help with loading really full basements[/*]
	[*]Fixed gaps in Augmented Chain chest piece[/*]
	[*]Female guards now have their heads back[/*]
	[*]Fixed shield with missing texture in Ferig's Battle Camp[/*]
	[*]Removed the coal mining nodes from Spectral Mines that didn't actually give coal[/*]
	[*]Added collision to windows in Benefactor Baron house[/*]
	[*]Fixed eyes rolling back on female avatar when using /toast emote[/*]
	[*]Fixed sparkles not showing up on ore nodes properly[/*]
	[*]/zone is now interrupted by entering combat[/*]
	[*]Kobold Archers no longer holding bow backwards[/*]
	[*]Added more resources to Spectral Foothills and made sure they were all accesible[/*]
	[*]Fixed place where you could climb out of  Spectral Foothills[/*]
	[*]Fixed non-interactive braziers in Solace Bridge[/*]
	[*]Pass through many maps to make sure all ore nodes are working properly (West Veiled Swamp,  East Perennial Trail, Necropolis Barrens, Southern & Northern Grunvald Barrens, Savrenoc Stronghold, Deep Savrenoc Timberlands, Savrenoc Timberlands)[/*]
	[*]Combat Idle animations should no longer cause elongated neck on male avatars[/*]
	[*]Satyr Archer holding bow backwards[/*]
	[*]Reconnected the North Ravenswood scene on HiddenVale[/*]
	[*]Fixed issue that was causing other players to appear stuck in various animation loops[/*]
	[*]Fixed issue that may have been causing other players to be invisible[/*]
	[*]The following items no longer need be taken to a specific NPC but can be sold for the same value at any merchant: Animal Hides, Ectoplasmic Residue, Silver Ore, and Mystic Graff Gems.[/*]
	[*]Fixed damage numbers not showing up on resurrected Skeletons[/*]
	[*]Can no longer exploit the Morgan/Myra quest for infinite gold/XP.[/*]
	[*]Equipped wands and spyglasses should now animate properly in left hand[/*]
	[*]/follow will now properly deactivate Vanish spell[/*]
	[*]Fixed decoration layer issues in Founder Knight  home[/*]
	[*]Fixed floating "For Sale" stones in Vengeance[/*]
	[*]Fixed issue where jump windup animation would not play[/*]
	[*]Secret door no longer rotated 90 degrees in Knight Benefactor Home[/*]
	[*]Back door now working in Knight Benefactor Home[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Planets will stop rotating randomly[/*]
	[*]If your video drivers are out of date characters will appear as if they are covered in triangles.[/*]
	[*]Some cities are experiencing performance spikes[/*]
	[*]Some assets create flash bulb like sparks on screen[/*]
	[*]The screen may go dark unexpectedly in some cases.  If this occurs, you can open the video options and turn off Tone Mapping as a temporary fix.[/*]
	[*]Many pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support. These will not be complete until later this year[/*]
	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
	[*]Unity 5 engine bug: Terrain is not accepting shadow casting lights and terrain lighting shows up on grid vs. radius[/*]
	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
	[*]Unity 5 Engine Bug: Objects in the foreground sort incorrectly against objects in the distance like trees and the horizon[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Release 18 Instructions
notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_CelestialBodies2.jpg[/img]


Greetings Avatars,

Thank you to our loyal backers of Shroud of the Avatar. We were not going to let torrential rains, high winds, tornadoes, microbursts, downed trees, blown out windows, massive power losses, or any other weather calamity thrown our way stop us from delivering Release 18! Access for all backers at First Responder level and above begins this Thursday, May 28 at 10:30 AM Central Time (16:30 UTC).

[h1][b]NOTE: Servers will be down from 9:00 AM until 10:30 AM Thursday morning in order to upload the build.[/b][/h1]

[b]Please read this entire message, as well as the linked [/b][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z-svq1OvcZwViqGxFCKdjH3NCn2LTfLuGny5qaAqjTM/pub][b]instructions[/b][/url][b] and [/b][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EQczZJxj38npLbysCEjSa_xiWwx7jQ9zFgvX9yPg2xY/pub][b]known issues[/b][/url][b].[/b]

We are far from launch, in a constant state of change, and we do not yet have in-game systems to inform players of these changes or to share ways to help them to explore new content and systems. This means we rely entirely on this message and the linked [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z-svq1OvcZwViqGxFCKdjH3NCn2LTfLuGny5qaAqjTM/pub]instructions[/url] and [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EQczZJxj38npLbysCEjSa_xiWwx7jQ9zFgvX9yPg2xY/pub]known issues[/url] to convey the current game state. We regularly have to answer questions or filter bug reports from helpful players, because they elect not to read this valuable information. By taking a few moments to read through this information, a great deal of our time and efforts can be redirected to focus on new “unanswered” questions, and addressing critical issues impacting each release. We greatly appreciate you taking the time to review this post, and for all the truly valuable feedback you continue to provide.

Release 17 included a lot of new content including the first Player Owned Town, Crafting Events, Player Titles, an Experience Doubler, and Lot Access Permissions. It was also our attempt to finish a bunch of work related to the Unity 5 upgrade. The good news is that the new content improved the play experience (for the most part). However, a lot of other issues were introduced in the process. For instance, we completely reworked our character state machine which governs everything the character does (animating, moving, fighting, spellcasting, etc.). This rework will, in the long term, make the game better by giving us better controls for things like blending between animations. In the near term, however, it broke almost everything and took us an entire week after the release to address the biggest issues.

Additionally, combat had been neglected for many months. As many of you have pointed out, it has been unbalanced, buggy, and almost unplayable for a few releases (and R17 actually made it worse!). On top of all that, our new user experience has been beyond challenging--punishing is more accurate, in fact. Based on those three issues, we decided to spend more time on overall improvements to combat and the new user experience. Unfortunately, that means we had to move some deliverables out of this release, but the game is now much more playable.

[list]
	[*][b]Maps: [/b][strike]Our goal is to get the Grunvald Region near completion and begin work on the Quel Region which includes scenes like the Etceter Mines.[/strike]
[list]
	[*][b][i]Grunvald and Quel Expansions Delayed:[/i][/b][i] We decided to focus mostly on iterating and improving existing scenes, including dynamic spawning, instead of creating more new scenes (although we did add 1 new scene in the Perennial Coast: Spectral Foothills). We did finish the world building for the Etceter Mines but they won’t be spawned until R19.[/i][/*]
[*][img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_CreatureSpawning.jpg[/img][/*]
	[*][b][i]Dynamic Creature & Resource Spawning: [/i][/b][i]Starting with this release, we have begun implementing a new spawning methodology. Our hope is this new method will result in a more immersive and dynamic play experience. The scenes below represent our first initial pass, but we will periodically come back to these scenes as new features come online (escorts, complex idles, sophisticated patrols, etc.). Additionally, each new scene that comes online will be spawned this way. This will also allow for balanced tiers of difficulty within regions, commensurate with the tiers of resources found within the areas. The goals and methodology for dynamic spawning include:[/i]
[list]
	[*][i]Each full exploration of an area should feel different than the last full exploration of the same area. As you travel around a map, you may see skeletons near some ruins in one pass. The next pass, you may see kobolds near the ruins. Additionally, the next pass you may see both, and they are fighting each other.[/i][/*]
	[*][i]Areas should always feel well/thickly spawned for ample opportunities of hunting creatures and gathering resources. This does not mean edge to edge critters and resources, just that they are not hard to find when looking. In fact, many areas may have overlapping groups of spawners, allowing players to encounter active battles between factions.[/i][/*]

notes.title: Update of the Avatar #126 – 2015.05.22
notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_MakeADifference_Water.org_bundle_large.png[/img]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=50566]this week's Update of the Avatar:[/url] SotA Backers Raise $4,000+ for Water.org, WGN Game/Music Bundle in Support of Alive Inside/Music & Memory, Abe's Desert Biome Template, Play DND1 on the SotA Teletype, R18  Bycocket Hat, Bard's Tale IV Kickstarter,  In-game Community Weekend Events, and More!


[h1]SotA Backers Raise $4,000+ for Rize Up Gaming's Charity Drive[/h1]

Rize Up Gaming is sponsoring a charity marathon this weekend for [url=http://water.org/]Water.org[/url], an organization that brings water to those who cannot get clean, safe water. The marathon started at 7PM CDT on May 21st and runs until 2AM CDT on May 25th with a goal of $1500 USD. On May 23rd, starting from 2PM CDT until 10PM CDT, Rize Up Gaming will be streaming Shroud of the Avatar community events and conversing with members of the community throughout the event. If you would like to donate directly to the event, you may do so on this page: 

Last week, as part of Portalarium's founding purpose to promote good will and make a positive difference in the world, we added our first "Make a Difference" charity items to the Add-On Store. For each of these items you purchase, Portalarium will donate 50% of its share of the purchase price to the designated charity. By purchasing these items, you are helping to make a difference in the lives of those less fortunate than ourselves. These first items are dedicated to Water.org, a nonprofit organization that has transformed hundreds of communities in Africa, South Asia, and Central America by providing access to safe water and sanitation. Learn more here: [url=http://water.org/]water.org[/url]

Our backers totally blew us away with their outpouring of support! In just one week they purchased over $9,000 of these items, with over $4,000 of this being donated! These items will remain available in the Add-On Store after the weekend drive, but let's see how much we can raise during Rize Up Gaming's Marathon which ends Monday, May 25.

[h1]Who's Gaming Now Game/Music Bundle in Support of Alive Inside/Music & Memory[/h1]

Whosgamingnow.net (WGN) is a rapidly growing, community-centric gaming community with a mission statement to promote, market and support game development teams and communities ranging from small independent titles to AAA games. WGN aims to promote the people and supporters of today's greatest upcoming games and enable fans to connect in a greater capacity to game development teams at a deeper level than ever before.

[b]Game and SotA Music Sales Bundle for Charity - Alive Inside/Music & Memory[/b]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/AliveInside_pics2.jpg[/img]

WGN is donating 20% of the net sales of their Greenlight games and music bundle to support [url=http://www.aliveinside.us/]Alive Inside[/url]. ALIVE INSIDE is a joyous cinematic exploration of music’s capacity to reawaken our souls and uncover the deepest parts of our humanity. Filmmaker Michael Rossato-Bennett chronicles the astonishing experiences of individuals suffering from Alzheimer’s or other forms of dementia who have been revitalized through the simple experience of listening to music. His camera reveals the uniquely human connection we find in music and how its healing power can triumph where prescription medication falls short.


This stirring documentary follows social worker Dan Cohen, founder of the nonprofit organization [url=https://musicandmemory.org/]Music & Memory[/url], as he fights against a broken healthcare system to demonstrate music’s ability to combat memory loss and restore a deep sense of self to those suffering from it. Rossato-Bennett visits family members who have witnessed the miraculous effects of personalized music on their loved ones, and offers illuminating interviews with experts including renowned neurologist and best-selling author Oliver Sacks (Musicophilia: Tales of Music and the Brain) and musician Bobby McFerrin (“Don’t Worry, Be Happy”).


[b]Shroud of the Avatar Music included in the bundle![/b]

Portalarium is donating the Shroud of the Avatar’s soundtrack (still in development) to support WGN's charity drive for Alive Inside.  Their goal is to sell over 5000 bundles and raise over $1000 to donate. You can help support this cause by purchasing the bundle here: [url=https://groupees.com/wgnaliveinside]https://groupees.com/<wbr />wgnaliveinside[/url]


[h1]Abe's Desert Biome Template - WIP[/h1]

Abe Robertson has been reworking the Player Owned Town Forest Template that Michael Hutchison built to terraform it into a desert biome template. For comparison, here's the initial Forest Biome Template he started from:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_PoT_Template_Forest_1.jpg[/img]

And here are a few work-in-progress images of the new Desert biome version, which will be available soon for selection in the Player Owned Town Submission form:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_PoT_Template_Desert1.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_PoT_Template_Desert2.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_PoT_Template_Desert3.jpg[/img]


[h1]Play DND1 Winning Entry on the SotA Teletype[/h1]

There is a new teletype device available as a deco item in the the Add-On Store. This is a special teletype, in that by activating it you will be able to play Richard Flemming's winning DND1 game from Lord British's Royal Challenge ([url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=39171]see Update #78[/url] for more details of the DND1 Contest).

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_Teletype.jpg[/img]

Here is a video of Richard Flemming's winning entry from last year's contest:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=IP91d-z7aao


[h1]The Bard's Tale IV Coming to Kickstarter June 2nd[/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/BardsTale4_PreKickstarter.jpg[/img]

Our long-time friend and colleague, Brian Fargo, and his team over at inXile recently announced they are reviving one of our favorite RPG series, The Bard's Tale! Here's the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/inxile/torment-tides-of-numenera/posts/1216569]announcement from a recent update[/url]:

[quote]We’re very excited about our upcoming Kickstarter for The Bard’s Tale IV, which we recently announced will kick off on June 2nd! Follow our countdown on our [url=http://bardstale.inxile-entertainment.com/]official The Bard’s Tale IV site[/url] or sign up to get notified when we launch. We have also provided an early viewing of the Kickstarter tiers we plan to make available, [url=https://forums.inxile-entertainment.com/viewtopic.php?f=43&t=12985]you can join the discussion on our official forums[/url].[/quote]

Bard's Tale IV will help drive the revival of the dungeon crawler genre. As described by inXile, it is a single-player, party-based cRPG with dynamic phase based combat, challenging puzzles and riddles, and a game heavily invested in music, set to gorgeous Gaelic songs. Cool stuff! If you're as excited as we are to see one of the most amazing RPG series live again, then head over to [url=http://bardstale.inxile-entertainment.com/]inXile's Bard's Tale IV[/url] site and sign up to be notified of their Kickstarter launch!


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=50816]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #126...[/url]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=50566]this week's Update of the Avatar:[/url] Make A Difference: Water.org Charity Drive, Release 17 Postmortem, Player Owned Town Submission Form, SotA SoundCloud Playlist, The New Britannia Theater Troupe Presents: Aurum Berries, Pledge Stats Update, New Asset Pack,  In-game Community Weekend Events, and More!


[h1]Make A Difference - Water.org Charity Drive by RizeUpGaming[/h1]
