Rize Up Gaming (www.twitch.tv/rizeupgaming) is a company, founded in September 2012, with the intentions of curbing bullying, sexism, gender discrimination, and hate speech on all gaming platforms. Their goal is to promote fun gaming without negativity. Rize Up Gaming uses a staff of streamers to keep their channel running and to fundraise for many different charities throughout the year.

This month's fundraiser is for Water.org, an organization that brings water to those who cannot get clean, safe water. Rize Up Gaming will be running this marathon from 7PM CDT on May 21st until 2AM CDT on May 25th with a goal of $1500 USD. On May 23rd, starting from 2PM CDT until 10PM CDT, Rize Up Gaming will be streaming Shroud of the Avatar community events and conversing with members of the community throughout the event. If you would like to donate directly to the event, you may do so on this page: http://give.water.org/f/RizeUpGaming/

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/logo1.png[/img]

Additionally, as part of Portalarium's founding purpose to promote good will and make a positive difference in the world, we've added our first "Make a Difference" charity items to the Add-On Store. For each of these items you purchase, Portalarium will donate 50% of its share of the purchase price to the designated charity. By purchasing these items, you are helping to make a difference in the lives of those less fortunate than ourselves. These first items are dedicated to Water.org, a nonprofit organization that has transformed hundreds of communities in Africa, South Asia, and Central America by providing access to safe water and sanitation. Learn more here: water.org

In keeping with the water theme, our first Make A Difference charity items include:

[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=9085&open=wishing_well_-_water_org_charity__digital_][b]Wishing Well[/b][/url]

Not only does this magical Wishing Well look stylish in your yard, but when you throw coins in it there is a random chance that you will receive something in return! And as an added bonus, wearing the Water Magic Cloak increases your chance to receive an item from the Wishing Well.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_MakeADifference_Water.org_wishing_well.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=9085&open=water_magic_cloak_-_water_org_charity__digital_][b]Water Magic Cloak[/b][/url]

Not only do you look stylish wearing this Water Magic Cloak, but it also increases the duration of the /rain emote and increases your chance to receive an item from the Wishing Well.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_MakeADifference_Water.org_water_magic_cloak.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=9085&open=rain_emote_-_water_org_charity__digital_][b]Rain Emote[/b][/url]

This emote allows the player to summon a rain cloud that rains for a short time. And as an added bonus, wearing the Water Magic Cloak increases the duration of the /rain emote.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_MakeADifference_Water.org_water_emote_rain_large.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=9085&open=water_package_-_water_org_charity__digital_][b]Water Package[/b][/url]

Buy all three of the water.org charity items and get a bundle discount! Includes the Wishing Well, Water Magic Cloak, and Rain Emote!

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_MakeADifference_Water.org_bundle_large.png[/img]


[h1]Hangout of the Avatar: Release 17 Postmortem[/h1]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Ec7Ik79T5BA

We had a great Hangout of the Avatar yesterday, with Richard, Starr, and Chris chatting about Release 17 and looking ahead to Release 18. And, of course, FireLotus was fielding lots of juicy questions live from the chat-room and also in advance from the OP comments section.

Several members of our community were presented with awards during the hangout, including:
[list]
	[*]Sean Saltzer received a ONBE for his role in coordinating large-scale monthly QA playtests and providing valuable feedback to the development team each and every Release.[/*]
	[*]The Syndicate was recognized with a Royal Warrant for their role in participating in monthly QA playtests which provide us with extensive feedback on vital game systems in the form of a 20+ page report each release, including a well prioritized Executive Summary. Even though they avoid the spotlight (some of you may not have even known they were here), they are superstars to us![/*]
	[*]The Phoenix Republic was recognized with a Royal Warrant for their continued support of in-game, player hosted events. They regularly host events, they founded the Novian Academy with its growing number of player-taught courses, and they assist other groups who wish to organize an event (providing everything from venues to a great barkeep)! On top of all that, WrathPhoenix, the leader and founder of The Phoenix Republic almost single-handedly orchestrated the extensive twitch streaming campaign for Release 17 and the launch of PaxLair.[/*]
	[*]Britannia Mining Company was issued a Royal Warrant in recognition of their support of in-game, player hosted events. From beach parties and crafting events to all-out brawls, the BMC hosts multiple events each month and has also created the sotaevents.com community calendar to spotlight all player events.[/*]
	[*]Matthew Bernard (Matterio) was awarded with an ONBE for the creation of the SotA Community App for iOS/Android, an invaluable resource for the SotA community that makes it possible to connect with what’s happening in Shroud of the Avatar even when you’re on the go! [img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/250px-SotA_Royal_Warrant1.jpg[/img]

Several cool prizes were also randomly given out to those attending the hangout, including:
[list]
	[*]$10 Store Credits to community members Keirna, Xavier, Adnor14, and Lontra1972[/*]
	[*]SotA Shot Glass to Kaydrah[/*]
	[*]SotA Pint Glass to Logain[/*]
	[*]SotA Coin to Womby[/*]
	[*]LB/Darkstarr Coin to redfish[/*]
	[*]Razer Deathadder Mouse to Themo Lock[/*]
[/list]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_Novia_Birko_R17.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=50435]this week's Update of the Avatar:[/url] Building of the PaxLair Maze, Birko's Map of Novia, Community Street Names; Player Town Submission, Steam Achievements, Mad Hermit's Grand Tour Video, R17 Postmortem Invite, Updated Fansite Kit,  In-game Community Weekend Events, and More!


[h1]Birko's Customized Map of Novia[/h1]

The custom map of Novia shown above was recently [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/novia-r17.25349/]posted in the SotA forums by community member Birko.[/url] It looks so cool, we just had to share it!


[h1]The Building of the PaxLair Maze[/h1]

Arianna [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/release-17-screenshot-gallery.24887/page-4#post-361821]posted this amazing time lapse video in the R17 Screenshot Gallery[/url] of the building of the PaxLair Maze in Release 17. Spanning 3 lots, this is (to our knowledge) the largest 3D maze ever constructed in SotA. It was designed by Net and constructed by Net and Sindariya ("Riya") in the Player Owned Town of PaxLair:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ERyPNewaY2k

Riya and Net have four events planned for their maze this Release. The next event is scheduled for this Sunday, May 10, at 1:30 pm CST. See [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/4b-maze-event-in-paxlair.25401/]Sindariya's R17 Events Forum post[/url] for more details.


[h1]Steam Achievements[/h1]

With the launch of Release 17, players were able to start earning Steam Achievements, of which there are currently sixteen (and a few hidden ones as well).

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_Achievements_Steam.jpg[/img]


[h1]Community Created Street Names in Release 17[/h1]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_StreetSigns1.jpg[/img]

Special thanks to everyone that posted street name suggestions in the forums. Below is a list of 24 of those community contributed names that we selected for streets in Release 17, and the community members that contributed them. We have many more community contributed street names approved for use so look for them in future Releases.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_Community_Street_Names_R17.jpg[/img]


[h1]Player Owned Town Submission Form[/h1]

We are putting some finishing touches on the first iteration of the Player Owned Town Submission Web Form and hope to make it available to all PoT owners sometime next week. We'll post on the forums as soon as it goes live, and you'll find a link to the submission form on your SotA Account Page next to the Player Owned Town that you purchased. Here is just a small snippet of the submission form:

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_PoT_SubmissionForm4.jpg[/img]


[h1]Bob's Bell Tower[/h1]

Bob Cooksey recently built this beautiful Bell Tower to Lord British's specifications (including the future ability to ring the bells by pulling on the ropes). Look for this NPC building in an upcoming release!

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_BellTower.jpg[/img]


[h1]The Mad Hermit's "How To Get The Fez Hat" Video[/h1]

Just as in our last several releases, we've included a Grand Tour Quest designed to guide you through all the new content. This release, you will be able to get the Fez Hat reward by completing the Release 17 Grand Tour Quest. This reward can only be unlocked during Release 17 (did someone say rares?), so be sure to log in soon and talk to all the Tour Guides!

If you need some assistance completing the R17 Grand Tour Quest, then check out this how-to video from The Mad Hermit:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=S2PxciZOV_I


[h1]Hear Ye, Hear Ye! Thou hast been invited to the Release 17 Postmortem[/h1]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_R17_FireLotusReleaseParty2.jpg[/img]

Please join us Thursday, May 14th at 3:00 PM Central (20:00 GMT) for our next Hangout of the Avatar! Richard, Starr, and Chris (and some very special guests!) will be chatting about Release 17 and looking ahead to Release 18. And, of course, FireLotus will be taking your questions and feedback live in the chat-room and also in advance right [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=50443]here[/url] in the comments section.

We will be giving some really awesome prizes during the 90 minute extended Hangout, and all you have to do to qualify for one is to come hang out with us in the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=5]IRC chatroom[/url] during the broadcast. As always, the link to the hangout will be posted here directly before the hangout begins.


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=50435]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #124...[/url]

notes.title: Release 17 Patch Notes: May 8, 2015
notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Pre-Alpha Release 17! Notes on what is in this release are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/release-17-instructions.24998/]here[/url].

[b]May 8, 2015[/b]
[b]Build Number 266: 7:00 PM[/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b][list]	[*]Stretch Goal Store “Boats Complete Package” and “Horse Mounts Complete Package” will both now deliver both gender versions of the Admiral’s Outfit and Riding Outfit (respectively)[/*]	[*]Fixed various exceptions that were probably breaking things[/*]	[*]Fixed black screen when trying to enter Owl's Head Sewers[/*]	[*]Durability damage on gear has been lowered by 50%[/*]	[*]Repair kits are now twice as effective[/*]	[*]Spells and Skills should now be more reliable[/*]	[*]Player lots should be properly free of plants again.[/*]	[*]Plate Chest Piece should look metallic again instead of red[/*]	[*]Picket Fence is now working better during placement[/*][/list][b]Known Issues:[/b][list]	[*]Meticulous Collection is currently disabled because it was breaking nodes. It will return in Release 18[/*]	[*]Some spells and skills are not working reliably[/*]	[*]Fences are still being tweaked so they will line up perfectly along the perimeter[/*]	[*]Any decoration placed outside the lot boundaries will now appear at the front of your lot. For some players this is a LOT of decorations. notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_R17_FireLotusReleaseParty5.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in this week's Update of the Avatar: PaxLair: Play Release 17 Now!, AetherVision: twitch Headquarters for Streaming R17 and the PaxLair Weekend Events, PVP Grudge Match: 30 Day Tournament, R17-R18 Deco Contest – PUB CRAWL!,  In-game Community Weekend Events, and More!


[h1]Play Release 17 Now![/h1]

Release 17 successfully launched yesterday, April 30, with thousands of backers downloading, patching, logging in, and checking out the new changes! Lots of new content to explore, including:
[list] [*]PaxLair: SotA's first Player Owned Town][/*] [*]8 improved adventure scenes[/*] [*]Steam Achievements[/*] [*]New Crafting Events: Success, Critical Success, Recovery, and Failure[/*] [*]New Summon Phoenix skill[/*] [*]Player Titles[/*] [*]Lot Access Permissions[/*] [*]Fences, pavers, and books[/*] [*]21 Pledge Rewards[/*] [*]...and more![/*] [/list]
Check out the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=50219]Release 17 Instructions update[/url] for detailed information about all the new R17 content.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA_R17_GrandTourReward_FezHat_LandingPage1.jpg[/img]

[b]The Grand Tour Quest[/b]
Just as in our last several releases, we've included a Grand Tour Quest designed to guide you through all the new content. You will be able to get the Fez Hat by completing the Release 17 Grand Tour Quest. This reward can only be unlocked during Release 17 (did someone say rares?), so be sure to log in soon and talk to all the Tour Guides!


[h1]AetherVision: twitch Headquarters for R17 and the PaxLair Weekend Events[/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/AetherVision_WhosGamingNow.jpg[/img]

Special thanks to WrathPhoenix for the tremendous work he did coordinating over fifty twitch broadcasters for the Release 17 opening weekend featuring the plethora of special events that PaxLair has planned for this weekend. They have a steady stream of twitch broadcasts all weekend long, so check out the [url=http://www.aethervision.net/]AetherVision website[/url] WrathPhoenix constructed to make it easy to see who is currently broadcasting at any given time.


[h1]PVP Grudge Match: 30 Day Tournament[/h1]


[url=//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA-Fireswords-HD-transparent-Header21.png][img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA-Fireswords-HD-transparent-Header21-300x203.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/pvp-tournament-by-royal-warrant.24893/][u][From a R17 Event Forum post by Duke Violation][/u][/url]

We will be hosting PvP Tournaments and giving you guys an actual leader board this release! Order of Vengeance is proud to host the first month long tournament in Shroud of the Avatar and will be accepting submissions of those willing to be openly flagged as pvp for at least 2 days each week during the release. Also, you need to play for a couple hours each time actively available for combat... more details to come!

GRUDGE MATCH ZONE: PaxLair

[b]How to sign up:[/b]

Please post a sign up by replying below or register on the site... there are two tournaments so you would need to register twice. Details on each will be provided in a couple days.

Tournament 1: [url=http://challonge.com/OoVr17t1]http://challonge.com/OoVr17t1[/url]

Tournament 2: [url=http://challonge.com/OoVr17t2]http://challonge.com/OoVr17t2[/url]

[b]NEED TO KNOWS / HOW TO PARTICIPATE:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Sign up (below, by replying, or above, by registration) to be on the Tournament 1 hit list... only people on the hit list will qualify for taking another member out and the selection of your opponents will be based on randomizing the list. I NEED YOU SIGNED UP BEFORE THIS SUNDAY THE 3rd PLEASE!
[list]
	[*]5 points per win[/*]
	[*]4 rounds scheduled for R17[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*]Take a screenshot of you fighting your foe and be sure to capture the combat log so we can see who wins. Post the screenshot here and I'll list you as a victor in a grudge match! Both the victor and the loser must agree to the match to not encourage random PKers in SotA.
[list]
	[*]1 point per win, 2 points MAX per opponent[/*]
	[*]unlimited opponents for R17[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[b]Prizes:[/b]

At the moment I'm personally offering a [u][b]$50 Shroud of the Avatar gift card to the winner[/b][/u][u].[/u] I am in conversation with a few people about getting that amount increased by other members of OoV.

[b]Tournament Details:[/b]

We're going to focus pvp into 4 different zones... one each week. I will keep the "grudge" zone of the week updated here. For the start I would like to see all PvP focus in on PaxLair for week 1. I will announce new zones a day or two in advance. We will additionally have a world-wide swiss tournament that overlays. The person with the most points from both events combined wins.

[b]How you get points:[/b]
[list]
	[*]The overlaying weekly tournament that is world-wide!
[list]
	[*]5.5 points per match win[/*]
	[*]1.0 points per match tie[/*]
	[*]0.5 points per bye (unlikely to occur)[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*]The Grudge Match zone that is 1 zone per week.
[list]
	[*]1.0 points per match win (maximum of two times with the same opponents per tournament, does not apply to weekly tournament)[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[b]The nitty gritty details:[/b]

Avatars will be pit against each other for world pvp and zone pvp. The use of zoning is not encouraged but is allowed ([url=http://sotawiki.net/sota/Commands#Zone]http://sotawiki.net/sota/Commands#Zone[/url]). Killing an avatar 1v1 is required for this tournament. Use of screen shot ([url=http://sotawiki.net/sota/Controls]http://sotawiki.net/sota/Controls[/url]) will be required. The kills will be documented with your combat log open to see who killed who first. If your Damage Over Time effects kill the opponent it counts as a tie. If the two who are matched against each other cannot agree on a victor or their are complaints of exploitation we will stage a match and officiate it.


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=50259]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #123...[/url]

[url=//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA-Fireswords-HD-transparent-Header21.png][img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/05/SotA-Fireswords-HD-transparent-Header21-300x203.png[/img][/url]

[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/pvp-tournament-by-royal-warrant.24893/][u][From a R17 Event Forum post by Duke Violation][/u][/url]

We will be hosting PvP Tournaments and giving you guys an actual leader board this release! Order of Vengeance is proud to host the first month long tournament in Shroud of the Avatar and will be accepting submissions of those willing to be openly flagged as pvp for at least 2 days each week during the release. Also, you need to play for a couple hours each time actively available for combat... more details to come!

GRUDGE MATCH ZONE: PaxLair

[b]How to sign up:[/b]

Please post a sign up by replying below or register on the site... there are two tournaments so you would need to register twice. Details on each will be provided in a couple days.

Tournament 1: [url=http://challonge.com/OoVr17t1]http://challonge.com/OoVr17t1[/url]

Tournament 2: [url=http://challonge.com/OoVr17t2]http://challonge.com/OoVr17t2[/url]

[b]NEED TO KNOWS / HOW TO PARTICIPATE:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Sign up (below, by replying, or above, by registration) to be on the Tournament 1 hit list... only people on the hit list will qualify for taking another member out and the selection of your opponents will be based on randomizing the list. I NEED YOU SIGNED UP BEFORE THIS SUNDAY THE 3rd PLEASE!
[list]
	[*]5 points per win[/*]
	[*]4 rounds scheduled for R17[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*]Take a screenshot of you fighting your foe and be sure to capture the combat log so we can see who wins. Post the screenshot here and I'll list you as a victor in a grudge match! Both the victor and the loser must agree to the match to not encourage random PKers in SotA.
[list]
	[*]1 point per win, 2 points MAX per opponent[/*]
	[*]unlimited opponents for R17[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[b]Prizes:[/b]

At the moment I'm personally offering a [u][b]$50 Shroud of the Avatar gift card to the winner[/b][/u][u].[/u] I am in conversation with a few people about getting that amount increased by other members of OoV.

[b]Tournament Details:[/b]

We're going to focus pvp into 4 different zones... one each week. I will keep the "grudge" zone of the week updated here. For the start I would like to see all PvP focus in on PaxLair for week 1. I will announce new zones a day or two in advance. We will additionally have a world-wide swiss tournament that overlays. The person with the most points from both events combined wins.

[b]How you get points:[/b]
[list]
	[*]The overlaying weekly tournament that is world-wide!
[list]
	[*]5.5 points per match win[/*]
	[*]1.0 points per match tie[/*]
	[*]0.5 points per bye (unlikely to occur)[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*]The Grudge Match zone that is 1 zone per week.
[list]
	[*]1.0 points per match win (maximum of two times with the same opponents per tournament, does not apply to weekly tournament)[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
[b]The nitty gritty details:[/b]

Avatars will be pit against each other for world pvp and zone pvp. The use of zoning is not encouraged but is allowed ([url=http://sotawiki.net/sota/Commands#Zone]http://sotawiki.net/sota/Commands#Zone[/url]). Killing an avatar 1v1 is required for this tournament. Use of screen shot ([url=http://sotawiki.net/sota/Controls]http://sotawiki.net/sota/Controls[/url]) will be required. The kills will be documented with your combat log open to see who killed who first. If your Damage Over Time effects kill the opponent it counts as a tie. If the two who are matched against each other cannot agree on a victor or their are complaints of exploitation we will stage a match and officiate it.


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=50259]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #123...[/url]

notes.title: Release 17 Instructions
notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_SolaceBridge3.jpg[/img]

Greetings Avatars,

Thank you to our loyal backers of Shroud of the Avatar. Release 17 access for all backers at First Responder level and above begins this Thursday, April 30 at 10:30 AM Central Time (16:30 UTC).

[b][i]NOTE: The server will be going down at approximately 6 AM and will stay down until 10:30 AM in order to deploy this release.[/i][/b]

[b]Please read this entire message, as well as the linked [/b][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z-svq1OvcZwViqGxFCKdjH3NCn2LTfLuGny5qaAqjTM/pub][b]instructions[/b][/url][b] and [/b][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EQczZJxj38npLbysCEjSa_xiWwx7jQ9zFgvX9yPg2xY/pub][b]known issues[/b][/url][b].[/b]

We are far from launch, and in a constant state of change, and we do not yet have in-game systems to inform players of these changes, or to share ways to help them to explore new content and systems. This means we rely entirely on this message, and the linked [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z-svq1OvcZwViqGxFCKdjH3NCn2LTfLuGny5qaAqjTM/pub]instructions[/url] and [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EQczZJxj38npLbysCEjSa_xiWwx7jQ9zFgvX9yPg2xY/pub]known issues[/url] to convey the current game state. We regularly have to answer questions or filter bug reports, because players elect not to read this valuable information. By taking a few moments to read through this information, a great deal of our time and efforts can be redirected to focus on new “unanswered” questions, and addressing critical issues impacting each release. We greatly appreciate you taking the time to review this post, and for all the truly valuable feedback you continue to provide.

As mentioned last release, we are still having to pay some debt incurred by our move to Unity 5. However, even with that factored in, we still managed to deliver quite a bit of new content, including our first Player Owned Town, Crafting Events, Player Titles, and Lot Access Permissions. Unfortunately, the amount of architectural changes in this release required us to do a full wipe of everything except Friends and Guilds. To slightly decrease the pain of this, we implemented an Experience Doubler that will temporarily speed up leveling (see details below).

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_PlayerEvents_book.jpg[/img]

Also, remember that while we are providing new content with each release, our community is working overtime to make new events for you to enjoy. So, be sure to check out a couple of the Community Events Calendars run by our community members (via in game book or the player run websites [url=http://avatarscircle.com/community-events/]Avatars Circle[/url] Community Events and [url=http://sotaevents.com/]Events of the Avatars[/url] calendar).

Without further ado, here are the R17 deliverables.


Key:
[list]
	[*]Plain Text: The original plan for the Release deliverables. We intentionally preserve the original text so that our backers can compare plan versus actuals.[/*]
	[*][i]Italics: Extra notes and new deliverables[/i][/*]
	[*][strike]Strikethrough: These are items that did not make the release[/strike][/*]
[/list]
[b]RELEASE 17, April 30, 2015[/b]
[list]
	[*][b]Polish & Performance: [/b]We will continue the work we started with Release 16 to improve overall polish and performance in the game. We will focus not only on improving frame rate, but also lowering load times. We may also spend some time on usability issues.
[list]
	[*][b][i]Load Times: [/i][/b][i]Significant work was done on reducing load times. This is especially noticeable for large cities like Ardoris and Owl’s Head.[/i][/*]
	[*][b][i]Performance: [/i][/b][i]Several background changes including things like threaded loading of AI data have improved performance, especially in larger scenes.[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Novia_SatelliteView.jpg[/img][/*]
	[*][b]Maps: [/b]Perennial Coast and Grunvald will continue to be expanded.
[list]
	[*][b][i]8 Improved Adventure Scenes:[/i][/b][i] We circled back to new scenes we added in R16 to make them more visually distinct from each other. We also polished some other scenes to improve overall visuals. The modified scenes include:[/i]

notes.title: Update of the Avatar #122 – 2015.04.24
notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_PaxLair_DevMap_1.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in this week's Update of the Avatar: PaxLair: SotA's First Player Owned Town, Shroud of the Avatar: New Beginnings Comic,Summon Phoenix Skill, Abe's Solace Bridge Upgrades, Release 17 Dev+ QA Server is Live, More Fences Galore, In-game Community Weekend Events, and More!


[h1]PaxLair: SotA's First Player Owned Town[/h1]

I found myself having an emotional moment last night when I logged into the R17 Dev+ QA servers to get some screenshots of PaxLair for this update. I found 20 or so other backers when I arrived, some of them long-time citizens of PaxLair from Ultima Online days, and others just visiting. PaxLair is the first Player Owned Town (PoT) in SotA, and we're using it to help us work out the construction process for all PoTs.

The concept of PoTs in SotA goes all the way back to our Kickstarter campaign, when some of us on the team discussed the notion of "Guild Towns", places that guilds could call their own. These discussions were mostly internal to the team, as it wasn't something we felt we could include in the design of SotA for budgetary reasons.

But over the course of the first year of our development, Richard and Winfield, the Governor of PaxLair, discussed how PaxLair could find a home in SotA. PaxLair has been operating in Ultima Online since 1998, and is considered the oldest, continuously operating Player Town in UO. PaxLair was established in SotA during Pre-Alpha Release 5 in April 2014 with the first PaxLair Town Hall. Lord British visited their first SotA "homestead" and [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/a-royal-illumination-on-release-5.10407/]declared it to be SotA's first Player Town[/url].

Starting with Pre-Alpha Release 6 in May 2014, PaxLair established itself in the the SotA town of Valemark, meticulously rebuilding their town between every data wipe (which was happening every month until just recently). PaxLair wasn't alone in these endeavors. There were several other "homestead" towns that re-built themselves every release, including Dara Brae - The Celtic Holdfast (established in Northshire), Vengeance (established in The Brave Coast), Beran's Reach (established in The Brave Coast), and Port Phoenix (established in Holtrot, then Kingsport).

Discussions between Richard and Winfield about player towns continued, and due to the success of our ongoing crowdfunding, it was decided in June 2104 to make Player Owned Towns an official feature of Episode 1. Player Owned Towns were added to our website store, and PaxLair was the very first to purchase our largest PoT, deemed a "[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=41907]Player Owned City[/url]".

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_PoT_Metropolis.jpg[/img]

We were not prepared for how popular PoTs were going to be. Backers were purchasing more towns than we anticipated. In fact, many backers wanted even larger towns, so we made a "Metropolis" available, which PaxLair (among others) immediately upgraded to. PoTs weren't scheduled for development until Q1-2015, so PoT owners have been excitedly waiting until we could deliver their towns to them. Last month we were finally able to start that process.

As [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=41907]described in our PoT Store[/url], all PoTs will be based on a collection of pre-designed templates that can be varied by lot placements, NPC home placement, and type of biome. We are just beginning the process of designing those templates. Because of PaxLair's unique and long-running history in the worlds of Britannia (and New Britannia), our ongoing discussions with them over the past two years, and the fact they were the first to purchase our largest PoT (a City which became a Metropolis), we chose them to be the "guinea pig" for our first test template.

Like most PoT owners, they had a very specific vision for their PoT. However, they had to greatly revise their vision to accommodate the constraints of our world building technology and the further constraints of operating as a template. Our goal has been to have this first template we use for PaxLair be one of the several templates all PoT owners will be able to select from. Under those conditions, the design of PaxLair needed to conform to the many template-based constraints our development process imposed.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_PaxLair_DevMap_2.jpg[/img]

It has been almost a year since the first PoTs were purchased, and now, with Release 17, all backers will be able to experience SotA's first player owned town, PaxLair. It is still a work-in-progress, while we collaborate with the owners of PaxLair to sort through the issues of template-based town development. But even given all these constraints, once we were able to walk through this first iteration of a player owned town, it was a moving experience.

I started this article by saying I found myself having an emotional moment last night when I logged into the R17 Dev+ QA servers to get some screenshots of PaxLair for this update. I specifically wanted a screenshot of Wody's Tavern, the location for the FireLotus Release 17 Party scheduled for next Friday, May 1, at 2:00 pm CST. I initially zoned to Amber Raine for directions, but she was AFK. Sean Silverfoot was nearby and he graciously volunteered to escort me to Wody's Tavern, and stood by while I grabbed some screenshots. Sean suggested I also check out the Stage that Themo Lock has been building, as it more decorated out than Wody's Tavern was at the moment.

I chatted with Sean, and several of the PaxLair citizens, and I was moved by their excitement and passion for finally being able to settle into their own town. It caused me to reflect upon how momentous an event these Player Owned Towns represent in the realm of RPG virtual worlds, and the impact they are going to have on all of us. This fact was driven home for me when Sean expressed his deep gratitude to all of us on the SotA dev team for helping them live an experience that many of them have been waiting 17 years for (yeah, I got a little misty-eyed when he said that).

We, the development team, cannot take credit for what PaxLair, and all other PoTs, are to become. We have simply provided the canvas upon which the communities of these towns will paint their masterpieces. The wealth of community-generated content, community-run events, and community-driven social connectivity, are the well-spring of the deep and lasting sense of belongingness they will bring to each of our lives.

dallas
COO/Founder/Portalarium


PaxLair's town marker on the in-game Overworld map of Novia:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_PaxLair_Overworld_1.jpg[/img]


Wody's Tavern (the location of the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/avatars-radio-and-lady-firelotus-present-the-traditional-release-17-party.24542/]FireLotus Release 17 Party[/url] next Friday at 2:00 pm CST) is housed in the Greenhouse building located in the town square near the base of the tall Moon Tower:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_PaxLair_WodysTavern_WIP_2.png[/img]

 

Themo Lock is busily decorating the theatrical stage area in preparation for The New Britannia Theater Troupe presentation of Aurum Berries at 9:00 am CST, Sunday, May 3:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_PaxLair_StageArea_WIP_1.jpg[/img]

 

[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=49996]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #122...[/url]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in this week's Update of the Avatar:  Abe's Vertas Pass Upgrades, Judging a Book by its Cover, Fences Galore, TableTop with Wil Wheaton & Richard Garriott, Video of Lord & Lady British's Easter Celebration, Community Screenshots and Videos, In-game Community Weekend Events, and More!


[h1]Abe's Vertas Pass Upgrades[/h1]

[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/vertas-pass-upgrades.24278/][From a Dev+ Forum Post by Abe Robertson][/url]

Hello everyone!

Lately we've seen some very exciting improvements to our game, notably the Unity 5 lighting, the standard shader, speedtrees, as well as an ever growing library of high fidelity art assets. I recently had some time to reiterate on one of our older scenes, Vertas Pass, to see what could be aesthetically possible after integrating all of these improvements. I've included a few before and after screenshots, as well as some sneak peek screenshots at the bottom.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Abe_VertasPass_BeforeAfter1.jpg[/img]

The above screenshot was one of the first areas I revisited, beginning with the replacement of all of the old rocks. (A few devs told me they looked like meatballs) The desert rocks worked perfectly after a texture pass to make them appear arctic themed. I also integrated a retextured version of a rock pile asset I built for the Spectral Mines exterior, to improve the blending between the terrain and the natural walls.



[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Abe_VertasPass_BeforeAfter2.jpg[/img]

Here is an example of some winter themed speedtrees, which look far more detailed than the previous palette, and are animated in a more realistic manner. Lighting contrast has been increased to make the environment appear colder.



[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Abe_VertasPass_BeforeAfter3.jpg[/img]

More rocks are being used to line the cliff so it feels more natural and more detailed.



[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Abe_VertasPass_BeforeAfter4.jpg[/img]

I covered the background hills in spruce trees to give a better sense of depth, and to evoke a feeling of being surrounded by a forest.



Sneak Peek Screenshots:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Abe_VertasPass_2.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Abe_VertasPass_3.jpg[/img]

 [img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Abe_VertasPass_4.jpg[/img]

Hope you guys like the changes!

Abe


[h1]Judging a Book by it's Cover[/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Books_ingame1.jpg[/img]

In [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=49319]Update #119[/url] we introduced you to the some of the new book covers that Scott Jones has been working on for Release 17. Each unique book cover is designed to give players a hint of the book's contents. Rick Holtrop has been integrating the books into R17 and decorated these shelves using the new books:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Books_ingame2.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Books_ingame3.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Books_ingame4.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Books_ingame5.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Books_ingame6.jpg[/img]

 

Here are more of Scott's new book covers you can expect to find in Release 17:

[b]Combat[/b]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Books_Combat.jpg[/img]

 

[b]Magic[/b]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Books_Magic.jpg[/img]

 

[b]Crafting[/b]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Books_Crafting.jpg[/img]

 

[b]Miscellaneous[/b]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Books_Misc.jpg[/img]

 

[b]Cities[/b]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Books_Cities1.jpg[/img]



[h1]Fences Galore[/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Fences.jpg[/img]

We're adding sixteen new fence styles to Release 17 which launches on April 30. Some of the fences will be available in-game and some in the Add-On Store, and some will even be added to basic pledge rewards (stay tuned for that info in an upcoming Update). Below are seven of the sixteen new fences.

We're also adding a variety of new "pavers" to R17 that can be used for decoration, and will showcase them in an upcoming Update. In the following screenshot, the cobblestone pavers used in combination with the Ivy Covered Stone Fence make for a very attractive look.

[b]Ivy Covered Stone Fence (add-on)[/b]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Fence_Ivy_Covered_Stone.jpg[/img]

 

[b]Ornate Iron Fence (add-on)[/b]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Fence_Ornate_Iron.jpg[/img]

 

[b]Viking Wooden Fence (add-on)[/b]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Fence_Viking_Wooden.jpg[/img]

 

[b]Rough Stone Fence (in-game)[/b]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Fence_Rough_Stone_Short.jpg[/img]

 

[b]White Picket Fence (add-on)[/b]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Fence_White_Picket.jpg[/img]

 

[b]Wooden Palisade Fence (add-on)[/b]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Fence_Wooden_Palisade.jpg[/img]

 

[b]Wooden Privacy Fence (add-on)[/b]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Fence_Wooden_Privacy.jpg[/img]


[h1]TableTop with Wil Wheaton & Richard Garriott[/h1]

Wil Wheaton and guests Jenna Busch, Satine Phoenix, and Richard Garriott play Five Tribes in this episode of TableTop!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=0bYD1TAmu3I


[h1]The Mad Hermit's Video of Lord & Lady British's Easter Celebration[/h1]

From The Mad Hermit's YouTube channel:

[quote]On Saturday April 4th, Lord and Lady British held their Annual Easter Celebration in Castleton...I was honored and privileged to have been in attendance. Here is a brief look at what that experience was like.[/quote]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=4M1sY8ENvlU

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_VIPs_2015_1.png[/img]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in this week's Update of the Avatar:  Duke & LotM VIP Design Roundtable and Lady British's Easter Event, Release 16 Postmortem, Street Names in R17, Elven House, New Hat Variations, Community in-game Videos, In-game Community Weekend Events, and More!


[h1]Duke & LotM VIP Design Roundtable and Lady British's Easter Event[/h1]

We hosted our largest group to-date of Dukes and Lord of the Manors this past Friday for the VIP Design Roundtable and Portalarium Studio Tour (part of the Duke and LotM pledge rewards).

Design discussions started early and didn't stop until near sundown! Many of the VIP's extended their stay so they could participate in Lady British's Easter Event the following day. Here are a few pics from the weekend events:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_VIPs_2015_Kailef_ONBE.jpg[/img]
Lord of the Manor Kailef being awarded the Order of the New Britannia Empire medal, in honor of his amazing musical contributions to SotA and work with the Bards of the Poets' Circle


[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_VIPs_Easter_2015_MarkBarros_ONBE.jpg[/img]
Duke The Mad Hermit being awarded the Order of the New Britannia Empire medal, in honor of his incredible video contributions to SotA (yes, that is Lord "Batman" British and Starr "Mardi Gras" Long)

And speaking of the Mad Hermit's video contributions, here is a videolog of his Pilgrimage to Portalarium to attend the VIP Roundtable and Studio Tour:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=TCfc57SYoIY


[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_VIPs_Easter_2015.jpg[/img]
The VIP's and a few SotA Dev Team members at Lady British's Easter Event


[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_VIPs_Easter_2015_Richard_Laetitia.jpg[/img]
Lord "Batman" British and Lady "Wonder Woman" British Rescuing Baby "Spiderman" British from Godzilla (What does any of this have to do with Easter? We're not sure...)


[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Easter_2015_JesterDallas.jpg[/img]
Dallas "Gorn" Snell getting bucked off his Rody Race Horse


[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Easter_2015_RickHoltrop.jpg[/img][/url]
Rick "Chaox" Holtrop enjoying a confetti egg being cracked on his sunburnt scalp


[h1]Hangout of the Avatar ~ Release 16 Postmortem[/h1]

During this week's Hangout of the Avatar, Richard, Starr, and Chris chatted about Release 16, recounting their favorite moments, answering questions from the community, giving out prizes to those that attended, while also looking ahead to Release 17. You can check it here if you weren't able to attend:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=p95ywD6pXb4


[h1]Street Names in Release 17[/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_StreetSigns1.jpg[/img]

Rick Holtrop has been working to integrate street names into Release 17. He shared these comments about his street-naming work-flow:
[quote]The steps I've been going through to get Street Signs and Street Names into the game have involved:
[list]
	[*]Identify cities to have roads named[/*]
	[*]Create a simple map of streets from in-game map (or Unity top-down view)][/*]
	[*]Number streets in any order[/*]
	[*]Create spreadsheet with city name and road number[/*]
	[*]Track each type of road (major, minor, waterfront, number or player properties, etc.)[/*]
	[*]Edit each city and place road signs at appropriate or desired location
[list]
	[*]We have different signs designed by Andy Cortez that define small-to-large roads[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*]Compile list of possible names, including approved suggestions from the community[/*]
	[*]Name each road by referencing the spreadsheet or directly walking the streets in-game, or both
[list]
	[*]The names are tracked on the spreadsheet and added to signs as a tooltip[/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]
Strangely enough, you will notice that the actual naming of the roads is about the last thing to happen. The planning and tracking of this process actually takes the most time, and is what I am best suited for. (Rows and columns in spreadsheets, and simple drawings on graph paper, this is what I live for).[/quote]
When Starr and Richard first discussed the need for street names in a recent Dev Hangout, community member Lollie started a street-naming thread in the forums that rapidly grew with street name suggestions! Rick needed help wrestling the numerous suggestions into a manageable list for Richard to review, so Scott Jennings (Lum) created a follow up [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/name-that-street-request-for-input.24166/]forum post requesting that members only submit their top three street name choices[/url]. Rick has been compiling those submissions for Richard to review, and adding the approved names to his street name master list for eventual inclusion in the game.

Here are a few samples of the various signs that Andy has been working on:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_StreetSigns2.jpg[/img]


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=49528]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #120...[/url]

(Rows and columns in spreadsheets, and simple drawings on graph paper, this is what I live for).[/quote]
When Starr and Richard first discussed the need for street names in a recent Dev Hangout, community member Lollie started a street-naming thread in the forums that rapidly grew with street name suggestions! Rick needed help wrestling the numerous suggestions into a manageable list for Richard to review, so Scott Jennings (Lum) created a follow up [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/name-that-street-request-for-input.24166/]forum post requesting that members only submit their top three street name choices[/url]. Rick has been compiling those submissions for Richard to review, and adding the approved names to his street name master list for eventual inclusion in the game.

Here are a few samples of the various signs that Andy has been working on:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_StreetSigns2.jpg[/img]


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=49528]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #120...[/url]

[h1]Happy Easter![/h1]

All of us at Portalarium wish you a Happy Easter! It warmed our hearts to see so many of you embrace the "bunny" theme for Release 16, as shown by some of these great screenshots posted to the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/release-16-screenshot-gallery.23365/]Release 16 Screenshot Gallery[/url] and [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/326160/screenshots/]Steam Community Screenshots[/url]:

[h1]SotA Companion App[/h1]

We were excited to learn of the new SotA Companion App being developed by community member Brenton. As [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/sota-companion-app.23271/]stated in his forum post[/url]:

[quote]Hello! I am making a thread here for the SOTA Companion app I am currently developing for iOS and soon Android. This app is designed to be used as a reference for maps, crafting, skills, and creatures that you will encounter in your journeys...I have a number of beta testers currently trying it out and giving suggestions, but I would love even more! Here's a video and a few screenshots of the app (Beta 3 version):

https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=8jRcIQSJJVY



[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/beta3_sceens11.png[/img]

[h1]Judging a Book by its Cover[/h1]

Scott Jones has been busy this week designing new book covers for in-game books. Each unique book cover will give players a hint of the book's contents. Here are a few samples:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_BookCovers.jpg[/img]


[h1]Release 17 Grand Tour Quest Reward: Fez Hat[/h1]

Just as in our past several releases, we're including a Grand Tour Quest in R17 designed to guide you through all the new content. When you complete the R17 Grand Tour Quest you will be rewarded with a Fez Hat. This reward can only be unlocked during Release 17 (did someone say rares?), so be sure to log in to R17 starting April 30 and talk to all the Tour Guides!

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_R16_GrandTourReward_FezHat.jpg[/img]


[b][i]Time is Running Out to Get Your R16 Grand Tour Quest Reward[/i][/b]

Better hurry if you want to add the Black Lepus Mask to your collection because the R16 Grand Tour Quest ends on April 30 when we launch Release 17. If you need help getting your R16 Black Lepus Mask reward, then check out The Mad Hermit's video guide to completing the R16 Grand Tour Quest:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=42YOXUmrxSg


[h1]Release 15 Decoration Contest Winners[/h1]

There were twenty participants in the Release 15 Decoration Contest coordinated by community member Lollie last month, representing a wide variety of decorating styles and themes. Congratulations to the winners [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/the-r15-decoration-contest.22384/page-5#post-343766]announced in this forum post by Lollie[/url]:

[quote][i]We have the results in folks! So without further ado

1st place = Lord Thomas - Home for Adventurers
2nd place = Gaelis - Furniture Shop
3rd place = Themo Lock - Performing Arts Centre

Was a very close fight for second and third place (and even fourth place!). Lord Thomas just gave us the whole package - fresh ideas and good taste, with all areas given attention.

Special mention goes to Net and Gaelis Trajan with the Bear Tavern Brawl Arena, then Umuri and his puzzle box, tied with Ravicus and the very famous Wody's Bar, followed by Raven Swiftbow with a very cool cemetery/crypt, and Soleidad and Silverglade and their City Home.

Thanks to our judges - me (of course), and Doctor (Doctor Shroud) and a special guest judge - Bumnog (had to pull in a favour at the last minute after one of the judges found himself unable to complete the judging). And thanks to all the awesome entries - it really was a hard choice, so many wonderful ideas and so much hard work. Really fantastic work guys! Feel free to PM me if you want any feedback, all our judges worked hard to take down notes as we went along.[/i][/quote]

Here are a few screen shots of the winning entries:

[b]1st Place: Lord Thomas - Home for Adventurers:[/b] A Rustic 3-Story home on a Village Lot in Aldwater, (Loc: -86.8, 25.1, 45.5)

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/SotA_Decoration_Contest_R15_1st_2.jpg[/img]


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=49319]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #119...[/url]

notes.title: Release 16 Patch Notes: March 31, 2015
notes.content:
[h1]Release 16[/h1]
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Pre-Alpha Release 16! Notes on what is in this release are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/release-16-instructions.23496/]here[/url].

[b]March 31, 2015[/b]

[b]Build Number 251[/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list] [*]Chroma and AlienFX support is now an option in Video called "Keyboard Lighting". Please note that it defaults to "Off"[/*] [*]Players should now appear correctly to other players when sitting (fixes bug where they were floating above the chair[/*] [*]2 Handed weapons now highlight both slots when being dragged to an equipment slot and they show up in both slots when equipped[/*] [*]Timothy the Enchanter will now only reward quest completion once (and so endeth Bunnygate)[/*] [*]Exiting Southmarsh now takes you to Novia (instead of Owl's Wash in the Vale)[/*] [*]Timothy the Enchanter now gives the correct location for his quest[/*] [*]Chests on player property will now no longer be locked open if the property owner leaves while the chest is open[/*] [*]Added Producer Level to the stats UI (so it no longer appears stuck at 0)[/*] [*]Fixed several places where players would appear floating in the air when exiting scenes to the Novia overworld[/*] [*]Replaced missing exit in West Veiled Swamp[/*] [*]Fixed various dialogue bugs reported in the forums[/*] [*]Fixed stairs in Lord Marshal home[/*] [*]Rear exit of Necropolis now puts players in correct location on Novia overworld[/*] [*]Solace Forest lighting levels corrected[/*] [*]Fix for being stuck in combat[/*] [/list]

[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Some scenes are too dark at night (ex. Obsidian Keep)[/*]
	[*]Overly bloomed visuals in places (ex. Necropolis)[/*]
	[*]Some assets create flash bulb like sparks on screen[/*]
	[*]The screen may go dark unexpectedly in some cases.  If this occurs, you can open the video options and turn off Tone Mapping as a temporary fix.[/*]
	[*]Many pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support. These will not be complete until later this year[/*]
	[*][The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
	[*][Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
	[*]Some scenes in the new Novia overworld are missing visible name scrolls, though they can still be entered and explored.[/*]
	[*]Hair is not responding to light correctly[/*]
	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
	[*]Interior Player House culling system also culls objects on balconies, porches, roof, etc.[/*]
	[*]Unity 5 engine bug: Terrain is not accepting shadow casting lights and terrain lighting shows up on grid vs. radius[/*]
	[*]Repairing Weapons While Equipped Makes them Disappear[/*]
	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
	[*]Unity 5 Engine Bug: Objects in the foreground sort incorrectly against objects in the distance like trees and the horizon[/*]
	[*]Spectral Mines and Graf Gem Mines do not have metal ore nodes (will be fixed in R17)[/*]
[/list]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_R16_Screenshot_Gallery1.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in this week's Update of the Avatar:  Play Release 16 Now!, Traditional FireLotus Release (16) Party, Q2 2015 Schedule Update, Novian Academy of Arts and Sciences, Kickstarter Shout-Outs, In-game Community Weekend Events, and More!


[h1]Play Release 16 Now![/h1]

Release 16 successfully launched yesterday, March 26, with thousands of backers downloading, patching, logging in, and checking out the new changes! Lots of new content to explore, including:
[list] [*]7 new Adventure Scenes[/*] [*]Necropolis Dungeon: our very first map that is completely focused on the narrative and is a single player instance[/*] [*]Novia Overworld expanded[/*] [*]New creatures, including crocodiles, Obsidian Golem, Sand Elemental, and pet rabbits[/*] [*]New NPC skills, damage types, and resistances[/*] [*]Discovery Navigation System[/*] [*]Performance improvements[/*] [*]...and more![/*]
[/list]
Check out the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=49134]Release 16 Instructions update[/url] for detailed information about all the new R16 content.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_R16_GrandTourReward_BlackLepusMask-150x150.jpg[/img]

[b]The Grand Tour Quest[/b]
Just as in our last several releases, we've included a Grand Tour Quest designed to guide you through all the new content. You will be able to get the Black Lepus Mask by completing the Release 16 Grand Tour Quest. This reward can only be unlocked during Release 16 (did someone say rares?), so be sure to log in soon and talk to all the Tour Guides!

If you need help completing the R16 Grand Tour Quest, then check this video walk-thru provided by The Mad Hermit:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=42YOXUmrxSg


[h1]Traditional FireLotus Release (16) Party![/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_R16_FireLotus_ReleaseParty0.jpg[/img]

Every Release, our Community Manager, Gina "FireLotus" Dionne, hosts a Release Party during the afternoon of the first Friday of the Release. Today's [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/its-the-firelotus-release-16-dance-party.23507/]Release 16 Dance Party[/url] was held in a [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=9085&open=city_stone_arena_basement__digital_]City Arena Basement[/url] at the World's End Club in Port Mirren (a small island accessible via a ferry from the Kingsport docks).

Special thanks to Soleidad and Athanil for offering such a cool place to party and the tremendous work they put into the amazing decor! [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=9085&open=white_lepus_mask__digital_]The Lepus Mask[/url] (both black and white) was quite popular at the event, as were the[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=9085&open=spotted_rabbit__digital_] new bunny pets[/url] (warily keeping an eye on the dog pets also in attendance). And the Zombie dance moves appeared to be quite the fav! Lord British himself showed up for a little boogie-down action:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_R16_FireLotus_ReleaseParty2.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_R16_FireLotus_ReleaseParty3.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Novian Academy of Arts and Science[/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/Novian_Academy_Header.png[/img]

We were pretty excited to learn of the founding of the [url=http://novianacademy.com/home]Novian Academy of Arts and Sciences[/url] by community member Kazyn Phoenixfyre! As described on the Academy's website:

[quote]We at the Novian Academy exist as a society of scholars, instructors and masters of our trade in order to bring our knowledge to the masses with an ever expanding collection of structured classes that Avatars of all levels of experience can learn from.

The first semester of the Novian Academy shall kick off this release, Release 16, and will continue on until release 17. From here, we hope to pick up more interested instructors and start new classes each release. If you or anyone you know is interested in becoming part of our society of teachers and scholars then by all means, contact us here in the forums

The Novian Academy hosts a wide variety of courses which allow avatars both young and old to experience and learn more about the world of New Britannia. Each course is divided into multiple lessons, and avatars completing each phase are eligible to recieve customized degrees demonstrating their completion of the course.[/quote]

Last week, Community member Net provided an introductory class to his 3-part Combat Basics course. During the very first lesson on the floor of the newly founded Novian Academy, Avatars had a chance to learn the basics of combat. Net taught avatars his secrets for success in combat, Gaelis Trajan helped with the practical demonstration of the ten basic principles (and surprisingly managed to kill Net) while Arianna recorded the lesson. Amber Raine (Avatars Radio) provided a commentary over the aether. Fortunately for everyone that missed the class, they created a YouTube video:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=CTPOMemitgU

Earlier today, Net taught his [b]CBT100 - Combat Theory and Introduction[/b] class for the first time, covering the 10 commandments of SotA combat. Thankfully, they captured a video of the class:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=o9qKbX8EQ5s

Net has a thread on his [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/combat-lessons-from-novice-to-master.23384/]combat lessons in the Release 16 Events forum[/url] detailing the schedule for his upcoming classes. If you're interested in learning the subleties of SotA combat from one of the game's Master Warriors, then check out the thread and mark the class dates in your calendar!

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in this week's Update of the Avatar:  Play Release 16 Now!, Traditional FireLotus Release (16) Party, Q2 2015 Schedule Update, Novian Academy of Arts and Sciences, Kickstarter Shout-Outs, In-game Community Weekend Events, and More!


[h1]Play Release 16 Now![/h1]

Release 16 successfully launched yesterday, March 26, with thousands of backers downloading, patching, logging in, and checking out the new changes! Lots of new content to explore, including:
[list] [*]7 new Adventure Scenes[/*] [*]Necropolis Dungeon: our very first map that is completely focused on the narrative and is a single player instance[/*] [*]Novia Overworld expanded[/*] [*]New creatures, including crocodiles, Obsidian Golem, Sand Elemental, and pet rabbits[/*] [*]New NPC skills, damage types, and resistances[/*] [*]Discovery Navigation System[/*] [*]Performance improvements[/*] [*]...and more![/*]

[b]The Grand Tour Quest[/b]
Just as in our last several releases, we've included a Grand Tour Quest designed to guide you through all the new content. You will be able to get the Black Lepus Mask by completing the Release 16 Grand Tour Quest. This reward can only be unlocked during Release 16 (did someone say rares?), so be sure to log in soon and talk to all the Tour Guides!

If you need help completing the R16 Grand Tour Quest, then check this video walk-thru provided by The Mad Hermit:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=42YOXUmrxSg


[h1]Traditional FireLotus Release (16) Party![/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_R16_FireLotus_ReleaseParty0.jpg[/img]

[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=9085&open=white_lepus_mask__digital_]The Lepus Mask[/url] (both black and white) was quite popular at the event, as were the[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=9085&open=spotted_rabbit__digital_] new bunny pets[/url] (warily keeping an eye on the dog pets also in attendance). notes.title: Release 16 Patch Notes: March 26, 2015
notes.content:
Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Pre-Alpha Release 16!

Notes on what is in this release are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/release-16-instructions.23496/]here[/url].

[b]March 26, 2015[/b]

[b]Build Number 245: 7:10 PM[/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
	[*]More lighting fixes for scenes including Necropolis Entrance, Obsidian Keep, etc.[/*]
	[*]Fixed the lack of collision on main doors to the Necropolis[/*]
	[*]Decreasing the saturation of the fill lights in Solania[/*]
	[*]Moved Anti-aliasing script around in the execution order to (hopefully) fix the black screen issue some were seeing in the tonemapping.[/*]
	[*]Fern transparency issue fixed[/*]
	[*]Windmills decorations can now only be placed outdoors[/*]
	[*]Changed shader on Tree Curtains and dialed settings so that they are not as dark as before[/*]
	[*]Reduced random encounter chance by 50%[/*]
	[*]Material fixes for city walls[/*]
	[*]Fixed issues with not being able to walk under small Necropolis bridges[/*]
	[*]Fixed items in basements being invisible[/*]
	[*]Removed collision from non-combat pets so they do not slow you down when you collide with them[/*]
	[*]Hid damaged states on Ardoris vases to resolve z-fighting issues until interactivity is set up properly[/*]
	[*]Dead reckoning improvements to improve synch issues between players[/*]
	[*]Added remaining events to R16 events book[/*]
	[*]Fix for Portcullis switches[/*]
	[*]Fixed some sparkly leaves on trees in Ardoris[/*]
	[*]Light Spell now casts shadows (which won't show up on terrain, see below)[/*]
	[*]Ardoris vases no longer have a seam[/*]
	[*]Fixed some sorting issues in Solania[/*]
	[*]Fixed missing Rowhouse texture[/*]
	[*]Fixed loading directly onto a plot and having invisible items inside the house[/*]
	[*]Increased chat bubble distance on overworld[/*]
	[*]You can now chat while seated[/*]
	[*]Bentley's still can no longer be interacted with (which fixes some folks getting stuck when interacting with it)[/*]
	[*]Owl's Head guild registrar once again recognizes guild names.[/*]
	[*]Old tour guide removed from North Grunvald Barrens[/*]
	[*]Fixed all sparkling Kobolds and Skeletons[/*]
	[*]Tour guide in Necropolis Barrens no longer references Tower of the Shuttered Eye in his progress message[/*]
	[*]Fixed basement endless teleport loop issue[/*]
[/list]
[b]Known Issues:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Some scenes are too dark at night (ex. Obsidian Keep)[/*]
	[*]Overly bloomed visuals in places (ex. Necropolis)[/*]
	[*]Some assets create flash bulb like sparks on screen[/*]
	[*]The screen may go dark unexpectedly in some cases.  If this occurs, you can open the video options and turn off Tone Mapping as a temporary fix.[/*]
	[*]Many pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support. These will not be complete until later this year[/*]
	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]
	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]
	[*]Some scenes in the new Novia overworld are missing visible name scrolls, though they can still be entered and explored.[/*]
	[*]Hair is not responding to light correctly[/*]
	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]
	[*]Interior Player House culling system also culls objects on balconies, porches, roof, etc.[/*]
	[*]Unity 5 engine bug: Terrain is not accepting shadow casting lights and terrain lighting shows up on grid vs. radius[/*]
	[*]Can't use skills after being interrupted when harvesting[/*]
	[*]Repairing Weapons While Equipped Makes them Disappear[/*]
	[*]ALT key can no longer be bound. This was necessary to re-enable quick self cast with ALT[/*]
	[*]Unity 5 Engine Bug: Objects in the foreground sort incorrectly against objects in the distance like trees and the horizon[/*]
	[*]Portcullises are broken randomly throughout the game[/*]
	[*]Spectral Mines and Graf Gem Mines do not have metal ore nodes (will be fixed in R17)[/*]
	[*]Cannot do any interactions while sitting (except chatting)[/*]
[/list]
[b]Build Number 241: 1:00 PM[/b]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
	[*]Targeted AOE Spells like Fireball now work again[/*]
	[*]Fixed Necropolis scene exits so they put you in the proper location on Novia Overworld[/*]
	[*]Added Rabbit calls to game[/*]
	[*]Added innkeeper shopkeeper vendor list for barmaid in Soltown[/*]
	[*]Adjusted Wolf weapon range based on creature size[/*]
	[*]Adjusted creature melee weapon range to reduce their max attack distance[/*]
	[*]Capped bottom of wedding dress[/*]
	[*]Celestis Sewers now have the correct display name of "Soltown Sewers"[/*]
	[*]Changing Spectral Mines tour guide journal entry so that it is different from last month's and thus will save for every character (from forums)[/*]
	[*]Weight no longer displays as "-0" when inventory is empty[/*]
	[*]ALT now works again for quick cast to target self[/*]
	[*]Necropolis door no longer selects everything around it when selected[/*]
	[*]Fixed flash bulb like sparkles on Crowns (Duke, Darkstarr, Baron), Epic Cloth Gear, Kobolds (warrior, archer, and mage), Cloaks (Lord and Knight)[/*]
	[*]Fixed material of "Wrasse Egg"[/*]
	[*]Fixed LOD issue with 4 Story Blue Roof Row House that was making it shimmer[/*]
	[*]Flavor text for if someone confronts Bentley the bootlegger in Soltown with his ledger. (suggested in forums)[/*]
	[*]Fixed home decoration torches that had the light way off center[/*]
	[*]Fixed issue in Necropolis Barrens that was making scene dark suddenly whenever a player went into the tunnel[/*]
	[*]You can now swim in a few places in the Necropolis[/*]
	[*]Most trees and foliage should no longer have white spots on them[/*]
	[*]Reduced range of PvP towers, it was hitting the middle of the arena[/*]
	[*]Removed old crypt and replaced with new[/*]
	[*]Removed spec from conifer trees to eliminate silvery nighttime appearance[/*]
	[*]Earthquake damage increased[/*]
	[*]Fixed stuck spot on 4 story stucco Row House[/*]
	[*]Set Skinning Difficulty and XP on skinnable creatures-these were previously all set to diff:0 xp:50, now they are set based on the creature difficulty[/*]
	[*]Setup locked spirit doors in Necropolis[/*]
	[*]Should no longer float in the air when leaving Savrenoc Stronghold[/*]
	[*]Lanterns should now look correct when on / off[/*]
	[*]Fixed label text for under/overbite slider in character creation[/*]
	[*]Fixed lighting in several scenes to fix darkness issues[/*]
	[*]Necropolis entrance map now called Necropolis Barrens[/*]
[/list]

notes.title: Q2 2015 Schedule Update
notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/Starr_avatar-150x150.jpg[/img]

Greetings Avatars,

As we stated in previous posts, our goal is to once-per-quarter post an updated schedule for our monthly releases. Even though these goals will likely change somewhat as we react to feedback, we feel it is important to provide you an updated roadmap periodically.

Our goal continues to be to deliver our backers content each and every month so that we can get feedback, and use it to iterate improvements. This has already paid off, with additional game features like jumping and swimming, as well as improvements to systems like crafting, conversations, and combat. Meeting that monthly goal is our highest priority, but we require flexibility in our deliverables to meet that goal. As you have seen in previous releases, sometimes we push things out, but we also often pull new things in.

It is worth noting that we develop in an iterative fashion. This means we will often get systems and content in the game as soon as we can, even if they are only partially functional. In general until you see me say something is "final" you can safely assume we will continue to improve on that feature. An example is our Pets which are in very early development and do not include a lot of their functionality like being able to hang out in your house.

As always, all dates, durations, and deliverables are subject to change as we adjust our designs based on direct feedback from you, our backers.

As you might notice many of the deliverables from Q1 are now in Q2. This is due to many factors including the Unity 5 conversion, conventions (we had not planned to attend GDC), bug fixes, and other completely normal game development challenges. This now obviously puts our launch by end of 2015 at risk. We are currently working on various strategies to keep launch within 2015 but as always our goal is to ship the product when it is ready, not before. We will do everything in our power however to complete Episode 1 in as timely a manner as possible without sacrificing scope or quality. It is worth noting that based on our current funding and fundraising data trends that we we will still be able to complete the game without any financial issues, even with slips like this. [i]NOTE: With this schedule change we will be extending payment plans to November.[/i]

[b]RELEASE 17, April 30, 2015:[/b]

[list]
	[*][b]Polish & Performance: [/b]We will continue the work we started with Release 16 to improve overall polish and performance in the game. We will focus not only on improving frame rate but also lowering load times. We may also spend some time on usability issues.[/*]
	[*][b]Maps: [/b]Perennial Coast and Grunvald will continue to be expanded.[/*]
	[*][b]Steam Achievements: [/b]Players will now be able to earn Steam Achievements.[/*]
	[*][b]Player Owned Town Test: [/b]We hope to have our first example of a Player Owned Town in the game with the PaxLair Metropolis.[/*]
	[*][b]Crafting: [/b]Crafting will now have events that occur during the crafting process that the player can interact with to influence the results.[/*]
	[*][b]Creatures:[/b] Our bestiary will expand to include various Human Enemies (mages, archers, etc.), the Phoenix, and Zombies![/*]
	[*][b]Player Titles: [/b]Players will now be able to display their title in the game.[/*]
	[*][b]Street Signs:[/b] We will begin placing street signs in major towns.[/*]
	[*][b]Player Wipe:[/b] We will be wiping all game, property, and player data for this release because of some fundamental changes to item architecture.[/*]
[/list]
[b]RELEASE 18, May 28, 2015:[/b]
[list]
	[*][b]Maps: [/b]Our goal is to get the Grunvald Region near completion and begin work on the Quel Region which includes scenes like the Etceter Mines.[/*]
	[*][b]Spells & Skills:[/b] The combat schools of Shields and Light Armor will expand, and more combos will be added to the game.[/*]
	[*][b]Housing: [/b]Fences and Walls will come online as new customization options for player property.[/*]
	[*][b]Player Owned Towns: [/b]We plan to start the official submission process and begin implementing more towns.[/*]
	[*][b]Crafting: [/b]Crafting skills will start to come online, and be used during crafting to modify results.[/*]
	[*][b]Creatures: [/b]Our creature list will continue to expand with Chaos Demons and Wisps.[/*]
	[*][b]Combat:[/b] The cover system will be introduced that modifies attack and defense values when you (or your target) are behind cover.[/*]
	[*][b]Overworld: [/b]Roving encounters (patrolling creatures) will now appear on the overworld map and can be engaged (pulling you into a scene) or avoided if you wish to sneak past.[/*]
	[*][b]Emote “Teaching”:[/b] Emotes will now be teachable to other players. Some emotes (like the ones tied to pledges) will only be teachable by the original owner. Teaching will be done via secure trading a consumable item that adds the emote when used.[/*]
	[*][b]Localization: [/b]We will begin crowdsourcing the translation of the game into various languages.[/*]
	[*][b]Player Made Books: [/b]Players will be able to write in blank books in the game, and share them with other players.[/*]
	[*][b]Customization:[/b] Clothing and Armor will now be dyeable.[/*]
[/list]
[b]RELEASE 19, June 25, 2015:[/b]
[list]
	[*][b]Maps: [/b]We hope to get the Quel Region near final and start on the Midmaer Region.[/*]
	[*][b]Spells & Skills:[/b] Chaos Magic and Ranged Combat will expand to include more spells, and more combos will come online.[/*]
	[*][b]Housing: [/b]Property ownership will now incur regular fees (unless you are using a tax free deed from a pledge). If the fees are not paid, the player will lose their claim, and their possessions (including the house and decorations) will be moved to their bank. Note: We will provide more details about timing, payments, etc. near the end of R18.[/*]
	[*][b]Crafting: [/b]Tailors and Alchemists will be able to begin crafting Taming Collars. We will also be adding more Cooking and Alchemy recipes.[/*]
	[*][b]Pets & Taming: [/b]We will expand pet functionality to include the ability to tame creatures.[/*]
	[*][b]Creatures: [/b]Dragons will begin appearing in Novia! Burninating will begin. All hail Trogdor, the Burninator![/*]
	[*][b]Combat:[/b] Guilds will now be able to declare war on each other.[/*]
	[*][b]Customization:[/b] New armor and clothing items will appear in the game.[/*]
	[*][b]Musical Instruments: [/b]Players can play music in the game with a variety of instruments.[/*]
	[*][b]Player Owned Vendors: [/b]Players will now be able to place a Vendor on their property to sell goods.[/*]
[/list]
We continue to be incredibly thankful for the support we receive from this amazing community. While the funding you provide makes all of this possible, it pales in comparison with the faith you have in us, the feedback you provide us, and the content you are making for everyone to enjoy. We are humbly grateful, and we cannot wait to see you again in New Britannia!


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=49183][Read the rest of Executive Producer Starr Long's post here...][/url]
