notes.title: Release 16 Instructions
notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_Necropolis_Entrance.jpg[/img]


Greetings Avatars,

Thank you to our loyal backers of Shroud of the Avatar. Release 16 access for all backers at First Responder level and above begins this Thursday, March 26 at 10:30 AM Central Time (16:30 UTC).

[b]Please read this entire message, as well as the linked [/b][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z-svq1OvcZwViqGxFCKdjH3NCn2LTfLuGny5qaAqjTM/pub][b]instructions[/b][/url][b] and [/b][url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EQczZJxj38npLbysCEjSa_xiWwx7jQ9zFgvX9yPg2xY/pub][b]known issues[/b][/url][b].[/b]

While I am proud of how much we accomplished with our last release, at the same time I am chagrined that the cost of that ambition was an overall decrease in the enjoyability of the game. We did move over to Unity 5 (which was a HUGE accomplishment) but we only got partially there and that transitional state caused bad performance and some less than stellar visual results. We also moved the players over to Novia for the first time, but we failed to balance the first region, Perennial Coast, for new players. For all of that we are very sorry and we will work to do better. We promise to pay closer attention to balancing forward progress with playability.

Release 16 (and 17) has had to be our repayment of the debt we incurred with Release 15 (tech debt is a term often used in our industry). That means that we were unable to deliver quite as much content as we had hoped, but we do feel the game will be in a stronger state because of our focus on playability. We still made time to include some cool new things for you to play with though, including shield bashing skeletons that just will not die and the sprawling narrative of the Necropolis!

I will be posting a Q2 Schedule by the end of this week so stay tuned for more information about what comes next.

Also, remember that while we are providing new content with each release, our community is working overtime to make new events for you to enjoy, so be sure to check out a couple of the Community Events Calendars run by our community members (via in game book or the player run websites [url=http://avatarscircle.com/community-events/]Avatars Circle[/url] Community Events and [url=http://sotaevents.com/]Events of the Avatars[/url] calendar).

Without further ado, here are the R16 deliverables.


[b]Key:[/b]
[list]
	[*][b]Plain Text:[/b] The original plan for the Release deliverables. We intentionally preserve the original text so that our backers can compare plan versus actual.[/*]
	[*][i][b]Italics:[/b] Extra notes and new deliverables[/i][/*]
	[*][strike][b]Strikethrough:[/b] These are items that did not make the release[/strike][/*]
[/list]
[b]RELEASE 16, March 26, 2015[/b]
[list]
	[*][b]Steam Achievements: [/b][strike]Players will now be able to earn Steam Achievements[/strike]
[list]
	[*][b][i]Achievements Rescheduled:[/i][/b][i] Refactoring of interactive objects (see below) required us to push this to a future release[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][b]Maps: [/b]Mainland scenes will continue to come online [strike]including Blood River Village, Vertas, and the Grunvald Shardfall.[/strike]
[list]
	[*][img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_Novia_Grunvald_Region_R16.jpg[/img][/*]
	[*][b][i]Region by Region Expansion: [/i][/b][i]As mentioned in the R15 post, we are now expanding the scenes region by region; starting with Perennial Coast and moving north and west from there. For R16, we brought Perennial Coast closer to a finished state (minus some story elements) and moved into Grunvald (the shardfall we actually put in game way back in R14). Vertas and Blood River Village will now be worked on when we move to Verdantis near the end of our map building work (i.e. closer to launch). Please note that all scenes should be considered “in progress” which means they are simply in a functional state (and in some cases they cannot be “completed”).[/i][/*]
	[*][b][i]7 New Adventure Scenes:[/i][/b][i] The Perennial Coast and Grunvald regions are filled with places to adventure and gather resources. New scenes include:[/i]
[list]
	[*][i]East Perennial Trail[/i][/*]
	[*][i]Southern Grunvald Barrens[/i][/*]
	[*][i]Northern Grunvald Barrens[/i][/*]
	[*][i]Savrenoc Timberland[/i][/*]
	[*][i]Deep Savrenoc Timberland[/i][/*]
	[*][i]Savrenoc Stronghold[/i][/*]
	[*][i]Necropolis Entrance[/i][/*]
	[*][img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_Necropolis_Entrance.jpg[/img][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][b][i]6 Improved Adventure Scenes:[/i][/b][i] We circled back to new scenes we added in R15to make them more visually distinct from each other. The modified scenes include:[/i]
[list]
	[*][i]West Perennial Trail[/i][/*]
	[*][i]South Celestial Wetlands[/i][/*]
	[*][i]North Celestial Wetlands[/i][/*]
	[*][i]South Brightbone Woods[/i][/*]
	[*][i]North Brightbone Woods[/i][/*]
	[*][i]West Veiled Swamp[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_Necropolis2a.jpg[/img][/*]
	[*][b][i]Necropolis (first pass): [/i][/b][i]This city of the dead underneath the Brightbone Mountains is our very first map that is completely focused on the narrative and it is a single player instance (this is one of the few plot moments that require solitary play). It is also one of the most complex underground spaces we have ever built. We do not yet have all of the story elements working, and there are still some lingering issues with the space itself, but it is in a mostly playable space (and looks amazing for a first pass).[/i][/*]
	[*][img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_Novia_Map1.jpg[/img][/*]
	[*][b][i]Novia Overworld Expanded: [/i][/b][i]Most of the Novia Overworld is now navigable and the scenes that are built are hooked up to their appropriate locations including Vertas Pass, Verdantis Shardfall, Graff Gem Mines, Blackblade Pass, and the Battle Camps. This also means we removed the Lunar Rift from Owl’s Head.[/i][/*]
[/list]


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=49134]And Much More! Click here the complete R16 Instructions[/url]

[img]https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/wp-content/themes/portalarium_sota/assets/r16hat.png[/img]

[list]
	[*][i]West Perennial Trail[/i][/*]

notes.title: Update of the Avatar #117 – 2015.03.20
notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_CommunityApp_MultiScreens.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in this week's Update of the Avatar:  SotA Community App for iOS and Android, SotA on More 2015 Most Anticipated Lists, SotA at SXSW, Lord British and Lord Blackthorn Keynote CGF2015, Help Name SotA Streets, Kickstarter Shout-Outs, In-game Community Weekend Events, and More!


[h1]SotA Community App for iOS and Android[/h1]

Wow! We were blown away when we learned of this new SotA Community App, built by community members, for community members! Here's an excerpt from [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/sota-community-app-ios.23073/]Matterio's forum post for the iOS version[/url]:

FEATURES & USE

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_CommunityApp_HomeScreen2.jpg[/img]

[u]Avatars Radio[/u]
Click the on and off button to access the radio stream. This version of the App is compatible with bluetooth. You need to turn off any other radio application, i.e. Pandora for the stream to be heard on a paired bluetooth radio. The volume does reset itself when you exit the App. Be aware when you touch the volume as it may increase the volume. The radio is directly linked to a shoutcast stream. We will want to get feedback on the quality of the stream. Any disconnections, crashes, locks, etc. Be sure to click the link at the very bottom to test the functionality and don't forget to support them!

[u]News[/u]
The news feature is pulling RSS feeds from a few select sites. We plan to expand the amount of sites in the future. For now, basic functionality is key. Upon clicking a news link, it will open a browser window. You can pinch and swipe to manipulate the web window.

[u]IRC[/u]
The IRC scene will bring you to a Kiwi IRC menu. At this time, you won't be able to log in with your registered name. You can authenticate after logging in unregistered. You are by default directed to #sota. You may need to adjust the IRC window by pinching the screen to fit the window.

[u]Calendar[/u]
The calendar is drawing from one source at the moment. This function uses the Google calendar integration. You can select an event and see more details within the post event. You can add the event to your calendar if you are a Google subscriber. We do have future plans to integrate with iOS default calendar.

[u]Wiki[/u] - Future release

[u]Maps[/u] - Future release

[u]Known Issues[/u] - iPad may present misaligned graphics.

I want to thank everyone on the team who put in countless hours to make this App possible. This App's intent is to bring the community closer by integrating the various utilities and solutions into one App. More features will be introduced in future releases.

[u]THE TEAM[/u]
Matterio: iOS
Belgeran: iOS/Android
Umbrae: Android
Bubonic: Graphics

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_CommunityApp_logo.png[/img]


If you'd like to help alpha-test the SotA Community App, then go to these links for further information:

[b]Android[/b]: [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/sota-community-app-android.23074/]https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/sota-community-app-android.23074/[/url]


[b]iOS[/b]: [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/sota-community-app-android.23074/]https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/sota-community-app-android.23074/[/url]


[h1]SotA on More 2015 Most Anticipated Lists[/h1]

SotA was included in a couple more Most Anticipated game lists for 2015 from MMORPG and GamingBolt! Check 'em out:

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/01/MMORPG_logo.jpg[/img]

[quote][url=http://www.mmorpg.com/showFeature.cfm/feature/9499/The-List-Top-10-Most-Anticipated-MMO-Releases-of-2015.html][b]The List: Top 10 Most Anticipated MMO Releases of 2015[/b][/url]

"It appears that we are entering a new era of MMOs, where developers can’t simply rely on the tried and true principles that have gotten them to where they are today. In 2015, it’s a year about diversity and reaching new audiences – and here are our most anticipated releases in the MMO world for 2015."

[b]#8 - Shroud of the Avatar: [/b]Ultima. Richard Garriott. Hardcore. Old-school. If any of those things sound familiar or intriguing to you, then this is a game you should already be excited about. Shroud of the Avatar was originally funded at almost twice its $1 Million target back in April of 2013, so the game is finally starting to come together. With a major focus on immersion and engaging stories, it has the makings to be one of the next big ones that people will play for years. The hype has died down recently and it’s been in an alpha state for quite some time, otherwise it would be higher on the list.[/quote]



[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/GamingBolt_logo.png[/img]

[quote][url=http://gamingbolt.com/most-anticipated-mmos-and-mmorpgs-of-2015/10][b]Most Anticipated MMOs And MMORPGs of 2015[/b][/url]

"If you’re looking for epic adventures, brawlers or some shooters with friends and gamers all over then you may want to look into these select video games. Set to release in 2015 with an open-beta or full release, here are the top MMO and MMORPG based video games."

[b]Shroud of the Avatar:[/b] An upcoming spiritual successor to the Ultima Series, development studio Portalarium will be releasing Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues. This is an upcoming fantasy role-playing video game that will offer five episodic content with unique virtue based stories...Little information is released about the overall story but it will be supported by the Blade of the Avatar novel. While players will have to pay a one time fee for each episode, there is an option to enjoy the game fully offline otherwise there will be two multiplayer modes for friends or completely open-world online gameplay.[/quote]


[h1]Help Name SotA's Streets[/h1]

During last week's video Hangout of the Avatar, Starr and team discussed the need for street names in SotA. We're going to need lots of street names, so community member, Lollie, started a street-naming thread in the forums:

[quote]So in this thread we're going to think up a whole bunch of street names - imagine that you're coming up with names for all the streets in Ardoris, or in Owl's Head or Kingsport, or Braemar, Holtrot, Northshire, Southmarsh, Greystone, Port Mirren...etc. So a whole huge range of names would be needed, for all the different kinds of areas. Probably thousands of street names will be needed, by the time we get to the mainland. We could help save the devs time if we can provide a quick and ready list of names to pick from...[/quote]

Sounds like a cool idea! Lord British and team will review all the community suggestions, and if we find names we can use, then we'll put them in the game! [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/street-names-brainstorming-thread.23062/]So head on over to Lollie's post[/url] and add your favorite street names to the growing list!


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=49017]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #117...[/url]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_DevHangout_R15Postmortem.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in this week's Update of the Avatar: R15 Postmortem with Special Guest Tracy Hickman, SotA Shows Razer Chroma Support at GDC, SotA at SXSW, Player Owned Towns Update: Scope, NPC Buildings, Icons, etc., White Lepus Mask, Kickstarter Reboots, In-game Community Weekend Events, and More!


[h1]Hangout of the Avatar ~ Release 15 Postmortem with Tracy Hickman[/h1]

It was awesome to have Tracy Hickman visiting the Portalarium Studios today! He's in town this weekend, participating in the SXSW Interactive Conference, and hanging out with Richard, Starr, and Chris for our video Hangout of the Avatar: R15 Postmortem. The Hangout highlights included: Grand Tour Quest reward stats, street names in towns for better navigation, full loot areas for some PVP areas, undead who resurrect themselves, trainer design, and more!

And for those of you curious as to how many of the Grand Tour Quest Rewards have been achieved:
[list] [*]R10 Cavalier Hat: 1425[/*] [*]R11 Tricorn Hat with Carnival Mask: 1731[/*] [*]R12 Pilgrim Hat: 2336[/*] [*]R13 Yule Hat: 2503[/*] [*]R14 Hennin Hat: 1835[/*] [*]R15 Silver Jester Carnival Hat: 1123 (with 2 weeks left to go)[/*] [/list]
If you missed the live broadcast earlier today, then check it out here:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=DM3DtJAxWv0


[h1]SotA Shows Razer Chroma Support at GDC[/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_Razer_TowerShutteredEye.jpg[/img]

One of the founders of Razer, Min-Liang Tan, proudly described to Richard that the Razer logo is based on Richard’s serpent necklace, so there is a deep connection between us and the Razer clan. At GDC, Razer introduced their Chroma SDK which allows game developers to [url=http://www.razerzone.com/chroma]connect game events to Razer Chroma peripherals[/url]. Prior to GDC we worked with the Razer team to implement this functionality in Shroud and players will be able to experience it firsthand in Release 16. Not only did we hook it up to game state but we also linked it up to combos (corresponding numbers light up of spells that can be combined together) and hints (corresponding keys related to the system light up to teach players which keys do what).

Razer was so impressed with our implementation that they invited us to show it at GDC in the Razer booth and they even filmed Richard giving a little demo. We had a great show at GDC with a lot of visitors and incredibly positive feedback from fellow developers, many of which had not yet seen the game.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=QOVA3jOmDyo

Here are a few more pics from the GDC event:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_GDC1.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_GDC2.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_GDC3.jpg[/img]
Umm, Finn Staber doing VR research at GDC?!?


[h1]SotA at SXSW This Weekend[/h1]


[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/sxsw-interactive-logo.png[/img]
Richard Garriott and Tracy Hickman will be on a SXSW Interactive panel moderated by Starr Long entitled [url=http://schedule.sxsw.com/2015/events/event_IAP43351]Linear versus Nonlinear Narrative in Video Games[/url] at 3:30 PM Saturday, March 14 in the Kodosky room at the [url=http://schedule.sxsw.com/?lsort=venue_all_days&venue=Long+Center]Long Center[/url].

Starr Long will also be giving a talk at SXSW Interactive entitled [url=http://schedule.sxsw.com/2015/events/event_IAP30691]Crowd Sharing: Crowd Funding and Sourcing in Games[/url] at 11 AM Sunday, March 15 in the Kodosky room at the [url=http://schedule.sxsw.com/?lsort=venue_all_days&venue=Long+Center]Long Center[/url].

Most of theSXSW Interactive talks, panels, and events are free to the public, so if you are in Austin this weekend then head downtown and check out the action!

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_THickman_RHoltrop_RGarriott.jpg[/img]
Tracy Hickman at Portalarium Studios, in town for SXSW, shown here with Rick Holtrop and Richard Garriott


[h1]Player Owned Towns Update: Scope, NPC Buildings, Icons, etc.[/h1]


[u][url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/player-owned-towns-update-scope-npc-buildings-icons-etc.23057/][A SotA Public Forum post by Starr Long][/url][/u]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/Starr_avatar-150x150.jpg[/img]

Greetings Avatars,

We continue to iterate on our submission, intake, and fulfillment process for Player Owned Towns (PoTs). We are also doing continual design work for PoTs, including ways to incentivize thriving PoTs filled with occupants and ways to keep traffic moving through PoTs. We are far enough in our thinking that I wanted to provide all of you with an update on a few topics (note that templates is not yet one of those topics).

I also wanted everyone to understand the scope of this feature. At a high level I am trying very hard to control the scope of PoTs for Episode 1 so that is why anything I propose will be more fixed than some of you might like. As much as possible I am trying to use systems we are already building (or have built) versus creating whole new systems or new parameters for existing systems. This will also make it easier to debug and balance. That means a lot of the requested features are not going to make Episode 1 launch including: contracts/automated taxes for owners, owners being able to decorate NPC areas, income to owner from in town purchases, etc.

I am also attempting to make the PoTs function as close to the regular towns as possible which is why you will see things like town size influencing certain parameters[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/06/SotA_Metropolis.jpg[/img]


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=48896]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #116...[/url]

One of the founders of Razer, Min-Liang Tan, proudly described to Richard that the Razer logo is based on Richard’s serpent necklace, so there is a deep connection between us and the Razer clan. At GDC, Razer introduced their Chroma SDK which allows game developers to [url=http://www.razerzone.com/chroma]connect game events to Razer Chroma peripherals[/url]. Prior to GDC we worked with the Razer team to implement this functionality in Shroud and players will be able to experience it firsthand in Release 16. Not only did we hook it up to game state but we also linked it up to combos (corresponding numbers light up of spells that can be combined together) and hints (corresponding keys related to the system light up to teach players which keys do what).

Razer was so impressed with our implementation that they invited us to show it at GDC in the Razer booth and they even filmed Richard giving a little demo. We had a great show at GDC with a lot of visitors and incredibly positive feedback from fellow developers, many of which had not yet seen the game.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=QOVA3jOmDyo

Here are a few more pics from the GDC event:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_GDC1.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_GDC2.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_GDC3.jpg[/img]
Umm, Finn Staber doing VR research at GDC?!?


[h1]SotA at SXSW This Weekend[/h1]


[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/sxsw-interactive-logo.png[/img]
Richard Garriott and Tracy Hickman will be on a SXSW Interactive panel moderated by Starr Long entitled [url=http://schedule.sxsw.com/2015/events/event_IAP43351]Linear versus Nonlinear Narrative in Video Games[/url] at 3:30 PM Saturday, March 14 in the Kodosky room at the [url=http://schedule.sxsw.com/?lsort=venue_all_days&venue=Long+Center]Long Center[/url].

Starr Long will also be giving a talk at SXSW Interactive entitled [url=http://schedule.sxsw.com/2015/events/event_IAP30691]Crowd Sharing: Crowd Funding and Sourcing in Games[/url] at 11 AM Sunday, March 15 in the Kodosky room at the [url=http://schedule.sxsw.com/?lsort=venue_all_days&venue=Long+Center]Long Center[/url].

Most of theSXSW Interactive talks, panels, and events are free to the public, so if you are in Austin this weekend then head downtown and check out the action!

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_THickman_RHoltrop_RGarriott.jpg[/img]
Tracy Hickman at Portalarium Studios, in town for SXSW, shown here with Rick Holtrop and Richard Garriott


[h1]Player Owned Towns Update: Scope, NPC Buildings, Icons, etc.[/h1]


[u][url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/player-owned-towns-update-scope-npc-buildings-icons-etc.23057/][A SotA Public Forum post by Starr Long][/url][/u]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/Starr_avatar-150x150.jpg[/img]

Greetings Avatars,

We continue to iterate on our submission, intake, and fulfillment process for Player Owned Towns (PoTs). We are also doing continual design work for PoTs, including ways to incentivize thriving PoTs filled with occupants and ways to keep traffic moving through PoTs. We are far enough in our thinking that I wanted to provide all of you with an update on a few topics (note that templates is not yet one of those topics).

I also wanted everyone to understand the scope of this feature. At a high level I am trying very hard to control the scope of PoTs for Episode 1 so that is why anything I propose will be more fixed than some of you might like. As much as possible I am trying to use systems we are already building (or have built) versus creating whole new systems or new parameters for existing systems. This will also make it easier to debug and balance. That means a lot of the requested features are not going to make Episode 1 launch including: contracts/automated taxes for owners, owners being able to decorate NPC areas, income to owner from in town purchases, etc.

I am also attempting to make the PoTs function as close to the regular towns as possible which is why you will see things like town size influencing certain parameters[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/06/SotA_Metropolis.jpg[/img]


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=48896]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #116...[/url]

[h1]Community Sponsored Decoration Contest[/h1]

Last month, community member [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/decoration-contest.20723/]Athanil sponsored a Release 14 Decoration Contest[/url] that [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/decoration-contest.20723/#post-311314]28 people participated in[/url]! Community member Lollie coordinated a tour of all the competing homes with the contestants hosting a walk-thru and describing their decorating efforts. The winners were determined by the participants voting on each other's homes. [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/decoration-contest.20723/page-6#post-327184]Themo Lock was the runner up, and the following community members tied for 1st Place[/url]:

[b]Doctor Shroud:[/b] Decorated a Druid Home in a Town Lot in Port Mirren, (Loc: -69.9, 185.0, -565.6)

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_Decoration_Contest_R14_1st_d.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_Decoration_Contest_R14_1st_c.jpg[/img]


[u][b]Malakas & Maganda:[/b][/u] Decorated three Village Lots in Owl's Wash (Loc: -93.1, 27.8, 41.7)

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_Decoration_Contest_R14_1st_a.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_Decoration_Contest_R14_1st_b.jpg[/img]

The screen shots don't do these gorgeous homes justice so if you have the time you should check them out in-game!


[h1]Release 15 Decoration Contest - March 19 Entry Deadline[/h1]

Community Member [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/the-r15-decoration-contest.22384/]Lollie posted the following announcement[/url] in the Release 15 Event Forum:

Every release we'll be doing the Decoration Contest to celebrate all the amazing work people are doing to make this game look so much better :)


This contest will be different to the last one held by Athanil - we have judges this time, and there will be a points system so the judges will be looking at all aspects of your creations. Two of our judges are former winners of the last Decoration Contest.

We will be looking at originality, detail, completeness, and a whole bunch of things you have done to make your lot and/or building unique - so get an idea together and enter in the R15 Decoration Contest!

You can enter a house, a castle, or an empty lot with deco items on it, or even several lots (if they join to each other). It can be your own private residence, or you could be running the town markets, or the local bar, or a boarding house or even a place of ill repute. It's up to you!

Anything goes!

Here's how to enter:
Name - write your ingame name here (both the name of decorator and name on the sign or stone on the lot).
Location - write the coordinates of your lot (type /loc when you're in the game, standing out right by the sign or stone of your lot).
Description - describe your idea, try to explain the function of your property, or the scene you are trying to create.


If you're not sure what house/lot you want to use right now just enter in first and modify your post later once you know what you're doing. And feel free to make a further post later with pictures to show off your property. The most important thing to do right now is register your entry.

Get your entries in by Thursday 19th March, and judging will begin on Friday 20th March.


[h1]Abe's Overworld Work-In-Progress[/h1]

Abe Robertson knocked it out of the park with the Novia Overworld map that was included in Release 15 last week. [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/novia-workflow-new-screenshots.21547/]Abe has an ongoing Dev+ forum thread[/url] where he continues to post some of his additional changes to Novia, as well as beginning to make a pass at re-working the Hidden Vale:

Hidden Vale

[url=//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/vale_before_after1.jpg][img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/vale_before_after1-1024x265.jpg[/img][/url]

[url=//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/before_after21.jpg][img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/before_after21-1024x253.jpg[/img][/url]

Here is BlackBlade Pass lava channel on Novia, night and day:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/blackblade_011-1024x253.jpg[/img]


[h1]Release 16 Grand Tour Quest Reward: Black Lepus Mask[/h1]

Just as in our past several releases, we're including a Grand Tour Quest in R16 designed to guide you through all the new content. Just in time for Easter, you will be rewarded with a Black Lepus Mask when you complete the R16 Grand Tour Quest. This reward can only be unlocked during Release 16 (did someone say rares?), so be sure to log in to R16 starting March 26 and talk to all the Tour Guides!

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/03/SotA_R16_GrandTourReward_BlackLepusMask.jpg[/img]

[b]Time is Running Out to Get Your R15 Grand Tour Quest Reward[/b]

Better hurry if you want to add the Silver Jester Carnival Mask to your collection because the R15 Grand Tour Quest ends on March 26 when we launch Release 16. If you need help getting your R15 Silver Jester Carnival Mask reward, then check out The Mad Hermit's video guide to completing the R15 Grand Tour Quest:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=iB4cAJNXFgY


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=48768]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #115...[/url]

[h1]Release 15[/h1]Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Pre-Alpha Release 15! Notes on what is in this release are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/release-15-instructions.22135/]here[/url].

[b]March 3, 2015[/b]

[b]Build Number 231[/b]

[b]Notes:[/b]
[list]	[*]Fix losing open PVP flag if you die.[/*]	[*]Fix for picking up decorations through other objects.[/*]	[*]Fix for Barman in Solania being stuck.[/*]	[*]Fix for attack audio being clipped.[/*]	[*]Fix culling problems in Ardoris.[/*]	[*]Fix for Lich being pink.[/*]		[/list][b]Known Issues:[/b][list]	
[*]The screen may go completely black except for UI in some cases.  If this occurs, you can open the video options and turn off Tone Mapping as a temporary fix.[/*]	[*]Many pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support. These will not be complete until later this year[/*]	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]	[*]Some scenes in the new Novia overworld are missing visible name scrolls, though they can still be entered and explored.[/*]	[*]Bugs in the lighting system during this transition to Unity 5 have degraded performance, especially in large towns like Owl's Head and Ardoris. This will require a sweeping change so unfortunately won't be fixed until Release 16.[/*]	[*]Hair is not responding to light correctly[/*]	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]	[/list]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in this week's Update of the Avatar: Play Release 15 Now and Get Your Silver Jester Carnival Mask, Underworld Funded and Final Week Push, Crowfall Funded, Jabbering Bertha, First Wedding in New Britannia, Rick Holtrop's Spectral Mines, In-game Community Weekend Events, and More!


[h1]Play Release 15 Now![/h1]

Release 15 successfully launched yesterday, February 26, with thousands of backers downloading, patching, logging in, and checking out the new changes! Lots of new content to explore, including:
[list]
	[*]Transitioned to Unity 5, the latest version of the Unity engine[/*]
	[*]Travel the Perennial Coast on the Novia Overworld[/*]
	[*]39 new scenes, including Spectral Mines, Verdantis Shardfall, Solania, and Soletown[/*]
	[*]11 new magic and combat skills (including Stealth)[/*]
	[*]20 new crafting skills[/*]
	[*]Pledge reward and add-on pets that follow you around[/*]
	[*]...and more![/*]
[/list]
Check out the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=48592]Release 15 Instructions update[/url] for detailed information about all the new R15 content


[b][u]The Grand Tour Quest[/u][/b]

.[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_R15_GrandTourReward_SilverJesterCarnivalMask-150x150.jpg[/img]
Just as in our last few releases, we've included a Grand Tour Quest designed to guide you through all the new content. You will be able to get the Silver Jester Carnival Mask by completing the Release 15 Grand Tour Quest. This reward can only be unlocked during Release 15 (did someone say rares?), so be sure to log in soon and talk to all the Tour Guides!


[h1]Underworld Funded - Now Entering Final Week!![/h1]

[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/othersidegames/underworld-ascendant/][img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/UA_Post_KS_banner2.jpg[/img][/url]

Our long-time friend and former Origin protégé, Paul Neurath, is rebooting the legendary [b]Ultima Underworld[/b] games with the [b][url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/othersidegames/underworld-ascendant/]Underworld Ascendant Kickstarter campaign[/url], [/b]which reached its $600k funding goal today! It has been more than a decade long wait, but the stars have aligned and Paul has at long last freed the rights to move forward with the franchise. We're especially excited that, just as the original Ultima and Underworld shared a connection on backstory and fictional elements, so too will [b]Shroud of the Avatar[/b] and [b]Underworld Ascendant[/b].

We're teaming up with Underworld Ascendant (UA) so that backers of both games can get special in-game items. We already announced the Dark Elven “Kinsman” Buckler (see below), and this week we're announcing a new item, Jabbering Bertha!

[b]Jabbering Bertha[/b]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_JabberingBertha1.png[/img]

When UA reached 10,000 backers, the Chattering Bart reward was added to all UA pledges. Chattering Bart, formerly known as Bartholomew, was the favorite court jester of a long-ago nobleman. Bart was famously sharp-witted. Sadly, Bart drowned in a huge vat of mead one evening after feasting. The nobleman had a necromancer animate Bart’s skull so that, in death, Bart could still chatter up a storm. While wielded in UA, Bart will share his wit and pithy statements with the player, usually at the most inopportune times. Some of Bart's dialogue are quips penned by UA backers who submit them to OtherSide Entertainment as part of a contest during their Kickstarter campaign!

Well, it turns out that Bart had a wife. After Bart was turned into a chattering skull, his soon to be deceased wife insisted she would be too, and became Jabbering Bertha. The two can talk up a storm! Sadly, Jabbering Bertha got separated from Bart. Indeed, she was taken through a portal to the lands of Shroud of the Avatar. For any players who get Jabbering Bertha as an Add-On in both games, the two will be reunited, and swap some unique quips. Not only that, but Bertha will put on her lipstick for Bart. Please don’t make any ‘lipstick on a pig’ jokes, Bertha can be sensitive about her looks. Jabbering Bertha is [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=9085&open=jabbering_bertha__digital_]currently available in the SotA Add-On Store[/url], and as an Add-On on the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/othersidegames/underworld-ascendant/]Underworld Ascendant Kickstarter page[/url].

[b]Dark Elven “Kinsman” Buckler[/b]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_UA_DarkElvenKinsmanBuckler_set-300x238.jpg[/img]

This buckler, inscribed with the Dark Elven symbol, has a moonstone gem inset. If a player owns the buckler in both Shroud of the Avatar and Underworld Ascendant, then the moonstone will glow with the warmth of kinship. This signifies that the Dark Elven clans, though sundered between distant worlds, still are one. The Dark Elven Buckler is [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=9085&open=dark_elven_kinsman_buckler__digital_]currently available in the SotA Add-On Store[/url], and as an Add-On on the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/othersidegames/underworld-ascendant/]Underworld Ascendant Kickstarter page[/url].

Otherside Entertainment has surpassed their $600k funding goal, but needs your help during their final week to start hitting their stretch goals! Be sure and [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/othersidegames/underworld-ascendant]check out the Underworld Kickstarter site[/url], and if you are as excited about it as we are, then show your support and make a pledge to [b]Raise the Underworld![/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=uPlAKIqUWAU


[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crowfall/crowfall-throne-war-pc-mmo][img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/224f250d4029f22b9c3b81d51b7d3869_original2.png[/img][/url]

[h1]Crowfall Kickstarter Funded in 3 Days![/h1]

Another of our long-time friends and former Origin protégés, Gordon Walton (Ultima Online, Star Wars Galaxies), has teamed up with J. Todd Coleman (Shadowbane, Wizard 101), to create an awesome sounding game called Crowfall. They describe it as a seamless blend of an MMO with a large-scale Strategy game! Think "...Game of Thrones meets Eve Online". They've enlisted the aid of yet another former Origin protégé, Raph Koster Ultima Online, Star Wars Galaxies), as a design consultant!

There are two types of Worlds in the Crowfall Universe: the Campaign Worlds, which produce materials such as stone, iron, and wood (and last until some "win condition is met" - typically 1 to 3 months), and the Eternal Kingdoms, which are barren of resources -- but last forever.

Another really cool feature is that the worlds are made of voxels (like Minecraft, only much smaller) – which means the entire world is destructible. They are harnessing VoxelFarm technology to generate an endless succession of unique and interesting Campaign Worlds for you to mine, shape, conquer and destroy.

Sounds pretty awesome, right? A lot of gamers think so because they reached their $800k funding goal in just 3 days! [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/crowfall/crowfall-throne-war-pc-mmo]Check out their Kickstarter page[/url] and if you like what you see then help them build Crowfall with your pledge!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=JFHJhULEu8Q


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=48628]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #114...[/url]

[h1]Release 15[/h1]Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Pre-Alpha Release 15! Notes on what is in this release are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/release-15-instructions.22135/]here[/url].

[b]February 27, 2015[/b]

[b]Build Number 229 
6:30 PM CST[/b]

[b]Notes:[/b]
[list]	[*]Fixes for Anti-Aliasing so it does not blur text too much[/*]	[*]Fix for merchant inventories showing up empty and then shutting immediately[/*]	[*]Improved feedback for when a purchase fails with a merchant[/*]	[*]You can now join a party member in a random encounter by double clicking on their marker[/*]	[*]Stealth spells cast while already in combat are not broken by attacks[/*]	[*]Blackblade Pass South Entrance now properly displays name[/*]	[*]Fixed some broken facial hair[/*]	[*]Fix for stealthed characters being too hard to see by the player operating them[/*]	[*]Barriers on Novia Overworld now higher to prevent access to unfinished areas[/*]	[*]Long beards should now sort properly in game[/*]	[*]Fix bug that was preventing some players from logging in[/*]	[*]Solania realtor no longer selling reward deeds, now same as housing NPC in Owl's Head[/*]	[*]Fixed bug where some cotton nodes were incorrectly named flax[/*]	[*]First room in Chillblain's Compendium of Doom (aka Challenge Dungeon) is now filled with wolves instead of stags that run out the room[/*]	[*]Help text for vendor proceeds in bank (to fix confusion on how to get your proceeds)[/*]	[*]Particles now longer render when characters are stealthed[/*]	[*]Fixed the encumbrance issue so that it only prevents interactions (harvesting, crafting, etc.) while not able to move and encumbered[/*]	[/list][b]Known Issues:[/b][list]	[*]The boat that takes you from Vale Overworld to Novia Overworld puts you outside the map boundary. You can work around this by entering either Ardoris or Tower of the Shuttered Eye from the water side and using the exit points of those maps. Alternatively you can use the boat from inside Kingport to Ardoris.[/*]
[*]The screen may go completely black except for UI in some cases.  If this occurs, you can open the video options and turn off Tone Mapping as a temporary fix.[/*]	[*]Many pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support. These will not be complete until later this year[/*]	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]	[*]Some scenes in the new Novia overworld are missing visible name scrolls, though they can still be entered and explored.[/*]	[*]Bugs in the lighting system during this transition to Unity 5 have degraded performance, especially in large towns like Owl's Head and Ardoris. This will require a sweeping change so unfortunately won't be fixed until Release 16.[/*]	[*]Hair is not responding to light correctly[/*]	[*]Skin tone will sometimes not match properly on different parts of the body[/*]	[*]Occlusion in Ardoris is not working properly which will result in places in the city where walls are invisible with nothing visible beyond them[/*][*]If you die and log out while flagged for PvP the flag will be removed when you log back in. You must return to the Oracle to have it restored.[/*][/list]

[b]Build Number 228 
11:30 AM CST[/b]

[b]Notes:[/b][list]	[*]Summoned Pets should respond and move faster[/*]	[*]Summoned creatures will now be more responsive to "Attack" command[/*]	[*]Changed the name of The Veiled Swamp to Tower of the Shuttered Eye[/*]	[*]Fixed exits for Restless Woods[/*]	[*]Fixed bug where players exiting Solace Bridge would end up near Ardoris on Novia Overworld[/*]	[*]Increased number of players allowed in Overworld instances.[/*]	[*]Fixed issues with facial hair colors[/*]	[*]Fix for where players were showing up under the Novia Overworld[/*]	[*]Fixes for resource nodes including difficulty, timers, and XP rewards[/*]	[*]Increased interactive range on boats in the Overworld so that they can be clicked on when zoomed all the way out.[/*]	[*]Fixed eyebrows not changing color with hair color[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where treasure chests were getting stuck open[/*]	[*]Removing query/response from Halmar in Braemar[/*]	[*]Made moon molten core rotate slowly and fixed a visible seam in the texture[/*]	[*]Added Brindle Greyhound and Grey Great Dane to game[/*]	[*]Minor fix to Overworld tutorial hint[/*]	[*]Fixed the halo bug on the Lighthouse light[/*]	[*]Minor fixes to convo data files on live as reported by players[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where players could apparently pull items out of each other's hands[/*]	[*]Fixed Female Guards so they will hold their maces correctly now[/*]	[*]Fixed infinite resource harvesting issue[/*]	[*]Stealth fix for effect not going away after being cast in combat[/*]	[*]Fix not being able to enter a basement without the deed in your inventory[/*]	[*]Performance improvements for lists with extremely large quantities of items (i.e. banks)[/*]	[*]Visual Effects for Moon Magic Spells: Night Step, Celestial Blessing, Vanish, and Night Vision (including Night Vision full screen effect)[/*]	[*]Fixed pathing and rotation issues for pets[/*]	[*]Added two more Add On Store basements to players reward packages[/*]	[*]The Moon in Owls Head had gone missing - the moon has returned[/*]	[*]Tricorn Carnival Hat now has mask attached properly[/*]	[*]Fixed issue where un-equipping an item would make the associated body part on the Avatar invisible[/*]	[*]Removed apostrophe from Pilgrim Hat[/*] [*]Ravensmoor Dungeon can now be entered again[/*] [/list][b]Known Issues:[/b][list]	[*]The screen may go completely black except for UI in some cases.  If this occurs, you can open the video options and turn off Tone Mapping as a temporary fix.[/*]	[*]Many pledge, add on, and stretch goal items have not yet been built and/or do not yet have tech support. These will not be complete until later this year[/*]	[*]The update to Unity 5 caused a host of general texture and lighting related issues, and not all of these have been resolved.[/*]	[*]Distant tree billboards may have a white outline that is especially noticeable at night, and some trees may shimmer with white at night.[/*]	[*]Some scenes in the new Novia overworld are missing visible name scrolls, though they can still be entered and explored.[/*]
[*]Bugs in the lighting system during this transition to Unity 5 have degraded performance, especially in large towns like Owl's Head and Ardoris. This will require a sweeping change so unfortunately won't be fixed until Release 16.[/list]

notes.title: Release 15 Instructions - Unity 5 is Alive!
notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_Novia_Overworld_R15.jpg[/img]


Greetings Avatars,

Thank you to our loyal backers of Shroud of the Avatar. Release 15 access for all backers at First Responder level and above begins this Thursday, February 26 at 10:30 AM Central Time (16:30 UTC).

[b]Please read this entire message, as well as the linked [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z-svq1OvcZwViqGxFCKdjH3NCn2LTfLuGny5qaAqjTM/pub]instructions[/url] and [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EQczZJxj38npLbysCEjSa_xiWwx7jQ9zFgvX9yPg2xY/pub]known issues[/url]. [/b]

We are very excited that Release 15 represents our first release using Unity 5, the latest version of the Unity engine. Unity 5 provides us with both improved performance opportunities and graphical upgrades that will allow us to iteratively and dramatically improve the visual presentation of Shroud of the Avatar. As we have said before, our goal is to make sure Shroud is as visually compelling as we have time to make it. Moving to Unity 5 requires us to redo and retouch just about every graphical asset in the game; including textures, camera rigs, and lighting setups. notes.title: Update of the Avatar #113 – 2015.02.20
notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_Novia_Overworld_R15.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in this week's Update of the Avatar: Underworld Gets Tracy Hickman and Steam Greenlight, SotA Single Player Features, Abe on Overworld, Chris Talks Economy, Massively Overpowered Kickstarter, In-game Community Weekend Events, Last Chance Exclusives, and More!

[h1]Underworld Gets Tracy Hickman and Steam Greenlight[/h1]


[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/underworld_ascendant-300x95.jpg[/img]

As previously reported, our long-time friend and former Origin protégé, Paul Neurath, is rebooting the legendary [b]Ultima Underworld[/b] games with the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/othersidegames/underworld-ascendant/][b][u]Underworld Ascendant Kickstarter campaign[/u][/b][/url]! It has been more than a decade long wait, but the stars have aligned and Paul has at long last freed the rights to move forward with the franchise. We're especially excited that, just as the original Ultima and Underworld shared a connection on backstory and fictional elements, so too will [b]Shroud of the Avatar[/b] and [b]Underworld Ascendant[/b].

We're excited to announce that SotA Lead Story Designer and co-author of SotA's Blade of the Avatar novel, Tracy Hickman, has signed up to pen an Underworld Ascendant novel as part of their $750k Stretch Goal:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2013/06/tracy-hickman-150x150.png[/img]

[quote]Tracy’s talents as a fantasy author, together with his deep experience with gaming and close collaboration on Shroud of the Avatar, a world connected to ours, make him ideally suited to write the Underworld Ascendant novel. The novel is going to be set several generations before the game takes place, and tell the story of how a band of Dark Elves from the land of the Shroud of the Avatar passed through a magic portal to make an exodus into the Stygian Abyss. It will tell of their trials in this harsh and dangerous underworld, and of how they carved out a place for themselves.  - [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/othersidegames/underworld-ascendant/posts/1140691]Underworld Ascendant Update #15[/url][/quote]

 

It was also pretty cool to see that [url=http://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=391292833]Underworld Ascendant was Greenlit on Steam[/url] this week:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/Steam_Greenlight.jpg[/img]

[quote]As some of you already know, Underworld Ascendant has been Greenlit on Steam! Only took a week. Not sure if that’s a record, but mighty fast. Huge thanks to all the fans who gave the game a big YES and helped bring us to the attention of the tens of millions of players on Steam. We are still in early prototype development, so many months to go before we’d have a build for Steam. But sweet that we’ve got a slot warmed up and waiting, for when we do.  - [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/othersidegames/underworld-ascendant/posts/1141634]Underworld Ascendant Update #16[/url][/quote]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_UA_DarkElvenKinsmanBuckler_set-300x238.jpg[/img]

As previously reported, we're teaming up with Underworld Ascendant so that backers of both games will get a special in-game Dark Elven “Kinsman” Buckler!

This buckler, inscribed with the Dark Elven symbol, has a moonstone gem inset. If a player owns the buckler in both Shroud of the Avatar and Underworld Ascendant, then the moonstone will glow with the warmth of kinship. This signifies that the Dark Elven clans, though sundered between distant worlds, still are one. The Dark Elven Buckler is [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=9085&open=dark_elven_kinsman_buckler__digital_]currently available in the SotA Add-On Store[/url], and as an Add-On on the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/othersidegames/underworld-ascendant/]Underworld Ascendant Kickstarter page[/url].

Otherside Entertainment is already at $500k of their $600k funding goal, but needs your help to reach their goal and start working toward their stretch goals! Be sure and [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/othersidegames/underworld-ascendant]check out the Underworld Kickstarter site[/url], and if you are as excited about it as we are, then show your support and make a pledge to [b][u]Raise the Underworld![/u][/b]


[h1]Single Player Offline Features[/h1]


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/single-player-offline-unique-features.21739/][A SotA Public Forum post by Starr Long][/url]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/Starr_avatar-150x150.jpg[/img]

Greetings Avatars!

This post is intended to be a quick update on some future plans for how we will handle Single Player Offline and how it will differ from the Online modes of play. None of this is set in stone but it is our current thinking so, as always, feedback is welcome!

As you review this remember that Offline Mode is completely separate from Online Modes. Characters cannot move between these modes.

As we have stated elsewhere, we have to build the sandbox first and then layer the narrative on top of that. It will totally fail if we try to do that in reverse. Please be patient and know we are as committed to the Single Player Offline mode of play as we are to online, we just have not implemented it yet.
[list]
	[*][b]Save Games: [/b]One of the benefits to our distributed server model is that even though we are a client-server game, we offload some of the server work to the local machines of our users. For offline mode, the server (including all data) will be entirely client side so we can relatively easily provide the ability for users to restore their game from backups; aka Save Games. For Episode 1 launch, we are planning to give players the ability to have multiple Save Games![/*]
	[*][b]Companions:[/b] In Online modes, companions will appear to the players from time to time along the story, but they will not travel with the players. We did it this way for the Online modes because we did not want clones of these key NPCs in the same party of players. For offline mode, we don’t have to worry about this though! This is, by far, the most requested feature, and we intend to provide a small set of Ultima like companions that will journey with you. They will still periodically go off to do “their thing” as part of their virtual lives, but for the most part they will indeed be companions. We intend for them to each have robust conversation and AI so that they truly feel like individuals (as they did in the linear Ultimas). In combat, they will have commands similar to the pet commands we have now. For Episode 1, we have a long wishlist of features that are probably outside scope, but...[/*]
	[*][b]Spawn Rules:[/b] Some scenes will never respawn (creatures and resources) in offline mode (clearing a dungeon for example). The scenes that do respawn may do so on a very slow timer, or only if there is a game state change that requires them to respawn (ex. a Town Siege by the Undead). We will balance this to make sure the game feels like it is reacting to the player, but it is also providing enough resources for crafting.[/*]
	[*][b]Content: [/b]There are a few items that we are not going to sell in game in Online mode, including the Castle and Keep sized lots. However, we do plan to make those available in Offline mode along with a handful of other items yet to be finalized.[/*]
[/list]
-Darkstarr


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=48439]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #113...[/url]

This post is intended to be a quick update on some future plans for how we will handle Single Player Offline and how it will differ from the Online modes of play. None of this is set in stone but it is our current thinking so, as always, feedback is welcome!

As you review this remember that Offline Mode is completely separate from Online Modes. Characters cannot move between these modes.

As we have stated elsewhere, we have to build the sandbox first and then layer the narrative on top of that. It will totally fail if we try to do that in reverse. Please be patient and know we are as committed to the Single Player Offline mode of play as we are to online, we just have not implemented it yet.
[list]
	[*][b]Save Games: [/b]One of the benefits to our distributed server model is that even though we are a client-server game, we offload some of the server work to the local machines of our users. For offline mode, the server (including all data) will be entirely client side so we can relatively easily provide the ability for users to restore their game from backups; aka Save Games. For Episode 1 launch, we are planning to give players the ability to have multiple Save Games![/*]
	[*][b]Companions:[/b] In Online modes, companions will appear to the players from time to time along the story, but they will not travel with the players. We did it this way for the Online modes because we did not want clones of these key NPCs in the same party of players. For offline mode, we don’t have to worry about this though! This is, by far, the most requested feature, and we intend to provide a small set of Ultima like companions that will journey with you. They will still periodically go off to do “their thing” as part of their virtual lives, but for the most part they will indeed be companions. We intend for them to each have robust conversation and AI so that they truly feel like individuals (as they did in the linear Ultimas). In combat, they will have commands similar to the pet commands we have now. For Episode 1, we have a long wishlist of features that are probably outside scope, but...[/*]
	[*][b]Spawn Rules:[/b] Some scenes will never respawn (creatures and resources) in offline mode (clearing a dungeon for example). The scenes that do respawn may do so on a very slow timer, or only if there is a game state change that requires them to respawn (ex. a Town Siege by the Undead). We will balance this to make sure the game feels like it is reacting to the player, but it is also providing enough resources for crafting.[/*]
	[*][b]Content: [/b]There are a few items that we are not going to sell in game in Online mode, including the Castle and Keep sized lots. However, we do plan to make those available in Offline mode along with a handful of other items yet to be finalized.[/*]
[/list]
-Darkstarr


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=48439]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #113...[/url]

notes.title: Update of the Avatar #112 – 2015.02.13

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_Necropolis2a.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in this week's Update of the Avatar: New Necropolis Dungeon, Underworld Dark Elven "Kinsman" Buckler, Verdantis Shardfall, SotA Reaches 50,000 Backers, Novia Overworld Work-In-Progress, Massively Overpowered Kickstarter, In-game Community Weekend Events, Last Chance Exclusives, and More!

[h1]Necropolis: The Halls of the Dead[/h1]

Scott "Scottie" Jones has taken off his environmental artist hat and put on his world building hat for Release 15. In just a few short weeks you'll be able to explore his new dungeon: Necropolis!

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_Necropolis3.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_Necropolis4.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_Necropolis5.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_Necropolis7.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_Necropolis10.jpg[/img]


[h1]Underworld Ascendant Dark Elven "Kinsman" Buckler[/h1]

As we described last week, our long-time friend and former Origin protégé, Paul Neurath, is rebooting the legendary Ultima Underworld games. It has been more than a decade long wait, but the stars have aligned and Paul has at long last freed the rights to move forward with the franchise. We're especially excited that, just as the original Ultima and Underworld shared a connection on backstory and fictional elements, so too will Shroud of the Avatar and Underworld Ascendant.

Last week we announced that we're teaming up with Underworld Ascendant so that backers of both games will get a special in-game item. This week, we're excited to announce the special item is a magical Dark Elven “Kinsman” Buckler!

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_UA_DarkElvenKinsmanBuckler_set.jpg[/img]
This buckler, inscribed with the Dark Elven symbol, has a moonstone gem inset. If a player owns the buckler in both Shroud of the Avatar and Underworld Ascendant, then the moonstone will glow with the warmth of kinship. This signifies that the Dark Elven clans, though sundered between distant worlds, still are one. The Dark Elven Buckler is [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=9085&open=dark_elven_kinsman_buckler__digital_]currently available in the SotA Add-On Store[/url], and will soon be available as an Add-On on the Underworld Ascendant Kickstarter page.

Otherside Entertainment is already at 70% of their funding goal for their Underworld Ascendant Kickstarter campaign, but needs your help to reach their goal and start working toward their stretch goals! Be sure and [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/othersidegames/underworld-ascendant]check out the Underworld Kickstarter site[/url], and if you are as excited about it as we are, then show your support and make a pledge to [b]Raise the Underworld![/b]

https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=uPlAKIqUWAU

For more information on [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/othersidegames/underworld-ascendant]Underworld Ascendant[/url], follow them on [url=https://www.facebook.com/OtherSideEntertainment]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/OtherSide_Games]Twitter[/url].


[h1]Verdantis Shardfall[/h1]

Scottie's not the only one wearing a new hat for Release 15, Andy Cortez is also taking a break from creating environmental art assets and has been crafting a new map, the Verdantis Shardfall. This map is located on a marshy island off the west coast of the Verdantis region of Novia.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_VerdantisShardfall1.jpg[/img]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_VerdantisShardfall2.jpg[/img]


[h1]Novia Overworld Work-In-Progress[/h1]

For the last few weeks we've been showing you glimpses of Abe Robertson's work on the Novia Overworld. Abe shifted over to working in Unity 5 this week, so here are some updated images of his Unity 5 Novia Overworld work-in-progress (which we hope to include in Release 15):


[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_Overworld_Novia_Unity5_wip_1.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_Overworld_Novia_Unity5_wip_3.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_Overworld_Novia_Unity5_wip_4.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_Overworld_Novia_Unity5_wip_5.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_Overworld_Novia_Unity5_wip_6.jpg[/img]


[h1]Hangout of the Avatar ~ Release 14 Postmortem (and Free Prize Giveaways!)[/h1]

Yes, we know that Release 14 is still alive and kicking, but it's become a tradition for our team to review each release and celebrate it's successes, while reflecting on what still needs to be improved! If you missed our Hangout of the Avatar on Wednesday, then be sure and check out the video. Richard, Starr, and Chris chatted about Release 14, recounting their favorite moments while also looking ahead to Release 15. And as usual, Gina "FireLotus" Dionne was taking questions and feedback live in the chat-room and also [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=48132]in advance in the OP comments section[/url].

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=5UcS9aWD7S8


[h1]SotA Reaches 50,000 Backers![/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_50kBackers2.jpg[/img]

In celebration of reaching the 50,000 Backer Milestone, I recently [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/sneak-peek-updated-pledge-data.21414/]posted these updated backer stats on our Dev+ forum[/url]:

The last pledge data published was in May 2014 and some of you have been asking for an update. We plan on releasing this new pledge data publicly in this week's Update of the Avatar on Friday, but thought we'd give our Dev+ backers a sneak peek.

This first chart shows the change in pledge counts from May 2014 to Feb 2015. The data does not include Steam Early Access, Guilt Pledges, or unassigned pledges. Big jump in the number of Adventurer pledges and Founder pledges. And since we made it more affordable to own property by adding the new Row House property deeds to the Ancestor tier, it has almost tripled in the number of backers. We were also surprised to see the number of Dukes almost doubled (from 43 to 84) and Lord of the Manors increased by almost 50% (24 to 34)!

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_Pledge_growth_chart2a_2015.02.jpg[/img]

This chart shows the change in pledge revenue per tier from May 2014 to February 2015:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_Pledge_revenue_growth_chart2_2015.02.jpg[/img]

This final chart shows the current pledge data with the pledge counts as vertical bars and the dollar value of each pledge tier as a gold line. The Knight tier continues to lead in terms of pledge revenue, especially if you combine it with the relatively new Knight Marshal tier. Knights also led in our May 2014 data.


Pledges with property (Ancestor+) represent 9% of all backers and 61% of all pledge revenue. Pledges without property represent 91% of all backers and 39% of pledge revenue.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_Pledge_data_chart2_2015.02.jpg[/img]


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=48265]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #112...[/url]

notes.title: Update of the Avatar #111 – 2015.02.06
notes.content:
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/othersidegames/underworld-ascendant][img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/ua_ad-finals-600x500_20150127-1.jpg[/img][/url]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in this week's Update of the Avatar: Help Support Underworld Kickstarter, Bank Slot Rewards, Carnival Mask, Time Top 50, $10 for $10 Bonus, Novia Overworld Work-In-Progress, Massively Overpowered Kickstarter, In-game Community Weekend Events, Last Chance Exclusives, and More!


[h1]Raise the Underworld[/h1]

Otherside Entertainment launched their [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/othersidegames/underworld-ascendant]Underworld Ascendant Kickstarter campaign[/url] this Wednesday, February 4th. They got off to a great start and have almost reached half their funding goal in just a few short days!

As we described last week, our long-time friend and former Origin protégé, Paul Neurath, is rebooting the legendary [b]Ultima Underworld[/b] games. It has been more than a decade long wait, but the stars have aligned and Paul has long last freed the rights to move forward with the franchise. We're especially excited that, just as the original Ultima and Underworld shared a connection on backstory and fictional elements, so too will [b]Shroud of the Avatar[/b] and [b]Underworld Ascendant[/b].

Additionally, we are teaming up with Underworld so that backers of both games can get special in-game items. Here's the description from the Underworld Kickstarter page:

[quote=Underworld Kickstarter][h1]Shroud of the Avatar Special Item[/h1]

To celebrate our history with the realms of Lord British, we’re teaming up to prepare a special
item for backers who also support Shroud of the Avatar. Watch this space to learn more soon.[/quote]


We'll announce in an upcoming update what the special Underworld/SotA co-backer item will be, so stay tuned!

Be sure and [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/othersidegames/underworld-ascendant]check out the Underworld Ascendant Kickstarter site[/url], and if you are as excited about it as we are, then show your support and make a pledge to [b]Raise the Underworld![/b]

For more information on Underworld Ascendant, follow them on [url=https://www.facebook.com/OtherSideEntertainment]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/OtherSide_Games]Twitter[/url].


[h1]New Pledge Rewards: Bank Slots[/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_Bank_Interior2-300x156.jpg[/img]
Release 14 included Bank storage as a major new feature. For that initial release, we gave everyone a fixed bank size that could hold 1000 items. Starting with Release 15, initial bank size will be based on pledge level. The bigger the pledge the more bank slots you will start with. We came to the starting number by looking at the number of items a starting player begins with and then we rounded that up to the nearest integer of 5 and then doubled that number. This means you will start with a little more than double the number of slots you need. For our highest three tiers we increased beyond that by several orders. Current thinking is that players will be able to purchase additional slots with in-game gold (up to a limit) and expansions beyond that will be purchasable through the add on store.

Please note that the exact numbers for bank slots will be iterated on over the next several months, but we believe these numbers are a good first approximation. Over the next week we will add the numbers to each pledge so you can view on our website exactly how much you get with each pledge. Here, for example, are the starting bank numbers for Benefactor-era backers:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_Bank_PledgeRewards.jpg[/img]


[h1]Receiving Pledge Rewards and Add-On Items in Release 14[/h1]

As mentioned in previous updates, backers will start receiving their pledge rewards and Add-On items in-game when they log into Release 14, which launched January 28. For all the previous Releases we would freely populate these reward items throughout the game for anyone to find. But those reward items are no longer be freely available. Instead, you will be able to find your Add-On items and the rewards included in your pledge tier at the new banks. In R14, there will be a banker NPC in every map where there is player housing because when you switch houses or unclaim a lot, all the decorations will go to your bank. In most locations the Town Crier is now also a banker.

Banks are local only. You can see your items in other bank locations (they appear in location tabs), but you can only access the items in the bank you are currently at. Pledge rewards are an exception to this and can be accessed from any location.

(NOTE: there are some Add-On and Pledge reward items that have not been built yet so you may notice some of your items not showing up in your bank. If you delete your character, all equipped and inventory items, including pledge reward items, will be deleted and cannot be recovered until the next wipe).


[h1]Time Top 50 Most Anticipated Games of 2015[/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/Time_logo.jpg[/img]

We were excited to see Shroud of the Avatar included in the [url=http://time.com/3648356/anticipated-video-games-2015/]Time Top 50 Games for 2015 across every major gaming platform![/url]

[quote=Time.com]These are the 50 most Anticipated Video Games of 2015. Check out the biggest games coming to PC, PlayStation 4, Xbox One, Wii U and 3DS this year…[/quote]


[h1]Release 15 Grand Tour Quest Reward: Silver Jester Carnival Mask[/h1]

Just as in our past several releases, we're including a Grand Tour Quest in R15 designed to guide you through all the new content. Just in time for the Carnival season, you will be rewarded with a Silver Jester Carnival Mask when you complete the R15 Grand Tour Quest. This reward can only be unlocked during Release 15 (did someone say rares?), so be sure to log in to R15 starting February 26 and talk to all the Tour Guides!

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_R15_GrandTourReward_SilverJesterCarnivalMask.jpg[/img]


[h1]Time is Running Out to Get Your R14 Grand Tour Quest Reward[/h1]

Better hurry if you want to add the Hennin Hat to your collection because the R14 Grand Tour Quest ends on February 26 when we launch Release 15. If you need help getting your R14 Hennin Hat reward, then check out The Mad Hermit's video guide to completing the R14 Grand Tour Quest:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QXIUdsSxixk


[h1]Special Edition Jester Carnival Mask[/h1]

In celebration of Carnival season, this Special Edition [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?page_id=9085&open=jester_carnival_mask__digital_]Jester Carnival Mask is available in the Add-On Store[/url] until March 31st! Get yours while they're available!

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/SotA_Jester_Carnival_Mask1.jpg[/img]


[h1]Massively Overpowered Kickstarter[/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/02/Massively_Overpowered_Kickstarter.png[/img]

We recently reported the very sad news that Massively was being closed down, and that we were including a tombstone for them in SotA. We're now excited to report that [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nbrianna/massively-overpowered]Massively has started a Kickstarter campaign[/url] to keep their site going![/url]

So, head on over to the [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/nbrianna/massively-overpowered]Massively Overpowered Kickstarter site and if you like what you see then pledge your support![/url]


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=48082]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #111...[/url]
