notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/Underworld_Ascendant_KS_promo2.png[/img]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in this week's Update of the Avatar: Raise the Underworld, Play Release 14 Now and Get Your Grand Tour Hennin Hat, $10 for $10 Bonus Promotion, Standing Stones, Novia Overworld Work-In-Progress, Support Denis Loubet on Patreon, In-game Community Weekend Events, Last Chance Exclusives, and More!


[h1]Raise the Underworld[/h1]

We are pleased to announce that our long-time friend and former Origin protégé, Paul Neurath, is launching a Kickstarter campaign on February 4th to reboot the legendary [b]Ultima Underworld[/b] games.

It has been more than a decade long wait, but the stars have aligned and Paul has long last freed the rights to move forward with the franchise, sans only the “Ultima” brand itself. He is joined by some of his Looking Glass colleagues who worked on the original franchise, as well as on [b]System Shock[/b] and [b]Thief[/b], in the newly formed company, [url=http://www.othersideentertainment.com/]OtherSide Entertainment[/url]. The team has vowed to stay true to the spirit of the original Underworld, while at the same time innovating in all new ways. And they want you to be a part of it.

We're especially excited to reveal that, just as the original Ultima and Underworld shared a connection on backstory and fictional elements, so too will [b]Shroud of the Avatar[/b] and [b]Underworld Ascendant[/b]. There is a portal between the two worlds, which over the ages travelers have crossed, some bringing with them artifacts and arcane lore.

Our partnership, forged in the bonds of creativity, inspires us to continue the legacy. As backers of [b]Shroud of the Avatar[/b], you know how pivotal you are in the development of the game. No longer is there a wall between the fans and the developers. Through the magic of crowdfunding, we can develop the game and check in with fans along the way. We can get a reality check at each step so we’re truly making the game you, the player want. Not only are we sharing storyline elements with [b]Underworld Ascendant[/b], but we share this philosophy of collaborative development. It is a powerful time in game design, where game creators can connect directly to you, the community.

So as you have shown your allegiance to [b]Shroud of the Avatar[/b], bring forth that same spirit and make your pledge to raise the Underworld on February 4th.

For more information on [url=http://www.underworldascendant.com/]Underworld Ascendant[/url], follow them on [url=https://www.facebook.com/OtherSideEntertainment]Facebook[/url] and [url=https://twitter.com/OtherSide_Games]Twitter[/url].


[h1]Play Release 14 Now and Get Your Grand Tour Hennin Hat[/h1]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/10623712_1620136244887837_1894904447910029781_o1.jpg[/img]


Release 14 successfully launched yesterday, January 29, with thousands of backers downloading, patching, logging in, and checking out the new changes! Lots of new content to explore, including:
[list]
	[*]Backers will will receive their pledge rewards and Add-On items in-game[/*]
	[*]10 new skills and 5 updated skills, 11 of the 18 schools are now complete[/*]
	[*]New alchemy crafting recipes, and the ability to put magical enchantments on gear[/*]
	[*]New creatures, including Water Elementals and man-eating Flesh Flayers.[/*]
	[*]New scenes, including Grunvald Shardfall, Brightbone Pass, and Wyrmsands[/*]
	[*]Banks to store your stuff, and where your pledge rewards are initially deposited[/*]
	[*]Encumbrance is enabled where the weight of items will determine what you can carry[/*]
	[*]...and more![/*]
[/list]
Check out the [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=47880]Release 14 Instructions update[/url] for detailed information about all the new R14 content.



[b][u]The Grand Tour Quest[/u][/b]
Just as in our last few releases, we've included a Grand Tour Quest designed to guide you through all the new content. You will be able to get the Hennin Hat by completing the Release 14 Grand Tour Quest. This reward can only be unlocked during Release 14 (did someone say rares?), so be sure to log in soon and talk to all the Tour Guides!

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_R14_GrandTourReward-300x215.jpg[/img]

If you are new to Shroud of the Avatar we highly recommend taking a few minutes to watch the excellent New Player's Video Guide from community member The Mad Hermit:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FcnNEnsnriw


[h1]Standing Stones[/h1]

Standing stones, remnants of ancient civilizations, have been found throughout Novia. Many speculate these are a vestige of magic akin to the Lunar Rifts. Many frequent them regularly in hopes of finding passage to somewhere else! Look for these stones in an upcoming Release.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_StandingStones.jpg[/img]

Andy Cortez modeled the in-game stones from the original concept art created by Stephen Daniele during one of his Pen of the Avatar episodes:

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/SotA_Standing-Stones_04.jpg[/img]


[h1]Novia Overworld Work-In-Progress[/h1]

Last week we showed you a first glimpse of Abe Robertson’s work on the Novia Overworld. Abe’s been busy over the past week and has some updated images of his Novia Overworld work-in-progress (which we hope to include in Release 15):

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_Overworld_Novia_wip_2.jpg[/img]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_Overworld_Novia_wip_4.jpg[/img]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_Overworld_Novia_wip_1.jpg[/img]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_Overworld_Novia_wip_3.jpg[/img]


[h1]Support Denis Loubet on Patreon[/h1]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/denis-loubet-patreon.jpg[/img]

Denis Loubet has been doing art and Graphics for Richard Garriott’s games for just about as long as Richard’s been doing games. Denis did the cover art for almost every Ultima game, as well as most of Origin’s other games. Most recently, Denis did all the chapter illustrations for the Blade of the Avatar novel, such as this one:

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/Chapter03.png[/img]

[url=https://www.patreon.com/denisloubet]Denis launched a Patreon campaign a few months ago[/url] to help fund his artwork:

[quote=Denis Loubet]“If you remember the Ultima series of computer games, I’m the guy that did most of the covers and the manual illustrations, as well as a lot of the in-game art and animation. I’ve been doing game art since the 80s for companies such as Steve Jackson Games, Hero Games, Origin Systems Inc, Kingsisle, Disney, and many more.

But you know what? I’m tired of doing art for companies that I have no stake in. Instead, I want to try doing art directly for my fans, with no middleman. That’s the reason for this Patreon project.”[/quote]

If you love Denis’ artwork, now’s your chance to help him create even more! For as little as $1 per artwork you can get a digital copy of the final art a day ahead of its public release. For more information, [url=https://www.patreon.com/denisloubet]check out his Patreon project and all the cool rewards he offers his patrons.[/url]


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=47929]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #110...[/url]

Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Pre-Alpha Release 14! Notes on what is in this release are available here[www.shroudoftheavatar.com]. 
Please note that there has been a character and property wipe for this release. 

[b]Build Number 205 (Linux, Mac, PC) 2:25 PM CST[/b]

[b]Notes:[/b] [list] [*]Bronze Ingot recipe now actually creates a Bronze Ingot (instead of a Constantan Ingot)[/*] [*]Pine Wood Staff can now be equipped[/*] [*]Fixed gap under window in Duke Founder Keep[/*] [*]Gap on basement trap door fixed[/*] [*]Fixed Textile section of Recipe book which was not displaying past the first page[/*] [*]Fixed journal issue with Braemar guard Halmar who was listed incorrectly as Michael in the journal[/*] [*]Attached the merchant's pants to his legs[/*] [*]Fixed the infamous indestructible Ravenswood Bandits to be more destructible[/*] [*]Iron and Meteoric Hilt recipes will now appear in the Recipe book when learned[/*] [*]Wolves should sound much more like actual canines[/*] [*]Fixed stuck spots in the Dragon Skull objects that were trapping players aka Curse of the Dragon Skull![/*] [*]Corpses no longer move across the ground when opened (was happening in Solace Bridge starting area)[/*] [*]Added tooltips to ladders in Kingsort[/*] [*]Fixed geometry issue with stairs in the Inn building[/*] [*]Moved South Valeway resurrection ankh location to be farther from hostiles[/*] [*]Lord Marshal helm now works in bag inventory mode[/*] [*]Made invisible Iron Halberd less invisible (hopefully)[/*] [*]Fixed issue with coal not being able to be traded between players[/*] [*]Limited number of decimal places when displaying stat values for Strength, Dexterity, and Intelligence[/*] [/list]

	[*]Merchant inventories will sometimes appear empty[/*]
	[*]Kingsport exit to overworld broken[/*]
	[*]Founder and Royal Founder backers of high level pledges may start with more items than the item bank limit[/*]
	[*]Cannot enter basement if deed is not in your inventory[/*]
[/list]
[b]Build Number 204 (Linux, Mac, PC) 10:30 AM CST[/b]

[b]Known Issues:[/b]

notes.title: Release 14 Instructions
notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_Wyrmsands.jpg[/img]

[b]Greetings Avatars,[/b]

Thank you to our loyal backers of Shroud of the Avatar. Release 14 access for all backers at First Responder level and above, as well as those who signed up at CES and PAX South, begins this Thursday, January 29 at 10:30 AM Central Time (16:30 UTC).

[b]Please read this entire message, as well as the linked [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z-svq1OvcZwViqGxFCKdjH3NCn2LTfLuGny5qaAqjTM/pub]instructions[/url] and [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EQczZJxj38npLbysCEjSa_xiWwx7jQ9zFgvX9yPg2xY/pub]known issues[/url].[/b]

[b]This far from launch, we are in a constant state of change and we do not yet have in-game systems to inform players of these changes, or to share ways to help them to explore new content and systems. This means we rely entirely on this message, and the linked [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z-svq1OvcZwViqGxFCKdjH3NCn2LTfLuGny5qaAqjTM/pub]instructions[/url] and [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EQczZJxj38npLbysCEjSa_xiWwx7jQ9zFgvX9yPg2xY/pub]known issues[/url] to convey the current game state. We regularly have to answer questions or filter bug reports because players elect not to read this valuable information. By taking a few moments to read through this information, a great deal of our time and efforts can be redirected to focus on new “unanswered” questions, and addressing critical issues impacting each release. We greatly appreciate you taking the time to review this post, and for all the truly valuable feedback you continue to provide.[/b]

Release 14 is our first release of 2015 and represents several major new features (Banking, Pledge Rewards, Encumbrance, Enchantments) as well as overhauls to existing features (Crafting). It is also a milestone because now more than half of the Adventuring schools (magic and combat) are complete! Of course, with new content comes new bugs and balance issues, so help us out by posting [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?categories/release-14-bug-forum.255/]bugs[/url] and [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?forums/release-14-feedback-forum.257/]feedback[/url] in our official forums.

Also, remember that while we are providing new content with each release, our community is also working overtime to make new events for you to enjoy, so be sure to check out the Community Events Calendar (via in game book or the player run [url=http://avatarscircle.com/community-events/]website[/url] Avatars Circle).

Without further ado, here are the R14 deliverables.


Key:
[list]
	[*]Plain Text: The original plan for the Release deliverables and what was actually delivered.[/*]
	[*][i]Italics: Extra notes and new deliverables[/i][/*]
	[*][strike]Strikethrough: These are items that did not make the release. We intentionally preserve the original text so that our backers can compare plan versus actuals.[/strike][/*]
[/list]


[b][i]RELEASE 14, January 29, 2015[/i][/b]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_BrightbonePass1.jpg[/img]


[list]
	[*][b]Scenes:[/b] Brightbone Pass [strike]and Blackblade Pass Entrances[/strike] will expand the mainland while another Desert scene will expand the Vale. We will also add the Shardfall biome to the game, along with a shardfall scene (this is the biome for our Open PVP scenes).
[list]
	[*][i][b]Brightbone Pass:[/b]This dangerous control point sits high atop the Brightbone Mountains near the Necropolis, city of the undead. Hordes of undead haunt this ancient fortress and block all who would venture through.[/i][/*]
	[*][i][b]Grunvald Shardfall:[/b] The Continent of Novia will have a number of these Shardfall areas, where the Blessings of the Oracle do not hold sway and all who venture in are at risk of conflict (open PVP). With that risk, though, there is rumor of even greater reward, for the Shardfall both generates and exposes more resources than anywhere else in Novia. This particular shardfall is located near the desert town of Desolis and is our first example of a scene built in the shardfall biome.[/i][/*]
	[*][i][b]Wyrmsands:[/b] This desert in the southwest corner of the Vale is also known as the graveyard of dragons. No one knows why these beasts came here to die in such large numbers. Some say those same dragons left behind great treasures upon their death, but few have dared to venture too far in these wastes to find out.[/i][/*]
	[*][i][b]Owl’s Head Polish:[/b] Shop signs have begun to be added, and we have relocated merchants and shops to more logical locations[/i][/*]
	[*][i][b]Blackblade Pass Entrances Delayed:[/b] The entrance maps to the underground Blackblade Pass have been delayed in order to give us more time to work on the Novia overworld map that we are targeting for Release 15.[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][b]Unity 5:[/b] We will begin transitioning the project to the latest version of Unity. For R14, it will most likely be a separate build, purely for testing.
[list]
	[*][i][b]QA Version:[/b] We have made significant progress on our port to Unity 5 and we hope to have a QA version to test the week after R14 goes live.[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][b]Banks:[/b] Players can now start storing things in the bank. This is also where all your pledge rewards will be at the start of the game, so you won’t start so encumbered that you cannot move.
[list]
	[*][i][b]Local Banks:[/b] Banks are local only. You can see your items in other bank locations (they appear in location tabs), but you can only access the items in the bank you are currently at. Pledge rewards are an exception to this and can be accessed from any location until claimed.[/i][/*]
	[*][i][b]Current Bank Locations:[/b] In R14, there will be a banker NPC in every map where there is player housing because when you switch houses or unclaim a lot, all the decorations will go to your bank. In most locations the Town Crier is now also a banker. Long term, there will only be banks in towns and cities like Owl’s Head, Kingsport, Ardoris, etc.[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][b]Encumbrance:[/b] The weight of items will now factor into how much you can carry. Your carrying capacity will be derived from your Strength stat.
[list]
	[*][i][b]Encumbered Debuff:[/b] When you are encumbered you move more slowly and a “debuff” icon will appear on screen to indicate that you are encumbered. Please note that all weights are only a rough first pass and will be tuned continuously.[/i][/*][img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_Encumbered_icon.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][b]Pledges Tied to Game Account:[/b] Your pledge will now be tied to your game account. This means you will start the game with your pledge rewards in your bank storage.
[list]
	[*][i][b]Available vs. Unavailable:[/b] Pledge Rewards, Stretch Goals and Add Ons that have been created and/or have tech to support them will now be available in the bank in the “Rewards” location (available in all banks until claimed). Any items that we have not yet created will not be available.[/i]
[list]
	[*][i][b]Available:[/b] Lot Deeds, House Deeds, Some Basement Deeds, Wearables (cloaks, helmets, armor), Weapons, Prosperity Tools, and Decorations[/i][/*]
	[*][i][b]Not Available:[/b] Pets, Vendors, Servants, Titles, Emotes, Crafting Stations, Physical Goods, Some Basement Deeds, etc[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][i][b]Add On "Convert to Credits" Disabled:[/b] Once you create a character in R14 you will no longer be able to melt down your add on items until the next server wipe.[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=47880/][h1]And Much, Much More! Click here for Executive Producer Starr Long's full post...[/h1][/url]

This particular shardfall is located near the desert town of Desolis and is our first example of a scene built in the shardfall biome.[/i][/*]
	[*][i][b]Wyrmsands:[/b] This desert in the southwest corner of the Vale is also known as the graveyard of dragons. No one knows why these beasts came here to die in such large numbers. Some say those same dragons left behind great treasures upon their death, but few have dared to venture too far in these wastes to find out.[/i][/*]
	[*][i][b]Owl’s Head Polish:[/b] Shop signs have begun to be added, and we have relocated merchants and shops to more logical locations[/i][/*]
	[*][i][b]Blackblade Pass Entrances Delayed:[/b] The entrance maps to the underground Blackblade Pass have been delayed in order to give us more time to work on the Novia overworld map that we are targeting for Release 15.[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][b]Unity 5:[/b] We will begin transitioning the project to the latest version of Unity. For R14, it will most likely be a separate build, purely for testing.
[list]
	[*][i][b]QA Version:[/b] We have made significant progress on our port to Unity 5 and we hope to have a QA version to test the week after R14 goes live.[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][b]Banks:[/b] Players can now start storing things in the bank. This is also where all your pledge rewards will be at the start of the game, so you won’t start so encumbered that you cannot move.
[list]
	[*][i][b]Local Banks:[/b] Banks are local only. You can see your items in other bank locations (they appear in location tabs), but you can only access the items in the bank you are currently at. Pledge rewards are an exception to this and can be accessed from any location until claimed.[/i][/*]
	[*][i][b]Current Bank Locations:[/b] In R14, there will be a banker NPC in every map where there is player housing because when you switch houses or unclaim a lot, all the decorations will go to your bank. In most locations the Town Crier is now also a banker. Long term, there will only be banks in towns and cities like Owl’s Head, Kingsport, Ardoris, etc.[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][b]Encumbrance:[/b] The weight of items will now factor into how much you can carry. Your carrying capacity will be derived from your Strength stat.
[list]
	[*][i][b]Encumbered Debuff:[/b] When you are encumbered you move more slowly and a “debuff” icon will appear on screen to indicate that you are encumbered. Please note that all weights are only a rough first pass and will be tuned continuously.[/i][/*][img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_Encumbered_icon.jpg[/img]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][b]Pledges Tied to Game Account:[/b] Your pledge will now be tied to your game account. This means you will start the game with your pledge rewards in your bank storage.
[list]
	[*][i][b]Available vs. Unavailable:[/b] Pledge Rewards, Stretch Goals and Add Ons that have been created and/or have tech to support them will now be available in the bank in the “Rewards” location (available in all banks until claimed). Any items that we have not yet created will not be available.[/i]
[list]
	[*][i][b]Available:[/b] Lot Deeds, House Deeds, Some Basement Deeds, Wearables (cloaks, helmets, armor), Weapons, Prosperity Tools, and Decorations[/i][/*]
	[*][i][b]Not Available:[/b] Pets, Vendors, Servants, Titles, Emotes, Crafting Stations, Physical Goods, Some Basement Deeds, etc[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][i][b]Add On "Convert to Credits" Disabled:[/b] Once you create a character in R14 you will no longer be able to melt down your add on items until the next server wipe.[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
[/list]


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=47880/][h1]And Much, Much More! Click here for Executive Producer Starr Long's full post...[/h1][/url]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_PAXSouth1.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in this week's Update of the Avatar: SotA at PAX South, Banks, In-Game Backer Rewards, First Glimpse of Novia Overworld, SotA in Game Informer Magazine, MMORPG R14 Preview, In-game Community Weekend Events, Last Chance Exclusives: Axe and Wood & Plaster Homes, and More!

[h1] SotA at PAX South[/h1]

Richard Garriott, Starr Long, and Finn Staber are at PAX South, demonstrating the game and talking to the press. You can find them in the Texas Indie Game Lounge presented by Microsoft (booth 1343) at the Henry B. Gonzalez Convention Center in San Antonio, Texas.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_PAXSouth2.jpg[/img]

Richard and Starr are there today only, but Finn will be demonstrating SotA all weekend, January 23 thru 25. PAX Attendees can sign up for free access to Release 14.

Additionally, Scott “Lum the Mad” Jennings will be on the panel "Confessions of a Troll: Human Nature Online" at 7:30 PM, Saturday, January 24th.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/Microsoft_plus_Texas-Indie-Game-Lounge-Logo_black_2.png[/img]


[h1]Banks in Release 14[/h1]

For the first time, backers will start receiving their pledge rewards in-game when they log into Release 14, which launches next week. For all the previous Releases we would freely populate these reward items throughout the game for anyone to find. But those reward items will no longer be freely available starting with R14. Instead, you will be able to find your Add-On items and the rewards included in your pledge tier at banks located in various towns (there are some Add-On and Pledge reward items that have not been built yet so you may notice some of your items not showing up in your bank).

Here are a few interior shots of the new banks:

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_Bank_Interior1.jpg[/img]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_Bank_Interior2.jpg[/img]


[h1]Changes to Store Credit Conversions[/h1]

If you wish to convert any of your purchased Add-On items to Store Credit, you will need to do so before logging into Release 14, which launches next week at 10:30 am CST, January 29, 2015.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_ConvertStoreCredit.jpg[/img]

The instant you log into R14 all of your available Pledge reward items and available Add-On items will be flagged as "claimed" and deposited in your in-game bank. Once the Add-On items are "claimed" they cannot be converted to Store Credit until the next wipe (which is currently unpredictable). After you've logged into R14, the "Convert to Credits" button on your account page will be deactivated for all those items available in the game, so if you had any plans to sell back some of your Add-On items, make sure you do it before you log into R14!

We intend to change the claiming process in an upcoming Release so that items are not automatically claimed when logging in, but will require you to actively claim them in your bank before they can be used.

Once R14 launches, if you purchase any new Add-On items, or upgrade your Pledge tier, those new items and upgraded rewards will automatically appear in your in-game bank the next time you log into the game (providing those items are available in the game).


[h1]First Glimpse of Novia Overworld[/h1]

Abe Robertson has has started work on Novia Overworld, which we hope to show in Release 15. Here's a sample of his work-in-progress:

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_Overworld_Novia_WIP.jpg[/img]


[h1]SotA in Game Informer Magazine[/h1]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/site-logo_beta.png[/img]

We were pretty excited about Game Informer magazine including a preview of Shroud of the Avatar in the February issue of their print magazine!

Physical magazines are becoming more rare with each passing year, and it always feels kind of special when you can see your game written about in an actual magazine you can hold in your hands. Especially one as prestigious as Game Informer. With over 8 million monthly subscribers, the popularity of the magazine has grown to become the 3rd largest consumer print publication in the United States and the largest digital publication in the world.

For those of you that may not have a subscription to Game Informer, here are a few excerpts from their preview:

[quote=Game Informer]With a focus on player housing, crafting, exploring the sandbox world, NPC interactions, and combat, Shroud of the Avatar takes a different approach to the now-standard, theme park MMORPG model....

One major difference in Shroud of the Avatar is that the housing system is not instanced and is part of the world itself...landowners in Shroud of the Avatar have their buildings front and center in player-occupied space. Customization options are impressive...The housing system goes even further, allowing guilds and players to become owners of entire towns.

Instead of pigeonholing players into archetypal classes, you’re free to dive into combat and magic schools, combining Chaos magic with ranged combat or Moon magic with heavy armor. Players can also specialize in crafting – a complex web of gathering, refining, and production that should keep even the most enthusiastic crafter bustling and busy.

In stark contrast to many other MMORPGs today, Shroud of the Avatar features a fully offline single-player mode that’s expected to have over 40 hours of content, including ethical dilemmas and player choices that have meaningful impact on the story. Multiplayer is also different than the norm, where players can opt to play solo, with friends, or with the greater community.

The project is still in Early Access alpha mode, but already we’re seeing a solid core gameplay loop become established, featuring freeform exploration and combat...

If you’re looking for a fresh MMO experience with an open-ended sandbox core, keep an eye on Shroud of the Avatar...[/quote]


[h1]MMORPG.COM - Release 14: Strong Start to a New Year[/h1]


Red Thomas was at Portalarium last week getting an early glimpse of Release 14 for his [url=http://www.mmorpg.com/gamelist.cfm/game/935/feature/9330/Shroud-of-the-Avatar-Release-14-Strong-Start-to-a-New-Year.html]MMORPG article[/url]. Here's an excerpt:

[quote=Red Thomas @ MMORPG]The folks at Portalarium are getting ready to roll out their 14th release for Shroud of the Avatar, and of course they timed it just as PAX South was kicking off. I’m sure it was a diabolical plot to force me into cramming this article in before I get sucked into the pending media storm that follows any PAX. That’s why I drove up to Austin this week. I wanted to look Starr Long and Richard Garriott in the eye when I told them just how rapid a turn around this article was going to have to be in order for me to slip it out before all the PAX coverage...[/quote]

[url=http://www.mmorpg.com/gamelist.cfm/game/935/feature/9330/Shroud-of-the-Avatar-Release-14-Strong-Start-to-a-New-Year.html][i][read the rest of Red's Release 14 preview at MMORPG][/i][/url]


[h1]Shack News: CES Interview with Starr Long[/h1]

At CES 2015, Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Executive Producer Starr Long was at the Plantronics booth discussing crowd development and the latest improvements to the Portalarium MMO RPG in this exclusive interview:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zuE9rUudgm4


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=47772]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #109...[/url]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_Geothermal_device.jpg[/img]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in this week's Update of the Avatar: Mad Hermit's Lay of the Land Video, SotA at PAX South, R13 Postmortem Video Hangout, Duke Upgraded Basement, Flesh Flayer, Steam Catchers, In-game Community Weekend Events, Last Chance Exclusives: Pickaxe and Wood & Plaster Homes, and More!

[h1] Geothermal Steam Catchers[/h1]

“Kobolds were the first to harness the powers of wind, water, and volcanism to generate and transmit aetheric energies. However, these mechanisms are now becoming more common in large human settlements. Windmills, waterwheels, and steam catchers are often used to turn aetheric generators to power a wide range of newfangled equipment such as moon towers, aethereal amplifiers, energy fences and even some new types of weapons. Uses for this new aethereal energy seem unbounded, yet finding new sources of mechanical power is always of utmost importance.”    - Lord British

This scene shows several Steam Catchers that capture the heat and steam from volcanic activity and use it to spin fans or funnel the steam directly into a boiler. The fan based steam catchers use the spinning fans to turn generators, while the boiler based catchers use the steam directly to build pressure and then route the steam to appliances like radiators to keep houses warm.


[h1]The Mad Hermit's Lay of the Land Video[/h1]

Need a high-level overview of where the various cities, towns and villages are in Shroud of the Avatar? Jump in the Mad Hermit's hot air balloon as he surveys the land from high-up above! Although most of SotA's Pre-Alpha content is confined to the "Hidden Vale" at this point, boats and Lunar Rifts allow access to some of the cities and points of interest that exist on the Island of Novia (where the core part of the story will eventually take place).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FU1T-WR51Tw


[h1]SotA at PAX South Next Week[/h1]

SotA will be at PAX South next weekend, January 23-25. We will be in the Texas Indie Game Lounge presented by Microsoft (booth 1343) at the Henry B. Gonzalez Convention Center in San Antonio, Texas.

We are demonstrating SotA all weekend, January 23 thru 25. PAX Attendees can sign up for free access to Release 14. There will also be daily prize drawings including: Plantronics headsets, Alienware mouse, t-shirts, and more!

Additionally, Starr Long and Richard Garriott will be on hand to demonstrate the game and do press interviews on Friday January 23rd, and Scott “Lum the Mad” Jennings will be on the panel "Confessions of a Troll: Human Nature Online" at 7:30 PM, Saturday, January 24th.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/Microsoft_plus_Texas-Indie-Game-Lounge-Logo_black_2.png[/img]


[h1]Hangout of the Avatar ~ Release 13 Postmortem[/h1]

We had a great Hangout of the Avatar this week, with Richard, Starr, and Chris chatting about Release 13; recounting their favorite moments while they also looked ahead to Release 14. And as usual, we spent a fair amount of time answering questions from the original post comments as well as live from the chat room. Check it out here if you missed it:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=V90NyEre83A


[h1]Duke Pledge Reward: Upgraded Basement[/h1]

In keeping with the Duke's lot size increase from City Lot to Keep Lot, we've upgraded the Duke's Basement pledge reward from a 3-story City lot size to a 2-story Keep lot size (the equivalent of 4 City lot sized basements)!

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_Duke_Keep_Basement1.jpg[/img]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_Duke_Keep_Basement3.jpg[/img]


[h1]Benefactor Knight & Knight Marshal Stonework Refinements[/h1]

When we introduced the Benefactor Knight and Benefactor Knight Marshal homes we intentionally made the stonework a bit warped to reflect the large structures "settling" in their foundations. However, we received feedback from our Knights and Knight Marshals requesting that we make the homes look a bit more upscale by straightening the warped stonework. Below are some before and after shots illustrating Bob Cooksey's stonework refinements:

BEFORE (Benefactor Knight on left; Benefactor Knight Marshal on right):

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/06/SotA_Knight_Marshal_Keep_exterior3.jpg[/img]

AFTER:

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_BeneKnight_BeneKnightMarshal_refinements1.jpg[/img]


[h1]Flesh Flayer[/h1]

Much in the world has changed since the moons collided and shards of the fragmented moons fell upon the earth. If the immediate destruction, fall of civilization and disruption of magic wasn’t enough… the shard fall locations are rife with strange powers that drive creatures crazy and mutate plants and animals alike to odd and malicious forms.

One such terror found near these polluted areas is the Flesh Flayer! When dormant, they are quite innocuous looking giant plants but once aroused by the smell of flesh, the Flesh Flayer will squirm about seeking that which it desires. Once the desired meal is located, the Flayer will rend the flesh from the bones of any creatures that wander too near. Sadly, it is rumored that even keeping your distance from an aroused Flesh Flayer is difficult because they are able to attack even from afar. My recommendation is to avoid them altogether!

Below is the original concept art for the Flesh Flayer from Stephen Daniele (labelled "Maneater"), as well as the in-game version.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_FleshFlayer_concept.jpg[/img]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_FleshFlayer.jpg[/img]


[h1]Boreas, The Titan of Truth[/h1]

"After the moons collided and civilization fell, three great and powerful leaders rose to become the Titans of Truth, Love, and Courage; the surviving principles of the times before the fall. Great are they, and great are the monuments built to them. While the Titans themselves may no longer exist, we are still inspired by colossal statues in their likeness which are occasionally found throughout New Britannia.”     - Lord British

The below image shows Stephen Daniele's original concept art for Boreas (leftmost image) and the in-game WIP version by Andy Cortez. Look for the Titan of Truth in-game in an upcoming Release.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_Titan_of_Truth_wip_1.jpg[/img]


[h1]The Avatars Chronicles I - Return of the Avatar: Special Developer Edition[/h1]

The New Britannia Theatre Troupe along with AvatarsRadio.com and TheCaverns.net are proud to present a theatrical voice presentation of astronomical proportions. The long awaited sequel to Once Upon A Time Lord; The Avatars Chronicles I - Return of the Avatar: Special Developer Edition. Coming to an Aether Vibration Amplifier near you Saturday January 17th 2015, 11am Central Time.

30 amazing voice actors from our very own community. Four of the communities favorite developers: Richard Garriot, Starr Long, FireLotus and Stephen Daniele. Hundreds of hours of work. All come together to bring the community one of the most epic sized productions to be entered into the history books.

We invite you to join us all, this Saturday, January 17th, in the Church of the Dark Star in PaxLair, Valemark in the Hidden Vale and on Avatars Radio for a fantastic listening party! Be one among your friends to be able to say "we were there when this happened!".


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=47600]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #108...[/url]

Windmills, waterwheels, and steam catchers are often used to turn aetheric generators to power a wide range of newfangled equipment such as moon towers, aethereal amplifiers, energy fences and even some new types of weapons. Uses for this new aethereal energy seem unbounded, yet finding new sources of mechanical power is always of utmost importance.”    - Lord British

This scene shows several Steam Catchers that capture the heat and steam from volcanic activity and use it to spin fans or funnel the steam directly into a boiler. The fan based steam catchers use the spinning fans to turn generators, while the boiler based catchers use the steam directly to build pressure and then route the steam to appliances like radiators to keep houses warm.


[h1]The Mad Hermit's Lay of the Land Video[/h1]

Need a high-level overview of where the various cities, towns and villages are in Shroud of the Avatar? Jump in the Mad Hermit's hot air balloon as he surveys the land from high-up above! Although most of SotA's Pre-Alpha content is confined to the "Hidden Vale" at this point, boats and Lunar Rifts allow access to some of the cities and points of interest that exist on the Island of Novia (where the core part of the story will eventually take place).

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FU1T-WR51Tw


[h1]SotA at PAX South Next Week[/h1]

SotA will be at PAX South next weekend, January 23-25. We will be in the Texas Indie Game Lounge presented by Microsoft (booth 1343) at the Henry B. Gonzalez Convention Center in San Antonio, Texas.

We are demonstrating SotA all weekend, January 23 thru 25. PAX Attendees can sign up for free access to Release 14. There will also be daily prize drawings including: Plantronics headsets, Alienware mouse, t-shirts, and more!

Additionally, Starr Long and Richard Garriott will be on hand to demonstrate the game and do press interviews on Friday January 23rd, and Scott “Lum the Mad” Jennings will be on the panel "Confessions of a Troll: Human Nature Online" at 7:30 PM, Saturday, January 24th.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/Microsoft_plus_Texas-Indie-Game-Lounge-Logo_black_2.png[/img]


[h1]Hangout of the Avatar ~ Release 13 Postmortem[/h1]

We had a great Hangout of the Avatar this week, with Richard, Starr, and Chris chatting about Release 13; recounting their favorite moments while they also looked ahead to Release 14. And as usual, we spent a fair amount of time answering questions from the original post comments as well as live from the chat room. Check it out here if you missed it:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=V90NyEre83A


[h1]Duke Pledge Reward: Upgraded Basement[/h1]

In keeping with the Duke's lot size increase from City Lot to Keep Lot, we've upgraded the Duke's Basement pledge reward from a 3-story City lot size to a 2-story Keep lot size (the equivalent of 4 City lot sized basements)!

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_Duke_Keep_Basement1.jpg[/img]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_Duke_Keep_Basement3.jpg[/img]


[h1]Benefactor Knight & Knight Marshal Stonework Refinements[/h1]

When we introduced the Benefactor Knight and Benefactor Knight Marshal homes we intentionally made the stonework a bit warped to reflect the large structures "settling" in their foundations. However, we received feedback from our Knights and Knight Marshals requesting that we make the homes look a bit more upscale by straightening the warped stonework. Below are some before and after shots illustrating Bob Cooksey's stonework refinements:

BEFORE (Benefactor Knight on left; Benefactor Knight Marshal on right):

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/06/SotA_Knight_Marshal_Keep_exterior3.jpg[/img]

AFTER:

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_BeneKnight_BeneKnightMarshal_refinements1.jpg[/img]


[h1]Flesh Flayer[/h1]

Much in the world has changed since the moons collided and shards of the fragmented moons fell upon the earth. If the immediate destruction, fall of civilization and disruption of magic wasn’t enough… the shard fall locations are rife with strange powers that drive creatures crazy and mutate plants and animals alike to odd and malicious forms.

One such terror found near these polluted areas is the Flesh Flayer! When dormant, they are quite innocuous looking giant plants but once aroused by the smell of flesh, the Flesh Flayer will squirm about seeking that which it desires. Once the desired meal is located, the Flayer will rend the flesh from the bones of any creatures that wander too near. Sadly, it is rumored that even keeping your distance from an aroused Flesh Flayer is difficult because they are able to attack even from afar. My recommendation is to avoid them altogether!

Below is the original concept art for the Flesh Flayer from Stephen Daniele (labelled "Maneater"), as well as the in-game version.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_FleshFlayer_concept.jpg[/img]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_FleshFlayer.jpg[/img]


[h1]Boreas, The Titan of Truth[/h1]

"After the moons collided and civilization fell, three great and powerful leaders rose to become the Titans of Truth, Love, and Courage; the surviving principles of the times before the fall. Great are they, and great are the monuments built to them. While the Titans themselves may no longer exist, we are still inspired by colossal statues in their likeness which are occasionally found throughout New Britannia.”     - Lord British

The below image shows Stephen Daniele's original concept art for Boreas (leftmost image) and the in-game WIP version by Andy Cortez. Look for the Titan of Truth in-game in an upcoming Release.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_Titan_of_Truth_wip_1.jpg[/img]


[h1]The Avatars Chronicles I - Return of the Avatar: Special Developer Edition[/h1]

The New Britannia Theatre Troupe along with AvatarsRadio.com and TheCaverns.net are proud to present a theatrical voice presentation of astronomical proportions. The long awaited sequel to Once Upon A Time Lord; The Avatars Chronicles I - Return of the Avatar: Special Developer Edition. Coming to an Aether Vibration Amplifier near you Saturday January 17th 2015, 11am Central Time.

30 amazing voice actors from our very own community. Four of the communities favorite developers: Richard Garriot, Starr Long, FireLotus and Stephen Daniele. Hundreds of hours of work. All come together to bring the community one of the most epic sized productions to be entered into the history books.

We invite you to join us all, this Saturday, January 17th, in the Church of the Dark Star in PaxLair, Valemark in the Hidden Vale and on Avatars Radio for a fantastic listening party! Be one among your friends to be able to say "we were there when this happened!".


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=47600]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #108...[/url]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/TTH_ReadersChoice_image_logo.png[/img]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in this week's Update of the Avatar: SotA #1 in TTH Readers Choice Awards, SotA at CES, 2014 Year in Review, R14 Grand Tour Reward, Air Elemental, In-game Community Weekend Events, Last Chance Exclusives: The Sickle and Village Ring of Stones, and More!

[h1]SotA #1 Most Anticipated Game of 2015 in Ten Ton Hammer Readers Choice Awards![/h1]

Wow! Our amazing community demonstrated to the world just how passionate and supportive they are by casting their vote for Shroud of the Avatar and making it the #1 Most Anticipated Game of 2015 in Ten Ton Hammer Readers Choice Awards! And this followed closely on the heels of all of you driving SotA to the #1 spot in the Massively Readers Choice Most Anticipated MMO of 2015 and Beyond!

Thank all of you so, so much for your passion and your support!


[h1]MMORPG's Players Choice Awards for Most Anticipated MMO of 2015[/h1]

[url=http://www.mmorpg.com/showFeature.cfm/loadFeature/9273/The-Players-Choice-Awards-Part-One.html][img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/MMORPG_PlayersChoice_AnticipatedMMO_2015_thumb.jpg[/img][/url]

Winning these Readers Choice awards is extremely valuable in helping to spread the word about Shroud of the Avatar and our passionate community to those people who haven't heard of us yet! We really appreciate all of you that responded to our request earlier this week to vote in the MMORPG Players Choice Awards. You quickly drove us to within 4 points of EQ Next at the #1 spot.

But the competition at MMORPG has been fierce and over the past couple days we have slid to the #4 spot, behind EQ Next, Black Desert, and Warhammer. It would be pretty awesome if we could make this a "three-peat" but with such fierce competition we're really going to need all of your help to regain our forward momentum! Some of you reported in the forums that MMORPG asks a lot of questions during their registration process, which is required before you can vote. We agree that they appear to ask for a tad more information than other sites, but we hope that doesn't put you off from voting!

Winning these awards helps grow our community, which helps all of us to make SotA even better, so please help make that happen and click the following link to go cast your vote for Shroud of the Avatar in MMORPG's 2015 Players Choice Awards!

http://www.mmorpg.com/showFeature.cfm/loadFeature/9273/The-Players-Choice-Awards-Part-One.html


[h1]SotA at CES[/h1]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_CES_2.jpg[/img]

Richard Garriott and Starr Long spent most of this week at CES in Las Vegas demoing how awesome the SotA audio sounds with Plantronics headsets! They were able to schedule several interviews with the press, so be on the lookout for those articles coming out soon.

Gamers Nexus got the jump on the other news sites and already published their article entitled "Shroud of the Avatar Trailblazes Future of RPG Community Involvement – Richard Garriott Interview." Check it out if you haven't seen it yet!

http://www.gamersnexus.net/news/1772-shroud-of-the-avatar-community-modding-garriott-interview


[h1]Shroud of the Avatar- A Year of Portalarium: 2014 in Review[/h1]

GolemDragon posted an amazing article on the Ultima Codex site entitled "Shroud of the Avatar- A Year of Portalarium: 2014 in Review". He starts the article by saying:

[i]"As Kenneth likes to do “A Year in Review”posts on Ultima Codex, He and I are both pleased to bring you, Shroud of the Avatar – A Year of Portalarium: 2014 in Review, in which we look at the news related to Richard Garriott, #Portalarium, and #LBSotA that came out in the last year. As you can see we have everything organized monthly. Enjoy!!!"[/i]

He then provides a summary of the key SotA events for each month, with links to the original material. He closed by saying:

[i]"It really has been an amazing year. Alot has changed for Shroud of the Avatar. We have multiple systems that have been created and are in the stage of being expanded, changed, and polished. Other systems still have yet to be developed and so 2015 will be another year of major changes. Many community members have only just started their own community projects or have moved on from past projects to new projects. May you all look back on 2014 as a good year of development for SotA and look forward to all 2015 may bring us."[/i]

We encourage you to check out GolemDragon's 2014 in Review article at Ultima Codex because it truly captures what an amazing year 2014 was for all of us traveling this journey together!

http://ultimacodex.com/2015/01/shroud-of-the-avatar-a-year-of-portalarium-2014-in-review/


[h1]Release 14 Grand Tour Quest Reward: A Hennin[/h1]

Just as in our past few releases, we're including a Grand Tour Quest in R14 designed to guide you through all the new content. By completing the R14 Grand Tour Quest you will be rewarded with a Hennin (popularly known as a "princess hat"). This reward can only be unlocked during Release 14 (did someone say rares?), so be sure to log in to R14 starting January 29 and talk to all the Tour Guides!

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_R14_GrandTour_HenninHat.jpg[/img]


[h1]Air Elemental[/h1]

Elementals are powerful beings that mages can summon to fight for them. In Release 13 players were able to summon a very early version of the Air Elemental. This week we are nearing completion of the Air Elemental; which is the first elemental to show our new visual language to differentiate summoned Elementals from wild Elementals.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_AirElemental1.jpg[/img]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_AirElemental2.jpg[/img]

Summoned Elementals are surrounded by magical bindings that keep them under the thrall of the summoning mage whereas wild elementals are free of these constraints. Here are the Earth and Ice Elementals with and without the bindings:

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_Earth_IceElemental_bonded.jpg[/img]

While we were doing this work we also decided to create another class of creatures similar to Elementals called Golems and we decided to use our former Ice Elemental as the model for them while making the Ice Elemental use the same mesh as the Earth Elemental. You can expect to see all these new elementals and Golems to begin appearing in Release 14 and 15.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_Earth_Ice_Golums.jpg[/img]


[h1]Dragon Pass Progress[/h1]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_DragonPass_v1.png[/img]

Last week we showed Andy Cortez's work-in-progress of the Dragon Pass sculptures based on Stephen Daniele's concept art. Andy made significant progress during the week, and here's an in-game shot of the latest version:

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/SotA_DragonPass_v2.jpg[/img]


[h1]The Avatars Chronicles I - Return of the Avatar: Special Developer Edition[/h1]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/The-New-Britannia-Theater-Troupe1.png[/img]

The New Britannia Theatre Troupe along with AvatarsRadio.com and TheCaverns.net are proud to present the sequel to Once Upon A Time Lord; The Avatars Chronicles I - Return of the Avatar: Special Developer Edition. Coming to an Aether Vibration Amplifier near you Saturday January 17th 2015, 11am Central Time.

[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=47490]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #107...[/url]

notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/Massively_MostAnticipated_MMO_2015_1.jpg[/img]

[h1]HAPPY NEW YEAR! From the Shroud of the Avatar Team![/h1]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in this week's Update of the Avatar: SotA #1 Anticipated MMO of 2015, Brightbone Pass, Shardfall Biome, Wyrmsands, In-game Community Weekend Events, Holiday Specials, Last Chance Exclusives: Skinning Knife of Prosperity, Wood & Plaster Row House and Town Home, and More!

[h1]Shroud of the Avatar #1 Most Anticipated MMO of 2015 and Beyond![/h1]

There's no better way to bring in the New Year than to be voted the #1 Most Anticipated MMO of 2015 and Beyond!

On December 18th, Massively opened a Reader's Poll for the Most Anticipated MMO of 2015 and Beyond. During the early hours of the poll, EQ Next/Landmark commanded a sizable lead for #1, which also reflected the Massively Staff Pick. Shroud of the Avatar was a distant #2, with Star Citizen only 2 votes behind at #3. However, within the next few hours, Camelot Unchained raced past everyone to claim the #1 spot, leaving SotA choking on its dust in the #3 spot!

But the SotA supporters rallied to the fray, and by early evening Shroud of the Avatar inched its way past Camelot Unchained to claim the #1 spot. And in the almost 2 weeks since the Reader's Poll opened, SotA supporters have driven SotA into a commanding lead on [url=http://massively.joystiq.com/2014/12/18/massivelys-best-of-2014-awards-most-anticipated-for-2015-and-b]Massively's Most Anticipated MMO of 2015 and Beyond[/url]! Here are the Top 5 standings as of the time of this writing:
[list] [*]Shroud of the Avatar (25.4%)[/*] [*]Camelot Unchained (18.9%)[/*] [*]EQ Next/Landmark (15.1%)[/*] [*]Skyforge (11.3%)[/*] [*]Star Citizen (9.0%)[/*] [/list]


[h1]Ten Ton Hammer Reader’s Choice – Most Anticipated Game of 2015[/h1]

[url=http://www.tentonhammer.com/game-rank/most-anticipated-games-2015][img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/TTH_ReadersChoice_image_logo.png[/img][/url]

We couldn't have won the Massively Reader's Poll without the tremendous support from all of you! And now we've just learned of another Reader's Choice poll for Most Anticipated Game of 2015 being held by Ten Ton Hammer. This poll appears to be more "official" than the Massively poll, and should have a follow up article on TTH once the results are finalized on January 7th.

So, what do you think? Can we keep the mojo going? Can we win two Most Anticipated Reader's Choice polls for 2015! I bet we can, but we're going to need all your help (again) to do it, so [url=http://www.tentonhammer.com/game-rank/most-anticipated-games-2015]please follow this link to go cast your vote for Shroud of the Avatar![/url]


[h1]SotA at CES Next Week[/h1]


[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/06/SotA_E3_pic2.jpg[/img]

We are excited that Shroud of the Avatar will be a featured game at the Plantronics booth at [url=http://www.cesweb.org/]CES[/url] next week. We want the audio landscape of SotA to be as immersive as the visual landscape and Plantronics is a great partner for us to work with on achieving that goal.

If you're a fan of Plantronics Gaming Headsets (like we are), then check out their [url=https://www.facebook.com/PlantronicsGaming]Plantronics Gaming Facebook page[/url], and if you like what you see then give them a "Like"!


[h1]Brightbone Pass[/h1]

This dangerous control point sits high atop the Brightbone Mountains near the Necropolis, city of the undead. Hordes of skeletons and ghosts haunt this ancient fortress and block all who would venture through. Some say a group of ancient Lich’s also call this their home.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_BrightbonePass1.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_BrightbonePass2.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_BrightbonePass3.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_BrightbonePass4.jpg[/img]


[h1]Shardfall Biome[/h1]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2015/01/Massively_MostAnticipated_MMO_2015_1.jpg[/img]

[h1]HAPPY NEW YEAR! From the Shroud of the Avatar Team![/h1]

[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in this week's Update of the Avatar: SotA #1 Anticipated MMO of 2015, Brightbone Pass, Shardfall Biome, Wyrmsands, In-game Community Weekend Events, Holiday Specials, Last Chance Exclusives: Skinning Knife of Prosperity, Wood & Plaster Row House and Town Home, and More!

[h1]Shroud of the Avatar #1 Most Anticipated MMO of 2015 and Beyond![/h1]

There's no better way to bring in the New Year than to be voted the #1 Most Anticipated MMO of 2015 and Beyond!

On December 18th, Massively opened a Reader's Poll for the Most Anticipated MMO of 2015 and Beyond. During the early hours of the poll, EQ Next/Landmark commanded a sizable lead for #1, which also reflected the Massively Staff Pick. Shroud of the Avatar was a distant #2, with Star Citizen only 2 votes behind at #3. However, within the next few hours, Camelot Unchained raced past everyone to claim the #1 spot, leaving SotA choking on its dust in the #3 spot!

But the SotA supporters rallied to the fray, and by early evening Shroud of the Avatar inched its way past Camelot Unchained to claim the #1 spot. And in the almost 2 weeks since the Reader's Poll opened, SotA supporters have driven SotA into a commanding lead on [url=http://massively.joystiq.com/2014/12/18/massivelys-best-of-2014-awards-most-anticipated-for-2015-and-b]Massively's Most Anticipated MMO of 2015 and Beyond[/url]! Here are the Top 5 standings as of the time of this writing:
[list] [*]Shroud of the Avatar (25.4%)[/*] [*]Camelot Unchained (18.9%)[/*] [*]EQ Next/Landmark (15.1%)[/*] [*]Skyforge (11.3%)[/*] [*]Star Citizen (9.0%)[/*] [/list]


[h1]Ten Ton Hammer Reader’s Choice – Most Anticipated Game of 2015[/h1]

[url=http://www.tentonhammer.com/game-rank/most-anticipated-games-2015][img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/TTH_ReadersChoice_image_logo.png[/img][/url]

We couldn't have won the Massively Reader's Poll without the tremendous support from all of you! And now we've just learned of another Reader's Choice poll for Most Anticipated Game of 2015 being held by Ten Ton Hammer. This poll appears to be more "official" than the Massively poll, and should have a follow up article on TTH once the results are finalized on January 7th.

So, what do you think? Can we keep the mojo going? Can we win two Most Anticipated Reader's Choice polls for 2015! I bet we can, but we're going to need all your help (again) to do it, so [url=http://www.tentonhammer.com/game-rank/most-anticipated-games-2015]please follow this link to go cast your vote for Shroud of the Avatar![/url]


[h1]SotA at CES Next Week[/h1]


[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/06/SotA_E3_pic2.jpg[/img]

We are excited that Shroud of the Avatar will be a featured game at the Plantronics booth at [url=http://www.cesweb.org/]CES[/url] next week. We want the audio landscape of SotA to be as immersive as the visual landscape and Plantronics is a great partner for us to work with on achieving that goal.

If you're a fan of Plantronics Gaming Headsets (like we are), then check out their [url=https://www.facebook.com/PlantronicsGaming]Plantronics Gaming Facebook page[/url], and if you like what you see then give them a "Like"!

notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2013/12/SotA_HappyHolidays.jpg[/img]

[h1]Happy Holidays from the Shroud of the Avatar Team![/h1]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/SotA_Team_white_background.jpg[/img]


[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in this week's Update of the Avatar: The Space Bards' cover of Iolo's "Stones", Scepter of Dread Artifact, First Quarter 2015 Schedule Update, In-game Community Weekend Events, Holiday Specials, Last Chance Exclusives: Smithing Hammer of Prosperity and Village Pavilion, and More!



[h1]The Space Bards' cover of Iolo's "Stones"[/h1]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/Recap-150x150.jpg[/img]


One of the backer rewards for The Space Bards (aka Recap) [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1616910078/the-space-bards-present-their-first-album-neon-mil]Neon Milk album Kickstarter[/url] was "[i]Set our course by having us cover any song of your choice[/i]". Richard "Lord British" Garriott's requested cover song was "Stones" by David Watson (aka Iolo).

[i]"We Recapped the hell out of this one for you,"[/i] said Space Bards Dom, Dan, and Steven. [i]"Pray Iolo doesn't decide we should awaken with a few bolts in our chest for it."[/i]

Here, for your listening pleasure, is The Space Bards cover of [url=https://soundcloud.com/spacebards/stones-opb-david-watson-aka-iolo]Stones (opb. David Watson A.k.a. Iolo)[/url]

[url=https://soundcloud.com/spacebards/stones-opb-david-watson-aka-iolo][img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/Stones_CoverSong_Recap.jpg[/img][/url]


[h1]Scepter of Dread Artifact[/h1]

Legend says the Scepter of Dread will cause all who gaze upon it to fall to the ground in fear. Others claim that if such an artifact existed, then the Obsidians of old, would have wielded it to consolidate their dominion over Novia. Since none have seen it, it remains the stuff of legend and rumor.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_ScepterDread.jpg[/img]


[h1]First Quarter 2015 Schedule Update[/h1]

As the fourth quarter of 2014 draws to a close it is time to look ahead to what we have planned in the coming year. Here is [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/first-quarter-2015-schedule-update.18635/]Starr Long's public forum post where he outlines the First Quarter 2015 Schedule Update[/url]:

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2013/07/Starr_avatar-150x150.jpg[/img]

Greetings Avatars,

As we stated in previous posts, our goal is to once-per-quarter post an updated schedule for our monthly releases. Even though these goals will likely change somewhat as we react to feedback, we feel it is important to provide you an updated road-map periodically.

Our goal continues to be to deliver our backers content each and every month so that we can get feedback, and use it to iterate improvements. This has already paid off, with additional game features like jumping and swimming, as well as improvements to systems like crafting, conversations, and combat. Meeting that monthly goal is our highest priority, but we require flexibility in our deliverables to meet that goal. As you have seen in previous releases, sometimes we push things out, but we also often pull new things in.

As always, all dates, durations, and deliverables are subject to change as we adjust our designs based on direct feedback from you, our backers.

[b]RELEASE 14, January 29, 2015[/b]
[list]	[*][b]Scenes:[/b] Brightbone Pass and Blackblade Pass Entrances will expand the mainland while another Desert scene will expand the Vale. We will also add the Shardfall biome to the game, along with a shardfall scene (this is the biome for our Open PVP scenes).[/*]	[*][b]Unity 5:[/b] We will begin transitioning the project to the latest version of Unity. For R14, it will most likely be a separate build, purely for testing.[/*]	[*][b]Banks:[/b] Players can now start storing things in the bank. This is also where all your pledge rewards will be at the start of the game, so you won’t start so encumbered that you cannot move.[/*]	[*][b]Encumbrance:[/b] The weight of items will now factor into how much you can carry. Your carrying capacity will be derived from your Strength stat.[/*]	[*][b]Pledges Tied to Game Account:[/b] Your pledge will now be tied to your game account. This means you will start the game with your pledge rewards in your bank storage.[/*]	[*][b]Customization:[/b] A pass will be made to improve hair and facial hair.[/*]	[*][b]Combat:[/b] Various skills will be added to finish out Earth, Water, Ranged, Blades, Bludgeon, Tactics, and Heavy Armor schools.[/*]	[*][b]Housing:[/b] Lot Deeds will be introduced to the game so property claiming will first require purchasing a lot deed in the game (or receiving one via pledge rewards). Also, more basements will be available.[/*]	[*][b]Crafting:[/b] We will also be adding more Cooking and Alchemy recipes and ingredients including the ability to put magical enchantments and stat enhancements (durability, weight, value, etc) on gear.[/*]	[*][b]Shopkeepers:[/b] Prices will now fluctuate based on available stock, and each vendor will have “I will buy” and “I will sell” lists. This means that the fruit vendor might not be interested in buying that sword from you.[/*]	[*][b]Creatures:[/b] Our bestiary will expand to include Man-Eating Plants, Water Elementals, Greyhounds, and various Human Enemies (mages, archers, etc.).[/*][/list]
[b]RELEASE 15, February 26, 2015:[/b]
[list]	[*][b]Maps:[/b] We will continue to expand the mainland scenes to include Resolute, Xenos, Desolace Town, The Necropolis, and the Verdantis Shardfall.[/*]	[*][b]Spells & Skills:[/b] Sun and Moon Magic will expand to include more spells. The combat schools of Shields will also expand, and more combos will be added to the game.[/*]	[*][b]Housing:[/b] Property ownership will now incur regular fees (unless you are using a tax free deed from a pledge). If the fees are not paid, the player will lose their claim, and their possessions (including the house and decorations) will be moved to their bank.[/*]	[*][b]Crafting:[/b] Crafting skills will start to come online, and be used during crafting to modify results.[/*]	[*][b]Creatures:[/b] Our creature list will continue to expand with the Fauns, the Phoenix and Wisps.[/*]	[*][b]Combat:[/b] Stealth mechanics will begin to appear.[/*]	[*][b]Customization:[/b] Clothing and Armor will now be dye-able.[/*]	[*][b]Overworld:[/b] Roving encounters (patrolling creatures) will now appear on the overworld map and can be engaged (pulling you into a scene) or avoided if you wish to sneak past. We will also have the first pass of the Novia map.[/*]	[*][b]Player Titles:[/b] Players will now be able to display their title in the game.[/*]	[*][b]Emote “Teaching”:[/b] Emotes will now be teachable to other players. Some emotes (like the ones tied to pledges) will only be teachable by the original owner. For now, “teaching” will be trading a consumable item that adds the emote via secure trade.[/*][/list]


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=47215]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #105...[/url]

We will also have the first pass of the Novia map.[/*]	[*][b]Player Titles:[/b] Players will now be able to display their title in the game.[/*]	[*][b]Emote “Teaching”:[/b] Emotes will now be teachable to other players. Some emotes (like the ones tied to pledges) will only be teachable by the original owner. For now, “teaching” will be trading a consumable item that adds the emote via secure trade.[/*][/list]

[h1]Play Release 13 Now and Get Your Grand Tour Yule Hat[/h1]

Just as in our last few releases, we've included a Grand Tour Quest designed to guide you through all the new content. notes.title: Release 13 Patch Notes: December 19
notes.content:
[b]Build Number 199 (Linux, Mac, PC): 
4:00 PM CST (22:00 GMT)[/b]
[b]Notes:[/b][list]	[*]Augmented Cloth Hood no longer removes facial hair[/*]	[*]Deathfield nerfed slightly[/*]	[*]Obsidian Cloak now displays the proper symbol[/*]	[*]Fixed a logic error that gave you bonuses and penalties to fizzle chances for standing still or moving BUT only if holding a bow. Now will apply those no matter what weapon is equipped. Also, cut the penalty in half.[/*]	[*]Immolation is now enabled in the game (no really, we aren't kidding)[/*]	[*]Fixed various typos in conversations[/*]	[*]Changed Launcher to default to 64 bit windows build if machine is capable[/*]	[*]Various performance optimizations (should make Owl's Head play much better)[/*]	[*]Updated the get hit sound effect to something marginally better but still placeholder[/*]	[*]Fixed doorways in desert buildings that were blocking fully scaled avatars[/*]	[*]Books should no longer appear in the equipment tab[/*]	[*]Kobold Mages and Archers should now have the correct names[/*]	[*]Fixed floating fence and boulders in Wynton's Folly (new desert scene)[/*]	[*]Fixed issue that was causing multiple items to be selected in inventory, even when trying to select single items[/*]	[*]Known Issues:[list]	[*]Marlene Graff's quest to recover her necklace is broken.[/*][*]Chain Lightning does not chain[/*]	[*]Ignite Weapon does not add a Fire DoT, only increases damage[/*]	[*]No visual effects for Air Elemental[/*]	[*]Some awning decorations cannot be placed[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[b]Build Number 198 (Linux, Mac, PC)
9:30 AM CST (15:30 GMT)[/b]
[b]Notes:[/b][list]	[*]Red Sash Bandits now dropping Red Sashes again[/*]	[*]Fixed text overlap issue in Options UI[/*]	[*]Fixed issues with Blink letting you go through walls of player houses[/*]	[*]Added more footstep sounds[/*]	[*]"Random Encounter!" text replaced with "Prepare to defend yourself!"[/*]	[*]Player placed lights can now be turned off[/*]	[*]Partial fix for the issue that many creatures will run away from you briefly before running towards you when they notice you[/*]	[*]Duke and Baron crows now work properly with hair[/*]	[*]Fixed Grand Tour bug where guides sometimes don't acknowledge you when you typed the "Progress" keyword[/*]	[*]Visual Effects for Caltrops and Explosive Potions are now in the game.[/*]	[*]Chest Mimics are now working again[/*]	[*]Fixed rock in Link of Hyrule's yard[/*]	[*]Random Encounters are now flagged as private so they will no longer be filled with dead animals and mined out resources[/*]	[*]Changed Tour Guide names so they have the place name in their name ("say name one more time *********!")[/*]	[*]Sitting with a torch while AFK no longer burns your nether regions[/*]	[*]Caltrops can no longer be placed in your non-combat bar (which was locking you in place if you tried to use it)[/*]	[*]Spiders in Deep Ravenswood should be more challenging/balanced[/*]	[*]Known Issues:[list][*]Marlene Graff's quest to recover her necklace is broken.[/*]	[*]Chain Lightning does not chain[/*]	[*]Ignite Weapon does not add a Fire DoT, only increases damage[/*]	[*]No visual effects for Air Elemental[/*]	[*]Some awning decorations cannot be placed[/*][/list][/*][/list]

notes.title: Release 13 Instructions
notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_Berserker_Stance.jpg[/img]

Greetings Avatars,

Thank you to our loyal backers of Shroud of the Avatar. Release 13 access for all backers at First Responder level and above, as well as winners of the Alienware Arena R13 contest and winners from our Cyber Monday telethon, begins this Thursday, December 18 at 10:30 AM Central Time (16:30 UTC).

[b]Please read this entire message, as well as the linked [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z-svq1OvcZwViqGxFCKdjH3NCn2LTfLuGny5qaAqjTM/pub]instructions[/url] and [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EQczZJxj38npLbysCEjSa_xiWwx7jQ9zFgvX9yPg2xY/pub]known issues[/url].[/b]

[b]This far from launch, we are in a constant state of change and we do not yet have in-game systems to inform players of these changes, or to share ways to help them to explore new content and systems. This means we rely entirely on this post/email, and the linked instructions and known issues to convey the current game state. We regularly have to answer questions or filter bug reports because players elect not to read this valuable information. By taking a few moments to read through this information, a great deal of our time and efforts can be redirected to focus on new “unanswered” questions, and addressing critical issues impacting each release. We greatly appreciate you taking the time to review this post, and for all the truly valuable feedback you continue to provide.[/b]

When we first released our Q4 2014 schedule over 3 months ago we were quite optimistic about how much we could accomplish in that period of time, while at the same time transitioning to 24/7 uptime with persistence. While we were able to complete as much work as we had planned (and in many cases more) that work ended up being very different than what we first planned. This is what comes out of a very iterative and responsive approach to development. Our velocity is almost exactly what we had hoped but the direction of our efforts varies.

We believe that this approach will result in a much better game than if we simply marched along with a rigid plan that had no room for adaptation. We hope you share that belief and continue to support us on this unique journey.

Release 13 is our first release since launching on Steam Early Access last month and we believe that the changes and additions we have made are making the game both more beautiful and more playable. From the incredible stark beauty of the desert scenes to the rush of flames engulfing your axe, you will find much to enjoy. Of course with new content comes new bugs and balance issues, so help us out by posting [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?categories/release-13-bug-forum.240/]bugs[/url] and [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?forums/release-13-feedback-forum.241/]feedback [/url]in our official forums.

Also remember while we are providing new content with each release, our community is also working overtime to make new events for you to enjoy so be sure to check out the Community Events Calendar (via in game book or the [url=http://avatarscircle.com/community-events/]website[/url]).
[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/avatars-circle-logo-concept-71.png[/img]

[b]Please note that December 20 - 28 and January 1 are official company holidays for Portalarium which means there will be no developer presence nor customer support on those dates.[/b]

Without further ado, here are the R13 deliverables, along with some [i]extra notes and new deliverables in italics.[/i]

[b]RELEASE 13, December 18, 2014[/b]
[list]
	[*][b]Steam Early Access:[/b] This will be our first update after launching on Steam Early Access on Dec 1st.
[list]
	[*][i]We actually opened up to Steam Access during Release 12 on 11/24.[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][b]Maps:[/b] We will continue to expand the mainland scenes to include Brightbone Pass, Resolute, Xenos and the Paladice Shardfall. We will also add the Shardfall biome to the game along with a shardfall scene (this is the biome for our Open PVP scenes).
[list]
	[*][i][b]Some Mainland Maps and Shardfall Biome pushed:[/b] When we originally built the Q4 2014 schedule we had not yet decided to move away from the generic repeated scenes so we had a much larger list of named mainland maps we were going to make. The shift in strategy to all unique maps required us to spend more time creating and polishing adventure scenes which pushed out the named Mainland maps we had hoped to work on, including the new Shardfall biome. We plan to return to a larger number of mainland maps (and shardfall work) in R14.[/i][/*]
	[*][i][b]Desert Biome:[/b] With each release our goal is to add not only new scenes but also new biomes that allow us to build new kinds of scenes. For R13 we were able to add the Desert Biome.[/i][/*][img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_DesertBiome1.jpg[/img]
	[*][i][b]Desert Scenes:[/b] We have one desert adventure scene in the game now that appears in the arid southwest of the Vale: Wynton’s Folly. We also added a Desert Random Encounter scene.[/i][/*]
	[*][i][b]Spawn Polish:[/b] Each map goes through multiple spawning passes. The first pass is merely to add enough creatures of the appropriate difficulty and type to the map. The second pass is where we prop the map according to where we want the creatures to be (ex. webs where spiders are, skeletons near graveyards, etc.). The final pass is to add movement and conflict so that creatures won’t just be standing around in one place on a map and, in some cases, will even fight other creatures on the map. We did second and third passes on the following maps in R13: West Ravenswood, North Ravenswood, South Ravenswood, Valeway North, and Mysterious Swamp.[/i][/*]
	[*][i][b]The Graff Gem Mines Entrance:[/b] The newest Mainland scene is The Graff Gem Mines, which can be found in the farthest Northeast corner of Novia. Lauran Graff himself founded these rich mines long ago, and they have proven to be the most productive mines of the largest and most valuable gems ever known. Recently however, the difficulties with undead in the region have lead to their temporary abandonment. Rumors of Kobolds moving in to claim the mine’s wealth have also recently been heard. The Lunar Rift in Owl’s Head that formerly took you directly to the Graff Gem Mines now takes you to the entrance map instead.[/i][/*]
	[*][i][b]Vertas Pass:[/b] We added two new waves of tougher elves to the Control Point so there will be a better ramp up in challenge when defending.[/i][/*]
	[*][i][b]Road Random Encounters:[/b] Travelling along roads in the Overworld map now also has the chance to trigger a random encounter.[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][b]Spells & Skills:[/b] Air, Earth, and Sun Magic will expand to include more spells. The combat schools of Ranged and Shields will also expand and more combos will be added to the game...

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_R13_GrandTourReward-300x215.jpg[/img]


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=47048/][h1]And Much, Much More! Click here for Executive Producer Starr Long's full post...[/h1][/url]
