notes.title: Update of the Avatar #103 - 2014.12.12
notes.content:
[b][i]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/i][/b] Here's what we have for you in this week's update: The Heart of Sorrow Artifact, Release 13 Grand Tour Quest, Ignite Weapons in R13, SotA Community is Rockin' it, In-game Community Weekend Events, SotA Merchandise Available at Relics by Rild, Holiday Specials, Last Chance Exclusives: Brindle Greyhound, and More!

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_HeartSorrow.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Heart of Sorrow Artifact[/h1]

The Heart of Sorrow is a legendary item rumored to be a powerful artifact of the ancient world. Some say it is a powerful weapon capable of driving foes into deep despair. Others say that it is a cursed item, that serves only to cause the one who possesses it to become lost in sadness.

[h1]The Release 13 Grand Tour Quest[/h1]

Just as in our past few releases, we're including a Grand Tour Quest in R13 designed to guide you through all the new content. Just in time for the holiday season, you will be able to get this Yule Hat by completing the Release 13 Grand Tour Quest. This reward can only be unlocked during Release 13 (did someone say rares?), so be sure to log in to R13 starting next week and talk to all the Tour Guides!

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_R13_GrandTourQuest_YuleHat.jpg[/img]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_R13_GrandTourQuest_YuleHat_2.jpg[/img]


[b][i]Time is Running Out to Get Your R12 Grand Tour Quest Reward[/i][/b]

Better hurry if you want to add the Pilgrim's Hat to your collection because the R12 Grand Tour Quest ends next week when we launch Release 13

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/SotA_R12_GrandTour_PilgrimHat_caption.jpg[/img]

[i](NOTE: We're not sure of the exact date that R12 ends. We're striving to keep R12 open until 10:00 am CST December 18 by opening a test server for R13, but we don't have confirmation of that at the time of this writing. We'll post an announcement once we've locked down times)[/i]


If you need help getting your R12 Pilgrim's Hat reward, then check out The Mad Hermit's video guide to completing the R12 Grand Tour Quest:

https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=I2AggBs6ahU


[h1]Ignite Weapons in R13[/h1]

Wish you had a flaming sword? Now you can ignite any weapon with the new Fire Magic spell in Release 13!

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_FlamingSword2.jpg[/img]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_IgniteWeaponSkill.jpg[/img]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_FlamingWeapons.jpg[/img]


[h1]SotA Community is Rockin' It![/h1]


It's time again to celebrate the quality and diversity of Shroud of the Avatar music being created by the amazing composers within our community. Enjoy!

[b][i]Power of Virtue, by James Stratton-Crawley (aka Holt Ironfell)[/i][/b]: https://soundcloud.com/poetscircle/holt-ironfell-power-of-virtue
Grandmaster Bard Holt Ironfell took on the challenge of crafting the major Truth, Love and Courage themes for Shroud of the Avatar’s main virtue themes. This was especially hard because we wished to find separate themes for Truth, Love and Courage, as well as instrumentation, that could all play separately and play well together at the same time. To add to the challenge, we would eventually want minor versions to represent anti-virtues, and for Love we needed a masculine and feminine version. All in all, a very tall order. The Power of Virtue is a towering example of the successful combination of Truth, Love and Courage! Hear the bells ring true, hear the love of the strings and the brassy horns of courage. Then combined with orchestration and vocals. It is a masterpiece of composition!

[b][i]Truth, by James Stratton-Crawley (aka Holt Ironfell)[/i][/b]: https://soundcloud.com/poetscircle/holt-ironfell-truth
The first of the 3 principle virtue break outs, Truth, by Grandmaster Bard Holt Ironfell, showcases the Principle of Truth, as a pure, and aspirational ideal!

[b][i]Hail Novia!, by Tuomas Pitkänen (aka Aftermath_FIN)[/i][/b]: https://soundcloud.com/tuomaspitkanen/travel-map-hail-novia-submission-version-2-feat-jenna-holdway-on-vocals
Composed and arranged by Tuomas Pitkänen with the marvelous vocals of Jenna Holdway, Hail Novia beckons to explorers of this first continent of New Britannia to come and seek their destinies, in the rich open lands full of adventure and promise. All visitors to our lands will be inspired by works such as this!"

[b][i]Travesty of Justice, by Douglas Yassen (aka Dougyfresh)[/i][/b]: https://soundcloud.com/doug-yassen/travesty-of-justice-shroud-of-the-avatar-final-mix
Many have forsaken the virtues in the lands of Lord British. Players will oft come across a place where a “Travesty of Justice” might be found and need righting. Douglas has composed this masterwork, that will both inform, yet beckon unto adventurers to bear witness and take action!

[b][i]Combat & Control, by Jarrod Kailef (aka Kailef)[/i][/b]: https://soundcloud.com/kailef/combat-and-control-lb-approved-by-kailef-and-holt-sota-major-track-percussive-negotiation
A brilliant collaboration between Kailef and Holt, Combat & Control echoes in the hills and canyons where the good people struggle to resist the forces that would otherwise destroy civilization in New Britannia!

- Lord British

Are you a composer who is interested in helping to shape the sounds of Novia? Then visit our forums (https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/music-submission-process.12808/) to find out how you can get involved!


[h1]Release 12 In-game Weekend Community Events[/h1]


Our amazing community has another great lineup of in-game events planned for Release 12 this weekend. If you missed out on these player events during the previous Releases, we highly recommend you check some of them out this weekend. Here is the latest schedule of player events from the Avatar's Circle Community Events calendar (http://avatarscircle.com/community-events/):

[b][i]Friday, December 12[/i][/b]
10:00pm CST - Dungeon Run - Braemar Cemetery
7:00pm CST - Dungeon Run - Braemar Cemetery

[b][i]Saturday, December 13[/i][/b]
9:00am CST - PaxLair Working Hours - Host Winfield (in Valemark)
11:00am CST - Church of the Dark Star - The Monsters that Dwell Within - Sacrifice (PaxLair, Valemark)
12:00pm CST - Port Phoenix - Governor's Office Hours (Kingsport, Port Phoenix Town Hall)
1:00pm CST - Learn to Gather (Owl's Head Crafting Pavilion; details)
3:00pm CST - Sky Arena PvP Tournament, Winner gets 250,000 Gold! (Island Castle on The Brave Coast; sign up here)

[b][i]Sunday, December 14[/i][/b]
5:30 am CST - Explore Novia with royalsexy (Braemer cemetery)
7:00 pm CST - PaxLair Meeting (in Valemark or "/zone Winfield PaxLair")


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=46911]And much, much more! Click here to read the rest of Update of the Avatar #103...[/url]

Composed and arranged by Tuomas Pitkänen with the marvelous vocals of Jenna Holdway, Hail Novia beckons to explorers of this first continent of New Britannia to come and seek their destinies, in the rich open lands full of adventure and promise. All visitors to our lands will be inspired by works such as this!"

[b][i]Travesty of Justice, by Douglas Yassen (aka Dougyfresh)[/i][/b]: https://soundcloud.com/doug-yassen/travesty-of-justice-shroud-of-the-avatar-final-mix
Many have forsaken the virtues in the lands of Lord British. Players will oft come across a place where a “Travesty of Justice” might be found and need righting. Douglas has composed this masterwork, that will both inform, yet beckon unto adventurers to bear witness and take action!

[b][i]Combat & Control, by Jarrod Kailef (aka Kailef)[/i][/b]: https://soundcloud.com/kailef/combat-and-control-lb-approved-by-kailef-and-holt-sota-major-track-percussive-negotiation
A brilliant collaboration between Kailef and Holt, Combat & Control echoes in the hills and canyons where the good people struggle to resist the forces that would otherwise destroy civilization in New Britannia!

- Lord British

Are you a composer who is interested in helping to shape the sounds of Novia? Then visit our forums (https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/music-submission-process.12808/) to find out how you can get involved!

We launched the Shroud of the Avatar Steam Trading Cards today, which includes these seven unique cards:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_SteamTradingCards1.jpg[/img]

If you are not familiar with Steam Trading Cards, they are collectible (virtual) cards you get by playing games on Steam. Collect a full set of SotA trading cards to earn SotA badges, profile backgrounds, and emoticons that help you customize your profile and show off your Shroud of the Avatar gameplay.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_SteamTradingCards3.jpg[/img]

You can get SotA trading cards simply by playing the game. As you play, you'll occasionally receive trading card drops which will be placed in your Steam Inventory. You can only receive about half of the SotA cards by playing and will need to collect the other half of the set from other community members. Try the beta group discussions, community market, barter with friends, and trade discussions. You can check how many drops you have remaining on your badges page (check out [url=http://steamcommunity.com/tradingcards/faq/]Steam's trading card FAQ[/url] for more information).

Here are images of the SotA trading card badges, emoticons, and sample profile background:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_SteamTradingCards4.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_SteamTradingCards5.jpg[/img]


[h1]Release 13 Grand Tour POI: Desert Scene[/h1]

A desert area is one of the new scenes and biome types we are introducing in R13. It will also be part of the R13 Grand Tour Quest.

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_DesertBiome1.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_DesertBiome2.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_DesertBiome3.jpg[/img]



[h1]Hair and Hats Play Nice in R13[/h1]

We're happy to announce that you will no longer have to give up your hair to wear a hat in Release 13! Yay!

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_HairAndHats.png[/img]


[h1]R13 Player Deco Items[/h1]

There will be many new decorations available in R13, including hedges, stone walls, room dividers, and even a stage with stairs. Can't wait to see the R13 mazes created with these decorations!

[url=//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_PlayerDeco_Hedges.jpg][img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_PlayerDeco_Hedges.jpg[/img][/url]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_PlayerDeco_StoneWall.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_PlayerDeco_RoomDividers.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/12/SotA_PlayerDeco_StageAndStairs.jpg[/img]


[h1]New Mad Hermit Video: How To Find And Identify Magical Reagents[/h1]

Thanks to community member The Mad Hermit for providing yet another great How-To video for Shroud of the Avatar. In this video he shows you how to find and identify magical reagents in Pre-Alpha Release 12. Magical Reagents are needed for casting higher level spells and can be purchased from certain vendors. They can also be obtained by killing certain creatures, field dressing certain animals, harvesting plants and mining rocks.

https://www.youtube.com/watch?feature=player_embedded&v=F7ne-6kS8xw

[url=https://www.youtube.com/user/TheMadHermitGaming]Click here to check out all of The Mad Hermit's amazing how-to videos![/url]



[h1]RECAP: Cyber Monday 12 Hour Streamathon[/h1]

We'd like to thank all the special guests that participated in our Cyber Monday 12 Hour Streamathon on December 1st! The twelve hours flew by with all the fun stories and design discussions that were shared! And thanks to all of you that tuned in to listen and post your questions!

We gave away tons of prizes, including 120 weekend passes to Release 13 (starting December 18), twelve $100 Store Credit coupon winners, and fifteen winners of Plantronics and Alienware peripherals, including one lucky grand prize winner of the Alienware Gaming Desktop computer!

notes.content:

Notes:[/b][list]	[*]Improvements to loading issues that were causing disconnects and were blocking some players from entering city scenes[/*]	[*]Fixed some disconnect issues in Vertas Pass

notes.title: Cyber Monday Telethon
notes.content:
[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/SotA_R11_Player_Screenshot8-1024x542.jpg[/img]
Please join us today Monday, December 1st at 10:00 AM CST (16:00 GMT) for our Cyber Monday 12 Hour Telethon celebrating our Steam Early Access launch and raising over $5 Million from our amazing backers! Richard, Starr, Chris, and the rest of our team, as well as various community members will be live on air throughout the day, hanging out and answering questions. As usual, I’ll be taking your questions and feedback live in the chat-room and also in advance, on the Shroud Website. Here is the link to post your questions and to pick up the Google+ Hangout links as they get posted: https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=46412

[b]Schedule (tentative): [/b]All times and content are subject to change[list]	[*]10:00: Welcome, R12 Post Mortem & R13 Preview[/*]	[*]11:00: Meet the Devs & Office Tour[/*]	[*]12:00: Community Spot: Music[/*]	[*]13:00: Deep Dive: Story & Single Player[/*]	[*]14:00: Deep Dive: Crafting & Economy[/*]	[*]15:00: Community Spot: In Game Events[/*]	[*]16:00: Deep Dive: Player Owned Towns Templates[/*]	[*]17:00: Deep Dive: Combat, PVP, & Death[/*]	[*]18:00: Dev Team Table Top Gaming Session[/*]	[*]19:00: Community Spot: Awarding of Orders of New Britannian Empire and Royal Warrants[/*]	[*]21:00: Community Spot: Hearth of Britannia[/*][/list][b]Hourly Prizes:[/b] If you are registered on our website (no purchase required) you will be eligible to receive one of the many prizes we will be giving away every hour. Please note if you purchased the game through Steam and created an account you are already registered. Prizes will include:  [img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Plantronics_Logo_RigHeadset-300x146.png[/img]
[list]	[*][b]Plantronics[/b] Headsets / Earbuds (1 per hour, 12 total)[/*]	[*]$100 Store Credits (1 per hour, 12 total)[/*]	[*]Release 13 (December 18) Opening Weekend Access Keys (10 per hour, 120 total)[/*]	[*][b]Alienware Desktop Grandprize[/b] for the the final hour[/list][img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/02/alienwareHeader.png[/img]
I'll have the link to the broadcast posted Monday shortly before we're set to go live, and a new link every 4 hours when we change the broadcast feed.. [img]https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/wp-includes/images/smilies/icon_biggrin.gif[/img] 
See you then!
- Lady Firelotus

Steam Early Access Launch, The Mad Hermit's R12 Player Video Guide, New R13 Scenes: Graff Gem Mines, Cyber Monday Telethon, Final Days of Recruitment Bonus, Crowdsourced Music, In-Game Weekend Events, and More!

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/SotA_LiveChess.jpg[/img]

This week's update is a couple days early due to the American Thanksgiving holiday. To all who celebrate it, we wish you a Happy Thanksgiving!

Here's what we have for you in this week's edition of Update of the Avatar: 
[list]	[*]SotA Successfully Launches on Steam Early Access[/*]	[*]The Mad Hermit's Video Guide to Release 12[/*]	[*]New Release 13 Scene: Graff Gem Mines[/*]	[*]SotA Community is Rockin' It![/*]	[*]Cyber Monday 12 Hour Telethon[/*]	[*]In-game Community Weekend Events[/*]	[*]R12 Steam Access Keys Available for All Backers[/*]	[*]6 Days Left to Get Your Black Friday 15% Bonus[/*]	[*]Holiday Specials[/*]	[*]Last Chance Exclusives: The Carpentry Hammer and Rustic Village Home[/*]	[*]Recruitment Bonus and Alienware Pledge Upgrade Promotions End[/*]	[*]Upcoming Events[/*][/list] [h1]SotA Successfully Launches on Steam Early Access[/h1]What an exciting week it's been, starting with the Release 12 Weekend and immediately followed by the successful launch of SotA on Steam Early Access! We've had a great response on Steam, currently rated as "[b][i]Very Positive[/i][/b]" across 52 player reviews!

Thanks to all our veteran community members that have put in extra effort to warmly greet the flood of new Steam players, providing a welcome atmosphere and guidance when needed!

[h1]The Mad Hermit's Video Guide to Release 12[/h1]
Community member The Mad Hermit has crafted another excellent How-To Video, this one walking you through the various game mechanics to get you up to speed as quickly as possible in Shroud of the Avatar Release 12. It covers basic character controls, how to access various menus and interfaces, combat, experience, skill points, training, health and focus, deck building, crafting, harvesting, item repair, shopping, housing, Overworld travel, Lunar Rifts and death.

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=FcnNEnsnriw]Shroud of the Avatar New Players Guide[/url]

[h1]The R12 Grand Tour Quest[/h1]
Just as in our last few releases, we've included a Grand Tour Quest designed to guide you through all the new content. And just in time for Thanksgiving, you will be able to get the Pilgrim's Hat by completing the Release 12 Grand Tour Quest.

[h1]Player Posted R12 Screenshots[/h1]

If you haven't seen the community posted screenshots from Release 12 we encourage you to check them out! There is a  [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/release-12-screenshot-gallery.16760/]Release 12 Screenshot Gallery in the SotA forums[/url], as well as the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/326160/screenshots/?p=1&browsefilter=trendweek]screenshots posted in the SotA Steam Community Hub[/url]. Here are a few sample player posted images:
[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/SotA_LiveChess4.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/SotA_R12_PlayerImage3.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/SotA_R12_PlayerImage1.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/SotA_R12_PlayerImage4.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/SotA_R12_PlayerImage5.jpg[/img]

[h1]New Release 13 Scene: Graff Gem Mines[/h1]
The Graff Gem Mines can be found in the farthest Northeast corner of Novia. Graff himself founded these rich mines long ago, and they have proven to be the most productive mines of the largest and most valuable gems ever known. Recently however, the difficulties with undead in the region have, hopefully, lead to their temporary abandonment. Rumors of Kobolds moving in to claim the mine's wealth have recently been heard. Here are a few new images of the Graff Gem Mine entrances:


[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/SotA_R13_GraffGemMine1.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/SotA_R13_GraffGemMine2.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/SotA_R13_GraffGemMine2.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/SotA_R13_GraffGemMine4.jpg[/img]

[h1]SotA Community is Rockin' It![/h1]

We would again love to celebrate the quality and diversity of music being created by the wonderful composers within our community. I believe we are ending up with one of the strongest soundtracks ever created for a game world. Today we offer you 3 more fine examples from 3 separate composers, and would also love to showcase the intro musical piece crafted for us by the beloved “Space Bards”, who recently produced their first album as “Recap” and played their first public full concert at the HoBLotH II:

[u][b]Trade and Commerce, by Sir Wombat[/b][/u]: [url=https://soundcloud.com/sirwombat/trade-and-commerce-1]https://soundcloud.com/<wbr />sirwombat/trade-and-commerce-1[/url]
Sir Wombat has composed an amazing piece which will be found throughout the land in growing communities as they aspire to grow from small villages to industrious towns.

[u][b]Trekking in the Tall Grass, by Kailef[/b][/u]: [url=https://soundcloud.com/kailef/tiptoe-version-4]https://soundcloud.com/kailef/tiptoe-version-4[/url]
Kailef provided “Trekking in the Tall Grass” to inspire explorers as they traverse the wide open plains of Novia.

[u][b]Valor and Cowardice, by Peter Boiko[/b][/u]: [url=https://soundcloud.com/peter-boiko/valor-cowardice-final-updated-strings-1]https://soundcloud.com/peter-boiko/valor-cowardice-final-updated-strings-1[/url]
Peter Boiko masterfully pulled off one of the more difficult requests, to begin to show the juxtaposition between the virtues and their forsaken opposites with “Valor and Cowardice."

[u][b]Dark Planet, by The Space Bards[/b][/u]: [url=https://soundcloud.com/spacebards/dark-planet]https://soundcloud.<wbr />com/spacebards/dark-planet[/url]
Finally, here is the complete instrumental created by the Space Bards for the opening cinematic for Shroud of the Avatar.

- Lord British

[h1]Cyber Monday 12 Hour Telethon[/h1]
Please join us Monday, December 1st at 10:00 AM CST (16:00 GMT) for our Cyber Monday 12 Hour Telethon celebrating our Steam Early Access launch! Richard, Starr, Chris, and the rest of our team, as well as various community members, hanging out and answering questions. We’ll be taking your questions and feedback live in the chat-room and also in advance,  [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=46412#comments](please post your Telethon comments/questions on the original post)[/url].

[b]Schedule (tentative): [/b]All times and content are subject to change[list]	[*]10:00: Welcome, R12 Post Mortem & R13 Preview[/*]	[*]11:00: Meet the Devs & Office Tour[/*]	[*]12:00: Community Spot: Music[/*]	[*]13:00: Deep Dive: Story & Single Player[/*]	[*]14:00: Deep Dive: Crafting & Economy[/*]	[*]15:00: Community Spot: In Game Events[/*]	[*]16:00: Deep Dive: Player Owned Towns Templates[/*]	[*]17:00: Deep Dive: Combat, PVP, & Death[/*]	[*]18:00: Dev Team Table Top Gaming Session[/*]	[*]19:00: Community Spot: Awarding of Orders of New Britannian Empire and Royal Warrants[/*]	[*]21:00: Community Spot: Hearth of Britannia[/*][/list][b]Hourly Prizes:[/b] If you are registered on our website (no purchase required) you will be eligible to receive one of the many prizes we will be giving away every hour. We'll have the link to the broadcast posted Monday shortly before we're set to go live, and a new link every 4 hours when we change the broadcast feed.


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=46224]And much, much more! Read the rest of Update of the Avatar #101 here...[/url]

notes.title: Release 12 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]Release 12[/h1]Welcome to Shroud of the Avatar: Forsaken Virtues Pre-Alpha Release 12! Notes on what is in this release are available [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=46035]here[/url].
[b]November 22, 2014[/b]
[b]Build Number 188 (Linux, Mac, PC)[/b]
[b]Notes:[/b][list]	[*]Fixed wall and ceiling collision issues in 5 story town basement so camera won't sort through the walls/ceiling[/*]	[*]Fix for creatures sometimes not respawning after zoning.[/*]	[*]Fixed it so that you can't mess up the login process by playing the intro after hitting "enter game"[/*]	[*]Made it always day when you start in Solace Bridge.[/*]	[*]Increased amount that repair kits increase durability from 10 to 50[/*]	[*]Turkeys are no longer mute (really this time). Enjoy their sweet songs as they waft over you. As you continue to listen your mind begins to shift. Perhaps you should be wearing feathers, not armor...[/*]	[*]Fix for chat bubble hiding behind player nameplate after coming back from death[/*]	[*]Islands no longer have 2 music tracks playing at once[/*]	[*]Removed guild name from player/party/target status UI[/*]	[*]Gave looting and skinning more reliable recovery mechanisms in case the player gets stuck.[/*]	[*]Fixed duplicate keybinding issues[/*]	[*]Females now have wide variety of skin tones[/*]	[*]Fixed material lighting issues that would appear after returning from death[/*]	[*]Fixed crash when using Light Armor Sprint skill[/*]	[*]Fixed supple leather recipe[/*][*]Known Issues:[list]	[*]North Ravenswood all trees, grass, and flowers are invisible[/*]	[*]Some NPCs are still missing eyes[/*]	[*]Wireless device can stop working over time[/*]	[*]Timber Wolves are green[/*][/list]

[b]November 21, 2014[/b]
[b]Build Number 187 (Linux, Mac, PC)[/b]
[b]Notes:[/b][list]	[*][u][b][u]URGENT: You must logout and patch up or you will not be able to see local chat.[/u][/b][/u][/*]	[*]Fixed duplicate IDs for NPCSpawners that should stop the out of control creature spawning[/*]	[*]Camera zoom in/out fixed when you go into the Overworld[/*]	[*]"Saddle and Bags with Stand" decoration no longer causes performance issues when moved[/*]	[*]Other players show properly as "wisps" when player is dead[/*]	[*]Switched the vendor in Owl's Nest to FriendlyToAll so he is no longer mimic/wolf chow[/*]	[*]Spawning fixes in North Ravenswood[/*]	[*]Norman (quest NPC) is also FriendlyToAll in Owl's Nest and less likely to be eaten by hungry wolves[/*]	[*]Fixed over scaled table in Kingsport[/*]	[*]Ghosts now OOOoOOooo at location of character's ghost (was at location of corpse)[/*]	[*]Fixed Iron Wire so it no longer uses copper[/*]	[*]Incorrect icons for Riding Clothes corrected[/*]	[*]Reduced random encounter chance from 20% to 5%[/*]	[*]Ladders in the catacombs under the Owls Head sewers can be used in both directions[/*]	[*]Fixed various eye materials again for commoner and servant NPCs so they no longer have empty souless eyes that gaze at you like a shark, waiting to kill you. We really mean it this time. We swear its fixed. No really.[/*]	[*]Fixed popping in some animations[/*]	[*]Fix for West Ravenswood where players were able to get outside rock boundary[/*]	[*]Crafted containers no longer stack which will both make them work and fix the issue that made it so you could no longer craft anything after you made one of these[/*]	[*]Make bucket not stackable[/*]	[*]Fixed random neck vert that was morphing with male nostrils in customization[/*]	[*]Character UI lighting update[/*]	[*]When clicking a keyword, the chat input no longer loses its focus[/*]	[*]Fixed where the player exits to the Overworld from Ravensend and Westhollow[/*]	[*]Kingsport smugglers now correctly lie about their job[/*]	[*]Replacing Empty Lot with Empty Lot no longer creates object errors[/*]	[*]Fixed the blue wolf again. Really. For real this time. We mean it.[/*]	[*]Known Issues:[list]	[*]Female Skin tones are still broken[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[b]Build Number 184 (Linux, Mac, PC)[/b]
[b]Notes:[/b][list]	[*]Fixed issue with new containers (cabinets, baskets, boxes, etc.) being placed in houses not working[/*]	[*]Fixed Turkey Call so it no longer fizzles and no longer puts you in combat. Now go out and summon your turkey army![/*]	[*]Dead bodies now highlight like all other interactive objects[/*]	[*]Fixed some cases causing over spawn of creatures on maps (but not a complete fix)[/*]	[*]Lie Down animation now hides your equipped items properly (sorry those of you who enjoyed self stomach stabbing)[/*]	[*]Fixing some recipe bugs where some recipes were calling for recipes as ingredients[/*]	[*]Did a pass to remove non functioning tools and make sure all crafting tools are in the game[/*]	[*]Fix elderberry bush collision[/*]	[*]Added Deep Ravenswood in game mini-map[/*]	[*]Known Issues:[list]	[*]Female Skin tones are broken[/*]	[*]Various maps have out of control creature spawning (Veiled Swamp, North Ravenswood, etc.)[/*][/list][/*][/list]

[b]November 20, 2014[/b]

notes.title: Update of the Avatar #100 – 2014.11.21: Play R12 and Get Your Pilgrim's Hat Reward, HoBLotH II, Easter Eggs, Cyber Monday Telethon, and More!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings Fellow Avatars![/b]

Here's what we have for you in this week's edition of [url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=46091]Update of the Avatar[/url]:
[list]	[*]Hearth of Britannia: Legends of the Hearth II[/*]	[*]Play Release 12 and Get Your Pilgrim's Hat[/*]	[*]Release 12 In-game Community Events[/*]	[*]Easter Egg: Sword of Power![/*]	[*]Lord British Weighs In on Companions, Solo Play and the Development Process[/*]	[*]Community Spotlight: Scholars of Novia's First Writing Contest Winners[/*]	[*]R12 Steam Access Keys Available for All Backers[/*]	[*]Get Your 15% Bonus[/*]	[*]Cyber Monday All Day Telethon[/*]	[*]Holiday Specials[/*]	[*]Last Chance Exclusives: Cooking Pot of Prosperity and Magic Sigil Cloak[/*]	[*]Monthly Payment Plan Extended Through June 2015[/*]	[*]Alienware Sponsors $20 Pledge Upgrade Coupon[/*]	[*]This Week In The News[/*]	[*]Upcoming Events[/*][/list]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/hobLogo.png[/img]
[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/cast-1024x730.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hearth of Britannia: Legends of the Hearth II[/h1]

On November 16th and 17th 2013, Rustic Dragon's Hearth of Britannia opened its Indianapolis, IN doors to thirty Ultima, Shroud of the Avatar, and Lord British fans across the country for the [b]Hearth of Britannia Lords of the Hearth[/b] (HoBLotH), a 1:1 recreation of the meal served just a month prior at Britannia Manor IV. There was Britannian food, plenty of libations, celebrity guests, themed activities, and a host of garbed attendees.

Last weekend, November 15th and 16th, almost one year exactly from HoBLotH I, Rustic Dragon once again assembled a semi-exclusive group of fans for [url=http://hearthofbritannia.com/hobloth.php][b]HoBLotH II: Legends of the Hearth[/b][/url]. Forty-one adventurers from all over the globe and fifteen cast members turned Richard's lakefront property of Castleton into Cove, the quiet hamlet East of Britain in the original Ultima games.

[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=46091]Read more...[/url]


[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/SotA_R12_PlayerScreenShot1b.jpg[/img]



[h1]Play Release 12 and Get Your Pilgrim's Hat[/h1]

Release 12 successfully launched yesterday, November 20, with thousands of backers downloading, patching, logging in, and checking out the new changes! Lots of new content to check out, including:
[list]	[*]An in-game hint system and New User Experience[/*]	[*]More than 15 new skills[/*]	[*]More than 50 new weapon and armor crafting recipes[/*]	[*]40 new songs (all crowd sourced by players)[/*]	[*]Skill Trainers: when a player levels up they’ll now have to go to trainers to unlock skills[/*]	[*]New Maps: Ravenswood Forest, Tower of the Shuttered Eye[/*]	[*]The Overworld Map now has polished visuals and random encounters[/*]	[*]Guilds[/*]	[*]Open PVP Flags[/*]	[*]The death system now includes being transformed into a ghost when you die[/*]	[*]Alien FX support for Alienware keyboards and cases[/*]	[*]...and more! [/*]	[/list]
[b][i]The Grand Tour Quest[/i][/b]
Just as in our last few releases, we've included a Grand Tour Quest designed to guide you through all the new content. And just in time for Thanksgiving, you will be able to get the Pilgrim's Hat by completing the Release 12 Grand Tour Quest. This reward can only be unlocked during Release 12 (did someone say rares?), so be sure to log in to R12 and talk to all the Tour Guides!

[h1][NOTE: Release 12 Available for purchase on Steam Early access on November 24][/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/SotA_R12_GrandTour_PilgrimHat_caption-300x215.jpg[/img]



[h1]Release 12 In-game Community Events[/h1]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/10/avatars-circle-logo-concept-71.png[/img]
Our amazing community has another great lineup of in-game events planned for Release 12. If you missed out on these player events during the previous Releases, we highly recommend you check some of them out this weekend. Here is the latest schedule of player events from the Avatar's Circle Community Events calendar ([url=http://avatarscircle.com/community-events/]http://avatarscircle.com/community-events/[/url]):

[i][b]Friday, November 21[/b][/i]
2:00pm CST - DJ FireLotus Release 12 Party, at Fire Lotus Tavern (Owl's Head)
6:00pm CST - PvP Tournament (at the Brave Coast, Hidden Vale or "/zone Duke Violation"; for more details use the "/sotawiki Vengeance" command in-game)
6:00pm CST - Dungeon Run - Braemar Cemetery
9:00pm CST - PaxLair Gathering -(in the [url=http://www.paxlair.com/images_pub/valemarkpaxmarkedsm.jpg]upper meadow of Valemark[/url] or /zone Winfield PaxLair)

[i][b]Saturday, [i][b]November 22[/b][/i][/b][/i]
9:00am CST - PaxLair Working Hours - Host Winfield (in Valemark)
12:00pm CST - Welcome Quest in R12 (starts in Northshire, Hidden Vale or "/zone Celtic")
2:00 pm CST - Port Phoenix Storytelling Event (center of Kingsport or "/zone Kazyn Phoenixfyre")
3:00pm CST - Storytelling Event in Port Phoenix (Holtrot)
6:00 pm CST - PvP Tournament (at the Brave Coast or "/zone Duke Violation"; for more details use the "/sotawiki Vengeance" command in-game)

[i][b]Sunday, [i][b]November 23[/b][/i][/b][/i]
11:30am CST - Live Book Reading - Net's Contest Winner (PaxLair Theater, Valemark or "/zone Winfield PaxLair")
1:00pm CST - Church of the Dark Star - Power of Chaos - The Hunger of Coveting (PaxLair, Valemark)
2:00pm CST - Real Human Live Chess Event (meet at Town Crier of PaxLair, Valemark)
3:00pm CST - All Town Gathering (at Kingsport or "/zone Jack Knyfe")
6:00pm CST - PvP Tournament (at the Brave Coast or "/zone Duke Violation"; for more details use the "/sotawiki Vengeance" command in-game)
7:00pm CST - PaxLair Meeting - (in Valemark or /zone Winfield PaxLair)

You will also find the "[i][b]Release 12 Events[/b][/i]" book in your in-game inventory, providing a list of the community events provided by the Avatar's Circle Community Events calendar. Here are some sample in-game images from the Events book:

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/SotA_EventsBook1.jpg[/img]

[img]//d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/SotA_EventsBook2.jpg[/img]

 

[h1]Lord British Weighs In on Companions, Solo Play, and the Development Process[/h1]

There is a lengthy thread on the SotA forums, entitled "Companions", where some have expressed their concerns about how, when, or if companions (among other things) will be implemented in SotA, Episode 1.  A recent post in that thread by Richard "Lord British" Garriott helped to answer some of their questions:

[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/forum/index.php?threads/companions.13038/page-10#post-264157][u][A Public Forum post by Richard "Lord British" Garriott][/u][/url]

[i]Fear not! You are all well aware, that only a year ago, we started letting you all play when we had only a generic avatar standing in a small room, with a chicken. We have come a LONG way since. But there is an order to the development operations that may not be obvious. We add systems and data based on how they interrelate or build on each other. For example, the best way for us to test combat was for we the developers to fight each other, thus you too could fight each other, well before creatures were much fun or balanced, and are only now gaining some real intelligence to fight back. This was not meant to imply more focus on PVP vs PVE, it just helped the development process...[/i]


[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=46091]And much, much more! Read the rest of Update of the Avatar #100 here...[/url]

notes.content:
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/SotA_R12_teaser1.jpg[/img]

Greetings Avatars,

Thank you to our loyal backers of Shroud of the Avatar. Release 12 access for all backers at First Responder level and above begins this Thursday, November 20 at 10:30 AM Central Time (16:30 UTC). Starting today, you can begin installing and patching (see instructions below), but login will not be enabled until Thursday morning.[quote][b][i]Steam Early Access for Release 12 will begin on Monday, November 24 at 10:00 AM Central Time (16:00 UTC).[/i][/b][/quote]

[b]Please read this entire message, as well as the linked [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1Z-svq1OvcZwViqGxFCKdjH3NCn2LTfLuGny5qaAqjTM/pub]instructions[/url] and [url=https://docs.google.com/document/d/1EQczZJxj38npLbysCEjSa_xiWwx7jQ9zFgvX9yPg2xY/pub]known issues[/url]. Also, please note that there has been a data wipe for Release 12.[/b]

[b]This early in development, we are in a constant state of change and we do not yet have in-game systems to inform players of these changes, or share ways to help them to explore new content and systems. This means we rely entirely on this post/email, and the linked instructions and known issues to convey the current game state. We regularly have to answer questions or filter bug reports because players elect not to read this valuable information. By taking a few moments to read through this information, a great deal of our time and efforts can be redirected to focus on new “unanswered” questions, and addressing critical issues impacting each release. We greatly appreciate you taking the time to review this post, and for all the truly valuable feedback you continue to provide.[/b]

We started Release 12 with a very aggressive and large set of deliverables, as well as a goal to launch on Steam Early Access. We quickly realized that these were not necessarily complementary goals. Prepping for the Steam launch ended up taking much more time than we had initially estimated. We also ran headlong into the network effect of ever more intertwined systems. The network effect I speak of is that each time you add a new system or a new feature to an existing system, you increase the number of connections all systems have with each other. That means each new feature that goes in requires more work than the previous feature, and often requires some level of rework on several existing features. This is a natural progression of a project’s development, but for some reason we were optimistic that it would not require us to move at a slower pace.

However, it was indeed the case that for a few of the larger new features (like Encumbrance, Banks, and linking Pledges to Accounts) that we had to go a bit slower to make sure that they had all the proper connections to everything else. This required us to take longer than one release to finish them, and so they did not make it into Release 12. We also spent a significant amount of time on performance and stability which came at a cost. However, there are a lot of other things we did get in, including a prototype of our “First Time User Experience” that shows a lot of promise.

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/SteamEarlyAccess_logo.jpg[/img] We are very excited about the launch on Steam Early Access on November 24th. We believe it will be a very important milestone for us, and it has the potential to increase our amazing community even more. We launched the store and community pages last week, and I want to express how much we appreciate that the community is already showing off Shroud of the Avatar with great screenshots, videos, and discussions.

Without further ado, here are the R12 deliverables, along with some [i]extra notes and new deliverables in italics. [/i]Please note that text that has strikeouts through it is information and/or deliverables that have either changed or been pushed from this release. We purposely keep all the original text (even when it changes) for transparency.

[b]RELEASE 12, November 20 [strike]- 26 2014[/strike] ([strike]and then[/strike] 24/7 [strike]starting Dec 1[/strike]) :[/b]
[list]
	[*][b]Steam Prep:[/b] [strike]Uptime will expand to 7 days and we will conduct a Steam test with all our current backers followed by a launch on Steam Early Access Dec 1st.[/strike]
[list]
	[*][i][b]Steam Early Access:[/b] We made the call last release to allow all backers to play via Steam for the entire release (which we extended to almost 3 weeks). For this release, we will be launching on Steam Early Access on November 24. We plan to mostly leave the servers on full time going forward.[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][b]Maps:[/b] We will continue to expand the mainland scenes to include [strike]The Necropolis (the main underground Undead area in the game), The Graf Gem Mines surface area, and [/strike]the Tower of the Shuttered Eye.[strike] We will also add the Desert biome to the game along with a desert scene.[/strike]
[list]
	[*][i][b]Veiled Swamp & Tower of the Shuttered Eye:[/b] These are the newest locations on the mainland of Novia. The Veiled Swamp is the scene where the Tower resides. From the lore: “The Tower of the Shuttered Eye appeared in the swamps of southeast Novia not long ago. No one saw it being built, because few ventured into the swamps other than those in search of rare reagents from time to time. As soon as it was known to be there, rumors began to arise about its inhabitants and their activities. Some visitors find the tower empty, filled only with cobwebs and rats, yet others, who visit on dark and stormy nights see hooded figures going in and out by torch light, often followed by lightning and thunder emanating from the top of the tower. Today, most avoid these swamps altogether, even those who seek rare reagents usually seek elsewhere!”
[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/SotA_TowerShutteredEye_external1b.jpg[/img]
[/i][/*]
	[*][i][b]Updated Hidden Vale Scenes:[/b] We did a massive pass through almost all the places on the island of Hidden Vale. Changes included increases in playable space, clear visual variations for each map, and spawning polish on the Valeway maps so creatures are not just “standing around”. Scenes modified include: Valeway South, Valeway North, East Ravenswood, South Ravenswood, West Ravenswood, and Kingsroad[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][b]Character Advancement:[/b] The advancement system will expand to include Skill Trainers
[list]
	[*][i][b]Trainers:[/b] Trainers can now be found in Kingsport, Owl’s Head, Ardoris and Braemar. They are now required to unlock skills in your skill trees and you will have to spend skill points and gold. For now, there are only two kinds of trainers: Combat and Magic. In the future, there will be more specialized trainers, including trainers for specific schools, and even trainers for the most powerful and rare skills (ex. Summon Lich). Also, in future releases, trainers may require certain tasks to prove your worth before they will train you.[/i][/*]
[/list]
[/*]
	[*][b]Spells & Skills:[/b] Life [strike]and Death[/strike] Magic will expand to include more spells. [strike]The combat schools of Tactics and [/strike]Polearms will also expand, and more combos will be added to the game.
[/list]

[img]https://d2sx9mrt4zumaq.cloudfront.net/wp-content/uploads/2014/11/SotA_R12_GrandTour_PilgrimHat_caption.jpg[/img]

[/list]
[url=https://www.shroudoftheavatar.com/?p=46035/][h1]And Much, Much More! Click here for Executive Producer Starr Long's full post...[/h1][/url]
